column2: 暴雪王超级进化后的样子。背上的嫩芽已经长成巨大的冰柱。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Aerodactyl. When it Mega Evolves, Mega Aerodactyl becomes even more vicious than it was before. The reason for that supposedly is because of the excess of this Pokemon's power is causing it pain.
column2: 化石翼龙的超级进化。超级进化后，超级化石翼龙会变得比原先更加凶暴。据说这是因为过剩的力量给它带来了痛苦。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Aggron. Using its horns, it is said to be able to destroy a steel tank.
column2: 波士可多拉超级进化后的样子。据说它能用角摧毁一辆钢铁坦克。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Altaria. Mega Altaria's singing voice is even more beautiful than that of its regular form. It is known for its sociable personality and is not timid.
column2: 七夕青鸟的超级进化。超级七夕青鸟的歌声比普通形态更加优美。它性格外向，善于与同伴相处，并不胆怯。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Ampharos. The orb on its tail can shine so bright, that it can be seen from space. People have used the light as a beacon, or to send signals across the ocean.
column2: 电龙超级进化后的样子。尾巴上的宝珠能发出从太空中都看得见的强光。人们会将这道光作为灯塔，或用它向海的另一端发送信号。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Banette. As Mega Banette, this Pokemon gains several additional zippers, revealing parts of Mega Banette's body.
column2: 诅咒娃娃的超级进化。变为超级诅咒娃娃后，身上会多出数条拉链，露出身体的部分内在结构。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Beedrill. Fast-acting poison is stored in the stingers on its limbs, while the tail stinger produces a slow-acting poison that is used to finish opponents.
column2: 大针蜂超级进化后的样子。四肢的毒针中储存着迅速起效的毒液，尾部的毒针则产生缓慢起效的毒液，用来给对手最后一击。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Blaziken. As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks, its legs can begin to burn from the friction of the surrounding atmosphere.
column2: 火焰鸡的超级进化。接连使出猛烈踢击时，双腿会因与周围空气摩擦而开始燃烧。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Camerupt. It has a deep hatred of water or any moisture, and has an explosive personality and a short temper. The volcano on its back erupts constantly in an effort to intimidate its foes.
column2: 喷火驼超级进化后的样子。极度厌恶水和任何湿气，性格火爆，脾气急躁。背上的火山不断喷发，借此威吓敌人。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Charizard. Mega Charizard Y is said to have incredible flying prowess, being able to reach incredible heights.
column2: 喷火龙的超级进化。据说超级喷火龙Y拥有惊人的飞行能力，能够飞到极高的地方。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Diancie. Because of its noble beauty, Mega Diancie is commonly referred to as "the Royal Pink Princess".
column2: 蒂安希超级进化后的样子。高贵而美丽的超级蒂安希常被称作“皇家粉红公主”。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Garchomp. The claws and fins on its arms morph together to form sharp blades.
column2: 烈咬陆鲨的超级进化。手臂上的爪子和鳍融合变形，形成锋利的刀刃。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Gardevoir. There are two horns in the center of its chest, extending to either side. These horns are said to be a physical manifestation of this Pokemon's heart, and it is able to use tremendous psychic power now that it is open.
column2: 沙奈朵超级进化后的样子。胸口中央的两个角向两侧展开。据说这些角是这只宝可梦内心的具象化，如今敞开了心扉，能够使出强大的超能力。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Glalie. The horns on top Mega Glalie's head have been partially turned into ice, with the addition of a third horn on its forehead.
column2: 冰鬼护的超级进化。超级冰鬼护头顶的角部分化成了冰，额头上还长出了第三只角。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Gyarados. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
column2: 暴鲤龙超级进化后的样子。体形庞大，性情凶暴，发怒时足以摧毁整座城市。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Houndoom. Due to the greater heat that it can produce, its claws exhibit a more intense red color.
column2: 黑鲁加的超级进化。由于能够产生更强的热量，它的爪子呈现出更鲜红的颜色。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Kangaskhan. The mother's happiness over its child's growth is the source of its additional strength. However, it feels uneasy about the child's future, as it is only skilled at fighting and nothing else.
column2: 袋兽超级进化后的样子。母亲为孩子的成长感到喜悦，这份喜悦是它获得额外力量的来源。但孩子除了战斗之外什么都不会，又让它对孩子的未来感到担忧。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Latios. Its body can refract light, which allows it to become invisible or alter its appearance.
column2: 拉帝欧斯的超级进化。它的身体能够折射光线，从而隐身或改变外观。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Lopunny. A full-power strike from Mega Lopunny's ears can crumple steel plates.
column2: 长耳兔超级进化后的样子。超级长耳兔用耳朵使出的全力一击，能够将钢板打得凹陷变形。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Mawile. Mega Mawile has a second set of jaws protruding from the back of its head. It is also able to control each jaw independently of each other.
column2: 大嘴娃的超级进化。超级大嘴娃的后脑勺会伸出第二张大嘴，而且能够分别独立控制两张嘴。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Medicham. Using its enhanced willpower, Mega Medicham has formed four ghost-like arms around itself. The more trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous its self-created arms become.
column2: 恰雷姆超级进化后的样子。超级恰雷姆凭借增强的意志力，在周身形成四条幽灵般的手臂。精神修炼得越充分，这些凭空创造的手臂就越真实、越灵巧。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Pidgeot. The crest is sensitive to air currents, acting like a large antenna and stabilizing Mega Pidgeot's flight. Additionally, its increased wing power allows it to produce gust capable of destroying huge trees.
column2: 大比鸟的超级进化。羽冠对气流十分敏感，就像一根大型天线，能够稳定超级大比鸟的飞行。增强的翅膀力量还使它能够掀起足以摧毁巨树的强风。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Pinsir. When it Mega Evolves, Pinsir is left in a constant state of excitement. Mega Pinsir can travel up to 30 mph (48 kph) and uses its two large horns to pierce its enemies before shredding them.
column2: 凯罗斯超级进化后的样子。超级进化后会一直处于兴奋状态。超级凯罗斯的移动速度可达每小时30英里（48公里），会先用两个大角刺穿敌人，再将其撕碎。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Sableye. All the energy from its Mega Evolution is concentrated into the red jewel on its chest, causing it to detach from Sableyes body and significantly increase in size. The enlarged jewel is said to boast such incredible hardness that no attack can even leave a scratch on it.
column2: 勾魂眼的超级进化。超级进化的全部能量集中在胸前的红色宝石上，使宝石脱离勾魂眼的身体并显著变大。据说这颗巨大的宝石坚硬无比，任何攻击都无法留下划痕。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Salamence. As a result of its Mega Evolution, Salamence becomes even more brutal than ever before, to the point where it is liable to turn against the Trainer who raised it. Because of this, Mega Salamence is feared as "the blood-soaked crescent".
column2: 暴飞龙超级进化后的样子。超级进化使暴飞龙变得比以往更加残暴，甚至可能袭击养育它的训练家。因此，超级暴飞龙被人们畏称为“沾满鲜血的新月”。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Scizor. The barbs on Mega Scizor's claws can stab through concrete, and opponents caught in them are unable to escape.
column2: 巨钳螳螂的超级进化。超级巨钳螳螂爪上的倒刺能够刺穿混凝土，被钳住的对手无法逃脱。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Sharpedo. With explosive propulsion, it can exceed 125mph (201kph) in an instant.
column2: 巨牙鲨超级进化后的样子。凭借爆发性的推进力，能在瞬间达到超过每小时125英里（201公里）的速度。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Steelix. The cells within its body, crystallized by the energy produced from Mega Evolution, are stronger than any mineral and able to withstand any temperature.
column2: 大钢蛇的超级进化。体内细胞在超级进化产生的能量作用下结晶，变得比任何矿物都坚固，能够承受任何温度。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Swampert. Mega Swampert fills the organs on its back with air before diving underwater or battling. It uses that pressure to increase the power of its punch.
column2: 巨沼怪超级进化后的样子。超级巨沼怪会在潜入水中或战斗前，将空气充入背上的器官，并利用其中的压力增强拳击威力。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Venusaur. Venusaur uses its flower to catch the suns rays to convert them into energy, which causes the flower to take on colors that are more vibrant.
column2: 妙蛙花的超级进化。妙蛙花利用花朵吸收阳光并将其转化为能量，使花朵的颜色更加鲜艳。

column1: A Mega evolution of Lucario. Mega Lucario was originally believed to be the first discovered Mega Evolution.
column2: 路卡利欧超级进化后的样子。人们最初认为超级路卡利欧是第一个被发现的超级进化。

column1: A Pokemon composed of an oblong, irregularly-shaped clay slab. Runerigus was formed from a painting imbued with an ancient curse, which was activated by absorbing the spirit of a Yamask and brought the painting to life.
column2: 一种由长条状、不规则形状的黏土板构成的宝可梦。古老诅咒寄宿在画作中，吸收哭哭面具的灵魂后被激活，赋予画作生命，形成了迭失板。

column1: A Pokemon composed of rock salt. Nacli are born deep within the earth, inside layers of rock salt. Bits of salt are scraped off of Nacli as it travels the ground, although Nacli is able to create and replenish the salt inside its body.
column2: 一种由岩盐构成的宝可梦。盐石宝诞生于地底深处的岩盐层中。在地面上行走时，身体会被磨下些许盐屑，不过它能在体内生成盐来补充。

column1: A Pokemon consisting of two spherical heads connected by a thin tube. Each of Weezing's heads contains a different toxin. It mixes its gases by inflating one head and deflating the other. When its gases mix, Weezing becomes more toxic and putrid.
column2: 一种由两个球形头部组成的宝可梦，两个头部之间通过细管相连。双弹瓦斯的两个头部各含有一种不同的毒素。它通过让一边的头膨胀、另一边放气来混合气体。混合之后，双弹瓦斯的毒性和恶臭都会变得更强。

column1: A Pokemon consisting of two spherical heads connected by a thin tube. Galarian Weezing consumes particles from the polluted air. It expels clean air instead of droppings. The toxins within Weezing's body are accumulated into poison gas clouds that leaks and drifts around it.
column2: 一种由细管连接两个球形头部的宝可梦。双弹瓦斯（伽勒尔的样子）会吸入污染空气中的颗粒，排出洁净空气而非粪便。体内的毒素积聚成毒气云，泄出后飘散在周围。

column1: A Pokemon encased inside a thick shell made of rock. While its arms and legs are developing inside the shell, Pupitar is capable of venting gas to propel itself around, and can generate enough force to knock down mountains.
column2: 宝可梦被包裹在由岩石制成的厚壳内。当它的手臂和腿在壳内发育时，沙基拉斯能够排出气体来推动自己，并能产生足够的力量来推倒山脉。

column1: A Pokemon formed from sand. Sandygast is born from grudges that seep into the sand, such as from Pokemon that suffer defeat in battle. It can suck the life force of people or Pokemon through its mouth.
column2: 一种由沙子形成的宝可梦。沙丘娃诞生于渗入沙中的怨念，例如宝可梦在战斗落败后留下的怨恨。它能用嘴吸取人或宝可梦的生命力。

column1: A Pokemon in the shape of an eye. Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. People think this Pokemon may come from another world.
column2: 眼睛形状的宝可梦。它一动不动，就像死了一样，身体摸起来有淡淡的温热。人们认为这个宝可梦可能来自另一个世界。

column1: A Pokemon made completely out of programming code. Due to its man-made origins, Porygon does not need to breathe or eat, though it can still accept food if given.
column2: 一种完全由程序代码构成的宝可梦。多边兽是人造的，因此无需呼吸或进食，不过给它食物时，它依然能吃下。

column1: A Pokemon made of matcha tea. It pretends to be tea in order to trick people into drinking it, so it can absorb their life force. It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted by a potter of great renown.
column2: 抹茶制成的宝可梦。它冒充茶，骗人喝，吸收人的生命力。它生活在一个由一位著名陶艺家制作的精美茶杯内。

column1: A Pokemon made up of an anchor and ship wheel, held together by a mass of seaweed. The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokemon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.
column2: 一种由大量海藻将船锚与船舵连接起来的宝可梦。随波漂流的海藻之魂转生成为了它。它会不断吸收海底碎屑和海藻来维持身体。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a balloon. It has been known to steal children that mistake it for a regular balloon. However, due to its light weight, it can be resisted easily and is often pulled around.
column2: 一种形似气球的宝可梦。它会掳走将它误认成普通气球的孩子。不过由于它的体重很轻，很容易被反抗，反而常常被拉来拉去。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a barracuda. Should Arrokuda see any movement near it, it will charge in a straight line using its sharp pointed jaws, though its movements tend to become sluggish when it eats too much, which is typically when Cramorant appear to swallow it up.
column2: 一种外形像梭鱼的宝可梦。刺梭鱼一旦察觉附近有动静，就会用尖锐的下颚直线冲锋。但吃得太多时会变得行动迟缓，古月鸟往往会趁这时将它吞下。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a bear. While Bewear may appear friendly, it is actually a very dangerous Pokemon. It must never be approached carelessly, even if it is merely swinging its arms around in a friendly fashion.
column2: 一种形似熊的宝可梦。穿着熊虽然看起来很友好，实际上却非常危险。即使它只是在友好地挥舞手臂，也绝不能贸然接近。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a blimp. Drifblim is strong enough to lift Pokemon or people, but has no control over its flight. This causes it to drift with the wind and end up anywhere.
column2: 一种外形像飞艇的宝可梦。随风球的力量足以吊起人或宝可梦，却无法控制自己的飞行方向，所以会随风飘荡，最终可能落在任何地方。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a cormorant. Cramorant is a gluttonous Pokemon that can swallow other Pokemon whole. Its preferred prey are Arrokuda, but sometimes it swallows other Pokemon such as Pikachu, attempting to spit them out if they realise their mistake.
column2: 一种形似鸬鹚的宝可梦。古月鸟十分贪吃，会把其他宝可梦整个吞下。它最喜欢的猎物是刺梭鱼，但有时也会吞下皮卡丘等其他宝可梦，发现自己吞错后便会试图将它们吐出来。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a durian. It can stick its spikes into cave walls to absorb the minerals from the rocks. If threatened, it can shoot a barrage of spikes so it can escape by rolling away.
column2: 一种外形像榴莲的宝可梦。会将尖刺扎入洞穴岩壁，吸收岩石中的矿物质。受到威胁时，会接连发射尖刺，然后滚动逃走。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a gamebird. Female Unfezant are more adept at flying than male Unfezant.
column2: 宝可梦类似于一只猎鸟。雌性高傲雉鸡比雄性高傲雉鸡更擅长飞行。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a gamebird. Male Unfezant threaten their opponents by swinging their heads.
column2: 一种外形像猎禽的宝可梦。雄性高傲雉鸡会通过摆动头部威吓对手。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a powerfully built lemur with broad shoulders. This Pokemon's battle strategy involves throwing Berries at opponents, hard ones for damage and soft ones to obscure vision, and confusing opponents by throwing the Berry to other troop members.
column2: 一种形似狐猴的宝可梦，肩膀宽阔，体格强壮。它会向对手投掷树果：用坚硬的树果造成伤害，用柔软的树果遮挡视线，也会把树果扔给族群中的其他成员来迷惑对手。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a robotic bird. A mysterious life-form resembling Delibird. It possesses a spherical apparatus from which can fire huge blasts of ice to propel itself through snowy lands.
column2: 一种外形像机器鸟的宝可梦。它是酷似信使鸟的神秘生命体，拥有能够喷出强烈冰流的球形装置，借此推进身体，穿越雪地。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a sand castle. Palossand controls adults to make them build it a sand castle, which provides it a disguise and defense. However, Palossand is able to replenish any sand it loses on its own.
column2: 宝可梦类似于沙堡。 噬沙堡爷控制成年人让他们建造一座沙堡，为其提供伪装和防御。然而，噬沙堡爷能够自行补充失去的沙子。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a scoop of vanilla ice cream. It creates ice inside its body by drinking water, and expels it to hide itself or freeze opponents.
column2: 一种外形像一球香草冰淇淋的宝可梦。会通过喝水在体内制造冰，再将冰排出，用来隐藏自己或冻住对手。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a small snake. Silicobra collects sand by swallowing it and is able to shoot it from its nostrils, an ability it uses to blind predators so it can escape by burrowing into the ground.
column2: 宝可梦形似小蛇。 沙包蛇通过吞咽沙子来收集沙子，并能够从鼻孔中射出沙子，这种能力可以使捕食者失明，从而可以通过挖洞逃脱。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a spider. It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
column2: 一种外形像蜘蛛的宝可梦。会用头上的水泡使出头槌。小型宝可梦会被吸入水泡，溺死在其中。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a starfish. Those attacked by Toxapexs poison will suffer great pain for three days and three nights. Even after recovering, there will be some aftereffects.
column2: 宝可梦形似海星。被超坏星毒攻击的人会遭受三天三夜的巨大痛苦。即使康复了，也会有一些后遗症。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a swirled scoop of vanilla ice cream. Vanillite can blow winds as low as -58 F (-50 C) (9910 U), which causes it to create ice crystals and make it snow in nearby areas when it exhales.
column2: 一种外形像旋卷香草冰淇淋球的宝可梦。迷你冰能吹出低至华氏零下58度（摄氏零下50度；9910 U）的冷风，呼气时会产生冰晶，并使附近下雪。

column1: A Pokemon resembling an anthropomorphic otter or weasel. To help it dive, Floatzel can deflate its floatation sac, and then inflate it once again when it wishes to surface.
column2: 宝可梦类似于拟人化的水獭或黄鼠狼。为了帮助它潜水，浮潜鼬可以对其浮囊进行放气，然后在它希望浮出水面时再次对其进行充气。

column1: A Pokemon resembling an insect or crustacean. It is very strong, to the point that it can carry heavy rocks for a long time, even through arid lands where it resides.
column2: 一种外形像昆虫或甲壳动物的宝可梦。力气很大，能长时间搬运沉重的岩石，即使穿越它居住的干旱地带也不例外。

column1: A Pokemon said to be created when a lonely spirit possesses a cold, leftover cup of tea. The teacup in which this Pokemon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
column2: 据说是孤独的灵魂附着在一杯冷掉的剩茶上诞生的宝可梦。它所居住的茶杯是著名的古董餐具，市面上流通着许多赝品。

column1: A Pokemon said to be created when a lonely spirit possesses a cold, leftover cup of tea. The teacup in which this Pok├⌐mon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware.
column2: 据说是孤独的灵魂附身于一杯已经冷掉的剩茶后诞生的宝可梦。它居住的茶杯是著名的古董餐具。

column1: A Pokemon shaped like a lawnmower. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 宝可梦形状像割草机。 洛托姆具有进入和控制电器的能力，并且经常对毫无戒心的人进行恶作剧。

column1: A Pokemon shaped like a microwave oven. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 一种外形像微波炉的宝可梦。洛托姆能够进入并操控电器，常常对毫无防备的人恶作剧。

column1: A Pokemon shaped like a washing machine. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 形状像洗衣机的宝可梦。 洛托姆具有进入和控制电器的能力，并且经常对毫无戒心的人进行恶作剧。

column1: A Pokemon shaped like an electric fan. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 一种外形像电风扇的宝可梦。洛托姆能够进入并操控电器，常常对毫无防备的人恶作剧。

column1: A Pokemon similar to a red ladybug. Ledyba secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body, which it uses to communicate with other Ledyba. Ledyba conveys its feelings to other Ledyba by altering the fluids scent.
column2: 宝可梦类似于红色瓢虫。 芭瓢虫从其腿与身体的连接处分泌芳香液，用于与其他芭瓢虫进行交流。 芭瓢虫通过改变液体气味向其他芭瓢虫传达其感受。

column1: A Pokemon somewhat resembling a cyclops. The antenna on Dusknoir's head allows it to receive transmissions from the spirit world, which tell it to bring people there.
column2: 一种有些像独眼巨人的宝可梦。黑夜魔灵头上的天线能接收来自灵界的信息，并据此将人带到灵界。

column1: A Pokemon surrounded by a gel-like substance. It has two brains, which occasionally causes it to attempt two different actions at once. However, its exhibits greater psychic powers when the brains think alike.
column2: 一种被凝胶状物质包裹的宝可梦。它拥有两个大脑，有时会因此同时尝试两种不同的动作。不过，当两个大脑的想法一致时，它的超能力会变得更强。

column1: A Pokemon that appears like a legless lump. Its favorite food is a type of mushroom that grows beneath dead grass, though it also eats Berries.
column2: 一种外表像没有腿的团块的宝可梦。最喜欢吃生长在枯草下的一种蘑菇，也会吃树果。

column1: A Pokemon that bears similarity to an owl. It has exceptional hearing and eyesight, can fly silently, and can turn its heads at a 180 angle to increase its intellect.
column2: 与猫头鹰相似的宝可梦。它具有非凡的听力和视力，可以安静地飞行，并且可以将头旋转180度以增加智力。

column1: A Pokemon that has the appearance of a pile of trash spilling out of a large, torn garbage bag. Garbodor is able to spray poisonous gas and filth from its fingertips, but only from its right hand. It also finishes off opponents by subduing them with its left arm and spewing an awful-smelling toxic gas from its mouth.
column2: 一种外形像从破裂大垃圾袋中溢出的一堆垃圾的宝可梦。灰尘山只能从右手指尖喷出毒气和污物。它也会用左臂制服对手，再从口中喷出恶臭毒气给予致命一击。

column1: A Pokemon that is heavily based on the coelacanth. Relicanth is a filter feeder, and it feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
column2: 一种外形十分像腔棘鱼的宝可梦。古空棘鱼通过滤食摄取食物，用没有牙齿的嘴吞食微小生物。

column1: A Pokemon that is similar to a mushroom. Toedscool has two long, thin, white legs resembling tentacles or mycelium, which it uses to run at a speed of 30 mph (50 km/h). Although Toedscool physically resembles Tentacool, the two species are biologically unrelated.
column2: 一种外形像蘑菇的宝可梦。原野水母的两条腿又细又长，呈白色，像触手或菌丝，能让它以每小时30英里（50公里）的速度奔跑。虽然外形与玛瑙水母相似，但两者在生物学上没有亲缘关系。

column1: A Pokemon that looks similar to a tree. Sudowoodo disguises itself as a tree and stands along paths to avoid being attacked.
column2: 看起来像树的宝可梦。 树才怪将自己伪装成一棵树，沿着小路站立以避免受到攻击。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a baby vulture. It seems to be wearing a broken skull as a diaper-like undergarment, hence its species name. Vullaby either finds this bone itself or uses one found for it by Mandibuzz.
column2: 一种外形像小秃鹰的宝可梦。似乎将破碎的头骨穿在身上当作尿布般的内衣，名字也由此而来。这块骨头可能是秃鹰丫头自己找到的，也可能由秃鹰娜找到。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a bipedal sea turtle. Carracosta has extremely strong jaws and have enough power in its slap to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
column2: 宝可梦类似于双足海龟。 肋骨海龟拥有极其坚固的下颚，其拍击力量足以在油轮底部打开一个洞。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a bipedal wasp. Disturbing a swarm of Beedrill will cause the whole colony to attack. It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and abdomen.
column2: 一种外形像双足黄蜂的宝可梦。惊动一只大针蜂，会引来整个蜂群的攻击。它能高速飞行，并用前腿和腹部的大型毒针攻击。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a box jellyfish. Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. It is also able to control Pokemon it touches with its tentacles.
column2: 类似于箱形水母的宝可梦。 玛瑙水母吸收太阳光，并利用体内的水进行折射，将其转化为光束能量。它还能够控制用触手接触到的宝可梦。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a bull. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
column2: 一种外形像牛的宝可梦。会使植物生长，再从生长的植物中吸收能量。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a cross between a salamander and a hippopotamus. Galarian Slowpoke are known to relax on seashores and riverbanks without a care in the world.
column2: 宝可梦类似于蝾螈和河马的杂交体。 伽勒尔呆呆兽以在海边和河岸上放松而闻名，无忧无虑。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a cross between a salamander and a hippopotamus. Slowpoke has notoriously dim intellect, and often forgets what it was doing. It takes a long time to respond to outside stimuli.
column2: 一种外形像蝾螈与河马混合体的宝可梦。呆呆兽出了名地迟钝，常常忘记自己正在做什么，也需要很长时间才会对外界刺激作出反应。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a duck. Farfetch'd is always seen carrying a leek stalk or spring onion. Unable to live without its stick, Farfetch'd will defend the stalk with its life.
column2: 一种形似鸭子的宝可梦。大葱鸭总是携带着一根韭葱或小葱。它无法离开这根葱生活，会拼上性命保护它。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a duck. Its body has developed a much stronger frame that gives it the strength required to carry its leek. However, the sheer mass of it makes it hard for Farfetch'd to fly.
column2: 一种外形像鸭子的宝可梦。骨架变得更加结实，赋予了它举起大葱所需的力量。不过，庞大的重量也让大葱鸭难以飞行。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a giant chain of boulders that become smaller towards the tail. This Pokemon has a magnet in its brain that serves as an internal compass. Its body absorbs many hard objects, making its body very solid.
column2: 宝可梦类似于一条巨大的巨石链，向尾部逐渐变小。这个宝可梦的大脑中有一块磁铁，充当内部指南针。它的身体吸收了很多坚硬的物体，使得它的身体变得非常坚固。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a giant chain of boulders that become smaller towards the tail. This Pokemon has a magnet in its brain that serves as an internal compass. This is a special Onix with a body made out of crystal glass.
column2: 一种外形像巨大岩石链的宝可梦，越靠近尾部的岩石越小。脑中有一块磁铁，能充当体内的指南针。这是一只身体由水晶玻璃构成的特殊大岩蛇。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a massive goliath with a body of coal atop of it. In battle, the coal on its head will burn bright red and radiate heat that sends sparks flying, scorching their surroundings.
column2: 一种体型庞大的宝可梦，巨大的身体上顶着一堆煤。在战斗中，头上的煤会燃烧成鲜红色并释放热量，火花四溅，烧焦周围的环境。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a minecart. Carkol forms coal inside of its body and frequently drops said coal.
column2: 一种外形像矿车的宝可梦。大炭车会在体内生成煤炭，并且经常掉落煤块。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a plant bulb with a round body. Oddish will wander up to 1000 feet (300 meters) during the night to scatter its seeds and find a nutrient-rich patch of soil in which to plant itself.
column2: 一种身体圆滚滚、形似植物球茎的宝可梦。走路草每晚会行走最多1000英尺（300米），撒播种子，并寻找一块养分充足的土壤把自己种下。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a quadruped wolf. In order to avoid needless fighting, the Midday Form prefers to live alone and does not form a pack with others of its kind.
column2: 一种外形像四足狼的宝可梦。为了避免无谓的争斗，白昼的样子喜欢独自生活，不与同类结成群体。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a rock covered in crystals. Carbink is born from temperatures and pressure underground, and it has slept for millions of years since its birth. Some have been unearthed during cave excavations.
column2: 宝可梦类似于一块覆盖着水晶的岩石。 小碎钻是从地下的温度和压力中诞生的，它从诞生至今已经沉睡了数百万年。有些是在洞穴挖掘过程中出土的。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a sauropod dinosaur or a lizard. The aroma wafting from the leaf-like growths around its neck has a spicy scent, and exhibits various beneficial effects on itself, nearby people, or Pokemon who inhale it.
column2: 一种外形像蜥脚类恐龙或蜥蜴的宝可梦。颈部长出的叶片状结构会散发带有辛辣味的香气，对自身及附近吸入香气的人或宝可梦有多种益处。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a shiny, hexagonal snowflake. When its body heat rises it will turn into steam and vanish, but will revert to ice when the body temperature lowers.
column2: 宝可梦类似于闪亮的六角形雪花。当它的体温升高时，它会变成蒸汽并消失，但当体温降低时，它又会变成冰。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a shrimp. Clawitzer's massive claw can launch cannonballs of water capable of piercing tanker hulls.
column2: 一种外形像虾的宝可梦。钢炮臂虾的巨大钳子能射出水炮弹，足以穿透油轮的船体。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a small piece of coal. It races around caves in the rough rocky terrain like a unicycle, burning through the red coal that sustains it.
column2: 类似于一小块煤炭的宝可梦。它像独轮车一样在崎岖的岩石地形中的洞穴中奔跑，燃烧着维持它的红煤。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a small turtle. Rather than actively hunting and foraging for food like most other Pokemon, it collects Berries and stores them in its shell. The Berries inside are liquefied and fermented by Shuckles digestive juices, which it then consumes.
column2: 一种外形像小乌龟的宝可梦。壶壶不会像大多数宝可梦一样主动狩猎和觅食，而是收集树果储存在壳内。树果被它的消化液液化并发酵后，再由它食用。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a spherical tadpole. The direction of the belly spiral differs by area, with the equator being thought to have an effect on this.
column2: 类似于球形蝌蚪的宝可梦。腹螺旋的方向因地区而异，赤道被认为对此有影响。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a spider. Rather than making a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls. It will attach silk to its prey and set it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
column2: 一种外形像蜘蛛的宝可梦。不会在固定地点结网安家，而是在夜幕降临后四处寻找食物。会将丝线附在猎物身上后放它离开，再沿丝线找到猎物及其同伴。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a tarantula. Galvantula in particular likes to use electrically charged silk to ensnare prey. The electricity stuns the victim, allowing Galvantula to consume the target at its leisure.
column2: 一种形似狼蛛的宝可梦。电蜘蛛尤其喜欢用带电的丝网缠住猎物。电流会将猎物麻痹，使电蜘蛛能够慢慢享用。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a tumbleweed. Bramblin's main form of locomotion is the wind, which blows it uncontrollably to destinations unknown.
column2: 一种外形像风滚草的宝可梦。纳噬草主要依靠风移动，被风不受控制地吹向未知的目的地。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a vaguely anthropomorphic butterfly. Butterfrees wings are covered with poisonous powders that fall off continuously as it flies. This powder repels water, enabling it to gather honey even in the rain.
column2: 宝可梦类似于一只隐约拟人化的蝴蝶。 巴大蝶的翅膀上覆盖着有毒粉末，在飞行时这些粉末不断脱落。这种粉末具有防水性，即使在雨中也能采集蜂蜜。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a wooly mammoth crossed with a boar. It can endure harsh cold and hunger for an almost indefinite amount of time.
column2: 一种外形像猛犸象与野猪混合体的宝可梦。能无限期地忍受严寒和饥饿。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles four interlocking gears. The red core is used to store energy gained from the rotating gears. This energy can be released through the spiked gear at the bottom.
column2: 宝可梦类似于四个互锁齿轮。红色核心用于存储从旋转齿轮获得的能量。这种能量可以通过底部的尖刺齿轮释放出来。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles three interlocking gears. Klang communicate with each other by spinning their gears in different directions.
column2: 一种外形像三个互相啮合的齿轮的宝可梦。齿轮组会向不同方向转动齿轮，以此相互交流。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles two swords sheathed on a plaque. The swords are able to communicate telepathically, and they use this ability to carry out complex attacks that are unstoppable even to those skilled at swordplay.
column2: 宝可梦类似于镶在牌匾上的两把剑。这些剑能够进行心灵感应交流，他们利用这种能力进行复杂的攻击，即使是那些擅长剑术的人也无法阻挡。

column1: A Pokemon which resembles a hand. Binacle always live in pairs on one gray rock, when they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
column2: 一种外形像手的宝可梦。龟脚脚总是成对栖息在灰色岩石上。如果发生争执，其中一只就会搬到另一块岩石上。

column1: A Pokemon whose body appears to be constructed out of black crystalline material. Due to the peculiar nature of its body, the power it wields, and the rumors that it came from another world in the distant past, it is speculated that it may be related to the Ultra Beasts if not actually one itself.
column2: 一种身体仿佛由黑色晶体构成的宝可梦。由于其独特的身体、拥有的力量，以及远古时来自异世界的传闻，人们推测它可能本身就是究极异兽，即使不是，也可能与究极异兽有关。

column1: A Pokemon with a body closely resembling a living skeleton. It uses its sharp scythes to cut enemies and drink their internal fluids.
column2: 一种身体像活骷髅的宝可梦。会用锋利的镰刀切开敌人，吸饮其体液。

column1: A Pokemon with a gaseous body. Haunter hides in very dark places, where it plots to take the life of the next living thing that comes near it.
column2: 具有气态体的宝可梦。 鬼斯通隐藏在非常黑暗的地方，它计划在那里夺走下一个靠近它的生物的生命。

column1: A Pokemon with a head reminiscent of a helmet. It is a very fast Pokemon; it can attack using ways similar to ninjas.
column2: 一种头部让人联想到头盔的宝可梦。速度极快，能以类似忍者的方式发动攻击。

column1: A Pokemon with a spherical body and a flat, paddle-shaped tail. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokemon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere.
column2: 宝可梦具有球形身体和扁平桨状尾部。渔民们厌恶这种麻烦的宝可梦，因为它会从刺中喷出毒液，将毒液弄得到处都是。

column1: A Pokemon with a spherical body and a flat, paddle-shaped tail. In order to attack, Qwilfish drinks over 2.6 gallons (10 litres) of water to inflate its body. It then uses the water pressure to shoot poisonous quills at its foe, which can cause fainting.
column2: 一种身体呈球形、尾巴扁平如桨的宝可梦。攻击时，千针鱼会喝下超过2.6加仑（10升）的水，使身体膨胀，再利用水压射出毒刺，可能使敌人昏厥。

column1: A Pokemon with a sunflower-like design. While the sun is up, it moves around in a hectic manner. When the sun sets, it comes to a complete stop and closes its petals.
column2: 一种外形如同向日葵的宝可梦。白天会忙碌地四处活动，太阳落山后就完全停止活动，并闭合花瓣。

column1: A Pokemon with the appearance of a hula dancer. Bellossom is often seen dancing and chanting. In particular, Bellossom dances when cloudy weather persists, or when the heavy rainfall season ends and it is drawn out by the warm sunlight.
column2: 一种外形像草裙舞者的宝可梦。常能看到美丽花边跳舞边吟唱，尤其在连日阴天或雨季结束后，温暖的阳光会吸引它出来舞蹈。

column1: A Primal form of Groudon. As Primal Groudon, its appearance is similar to Groudon, but larger in size.
column2: 固拉多的原始形态。原始固拉多的外观与固拉多相似，但体型更大。

column1: A badger like bipedal Pokemon. While combative to the extreme, it doesn't attack often as it prefers taunting an opponent into attacking first. When that happens, it will take a threatening pose posture by crossing its arms and then releasing a staggering voice, so loud and obnoxious that would cause any opponent to flinch.
column2: 一种外形像獾的双足宝可梦。虽然极其好斗，却不常主动攻击，更喜欢挑衅对手先动手。对手出招时，它会交叉双臂摆出威吓姿势，再发出震耳欲聋、令人厌烦的巨响，让任何对手都畏缩。

column1: A bagworm-like Pokemon with a coat that has fused with its body. Wormadam that evolve on cold days are said to form thicker cloaks.
column2: 一种形似蓑蛾幼虫的宝可梦，身上的蓑衣已经与身体融为一体。据说，在寒冷天气中进化的结草贵妇会形成更厚的蓑衣。

column1: A bat-like Pokemon. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
column2: 一种外形像蝙蝠的宝可梦。会交替让前后两对翅膀休息，因此能连续飞行一整天而无需停下。

column1: A bat-like Pokemon. Noibat is capable of emitting ultrasonic waves of 200,000 Hertz from its ears, which it can use to stun large creatures, immobilize prey, and determine the ripeness of fruit it enjoys eating.
column2: 类似蝙蝠的宝可梦。 嗡蝠能够从耳朵发射200,000赫兹的超声波，可以用来击晕大型生物、使猎物动弹不得，并确定它喜欢吃的水果的成熟度。

column1: A bat-like Pokemon. When it shakes its tail vigorously, it is producing sound waves powerful enough to destroy concrete. In contrast, it produces waves during courtship that can gladden any who hear it
column2: 一种外形像蝙蝠的宝可梦。用力摇动尾巴时，能产生足以摧毁混凝土的声波。求偶时发出的声波则截然不同，任何听到的生物都会感到愉悦。

column1: A beagle-like, bipedal Pokemon. It has a long tail with an end resembling a paintbrush. This paintbrush oozes with paint, and the color of the paint may vary for each Smeargle.
column2: 类似小猎犬的双足宝可梦。它有一条长尾巴，末端像画笔。该画笔会渗出颜料，每个图图犬的颜料颜色可能有所不同。

column1: A bee-like Pokemon. A Vespiquen is far more powerful than its followers, and will only take action if its Combee are unable to protect the hive.
column2: 一种外形像蜜蜂的宝可梦。蜂女王比追随者强大得多，只有在三蜜蜂无法保护蜂巢时才会亲自行动。

column1: A beetle-like Pokemon with a large pair of mandibles. It is an adept flier, capable of acrobatic maneuvers such as tailspins and sharp turns. Even as it weaves through complicated tangles of branches in the forest, it is able to maintain high-speed flight.
column2: 类似甲虫的宝可梦，有一对大下颌。它是一名熟练的飞行者，能够进行诸如尾旋和急转弯等杂技动作。即使在森林中错综复杂的树枝中穿梭，也能保持高速飞行。

column1: A bell-shaped Pokemon. Victreebel produces a sweet scent to aid in luring its victims. Acid that has dissolved numerous prey animals becomes sweeter and even more effective at attracting prey.
column2: 一种外形像钟的宝可梦。大食花会散发甜香来引诱猎物。溶解过许多猎物的酸液会变得更甜，也更能吸引猎物。

column1: A big, furry Pokemon with an impressive hump on its back. As it is usually unable to see, it checks surroundings with its sensitive pig-like nose instead.
column2: 一只毛茸茸的大宝可梦，背上有一个令人印象深刻的驼峰。由于平时看不见，所以用灵敏的猪鼻子来观察周围的情况。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon resembling a chimpanzee. Being very agile, it is able to climb the rocky ledges of tall mountains, where it lives.
column2: 一种外形像黑猩猩的双足宝可梦。身手非常敏捷，能攀爬它居住的高山上的岩石壁架。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon resembling a large, portly rabbit. Its ears are strong enough to lift objects weighing over a ton and prove to be an invaluable asset in Diggersby's digging.
column2: 一种形似肥大兔子的双足宝可梦。它的耳朵足以举起重量超过一吨的物体，是掘地兔挖掘时不可或缺的帮手。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon resembling a poison dart frog. By croaking, Toxicroak churns the poison stored in the poison sac on their throat for more potency.
column2: 一种外形像箭毒蛙的双足宝可梦。毒骷蛙会通过鸣叫，搅动储存在喉部毒囊中的毒液，使毒性增强。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon similar in appearance to a theropod dinosaur. Its leafy appearance allows it to be camouflaged in the forests where it lives.
column2: 双足宝可梦外观与兽脚亚目恐龙相似。它多叶的外观使其能够在其居住的森林中进行伪装。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon similar to a gremlin. It is feared by people, since it is said to steal a persons soul if they look into its eyes.
column2: 一种外形像小恶魔的双足宝可梦。人们害怕它，因为据说只要注视它的双眼，就会被夺走灵魂。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that appears to be a mixture of a pineapple and a duck. Ludicolo becomes more powerful when it hears festive music and will appear near laughing children on hikes.
column2: 两足动物宝可梦看起来像是菠萝和鸭子的混合体。 乐天河童在听到节日音乐时会变得更加强大，并且会出现在远足时欢笑的孩子附近。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that has an ovoid body. Azumarill has highly developed hearing that allows it to hear distances, even when it is underwater. By keeping still and listening closely, it can identity prey even in wild, fast-moving rivers.
column2: 一种身体呈卵形的双足宝可梦。玛力露丽的听觉非常发达，即使在水下也能听见远处的声音。只要静止不动仔细聆听，即使在水流湍急的河中也能辨认猎物。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that resembles a poison dart frog. Croagunks cheek pouches and fingers contain a poisonous fluid. However, the fluid squeezed from its finger is also a significant ingredient in remedies for lower back pain.
column2: 类似箭毒蛙的双足宝可梦。 不良蛙颊囊和手指含有有毒液体。然而，从其手指挤出的液体也是治疗腰痛的重要成分。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.
column2: 一种外形像南瓜的双足宝可梦。居住在南瓜里的灵魂被困在了这个世界。南瓜精能将游荡的灵魂带回它们应去的地方，让它们继续旅程。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that resembles both cats and weasels. Hisuian Sneasel's sturdy and curved claws allow it to climb and travel through the precipitous walls and cliffs where it lives. The venom from the tips of Hisuian Sneasel's claws is capable of invading the nervous system of any prey it scratches.
column2: 一只双足动物宝可梦，既像猫又像黄鼠狼。 洗翠狃拉的坚固而弯曲的爪子使它能够攀爬和穿越它所居住的陡峭的墙壁和悬崖。 洗翠狃拉的爪尖的毒液能够侵入其抓伤的任何猎物的神经系统。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that resembles both cats and weasels. Sneasel is a notoriously vicious Pokemon, which is perfectly capable of using its claws to do substantial damage.
column2: 一种既像猫又像黄鼠狼的双足宝可梦。狃拉以凶狠著称，能用爪子造成严重伤害。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a Shellder latched onto its head. Shellder's bite releases venom into Slowpoke's brain, causing a chemical chain-reaction that unlocks a superior intelligence and extraordinary power. More venom is injected into Slowking every time it yawns.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦，头上紧咬着一只大舌贝。大舌贝咬下时会把毒液注入呆呆兽的大脑，引发化学连锁反应，激发出超凡的智慧和力量。呆呆王每次打哈欠，都会被注入更多毒液。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a bulky build. Makuhita is very gutsy and never gives up, no matter how many times it is knocked down. Energy is built into its body each time it rises back up.
column2: 一种身体肥大的双足宝可梦。幕下力士十分勇敢，无论被击倒多少次都不会放弃。每次重新站起，体内都会积聚力量。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a large mouth. Exploud uses the tubes on its body to draw in air and increase its noise-based attacks. Its bellowing is capable of triggering earthquakes and can be heard from over six miles away.
column2: 具有大嘴的双足宝可梦。 爆音怪利用身体上的管子吸入空气并增加基于噪音的攻击。它的吼叫声能够引发地震，六英里外都能听到。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a pair of spiky pincers on top of its head. It can use its pincers to crush, toss, bludgeon, or tear opponents, lift things twice its weight, and shatter logs. Captured prey is kept in place by the piercing thorns and sheer strength of Pinsirs horns, and will not be released until they are torn in half.
column2: 一种头顶长着一对尖刺钳角的双足宝可梦。能用钳角压碎、抛掷、猛击或撕扯对手，举起自重两倍的物体，并将木头击碎。凯罗斯角上的尖刺和强大的力量会牢牢夹住猎物，直到将其撕成两半才松开。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a round body. Primeape is easily angered; even the slightest glance of eye contact will make it furious. When Primeape is furious, its blood circulation is boosted. This makes its muscles stronger, but at the cost of some of its intelligence.
column2: 圆形身体的双足宝可梦。 火暴猴很容易生气；即使是最轻微的目光接触也会让它变得愤怒。当火暴猴愤怒时，其血液循环会加快。这使它的肌肉更强壮，但代价是它的一些智力。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a roundish body. Gengar is very mischievous, and at times, malicious. It enjoys playing practical jokes and casting curses, such as pretending to be ones shadow, then behaving erratically. When the quarry notices, the Gengar takes delight in its victims terror.
column2: 一种身体浑圆的双足宝可梦。耿鬼十分调皮，有时甚至很恶毒。喜欢恶作剧和诅咒，例如假扮成别人的影子，再做出反常的动作。猎物察觉后表现出的恐惧会让耿鬼感到愉悦。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a spherical body. It is always covered in an oily fluid that allows it to slip away from enemies. All of its skin feels this away except where its swirl is, which is very smooth.
column2: 一种身体呈球形的双足宝可梦。体表始终覆盖着油性液体，使它能够从敌人手中滑脱。除腹部光滑的漩涡图案外，皮肤各处都有这种油滑的触感。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a spherical body. Whismur's murmurs are barely audible, but when it senses danger, it lets out an ear-splitting cry. Startled by its own cries, it will cry louder. When it finally stops crying, it will fall asleep from exhaustion.
column2: 一种身体呈球形的双足宝可梦。咕妞妞平时声音很小，但察觉危险时会发出震耳欲聋的哭声。它会被自己的哭声吓到，哭得更响；终于停止哭泣后，又会因精疲力竭而睡着。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with an appearance that incorporates features of roses and masquerade attire. Roserade lures prey with a sweet aroma. The more toxic its poison, the sweeter its aroma becomes.
column2: 外观兼具玫瑰和化装舞会特征的双足宝可梦。 罗丝雷朵用甜美的香气引诱猎物。它的毒越毒，它的香气就越甜。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with an insectoid appearance. Kricketune's melodic cry varies greatly and can be used to signal its emotions.
column2: 一种外形像昆虫的双足宝可梦。音箱蟀鸣叫的旋律变化丰富，可以表达它的情绪。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with rudimentary hands and feet. Gloom trickles sticky nectar from its mouth with the appearance and consistency of drool. This can be used as a fertilizer for plants.
column2: 具有基本手脚的双足宝可梦。 臭臭花从嘴里滴出粘稠的花蜜，其外观和稠度与口水一样。这可以用作植物的肥料。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with rudimentary hands and feet. It can shake, flap, or burst its petals into bloom with a bang in order to release clouds of pollen. This pollen is highly allergenic to humans and toxic to other Pokemon; Vileplume uses it to paralyze its prey.
column2: 一种手脚尚未充分发育的双足宝可梦。会摇动、拍动花瓣，或让花瓣砰地绽放，释放成团的花粉。花粉会使人类严重过敏，对其他宝可梦则有毒；霸王花用它来麻痹猎物。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Abra can sense danger by reading minds. When it does, it teleports itself to a safe location so quickly that it creates the illusion of having made copies of itself.
column2: 双足宝可梦。 凯西可以通过读心术感知危险。当它这样做时，它会如此迅速地将自己传送到一个安全的位置，以至于给人一种复制了自己的错觉。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Galarian Slowbro are considered highly dangerous due to it indiscriminately attacking its surroundings; the reason for which is due to Shellder sometimes unconsciously biting down hard on its arm.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。呆壳兽（伽勒尔的样子）会不分对象地攻击周围，被认为十分危险。这是因为大舌贝有时会无意识地狠狠咬住它的手臂。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. It has an exceptionally keen sense of smell, being 100 million times that of a human, allowing it to distinguish even the faintest of smells.
column2: 双足宝可梦。它的嗅觉异常敏锐，是人类的一亿倍，即使是最微弱的气味也能分辨出来。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. It is a hyperactive Pokemon. It does not mind walking and running from place to place as it looks for food.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。精力旺盛，寻找食物时不介意从一个地方走或跑到另一个地方。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. It is known to usually carry an I-beam girder in its arms. The steel frame is used to train its muscles, and Gurdurr boasts about its muscles with its comrades.
column2: 双足宝可梦。众所周知，它的手臂通常携带工字梁。钢架是用来训练肌肉的，铁骨土人和战友们一起夸耀自己的肌肉。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Lickitung's tongue is twice as long as its body. Sticky saliva coats its tongue, which causes a tingling sensation when touched.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。大舌头的舌头长度是身体的两倍。舌头上覆盖着黏稠的唾液，触碰时会有刺痛感。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Marowak is well known for ferocity with its bone club, which it is said to collect from a hidden graveyard.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。嘎啦嘎啦挥舞骨棒时十分凶猛。据说它会从一处隐蔽的墓地收集这些骨棒。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Minun cares more for its teammates than itself, sending off showers of sparks when it cheers for them. When its partner is in trouble, it gives off increasing amounts of sparks.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。负电拍拍关心同伴胜过自己，为同伴加油时会迸出阵阵火花。同伴遇到困难时，它发出的火花会越来越多。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Slowbro has lost the capability to feel pain due to the Shellder's poison. However, it apparently becomes inspired when the Shellder bites down on its tail.
column2: 双足宝可梦。 呆壳兽因大舌贝的毒药而失去了感觉疼痛的能力。然而，当大舌贝咬住它的尾巴时，它显然受到了启发。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. The feelers on its ears act like stethoscopes in that it can feel the beat of another Pokemons heart, to assess the Pokemon's feelings and overall physical condition. The feelers are also able to determine when an Egg is close to hatching.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。耳朵上的触角像听诊器，能感知其他宝可梦的心跳，判断其心情和身体状况，也能判断宝可梦的蛋是否即将孵化。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. These Pokemon willingly serve people and other Pokemon, as they derive energy from feelings of gratitude. They sense emotions by touching their horns to determine other's needs and serve them better.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。它们从感激之情中获取能量，因此乐于为人类和其他宝可梦服务。它们通过角的触碰感知情绪，了解他人的需求，以提供更好的帮助。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
column2: 一种双足宝可梦。性情友善，但保卫领地时可能毫不留情，会用能切开钢铁的獠牙迎战敌人。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Very mischievous, this Pokemon will tug on fishing lines from underwater and pop out to startle people.
column2: 双足宝可梦。这种宝可梦非常顽皮，它会从水下拉动鱼线并弹出来吓人。

column1: A bipedal automaton Pokemon resembling a suit of armor. Despite its large size, Golurk is capable of flying by inserting its hands in its arms and its legs and feet in its body, then taking off like a rocket.
column2: 一种双足行走、外形像盔甲的机器人宝可梦。泥偶巨人虽体形庞大，却能将双手收进手臂、腿脚收进体内，像火箭一样起飞。

column1: A bipedal bulldog-like Pokemon. Despite its fierce appearance, it is actually very timid. Unless Granbull is startled, it will not bite indiscriminately.
column2: 类似双足斗牛犬的宝可梦。虽然外表凶猛，但实际上却非常胆怯。除非布鲁皇受到惊吓，否则它不会乱咬人。

column1: A bipedal bulldog-like Pokemon. It is not aggressive and tends to prefer to scare away its opponent rather than fight. However, it is saddened that others run from its frightening appearance.
column2: 一种外形像斗牛犬的双足宝可梦。没有攻击性，比起战斗更喜欢吓退对手。然而，其他生物仍会因它可怕的外表而逃走，让它十分难过。

column1: A bipedal crocodilian Pokemon. Fuecoco is laid-back and does things at its own pace. It enjoys eating, and it will rush towards any food it sees.
column2: 双足鳄鱼宝可梦。 呆火鳄很悠闲，按照自己的节奏做事。它喜欢吃东西，看到任何食物就会冲过去。

column1: A bipedal feline Pokemon. Perrserker has a violent and barbaric demeanor, and it lives for the thrill of battle.
column2: 一种外形像猫的双足宝可梦。喵头目生性暴躁野蛮，为享受战斗而活。

column1: A bipedal feline mythical Pokemon. It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
column2: 一种形似猫科动物的双足幻之宝可梦。它以闪电般的速度接近敌人，再用锋利的爪子将对方撕成碎片。

column1: A bipedal frog-like Pokemon. Politoed likes to expand its throat and sing. When three or more assemble, they sing in a chorus with a loud, bellowing voice.
column2: 一种外形像青蛙的双足宝可梦。蚊香蛙皇喜欢鼓起喉咙唱歌。三只或更多聚在一起时，会用响亮低沉的声音齐唱。

column1: A bipedal humanoid monkey Pokemon. Thwackey can use its two sticks to create a rhythmic beat. The faster a rhythm Thwackey creates, the more respect it earns from its peers.
column2: 一只双足人形猴子宝可梦。 啪咚猴可以使用它的两根棍子来创造有节奏的节拍。 啪咚猴创造的节奏越快，就越能赢得同行的尊重。

column1: A bipedal legendary Pokemon of indefinable but seemingly draconic basis. Black Kyurem is formed by combining with Zekrom and shares many aspects of its design.
column2: 一种双足的传说的宝可梦，原型难以确定，但似乎具有龙的特征。暗黑酋雷姆由酋雷姆与捷克罗姆合体而成，外形中也有许多共同之处。

column1: A bipedal legendary Pokemon of indefinable but seemingly draconic basis. White Kyurem is formed by combining with Reshiram and shares many aspects of its design.
column2: 一种外形难以归类、但具有龙类特征的双足传说的宝可梦。焰白酋雷姆由酋雷姆与莱希拉姆合体而成，外观上也与莱希拉姆有许多相似之处。

column1: A bipedal legendary Pokemon resembling a dragon or dinosaur. Zekrom's tail consists of large, round, conical and spiked formation, likened to an electricity generator. This tail produces energy for its attacks and emits an anti-gravity field, allowing Zekrom to fly through the air with minimal effects from aerodynamic resistance and gravity.
column2: 一种外形像龙或恐龙的双足传说的宝可梦。捷克罗姆的尾巴由大型圆形、圆锥形和尖刺状结构组成，外形像发电机。尾巴为攻击提供能量，还能产生反重力场，使它飞行时受到的空气阻力和重力影响降至最低。

column1: A bipedal mythical Pokemon. It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers.
column2: 一种双足幻之宝可梦。它潜伏在他人的影子里，复制对方的动作和力量。

column1: A bipedal mythical Pokemon. Mew is said to have the DNA of every single Pokemon contained within its body. Since Mew can make itself invisible at will, very few people have knowingly seen it, leading some to declare it extinct and most to assume it to be a mirage.
column2: 一种双足的幻之宝可梦。据说梦幻体内蕴藏着所有宝可梦的DNA。它能随意隐形，很少有人真正见过，因此有人认为它已灭绝，而大多数人把它当作幻影。

column1: A bipedal sea otter-like Pokemon. It carries a seashell called a "scalchop" on its belly. This shell is made of the same material as its claws, and is used for both battle and cracking hard berries.
column2: 一种形似海獭的双足宝可梦。腹部携带着一枚被称为“扇贝”的贝壳。贝壳的材质与它的爪子相同，既能用于战斗，也能敲开坚硬的树果。

column1: A bipedal sheep-like Pokemon. Storing too much electricity caused Flaaffy to lose the wool over most of its body, but the bare, rubbery skin protects it from the electricity stored in its fleece.
column2: 一种外形像绵羊的双足宝可梦。储存过多电力让茸茸羊失去了身体大部分毛发，但裸露的橡胶般皮肤能保护它免受剩余羊毛中储存的电力伤害。

column1: A bipedal ursine Pokemon. The marking on its face glows when it finds honey already made. Honey is often absorbed into the forepaws, and Teddiursa is often seen licking them.
column2: 一种形似熊的双足宝可梦。找到现成的蜂蜜时，它脸上的图案会发光。蜂蜜经常渗入前爪，因此常能看到熊宝宝舔自己的前爪。

column1: A bipedal ursine Pokemon. While it is skilled at climbing trees, it gathers food by snapping them and collecting whatever berries or fruits fall down. It will mark trees bearing delicious fruit in its territory with its claws.
column2: 一种外形像熊的双足宝可梦。虽然擅长爬树，却会折断树木，收集掉落的树果或水果来获取食物。领地内结有美味果实的树，会被它用爪子留下标记。

column1: A bipedal, amphibious Pokemon, somewhat resembling a mantis shrimp. Its strong claws can break stones and punch through a steel slab. Furthermore, they can be freely extended or retracted.
column2: 两足两栖宝可梦，有点像螳螂虾。它强大的爪子可以击碎石头并击穿钢板。此外，它们可以自由延伸或缩回。

column1: A bipedal, amphibious Pokemon. An unintelligent Pokemon, it tends to bump its head inadvertently while swimming and seems not to care.
column2: 一种双足的两栖宝可梦。不太聪明，游泳时经常不小心撞到头，却似乎并不在意。

column1: A bipedal, ape-like Pokemon. Rillaboom always carries its signature drum with it on its back, and pulls it out when engaged in battle. By drumming, Rillaboom can tap into the power of its special tree stump.
column2: 两足类猿宝可梦。 轰擂金刚猩总是背着它的标志性鼓，在战斗时将其拉出来。通过击鼓，轰擂金刚猩可以利用其特殊树桩的力量。

column1: A bipedal, beetle-like Pokemon. Using its horn, it throws opponents or competitors for food. It can lift and throw objects 100 times its own weight.
column2: 一种外形像甲虫的双足宝可梦。会用角抛飞敌人或争夺食物的对手。能够举起并抛出自重100倍的物体。

column1: A bipedal, bovine Pokemon. The milk that it produces is sweet and very nutritious, and can be used to heal Pokemon and ill or weary humans. It can produce over five gallons of milk per day, which in turn can be turned into yogurt or enjoyed unchanged by children and adults alike.
column2: 双足牛宝可梦。它产生的牛奶甜美且营养丰富，可以用来治疗宝可梦和生病或疲倦的人。它每天可以生产超过五加仑的牛奶，这些牛奶可以转化为酸奶，或者供儿童和成人原样享用。

column1: A bipedal, bug-like Pokemon. By shaking its head and rubbing its antennae together, it is able to create a xylophonic sound that it uses to communicate.
column2: 一种外形像虫子的双足宝可梦。会通过摇头并摩擦触角，发出木琴般的声音来交流。

column1: A bipedal, chicken-like Pokemon. Its flames burn more intensely when it faces stronger opponents. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
column2: 一只像鸡一样的双足宝可梦。面对更强的对手时，它的火焰会燃烧得更猛烈。每隔几年，它的旧羽毛就会被烧掉，新的、柔软的羽毛会重新长出来。

column1: A bipedal, chicken-like Pokemon. While it is fighting, it is noisy and produces sharp cries that distract and intimidate its opponent.
column2: 一种外形像鸡的双足宝可梦。战斗时会制造噪音和发出尖叫，分散对手注意力并进行威吓。

column1: A bipedal, draconian Pokemon. Garchomp can fly at an incredible speed, helped by the fine scales on its body that reduce drag to catch its prey.
column2: 一种双足龙形宝可梦。烈咬陆鲨身上细密的鳞片能够减少空气阻力，使它以惊人的速度飞行，追捕猎物。

column1: A bipedal, draconic Pokemon. Fights over turf often break out between it and another Fraxure. After a fight, it sharpen its tusks on river rocks, as they do not regenerate.
column2: 一种外形像龙的双足宝可梦。经常与其他斧牙龙争夺领地。战斗结束后会在河边的岩石上磨利獠牙，因为这些獠牙无法再生。

column1: A bipedal, feline Pokemon with a muscular build. Incineroar's flame belt is produced from within its body and burst from its navel and waist as its fighting spirit rises.
column2: 一只双足猫科动物宝可梦，体格肌肉发达。 炽焰咆哮虎的火焰腰带从体内产生，随着战意的升腾，从肚脐和腰部爆裂开来。

column1: A bipedal, feline Pokemon. Floragato is intelligent and dexterous. It is also mischievous and likes showing off, desiring attention and companionship from others.
column2: 一种外形像猫的双足宝可梦。蒂蕾喵聪明而灵巧，也很调皮，喜欢炫耀，渴望得到关注和陪伴。

column1: A bipedal, fox-like Pokemon. Braixen always keeps a stick in its tail, which it sets alight using its bushy tail fur. The flame from the lit twig is used for both attack and communication.
column2: 一只像狐狸一样的双足宝可梦。 长尾火狐的尾巴上总是插着一根棍子，它用浓密的尾毛点燃棍子。点燃的树枝发出的火焰可用于攻击和交流。

column1: A bipedal, fox-like Pokemon. Zoroark can create illusions that are indistinguishable from reality, deluding many people simultaneously. It is extremely protective of those it cares about and will go to any lengths to keep them safe, including risking its own life, and it can hold grudges on those who harm its loved ones.
column2: 一种外形像狐狸的双足宝可梦。索罗亚克能制造与现实无法分辨的幻觉，同时迷惑许多人。会竭尽全力保护自己珍视的对象，甚至不惜冒生命危险，并对伤害其亲友的生物记恨在心。

column1: A bipedal, ground dwelling pholidote Pokemon. Despite the weight of its ice-covered body, Alolan Sandslash is able to move swiftly by carving a path in the snow with its claws.
column2: 一种生活在地面的双足穿山甲状宝可梦。虽然冰覆盖的身体十分沉重，阿罗拉穿山王仍能用爪子在雪中开辟路径，迅速移动。

column1: A bipedal, ground dwelling pholidote Pokemon. Its claws and spikes can both break off and are shed regularly, but grow back quickly.
column2: 一种双足行走、栖息于地面的穿山甲般的宝可梦。爪子和尖刺可能折断，也会定期脱落，但很快就能重新长出。

column1: A bipedal, ground dwelling pholidote Pokemon. The steel-like covering grants it extra defense, but it is unable to curl into a ball like its desert counterpart.
column2: 一种生活在地面的双足穿山甲状宝可梦。钢铁般的外壳提供了额外的防护，但它无法像沙漠中的同类那样蜷成一团。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon that appears to be wearing a tutu. Kirlia's horns are used to amplify its psychokinetic power and distort the air around it. The distortion in the air causes scenery mirages and can cause a rip in dimensions.
column2: 一种外形像穿着芭蕾舞裙的人形双足宝可梦。奇鲁莉安的角能够增强念力并扭曲周围的空气。扭曲的空气会制造幻景，甚至可能撕裂空间维度。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon whose body resembles a flowing gown. Gardevoir is able to see the future using its psychic powers. Additionally, it is able to create small black holes, distort dimensions, and support itself without feeling the pull of gravity.
column2: 两足人形宝可梦，其身体类似于飘逸的长袍。 沙奈朵能够利用其心灵力量看到未来。此外，它还能够创造小黑洞、扭曲维度并在不感受到重力的情况下支撑自身。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon with four well-muscled arms. Machamp punches extremely fast, throwing five hundred punches a second. With only one hand, it can move a mountain.
column2: 一种有四条强壮手臂的人形双足宝可梦。怪力的出拳速度极快，每秒能打出500拳，只用一只手就能移山。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Bisharp rules over a pack of Pawniard, and fights other Bisharp to become the alpha of the pack. The loser of these fights is cast out.
column2: 一种双足人形宝可梦。劈斩司令统率着一群驹刀小兵，并与其他劈斩司令战斗，争夺族群首领的位置。落败者会被逐出族群。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Ceruledge is merciless and will do anything to win a battle. It prefers to do close-quarters combat, with a mix of sneak and surprise attacks.
column2: 一种人形双足宝可梦。苍炎刃鬼冷酷无情，为了获胜会不择手段。喜欢近身战斗，结合偷袭和突袭击败对手。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. If anyone comes by Hypno, it will hypnotize them and eat their dreams. While it awaits its prey, it polishes its pendulum.
column2: 一种双足人形宝可梦。只要有人从引梦貘人身边经过，它就会将对方催眠并吃掉其梦境。等待猎物时，它会擦亮自己的钟摆。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. It is driven to throw larger opponents and will always try to do so.
column2: 一种人形双足宝可梦。总是渴望击败比自己更大的对手，并不断为此努力。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Mr. Rime is highly skilled in tap dancing and waves its ice cane while it moves gracefully. It can release psychic powers through the pattern on its belly.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。 踏冰人偶踢踏舞技术精湛，挥动冰杖动作优雅。它可以通过腹部的花纹释放出精神力。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Sawk is found secluded in the mountains where it trains to increase its strength. It becomes angered if it is interrupted while training.
column2: 一种人形双足宝可梦。打击鬼栖息在偏僻的山中，不断训练以增强力量。训练被打断时就会发怒。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid legendary Pokemon with some feline features. It is said to have the most savage heart among all Pokemon, lack compassion, and strike fear into its enemy with cold, glowing eyes.
column2: 具有一些猫科动物特征的双足人形传说的宝可梦。据说宝可梦拥有最凶残的心，缺乏同情心，用冰冷发光的眼睛让敌人感到恐惧。

column1: A bipedal, insectoid Pokemon with a metallic exoskeleton. It will raise its claws and wave them around to scare off predators or foes, giving it the appearance of having three heads.
column2: 一种有着金属外骨骼的昆虫般的双足宝可梦。会举起并挥动钳子，使自己看起来像有三个头，以此吓退捕食者或敌人。

column1: A bipedal, insectoid mythical Pokemon. The powerful cannon on its back and other enhancements were apparently added as part of the bizarre modifications made to it.
column2: 一种形似昆虫的双足幻之宝可梦。背上的强力大炮和其他强化部件，显然都是在对它进行怪异改造时加装的。

column1: A bipedal, lizard-like Pokemon. Amped Form Toxtricity are known to be short-tempered and extremely confident. This form aggressively attacks anything that makes eye contact with it.
column2: 一种外形像蜥蜴的双足宝可梦。颤弦蝾螈（高调的样子）脾气急躁、极为自信，会猛烈攻击任何与它对视的生物。

column1: A bipedal, lizard-like Pokemon. Scrafty is powerful enough to kick through concrete blocks, and can also spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
column2: 类似蜥蜴的双足宝可梦。 头巾混混的力量足以踢穿混凝土块，还可以从嘴里吐出酸性液体。

column1: A bipedal, lizard-like Pokemon. Scraggy is easily engaged in battle, as it will attack any foe that so much as meets its gaze with its thick cranium.
column2: 一种外形像蜥蜴的双足宝可梦。滑滑小子很容易惹起争斗，会用厚实的头骨攻击任何与它对视的敌人。

column1: A bipedal, mammalian Pokemon with some plant-like features. When it is forced to defend itself, it relies on its shell to deflect attacks, before counterattacking with its sharp quills.
column2: 一种双足哺乳动物宝可梦，具有一些类似植物的特征。当它被迫自卫时，它会依靠外壳来偏转攻击，然后用锋利的刺进行反击。

column1: A bipedal, mammalian Pokemon. Despite having a curious nature that tends to get it in trouble, Chespin keeps an optimistic outlook and does not worry about small details.
column2: 一种双足的哺乳动物般的宝可梦。虽然哈力栗的好奇心常让它惹上麻烦，但它始终乐观，不为小事烦恼。

column1: A bipedal, mustelid-like Pokemon. In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves.
column2: 一种形似鼬科动物的双足宝可梦。战斗时，它们以流畅而连绵不绝的攻势压制对手，并为自己使出招式的速度感到自豪。

column1: A bipedal, panda Pokemon with rabbit-like features. It has dizzying, confusing, and scattering dance-like movements. These movements confuse its opponents and make it difficult for them to aim at it.
column2: 一种兼有兔子特征的双足熊猫般的宝可梦。舞蹈般的动作令人眼花缭乱、混乱失神。对手会被这些动作迷惑，难以瞄准它。

column1: A bipedal, pig-like Pokemon. There appear to be three shining pearls on its body. These pearls are used to amplify its psychic powers, which allow it to control its opponents.
column2: 一只像猪一样的双足宝可梦。它的身上似乎有三颗闪闪发光的珍珠。这些珍珠用于增强其精神力量，使其能够控制对手。

column1: A bipedal, plant-like Pokemon with a humanoid appearance. This Pokemon has a high-class nature, and punishes anyone that approaches it with evil in mind. This attitude will even be directed at its Trainer if given commands Tsareena dislikes, such as being told to use an ineffective move.
column2: 一种人形的植物般的双足宝可梦。性情高傲，会惩罚心怀恶意而接近它的生物。若训练家下达甜冷美后不喜欢的指令，例如让它使用效果不佳的招式，它也会以这种态度对待训练家。

column1: A bipedal, primate-like Pokemon. The flame on Monferno's tail has several purposes. It can be controlled to keep opponents at an ideal distance or stretched in order to make Monferno appear larger.
column2: 类似灵长类动物的双足宝可梦。 猛火猴的尾部的火焰有多种用途。可以控制它以与对手保持理想的距离，也可以拉伸它以使猛火猴显得更大。

column1: A bipedal, primate-like Pokemon. This quick Pokemon practices a unique kind of martial art that involves all of its limbs. This style uses fiery punches and kicks as well.
column2: 一种外形像灵长类动物的双足宝可梦。身手敏捷，修炼一种独特的武术，四肢都参与其中，并会使出带有火焰的拳击和踢击。

column1: A bipedal, rabbit-like Pokemon. Due to its strong core and great balance, Cinderace can unleash powerful kicks from any position. In battle, it uses artful footwork to feint and throw its opponents off.
column2: 一种形似兔子的双足宝可梦。闪焰王牌拥有强健的核心肌群和出色的平衡能力，能从任何姿势使出强力踢击。战斗时，它会用巧妙的步法佯攻，扰乱对手的判断。

column1: A bipedal, rabbit-like Pokemon. Lopunny is a timid Pokemon that will cloak its body with its ears or spring away when it senses danger.
column2: 一种外形像兔子的双足宝可梦。长耳兔胆小，察觉危险时会用耳朵遮住身体，或跳开躲避。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon that resembles a chameleon. Inteleon has many hidden capabilities. It has a long, extendable yellow membrane on its back that allows it to glide in the air and nictitating membranes that allow it to analyze for an opponent's weak point.
column2: 类似变色龙的双足爬行动物宝可梦。 千面避役有很多隐藏的功能。它的背部有一层长长的、可伸展的黄色膜，可以让它在空中滑行，而瞬膜可以让它分析对手的弱点。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon vaguely resembling Pachycephalosaurus. It longs to fly and dreams of one day being able to do so. Frustrated at its inability to fly, it leaps off cliffs and smashes its head against large rocks. This process of continually bashing its head causes it to become as hard as steel.
column2: 一种外形略像厚头龙的双足爬行动物般的宝可梦。渴望飞翔，梦想有朝一日能飞起来。因无法飞翔而沮丧时，会从悬崖跳下，用头撞击巨岩。反复撞击使头部变得像钢铁一样坚硬。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon with many scaly plates. When it finds an opponent, it dances and clangs its scales together to show its strength. This ferocious dance climaxes with a challenging war cry.
column2: 一种双足爬行动物宝可梦，具有许多鳞片。当它发现对手时，它会跳舞并让鳞片碰撞在一起以显示其力量。这场凶猛的舞蹈以富有挑战性的战吼达到高潮。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon. A fire burns at the tip of this Pokemon's slender tail, and is said that Charmander dies if its flame goes out.
column2: 一种双足的爬行动物般的宝可梦。细长尾巴的末端燃烧着火焰，据说火焰熄灭时，小火龙就会死亡。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon. Kecleon is able to change the colors of its body at will, and is known for frequently using this ability to camouflage itself.
column2: 两足爬行动物宝可梦。 变隐龙能够随意改变身体的颜色，并以经常使用这种能力来伪装自己而闻名。

column1: A bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. By collecting its psychic power in its tail, it is able to ride it like a surfboard and float in the air. While its cheek sacs are still used to store electricity, rubbing them releases a sweet aroma.
column2: 一种外形像啮齿动物的双足宝可梦。将超能力集中到尾巴后，能像踩着冲浪板一样乘着尾巴在空中漂浮。颊囊仍用于储存电力，摩擦时则会散发甜香。

column1: A bipedal, rosebud-like Pokemon. It keeps its buds closed during the cold winter, but opens them again in the spring and releases pollen.
column2: 两足行走、玫瑰花蕾状的宝可梦。它在寒冷的冬天保持花蕾闭合，但在春天再次打开并释放花粉。

column1: A bipedal, turtle-like Pokemon with a spiny shell. When prey steps onto its shell, it strikes itself with its own tail to cause an explosion. The explosion is ignited by sparks from the spikes on its shell, and released through the hole on its chest.
column2: 一种外形像乌龟、拥有带刺甲壳的双足宝可梦。猎物踩到甲壳时，会用尾巴敲击自己，引发爆炸。壳上尖刺产生的火花点燃爆炸，并从胸口的孔洞释放出去。

column1: A bipedal, weasel-like Pokemon. Weavile is devious and intelligent. It usually lives in cold, icy areas where it forms small packs. Using teamwork to take down its prey.
column2: 一只双足、类似黄鼠狼的宝可梦。 玛狃拉狡猾而聪明。它通常生活在寒冷、冰冷的地区，在那里形成小群。通过团队合作来消灭猎物。

column1: A bipedial legendary Pokemon. It has been referred to as the "King of Bountiful Harvests" due to its role in bringing lush vegetation and harvests yearly. Calyrex's right hand can cause the land to be covered in verdant grass and blooms. The left hand of Calyrex allows it to make the fields of fruit become ripen and heavy.
column2: 一种双足的传说的宝可梦。每年带来繁茂的植被和丰收，被称为“五谷丰登之王”。蕾冠王的右手能使大地绿草如茵、繁花盛开，左手则能让田地与果园结满沉甸甸的果实。

column1: A blob-like Pokemon with a geometric shaped shell. While growing inside, Dottler uses its shell to examine its environment, using its psychic powers to keep itself protected and gather information about its habitat until it evolves.
column2: 一种团块状宝可梦，拥有几何形状的外壳。天罩虫在壳内成长时，会借助外壳观察环境，用超能力保护自己，并在进化前持续收集栖息地的信息。

column1: A boulder Pokemon with arms. It is often stepped on, and will sometimes swing its arms in anger when this occurs.
column2: 一种外形像长着手臂的巨石的宝可梦。经常被踩到，有时会因此愤怒地挥动手臂。

column1: A bovine, quadruped legendary Pokemon. It is strong enough to destroy a castle wall in one blow.
column2: 一种牛形的四足传说的宝可梦，力量足以一击摧毁城墙。

column1: A bulky quadruped Pokemon resembling a tortoise. Torterra's large and clean shell supports the lives of many small Pokemon, which occasionally gather and build their nests upon the shell. Some are born and spend their entire life there.
column2: 一种体形庞大、外形像乌龟的四足宝可梦。土台龟宽大而洁净的甲壳为许多小型宝可梦提供了栖息地，它们有时会聚集在壳上筑巢，有的甚至在那里出生并度过一生。

column1: A bulky, bipedal Pokemon with pig-like features. Using the wreath of flames on its neck and shoulders, Emboar will set its hands on fire.
column2: 一种体格粗壮、具有猪类特征的双足宝可梦。炎武王会用环绕颈部和肩膀的火焰点燃自己的双手。

column1: A bulky, bipedal canine legendary Pokemon. Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
column2: 一种身材壮硕、外形像犬的双足传说的宝可梦。够赞狗脾气暴躁，性情粗野，挥舞脖子上的锁链就能粉碎任何东西。

column1: A bulky, bipedal toad-like Pokemon. The various lumps on its body have varying capabilities. The ones on its head can shoot a paralyzing liquid, while the ones on its hands can be vibrated to increase its punching power.
column2: 一只巨大的双足蟾蜍宝可梦。它身上的各个肿块有着不同的能力。头上的可以发射麻痹液体，手上的则可以振动以增强出拳威力。

column1: A butterfly-like Pokemon with wings that come in a large variety of patterns. Its wing's pattern is affected by the climate in which it lives and can spread its scales to calm an opponents fighting spirit.
column2: 一种翅膀具有多种花纹的蝴蝶般的宝可梦。翅膀花纹取决于栖息地的气候，能散播鳞粉平息对手的斗志。

column1: A cactus-like Pokemon, with large ear-like extensions. When Maractus moves its body rhythmically, it emits sounds reminiscent of maracas being played. This allows Maractus to produce up-tempo songs and dances that it can use to scare away predators.
column2: 一种形似仙人掌的宝可梦，长着耳朵般的大型突出物。沙铃仙人掌有节奏地摆动身体时，会发出类似沙锤的声音。它以轻快的歌声和舞蹈吓退捕食者。

column1: A canine Pokemon with a talent for rescuing people lost at sea or in the mountains. Its fur is thick enough to protect itself and others against freezing temperatures.
column2: 一种犬般的宝可梦。擅长营救在海上或山中迷路的人。厚实的皮毛足以保护自己与他人免受严寒伤害。

column1: A canine Pokemon. It is an intelligent, courageous Pokemon capable of judging its opponents strength.
column2: 一只犬宝可梦。它是一只聪明、勇敢、能够判断对手实力的宝可梦。

column1: A canine Pokemon. It uses friction from the atmosphere to generate electricity. Because of this, its body gives off showers of sparks in seasons with arid air or before a storm.
column2: 一种犬般的宝可梦。利用与大气摩擦产生电力。因此在空气干燥的季节或暴风雨来临前，身体会迸出阵阵火花。

column1: A caterpillar-like Pokemon. Sewaddle makes itself leafy clothes using chewed-up leaves and a thread-like substance it produces from its mouth.
column2: 一条像毛毛虫的宝可梦。 虫宝包使用咀嚼过的叶子和从嘴里产生的线状物质为自己制作叶子衣服。

column1: A catfish-like Pokemon. It causes earthquakes that can extend for over three miles, and can predict when natural earthquakes will occur.
column2: 一种外形像鲶鱼的宝可梦。它引发的地震能波及三英里以外，也能预测自然地震何时发生。

column1: A cephalopod-like Pokemon. In the wild, it will spurt ink at predators to protect its young from danger.
column2: 类似头足类动物的宝可梦。在野外，它会向捕食者喷射墨水，以保护幼崽免受危险。

column1: A cetacean Pokemon resembling a dolphin. It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
column2: 一种外形像海豚的鲸类宝可梦。喜欢用尾巴上的水环与同类嬉戏，能通过超声波感知其他生物的情绪。

column1: A cetacean Pokemon resembling a dolphin. Palafin is known as the "Pelagic Protector". When it hears its allies calling for help, Palafin will change its appearance from its Zero Form to its Hero Form.
column2: 一种形似海豚的鲸类宝可梦。海豚侠被称为“海洋守护者”。听见同伴呼救时，它会从平凡形态变为全能形态。

column1: A chimp-like Pokemon. It uses its stick to beat rhythmically against the surfaces of all sorts of objects. This has been observed to cause grass to grow, and wilted flowers and leaves seem to regain their color when Grookey drums nearby.
column2: 一种外形像黑猩猩的宝可梦。会用木棍有节奏地敲击各类物体的表面。人们观察到，敲音猴在附近敲击时，会使草木生长，枯萎的花叶也仿佛恢复了色彩。

column1: A circular Pokemon. Cottonee is blown around by the wind because of its lightweight composition. The only circumstance in which it cannot be blown by wind is when it has been soaked by rain, which weighs it down and makes it soggy.
column2: 一种圆形宝可梦。木棉球的身体很轻，会被风吹得到处飘动。只有被雨水浸湿、变得湿重时，它才不会被风吹走。

column1: A cocoon Pokemon. When it comes close to evolving, its body gives off heat that makes it warm to the touch.
column2: 一种茧般的宝可梦。临近进化时身体会散发热量，摸起来暖暖的。

column1: A cocoon-like Pokemon. It is covered in silk which hardens into a tough cocoon that is able to endure attacks, and this Pokemon will not move even when it is attacked. However, it never forgets the pain it endures and seek revenge upon evolution.
column2: 一种形似茧的宝可梦。包裹身体的丝会硬化成坚韧的茧，能够承受攻击。即使遭受攻击，它也不会移动。不过它绝不会忘记承受过的痛苦，进化后会寻求报复。

column1: A composite Pokemon sharing physical traits of aquatic and land animals. It has a cell composition similar to water molecules. This structure allows Vaporeon to melt into water at will and keeps it camouflaged as it swims.
column2: 一种兼具水生与陆生动物特征的宝可梦。细胞结构类似水分子，使水伊布能随意融入水中，在游泳时隐藏身形。

column1: A coned flower Pokemon. It can latch onto walls to disguise itself as a plant. Should Glimmora sense danger, it will open all its petals to unleash a beam attack in retaliation.
column2: 锥形花宝可梦。它可以粘在墙上，将自己伪装成植物。如果晶光花感觉到危险，它会张开所有花瓣，释放光束攻击进行报复。

column1: A coral-like Pokemon with an ectoplasmic "body". This ectoplasm was a result of a long and continuous process absorbing spirit energy from other creatures. Anyone who touches it will rapidly stiffen.
column2: 一种外形像珊瑚、具有灵质“身体”的宝可梦。这些灵质由长期不断吸收其他生物的灵力形成。接触它的生物会迅速僵硬。

column1: A cross between a Zuniceratops and a bulldozer. If a herd of Bastiodon is attacked, the adults will line up in a wall around their young. Their rock-hard heads can repulse any attack.
column2: 一种外形兼具祖尼角龙和推土机特征的宝可梦。护城龙群遭到袭击时，成年个体会在幼体周围排成一道墙。坚如岩石的头部能够抵挡任何攻击。

column1: A crow-like, avian Pokemon. Corvisquire are intelligent enough to use tools in battle, having been seen to throw rocks at their opponents or use vines to entangle them.
column2: 一种外形像乌鸦的鸟类宝可梦。蓝鸦聪明到会在战斗中使用工具，曾被观察到向对手投石，或用藤蔓缠住对手。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon resembling a crab. While Kingler's large, left claw is it main tool for offensive maneuvers, it is so large and heavy that Kingler can barely lift it.
column2: 类似螃蟹的甲壳类动物宝可梦。虽然巨钳蟹的大型左爪是其进攻机动的主要工具，但它又大又重，巨钳蟹几乎无法举起它。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon resembling both a horsehair crab and the mythical yeti. It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
column2: 一种既像毛蟹又像传说中雪人的甲壳动物般的宝可梦。只会不分对象地挥拳。陷入绝境时，会卸下自己的钳子，像火箭一样发射出去。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon. A hardy creature, Corphish is able to live in polluted water and eat nearly anything.
column2: 一种甲壳类宝可梦。龙虾小兵的生命力很顽强，能够在受污染的水中生存，而且几乎什么都吃。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon. Because of its constant challenges to battle, no other Pokemon wants to inhabit its territory. Any that do venture too close are tossed out of its pond with its pincers.
column2: 一种甲壳动物般的宝可梦。由于它总是向其他宝可梦发起战斗挑战，没有其他宝可梦愿意栖息在它的领地。冒险靠得太近的生物会被它用钳子扔出池塘。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon. Klawf hangs upside-down from the sheer cliffs on which it lives in order to ambush its prey from above; however, it can't stay in this position for too long as its blood will rush to its head, causing it to get dizzy.
column2: 甲壳类动物宝可梦。 毛崖蟹倒挂在它所居住的悬崖上，以便从上方伏击猎物；不过这个姿势不能保持太久，因为血液会冲到头部，导致头晕。

column1: A crystal plant-like Pokemon. Glimmet's diet consists of absorbing minerals from the walls of caves. To defend itself from foes, Glimmet scatters poisonous powder from its petals.
column2: 一种水晶植物般的宝可梦。晶光芽以洞穴岩壁中的矿物质为食。防御敌人时，会从花瓣中散播有毒的粉末。

column1: A deer-like Pokemon. Sawsbuck lives in herds led by the Sawsbuck with the most splendid antlers. It can live almost anywhere as they adapt to the season.
column2: 一种形似鹿的宝可梦。萌芽鹿群由拥有最华丽鹿角的个体领导。它们能够适应季节变化，因此几乎在任何地方都能生活。

column1: A dinosaur-like Pokemon resembling the Pachycephalosaurus. When it lived in dense forests and jungles 100 million years ago, it would use headbutts to snap obstructing trees and down its prey.
column2: 一种外形像厚头龙的恐龙般的宝可梦。一亿年前生活在茂密的森林和丛林中，会用头撞断挡路的树木，并撞倒猎物。

column1: A dog-like Pokemon similar to a poodle. This Pokemon's furry coat cushions it against physical attacks. Some domesticated Furfrou are commonly seen with their fur trimmed into various styles.
column2: 一种形似贵宾犬的犬形宝可梦。身上厚实的毛皮能够缓冲物理攻击。部分驯养的多丽米亚常被修剪成各种毛型。

column1: A doll-like Pokemon that is possessed by pure hatred. Being driven to life by a powerful grudge, it keeps its life force safely in its body by the means of its zipped up mouth. If unzipped, it would lose its energy.
column2: 一种充满憎恨的玩偶般的宝可梦。强烈的怨念让它活了过来，拉上拉链的嘴巴将生命力封存在体内。一旦拉链打开，就会失去能量。

column1: A draconic, bipedal Pokemon. Despite its bulky build, Dragonite is capable of flying faster than the speed of sound. It can circle the globe in sixteen hours, traveling roughly 1,556 mph (2,505 km/h), or about three times the speed of an average airplane.
column2: 龙类、双足宝可梦。尽管其体积庞大，快龙的飞行速度仍能超过音速。它可以在 16 小时内绕地球一圈，飞行速度约为 1,556 英里/小时（2,505 公里/小时），大约是普通飞机速度的三倍。

column1: A draconic, bipedal Pokemon. This Pokemon flies in search of powerful opponents to battle, and its fire will burn hotter as it gains experience. Its fiery breath is capable of melting boulders, massive glaciers, and has been known to accidentally cause forest fires.
column2: 一种龙般的双足宝可梦。会飞行寻找强大的对手挑战，随着经验积累，火焰会燃烧得更加炽热。喷出的火焰足以熔化巨岩和庞大的冰川，也曾不慎引发森林火灾。

column1: A dragonfly-like Pokemon. Vibrava's wings are not fully developed, so it is unable to fly very far. However, it is able to create vibrations and ultrasonic waves with its wings.
column2: 类似蜻蜓的宝可梦。 超音波幼虫的翅膀尚未发育完全，因此无法飞很远。然而，它能够用翅膀产生振动和超声波。

column1: A duck-like Pokemon. Quaxwell has a serious, stoic personality. It learns and practices dance routines by observing the movements of people and Pokemon from various regions.
column2: 一种外形像鸭子的宝可梦。涌跃鸭认真而沉稳，会观察不同地区的人与宝可梦的动作，学习并练习舞步。

column1: A duckling-like Pokemon. Quaxly is an earnest and tidy Pokemon, and tends to overthink things. It hates getting itself dirty, especially on its head.
column2: 像小鸭一样的宝可梦。 润水鸭是认真整洁的宝可梦，并且容易想太多。它讨厌把自己弄脏，尤其是头上。

column1: A electric golem-like legendary Pokemon. Regieleki absorbs electrons in order to stay alive and is said to have the greatest power of any Electric-type Pokemon.
column2: 一种电气魔像般的传说的宝可梦。雷吉艾勒奇通过吸收电子维持生命，据说拥有所有电属性宝可梦中最强的力量。

column1: A fawn-like Pokemon, most resembling a fallow deer. It can change in appearance with the changing of the seasons. If it senses animosity, it hides in tall grass.
column2: 一种形似幼鹿的宝可梦，尤其像黇鹿。它的外观会随季节变化。察觉敌意时，会躲进高草丛中。

column1: A feline Pokemon with a slender physique. Glameow tends to be spiteful and fickle, having a tendency to hook its claws into the nose of its owner if its not fed. When its happy, it demonstrates movements with its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
column2: 一种身材纤细的猫般的宝可梦。魅力喵性情凶狠而善变，没有得到食物时，会用爪子钩住主人的鼻子。高兴时则会挥动尾巴，像一条飘舞的丝带。

column1: A feline Pokemon. Purrloin is a mischievous Pokemon that likes to steal from people. It will put on a cute act in order to get its victims to let its guard down.
column2: 猫科动物宝可梦。 扒手猫是一只淘气的宝可梦，喜欢偷东西。它会做出可爱的举动来让受害者放松警惕。

column1: A feline legendary Pokemon. Chien-Pao is able to control 100 tons of fallen snow, causing avalanches and playing around in them innocently.
column2: 一种猫般的传说的宝可梦。古剑豹能够操纵100吨积雪，引发雪崩，并天真无邪地在其中嬉戏。

column1: A femininely anthropomorphic mythical Pokemon. Meloetta's beautiful music and dance inspired many works of art, music, and songs. This made the Pokemon popular among both musicians and dancers.
column2: 一种拥有女性人形外貌的幻之宝可梦。美洛耶塔优美的音乐和舞蹈启发了许多艺术作品、乐曲和歌曲，因此深受音乐家和舞者喜爱。

column1: A firefly-like, bipedal Pokemon. Illumise uses its sweet aromas to lure in Volbeat and have them draw geometric patterns in the sky. It is said to earn respect from others by composing designs that are more complex.
column2: 一种外形像萤火虫的双足宝可梦。甜甜萤会用甜香吸引电萤虫，让它们在天空中画出几何图案。据说图案越复杂，就越能赢得同类的尊敬。

column1: A fish Pokemon with a body covered in tiny, sharp denticles. It swarms any intruder and prey that invade its territory, and becomes timid when it is alone.
column2: 一种鱼类宝可梦，身体覆盖着细小而锋利的齿状鳞片。它会成群围攻闯入领地的入侵者和猎物，独处时却很胆怯。

column1: A fish Pokemon. Both forms of Basculin are extremely hostile, especially towards their opposite form. Red and blue striped Basculin generally start fighting each other on sight.
column2: 一种鱼类宝可梦。野蛮鲈鱼的两种样子都极为凶狠，尤其敌视另一种样子。红条纹与蓝条纹的野蛮鲈鱼通常一碰面就会打起来。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon with a heart-shaped body. If it finds an injured Pokemon floating at sea, Alomomola will heal the Pokemon's wounds and carry it back to shore. It heals Pokemon using its special membrane enveloping its entire body.
column2: 一条像鱼一样的宝可梦，有着心形的身体。如果它发现海上漂浮着受伤的宝可梦，保姆曼波会治愈宝可梦的伤口并将其带回岸上。它使用包裹整个身体的特殊膜来治愈宝可梦。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon with a relatively flat body in the shape of a heart. Loving couples gave this Pokemon its name after spotting it in the ocean waters.
column2: 一种身体较扁平、呈心形的鱼般的宝可梦。相爱的情侣在海中发现它后，为它取了这个名字。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon. It has a wild temperament, and will use its horn to smash its way to freedom if kept in an aquarium. Humans swimming near it must exercise caution lest Goldeen ram them.
column2: 一种鱼形宝可梦，性情凶猛。如果被关在水族箱里，它会用角撞开阻碍，争取自由。在附近游泳的人必须当心角金鱼的冲撞。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon. Lumineon attracts its own prey by using the patterning on its wing-like fins, and typically competes with Lanturn for food.
column2: 一种鱼般的宝可梦。霓虹鱼会用翅膀般的鱼鳍上的花纹吸引猎物，经常与电灯怪争夺食物。

column1: A fish-like legendary Pokemon. Its body is a form it has constructed using its control over fire. Chi-Yu's flames burn at over 5,400 degrees F (3000 C, 15368 U), allowing it to melt rock and sand into lava that it can swim through.
column2: 一种鱼形传说的宝可梦。它利用操控火焰的能力构成了自己的身体。古玉鱼的火焰温度超过5400°F（3000°C，15368 U），能够将岩石和沙子熔成熔岩，并在其中游动。

column1: A fishlike Pokemon. Veluza's main method of hunting comes from its ability to shed its own flesh. This boosts its offensive prowess and psychic power, as well as its agility, giving it an easier time when chasing down and tearing apart prey.
column2: 一种鱼般的宝可梦。轻身鳕主要依靠舍弃自身肉体的能力捕猎。这会增强它的攻击力、超能力及敏捷性，使它更容易追上并撕裂猎物。

column1: A flat, circular Pokemon. A crest resembling an herb or branch is on its back. This crest is said to possess a mysterious power.
column2: 扁平圆形宝可梦。它的背上有一个类似药草或树枝的冠。据说这个纹章拥有神秘的力量。

column1: A flat, fish-like Pokemon with a broad body. Galarian Stunfisk leaves its red and white mouth, which looks similar to a Poke Ball, visible to lure in prey and then slams its fins shut on them so they cannot escape.
column2: 一种身体宽大而扁平的鱼般的宝可梦。泥巴鱼（伽勒尔的样子）会露出红白相间、酷似精灵球的嘴巴，引诱猎物靠近，再猛地合上鱼鳍，将其困住。

column1: A flat, thin Pokemon shaped like an eye with appendages that make it resemble a letter or a punctuation mark.
column2: 扁平、薄的宝可梦形状像一只眼睛，带有附属物，使其类似于字母或标点符号。

column1: A flying cloud turtle and snake hybrid legendary Pokemon. Enamorus's love was said to have given rise to fresh life. However, it's also known to be vengeful to those who disrespect any form of life. It will descend from the clouds and deliver a wrathful, ruthless punishment in the process.
column2: 一种在云中飞行、外形像龟与蛇混合体的传说的宝可梦。据说眷恋云的爱孕育了新的生命，但它也会向轻视任何生命的生物复仇，从云中降下，施以愤怒而无情的惩罚。

column1: A fox-like Pokemon. Hisuian Zorua retains its ability to cast illusions, but accomplishes this by constantly unleashing its spiteful power of malice through its ghostly fur, specifically atop of its head. This power comes from Hisuian Zorua's own resentment of everything.
column2: 一种狐形宝可梦。洗翠索罗亚仍能制造幻象，但它是通过幽灵般的毛发，尤其是头顶的毛发，不断释放充满恶意的怨念力量来实现。这种力量来自它对万事万物的怨恨。

column1: A fox-like Pokemon. Zorua keeps its true form hidden to ensure its safety, and takes on the appearance of other Pokemon to frighten off enemies. Sometimes it will take the form of a silent child.
column2: 一种狐狸般的宝可梦。索罗亚会隐藏真实样子以保障安全，变成其他宝可梦的外形来吓退敌人。有时也会化作沉默的孩子。

column1: A fox-like, quadruped Pokemon. Ninetales is a very vengeful Pokemon that has been known to curse those who mistreat it. This intelligent Pokemon is able to understand human speech easily.
column2: 一只类似狐狸的四足动物宝可梦。 九尾是一只复仇心极强的宝可梦，众所周知，它会诅咒那些虐待它的人。这种智能宝可梦能够轻松理解人类语音。

column1: A free-form blob with vestigial facial features. It is capable of transforming into an exact replica of any physical object. However, if Ditto tries to transform into something based on memory, it may get some of the details wrong.
column2: 一种带有简单面部特征、形状不定的团块。能变成任何实体物品的精确复制品，但百变怪若仅凭记忆变身，就可能弄错部分细节。

column1: A furry chinchilla-like Pokemon. Its tail acts like a broom as Minccino uses it to clean its den. It also brushes another Minccino with its tail to greet it.
column2: 毛茸茸的龙猫状宝可梦。当泡沫栗鼠用它来清洁它的巢穴时，它的尾巴就像一把扫帚。它还用尾巴拂过另一只泡沫栗鼠来迎接它。

column1: A fuzzy, moth larva-like Pokemon. There are five slightly whorled horns on the sides of its head, which it can use to spit fire as a defensive tactic to deter predators. It has been seen using fire it spits from these horns to fly.
column2: 一种外形像毛茸茸的蛾幼虫的宝可梦。头部两侧共有五只微弯的角，能从中喷火驱退捕食者。曾有人见到它利用角中喷出的火焰飞行。

column1: A ghost-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling a giant Misdreavus, albeit a highly fierce and aggressive one. It is said to float around the sky at night with its long hair writhing about it.
column2: 幽灵般的宝可梦。一种类似于巨型梦妖的神秘生命体，但非常凶猛且具有攻击性。据说它在夜间漂浮在天空中，长发在其周围翻滚。

column1: A ghost-like Pokemon. It spends its days sleeping in darkness and its nights startling people with mischievous tricks.
column2: 一种幽灵般的宝可梦。白天睡在阴暗处，夜晚用恶作剧吓人。

column1: A giant piscine Pokemon. Although powerful, Dondozo is dull and not very good at hunting, so it teams up with Tatsugiri to catch prey.
column2: 一条巨型鱼宝可梦。虽然力量强大，但吃吼霸性格迟钝，不太擅长狩猎，所以它与米立龙联手捕捉猎物。

column1: A gigantic, draconic alien legendary Pokemon. Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokemon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.
column2: 一种巨大的外星龙般的传说的宝可梦。无限的能量从扩大的核心中涌出，扭曲周围的时空。

column1: A gooey Pokemon with the body structure of a snail. It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything.
column2: 具有蜗牛身体结构的粘稠宝可梦。它通过排出一种可以溶解任何东西的粘稠液体来驱赶对手。

column1: A gooey Pokemon with the body structure of a snail. When it wants to move quickly, it will tuck its entire body into its shell, position the shell vertical to the ground, and roll itself away. It can also use its shell to float on water.
column2: 一种身体像蜗牛般黏滑的宝可梦。想要快速移动时，会将整个身体缩进壳内，竖起外壳滚动前进，也能借助外壳漂浮在水面上。

column1: A hoofed quadruped Pokemon with a long neck. Girafarig's tail possesses a head of its own. However, this head is incapable of independent thinking and relies on outside stimuli such as smell to guide its actions.
column2: 一种脖子很长的有蹄四足宝可梦。麒麟奇的尾巴上也长着一个头，但这个头不能独立思考，只能依靠气味等外界刺激来支配行动。

column1: A huge Pokemon based on the blue whale. When it is jumping out of the water, it makes a giant splash due to its large size. It can dive deep at 10,000 feet (3,000 meters) in one breath.
column2: 一种以蓝鲸为原型的巨大宝可梦。跃出水面时，庞大的体形会溅起巨大的水花。能一口气潜到10000英尺（3000米）深处。

column1: A huge, bipedal Pokemon. The gouges in Aggron's armor from previous battles are worn as mementos. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled.
column2: 一种巨大的双足宝可梦。波士可多拉把盔甲上过往战斗留下的伤痕当作纪念。伤痕越多，说明它经历的战斗越多。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon resembling a fish. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.
column2: 一种外形兼有鱼类特征的人形宝可梦。据说它产生的纯净水能够洗去一切污秽。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon said to have been born from burnt charcoal. Charcadet has a fiery fighting spirit, and will battle opponents tougher than itself. When it fights, its firepower increases, reaching temperatures of over 11768 U (1800 F, 1000 C).
column2: 据说是从烧焦的木炭中诞生的人形生物宝可梦。 炭小侍拥有火热的斗志，会与比自己更强硬的对手战斗。当它战斗时，它的火力会增强，温度可达 11768 U（1800°F，1000°C）以上。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon whose appearance resembles a samurai. Kingambit has a battle-hungry disposition, and will not stop until it gets what it desires. It is flawed at devising complex strategies, but is still extremely powerful.
column2: 一种外形像武士的人形宝可梦。仆刀将军生性好战，不达目的绝不罢休。虽然不擅长制定复杂策略，但依然十分强大。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon with a shell that resembles a bug. Its known to scatter glowing scales, which affect others by stimulating and healing their bodies; however, these scales are also dangerous if too many are touched at once.
column2: 具有类似虫子外壳的人形宝可梦。众所周知，它会散布发光的鳞片，通过刺激和治愈他人的身体来影响他人；然而，如果同时接触太多鳞片，这些鳞片也会很危险。
