column1: A humanoid Pokemon with an ovoid body. Hitmonlee's legs freely contract and stretch similar to a coiled spring. This flexibility allows Hitmonlee to run with lengthy strides and gives it greater reach for its kicks.
column2: 一种身体呈卵形的人形宝可梦。飞腿郎的腿能像螺旋弹簧般自由伸缩，使它能够大步奔跑，并扩大踢击范围。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Alakazam is able to use all forms of psychic abilities. These powers are used to move its body, as opposed to its weak muscles. It also uses its psychic powers to hold up its head, which is too heavy to be supported by its neck, due to its continually growing brain.
column2: 人形宝可梦。 胡地能够使用所有形式的心灵能力。这些力量用于移动其身体，而不是其薄弱的肌肉。它还利用其精神力量来支撑其头部，由于其不断生长的大脑，头部太重而无法由颈部支撑。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Electivire is known to be recklessly careless regarding enemy attacks. It uses its tails to make contact with its opponents, and shocks them with over 20,000 volts.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。电击魔兽以不顾敌人的攻击、鲁莽进攻而著称。会用尾巴接触对手，再以超过20000伏的电压将其电击。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Grimmsnarl's hair works like muscle fibers and helps enhance its strength. Grimmsnarl is able to move its hair, and uses them to ensnare opponents in a tentacle-like fashion.
column2: 人形宝可梦。 长毛巨魔的头发的作用类似于肌肉纤维，有助于增强其强度。 长毛巨魔能够移动自己的毛发，并利用它们以触手般的方式诱捕对手。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. It is able to throw punches too quick to be seen with the naked eye. By punching with a corkscrew motion, it is even capable of drilling through concrete.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。出拳速度快到肉眼无法看清，螺旋式出拳甚至能够钻穿混凝土。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Kadabra emits alpha waves strong enough to induce headaches, and can even cause clocks to run backwards, machines to malfunction, and delicate devices to cease functioning altogether. When it has a headache, the alpha waves become unusual.
column2: 人形宝可梦。 勇基拉发出的阿尔法波强度足以引起头痛，甚至可能导致时钟倒转、机器故障和精密设备完全停止运行。当它头痛时，α波就会变得异常。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Ralts uses its horns to read people and Pokemon's emotions. Warm feelings cause its body to warm as well, but it hides if it senses hostility.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。拉鲁拉丝会用角感知人类与宝可梦的情绪。温暖的情绪也会让它的身体变暖，察觉敌意时则会躲起来。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Tinkatuff carries a large, gray, crude yet sturdy hammer, with loose metal plates for the hammer head and what appears to be the old hammer Tinkatuff had as a Tinkatink on top of the shaft.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。巧锻匠携带着一柄巨大、灰色、粗糙却结实的锤子。锤头由松散的金属板组成，而柄的顶端似乎装着它还是小锻匠时用过的旧锤子。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Tyrogue is famous for its eagerness to compete and boundless energy, to such an extent that it will challenge anyone, even larger foes. Determined to make itself stronger, Tyrogue will not quit no matter how many times it loses.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。无畏小子以强烈的竞争心和无穷精力著称，会挑战任何对手，哪怕对方比自己更大。它一心想变强，无论输多少次都不会放弃。

column1: A humanoid legendary Pokemon. It fights by confusing its opponents with its nimble movements and kicks, and it draws type-based energy from its masks, imbuing its cudgel with different elements.
column2: 一种人形传说的宝可梦。它用灵巧的动作和踢击迷惑对手，并从面具中汲取相应属性的能量，为棍棒赋予不同的元素力量。

column1: A humanoid like Pokemon. Florges claims well-tended flower gardens as its territory, and it basks in energy emitted from flowers to obtain power.
column2: 一种人形宝可梦。花洁夫人将精心照料的花园作为领地，沐浴在花朵释放的能量中，从而获取力量。

column1: A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a person meditating. Meditite heightens its inner energy and spiritual power through meditation, which allows it to levitate. It trains hours a day, and never skips its daily yoga training.
column2: 人形双足宝可梦，类似于正在冥想的人。 玛沙那通过冥想增强其内在能量和精神力量，使其悬浮。它每天训练几个小时，并且从不跳过日常瑜伽训练。

column1: A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a scarecrow made of cacti. Cacturne is a nocturnal Pokemon that rarely moves during the day, which allows it to hold moisture. At night, it searches for prey or follows travelers until they become exhausted.
column2: 一种外形像仙人掌制成的稻草人的人形双足宝可梦。梦歌仙人掌夜间活动，白天很少移动，以此保存水分。夜里会寻找猎物，或跟踪旅行者，直到对方精疲力竭。

column1: A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon. Machop's entire body is covered with muscles that will never tire or cramp. With these muscles, it can lift many times its own body weight.
column2: 一种双足人形宝可梦。腕力全身都是不会疲劳或抽筋的肌肉，凭借这些肌肉，它能够举起自身重量数倍的重物。

column1: A humanoid, rabbit-like Pokemon. Due to its thick and fluffy fur, Raboot is protected from the cold and can use hotter fire moves. Raboot usually practices its footwork by kicking berries from a tree's branches and then juggling them with its feet.
column2: 一种人形兔子般的宝可梦。厚实蓬松的毛皮使腾蹴小将能够抵御寒冷，并使出温度更高的火属性招式。它常将树枝上的树果踢下来，再用脚颠耍，练习脚法。

column1: A hybrid fossil Pokemon. Dracovish is said to have been the apex predator of its time due to its powerful legs and jaws, and the ability to run at speeds exceeding 40 mph (60 km/h).
column2: 混合化石宝可梦。据说鳃鱼龙因其强大的腿和下巴而成为当时的顶级掠食者，并且能够以超过 40 英里/小时（60 公里/小时）的速度奔跑。

column1: A hybrid fossil Pokemon. In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
column2: 一种由不同化石拼合而成的宝可梦。古代凭借强大的下半身所向无敌，但耗尽所有植物性食物来源后，还是灭绝了。

column1: A insectoid Pokemon with a steel body. Durant is extremely territorial. It only lives in colonies and digs mazes underground designed to be as complicated as possible. It grows steel armor to protect itself from its natural predator, Heatmor.
column2: 一种拥有钢铁身体的昆虫状宝可梦。铁蚁的领地意识极强，只在群体中生活，会在地下挖掘尽可能复杂的迷宫。它长出钢铁铠甲，保护自己免受天敌熔蚁兽的侵害。

column1: A jellyfish-like Pokemon resembling young royalty. It gently floats around in waves until it can strike its prey. It makes its victim numb with the use of its poison and takes it to its deep den.
column2: 一种外形像年幼王族的水母般的宝可梦。轻轻随波漂浮，等待攻击猎物的时机。会用毒液使猎物麻痹，再将其带到深处的巢穴。

column1: A large Pokemon resembling an orangutan. This solitary Pokemon spends its time deep in the forest, meditating high up in the trees. While it is not normally active, it will provide food to hungry Pokemon and give medicine to injured ones.
column2: 一种形似猩猩的大型宝可梦。它喜欢独居，常在森林深处的高树上冥想。虽然平时不怎么活动，但会为饥饿的宝可梦提供食物，也会给受伤的宝可梦药物。

column1: A large Pokemon that resembles a mud statue. Its arms are not attached to its body, but are usually kept floating close by Claydol's psychic powers. Claydol uses the same telekinetic abilities to move and float through the air.
column2: 一种外形像泥塑的大型宝可梦。手臂并未连在身体上，而是由念力土偶的超能力维持在身边悬浮。它也用同样的念力在空中移动和漂浮。

column1: A large Pokemon that resembles a plesiosaur. Lapras is a gentle, helpful Pokemon that enjoys ferrying people across bodies of water.
column2: 类似于蛇颈龙的大型宝可梦。 拉普拉斯是一只温柔、乐于助人的宝可梦，喜欢载人穿越水域。

column1: A large Pokemon wrapped in vines. When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.
column2: 一种被藤蔓包裹的大型宝可梦。静止时像一丛巨大的灌木，毫无防备的猎物靠近时，就会被藤蔓缠住。

column1: A large Pokmon resembling a turtle. Drednaw's sharp jagged fangs are powerful enough to chomp on rock, iron, and steel rods. It can move very fast despite how extremely heavy the shell on its back is.
column2: 一种形似乌龟的大型宝可梦。暴噬龟锋利的锯齿状獠牙能够咬碎岩石、铁块和钢棒。虽然背壳极其沉重，移动速度仍然很快。

column1: A large avian Pokemon resembling a raven. Corviknight's feathers are tempered with steel. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
column2: 一种外形像乌鸦的大型鸟类宝可梦。钢铠鸦的羽毛如经淬炼的钢铁。钢铁身体的黑色光泽能让任何敌人恐惧。

column1: A large avian Pokemon. Kilowattrel uses its throat sac to store the electricity that its wings generate, and can inflate the sac in order to amplify this electricity. When inflated, Kilowattrel's throat sac glows like a light bulb.
column2: 大型鸟类宝可梦。 大电海燕使用其喉囊来储存其翅膀产生的电力，并且可以使喉囊膨胀以放大该电力。充气时，大电海燕的喉囊会像灯泡一样发光。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. Belligerent by nature and ever thirsting for battle, Galarian Zapdos seeks out opponents stronger than itself so it could test its might. Its powerful legs allow it to perform devastating kicks capable of destroying a dump truck, and it can run across mountains at up to 180 mph (290 kph).
column2: 一种大型鸟类传说的宝可梦。闪电鸟（伽勒尔的样子）好战，总是寻找比自己更强的对手来试验力量。强健的腿能踢出足以摧毁自卸卡车的一击，也能让它以每小时180英里（290公里）的速度穿越群山。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. Galarian Moltres attacks by spreading its wings wide to unleash its energy in a powerful aura that attacks the minds of its foes, inflicting deep fatigue as it burns away their energy from within. The aura has the power to consume the spirit of its victims, reducing them to burned-out shadows of themselves.
column2: 一种大型鸟类传说的宝可梦。伽勒尔火焰鸟会展开双翼，释放强大的气场攻击敌人的心智，从内部消耗敌人的能量，使其极度疲惫。这种气场能够吞噬受害者的精神，使其变得毫无生气。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. Moltres sheds embers with every flap of its wings, creating a brilliant flash of flames. By dipping itself into the magma of an active volcano, this Pokemon can heal itself.
column2: 一种大型鸟类传说的宝可梦。火焰鸟每次扇动翅膀都会洒落余烬，产生绚丽的火光。将身体浸入活火山的岩浆，就能治愈自己。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. When Zapdos flaps its glittering wings, it releases electricity that can potentially cause thunderstorms. It produces massive crackling and snapping sounds when it flies; these are attributed to the lightning bolts it sheds when airborne.
column2: 一种大型鸟类传说的宝可梦。闪电鸟拍动闪闪发光的双翼时，会释放电流，甚至引发雷暴。飞行时会发出巨大的噼啪声，那是它在空中释放闪电造成的。

column1: A large bat-like Pokemon with enormous ears suited for precise hearing. From its ears, Noivern releases ultrasonic waves, which can be strong enough to shatter a large boulder. It uses these waves to freely navigate through darkness, allowing it to easily ambush prey under cover of night.
column2: 一种有着巨大耳朵、听觉敏锐的蝙蝠般的大型宝可梦。音波龙能从耳中发出足以粉碎巨岩的超声波，借此在黑暗中自由行动，并利用夜色轻松伏击猎物。

column1: A large bird Pokemon. An impressive dive-bomber, it will never miss its target. Additionally, it takes great pride in its glossy plumage, and often cleans the wings of other Swellow.
column2: 一种大型鸟类宝可梦。它擅长俯冲攻击，从不失手。它为光泽亮丽的羽毛感到自豪，也常常清理其他大王燕的翅膀。

column1: A large cetacean Pokemon. Cetitan can use echolocation to find and communicate with others of its kind through sound waves. The sound Cetitan makes is said to be similar to a flute.
column2: 一种大型鲸类宝可梦。浩大鲸能用回声定位寻找同类，并通过声波与其交流。据说它发出的声音像长笛。

column1: A large dragonfly Pokemon. Yanmega can create shock waves by beating its wings. These shock waves are so powerful, they may inflict critical injuries on the foe.
column2: 一只大蜻蜓宝可梦。 远古巨蜓可以通过拍打翅膀产生冲击波。这些冲击波非常强大，可能会对敌人造成严重伤害。

column1: A large fish roughly formed from various smaller fish. Wishiwashi's powerful School Form is formed when a Wishiwashi is in danger and calls on its friends by making its eyes shine in an SOS signal.
column2: 一种由许多小鱼组成的大鱼。弱丁鱼遇到危险时，会让眼睛发出SOS信号呼唤伙伴，从而聚成强大的鱼群的样子。

column1: A large fish-like Pokemon. Seaking uses its powerful horn to bore holes in riverbed boulders in order to shelter its Eggs from water currents.
column2: 一条像大鱼一样的宝可梦。 金鱼王使用其强大的角在河床巨石上钻孔，以保护其卵免受水流的影响。

column1: A large humanoid Legendary Pokemon. Zygarde Complete Forme is said to exceed both Xerneas and Yveltal in power, possessing 100% of its total cells.
column2: 一种大型人形传说的宝可梦。基格尔德（完全体形态）聚集了全部100%的细胞，据说力量超越哲尔尼亚斯和伊裴尔塔尔。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon resembling a cloven-hoofed mammal such as a deer or a moose. Its body is a form it has constructed using its control over the earth. Ting-Lu is able to create fissures over 160 feet (50 meters) deep just by slowly putting down its head on the ground.
column2: 大型传说的宝可梦 ，类似于偶蹄哺乳动物，例如鹿或驼鹿。它的身体是它利用对大地的控制而构建的形态。 古鼎鹿只需将头缓慢地放在地面上，就能产生超过 160 英尺（50 米）深的裂缝。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon resembling a skeletal, legless bat. Known as the "beast that calls the moon," Lunala has long been honored as an emissary of the moon. This Pokemon constantly absorbs light to convert into energy.
column2: 一种外形像无腿骷髅蝙蝠的大型传说的宝可梦。露奈雅拉被称为“呼唤月亮之兽”，自古受尊崇为月亮的使者。它会不断吸收光并将其转化为能量。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon that resembles a dragon, a plesiosaur, and a bird. It is said that a light flutter of its wings is capable of causing winds powerful enough to tear down cliffs. If it were to flap its wings, it could hypothetically spawn storms lasting as long as 40 days.
column2: 大型传说的宝可梦，类似龙、蛇颈龙和鸟。据说，它的翅膀轻轻一扇，就能产生足以撕裂悬崖的强风。如果它扇动翅膀，它可能会引发长达 40 天的风暴。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon with avian and draconian traits. Yveltal has the power to absorb life energy. When it reaches the end of its lifespan, it expands its wings and steals all of the life energy of every living thing around it before transforming into a cocoon to sleep for 1,000 years.
column2: 一种兼有鸟类和龙类特征的大型传说的宝可梦。伊裴尔塔尔能吸收生命能量，生命终结时会展开双翼，夺取周围所有生物的生命能量，再化成茧，沉睡一千年。

column1: A large mythical Pokemon with a roughly humanoid build. Melmetal was known in ancient times to be worshipped for the ability to create metal. Due to the state of its liquid metal body, the arms are very flexible, capable of delivering power punches.
column2: 具有大致人形构造的大型幻之宝可梦。 美录梅塔在古代因具有创造金属的能力而受到崇拜。由于其液态金属身体的状态，手臂非常灵活，能够发出强力的拳头。

column1: A large proboscidean Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Donphan, albeit one with gigantic tusks, tough scales, and an aggressive disposition. Unlike its present-day and future relatives, Great Tusk is never seen curling up into a ball, perhaps prevented by its enormous tusks.
column2: 一种大型长鼻动物般的宝可梦。它是酷似顿甲的神秘生命体，拥有巨大的獠牙、坚硬的鳞片和好战的性情。与它现世及未来的亲缘者不同，从未有人见到雄伟牙将身体蜷成球，或许是因为獠牙太大。

column1: A large robotic reptilian legendary Pokemon. It keeps itself afloat to maintain an advantageous position that applies pressure to grounded opponents, and it anticipates their moves before striking at their weak points. One strike from its charged tail is said to knock out even the sturdiest foe.
column2: 大型机器人爬行动物传说的宝可梦。它能够保持自己的漂浮状态，以保持有利的位置，向地面上的对手施加压力，并在攻击他们的弱点之前预测他们的行动。据说，它带电的尾巴一击就能击倒最强壮的敌人。

column1: A large rodent Pokemon. If attacked, Raticate stands up on its hind legs, bares its fangs and shrieks in an intimidating manner at its enemy.
column2: 一种大型啮齿动物般的宝可梦。受到攻击时，拉达会以后腿站立，露出獠牙，并向敌人发出威吓的尖叫。

column1: A large sauropod-like Pokemon. It has a long neck, which it uses for reaching treetops to gorge on its most favored fruit. Since it ate only this kind of fruit continuously, the fruit began to grow around its neck.
column2: 大型蜥脚类恐龙宝可梦。它有一个长长的脖子，可以用来到达树顶，狼吞虎咽地吃它最喜欢的水果。由于它一直只吃这种果实，所以脖子上的果实开始生长。

column1: A large sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.
column2: 一种外形像南瓜的大型双足宝可梦。居住在南瓜里的灵魂被困在了这个世界。南瓜精能将游荡的灵魂带回它们应去的地方，让它们继续旅程。

column1: A large spherical Pokemon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
column2: 大球形宝可梦。其长矛般的尖刺和凶猛的性情为它赢得了“海魔”的绰号。它吞食毒物来滋养自己。

column1: A large, Ultra Beast. Although it constantly eats, its droppings have never been found. It is speculated that the entirety of the matter it consumes is converted into energy, with no waste products left over.
column2: 一种大型究极异兽。虽然不停进食，却从未有人发现它的粪便。据推测，吃下的所有物质都会转化成能量，不留下任何废物。

column1: A large, avian Pokemon. Its powerful wings are capable of stirring up windstorms in just a few flaps, and it may spread its wings to intimidate enemies.
column2: 大型禽类宝可梦。其强大的翅膀只需轻轻拍打几下就能掀起风暴，甚至可以张开翅膀威吓敌人。

column1: A large, avian Pokemon. When it hunts, it sends out a bloodcurdling battle cry to signal that it's hunting. It can use its psychic powers to unleash eerie screeches capable of generating shock waves.
column2: 一种大型鸟类宝可梦。捕猎时会发出令人毛骨悚然的战吼，宣告狩猎开始。能用超能力发出怪异的尖啸，产生冲击波。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon composed of rock salt. Garganacl's salt is rich in minerals and known to have medicinal properties. Garganacl will scrape its fingertips together to share its salt with injured Pokemon, which can heal them quickly.
column2: 由岩盐组成的大型双足宝可梦。 盐石巨灵的盐富含矿物质，并具有药用特性。 盐石巨灵会用指尖刮擦，与受伤的宝可梦分享盐，这样可以快速治愈他们。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon covered in shaggy fur. Abomasnow appears only when snow flowers bloom. Once the flowers die, it retreats to isolated areas.
column2: 一种全身覆盖蓬松长毛的大型双足宝可梦。暴雪王只在雪花盛开时出现，花朵枯萎后就会退回偏僻的地方。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon with distinct reptilian features. When in contact with foes, it can poison them with the spikes from its back or cause small tremors by slamming the ground.
column2: 大型双足宝可梦，具有明显的爬行动物特征。当与敌人接触时，它可以用背部的尖刺使敌人中毒，或者通过猛击地面引起轻微的震动。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon with features of both dinosaurs and rhinoceroses. Rhydon is a physically powerful Pokemon. It is recorded as being able to topple buildings with a sweeping blow of its tail, and its horn is able to bore through solid rock and shatter diamonds.
column2: 一种兼有恐龙和犀牛特征的大型双足宝可梦。钻角犀兽力气很大，据记载能用尾巴一扫便推倒建筑，角能钻穿坚硬的岩石，击碎钻石。

column1: A large, bipedal creature with a thick tail. Kangaskhan is a nurturing Pokemon that protects its young at all costs. If the mother feels the environment is safe, it will allow its young out to play. However, it will violently attack anything that it sees as a threat to its young.
column2: 一种大型双足生物，有一条粗尾巴。 袋兽是一只培育型宝可梦，它不惜一切代价保护其幼崽。如果母亲觉得环境安全，就会允许幼崽出去玩耍。然而，它会猛烈攻击任何它认为对其幼崽构成威胁的东西。

column1: A large, bipedal legendary Pokemon resembling a humanoid black bear with a wushu motif. Rapid Strike Style Urshifu prefers calmly observing the opponent and their strength while dodging. Urshifu strongly believes in defeating its opponents with many rapid blows nonstop like a flowing river.
column2: 一种具有武术特征、外形像人形黑熊的大型双足传说的宝可梦。武道熊师（连击流）喜欢在闪避时冷静观察对手及其力量，坚信应以流水般连绵不绝的迅疾连击击败对手。

column1: A large, bipedal tortoise-like Pokemon. The powerful cannons on this Pokemon's back are capable of producing water blasts that can pierce steel and concrete. Blastoise deliberately makes itself heavy to withstand these powerful blasts, and it will crush its opponents with its bulk.
column2: 一种形似陆龟的大型双足宝可梦。背上的强力水炮能够喷出足以穿透钢铁和混凝土的水流。水箭龟特意增加体重来承受强大水流的反作用力，也会用沉重的身体压倒对手。

column1: A large, bipedal, dinosaurian Pokemon with an armor-like hide covering its body. Tyranitar is a powerful Pokemon with an insolent nature. It is extremely strong, and its thick, rocky hide gives it a good resistance to all forms of attack. Because of this, it is always looking for a battle and will not flinch at anything.
column2: 一种全身覆盖盔甲般厚皮的大型双足恐龙般的宝可梦。班基拉斯力量强大，性情傲慢。厚实的岩石般皮肤使它能抵抗各类攻击，因此总是寻找战斗，不会因任何事而畏缩。

column1: A large, bipedal, frog-like Pokemon. Through a transformation called Bond Phenomenon, Greninja can change into an alternate form called Ash-Greninja.
column2: 一种形似青蛙的大型双足宝可梦。通过一种称为牵绊现象的变化，甲贺忍蛙能够变成小智版甲贺忍蛙。

column1: A large, bipedal, robotic dinosaur-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Tyranitar. It is said to be coolheaded and prefers to avoid unnecessary fights.
column2: 一种大型双足机器恐龙般的宝可梦。它是酷似班基拉斯的神秘生命体，据说头脑冷静，喜欢避免无谓的争斗。

column1: A large, bulky Pokemon that is modeled after a sumo wrestler. Hariyama's body consists mostly of muscle instead of fat. When its body tenses, its muscles become as hard as stone.
column2: 仿照相扑选手设计的大型宝可梦。 铁掌力士的身体主要由肌肉而不是脂肪组成。当它的身体紧张时，它的肌肉就会变得像石头一样坚硬。

column1: A large, bulky cyborg Pokemon that looks like a futuristic sumo wrestler. A mysterious life-form that resembles Hariyama. It is said to have fists that move independently of its body and to be capable of throwing large, fast-moving vehicles.
column2: 一种体形庞大而笨重、外形像未来相扑力士的机器宝可梦。它是酷似铁掌力士的神秘生命体，据说双拳能脱离身体独自移动，并能抛飞高速行驶的大型车辆。

column1: A large, canine Pokemon. Mabosstiff has a gentle temperament and loves playing with children. However, it will bare its teeth and take on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
column2: 一只大型犬宝可梦。 獒教父性情温和，喜欢和孩子们一起玩耍。然而，当它保护家人时，它会露出牙齿并呈现出令人生畏的样子。

column1: A large, dinosaur-like Pokemon resembling a Pachycephalosaurus. A charging Rampardos can knock down virtually anything with one hit. It enjoys barging into objects with its head to train its strength and reflexes.
column2: 一种外形像厚头龙的大型恐龙般的宝可梦。战槌龙冲锋时，几乎任何东西都能被一击撞倒。它喜欢用头撞击物体，锻炼力量和反应速度。

column1: A large, draconic Pokemon. It has savage physical strength; it nimbly chases prey around its den, using its outstretched claws to catch them.
column2: 大型龙族宝可梦。它拥有野蛮的体力；它灵活地在巢穴周围追逐猎物，用伸出的爪子捕捉它们。

column1: A large, draconic legendary Pokemon. Giratina is able to travel through and control dimensions besides those of time and space. When in its Origin Forme, it is able to pass through dimensions at will, however, it will turn back to its Altered Forme due to the gravity change from the Reverse World.
column2: 一种大型龙般的传说的宝可梦。骑拉帝纳能够穿越并操控时间与空间之外的维度。处于起源形态时能随意穿梭维度，但离开反转世界后，重力的变化会使它恢复为别种形态。

column1: A large, equine Pokemon. Mudsdale is known for both its powerful body and emotional fortitude, which prevents it from becoming agitated. Regardless of the trouble it is in, it will never cry out and defeats opponents with a single blow.
column2: 大型马宝可梦。 重泥挽马以其强大的身体和坚韧的情感而闻名，这使其不会变得焦躁不安。无论遇到什么困难，它都不会叫喊，一击击败对手。

column1: A large, fish-like Pokemon. Lanturn uses the bright part of its body to lure fish prey. It then blinds the prey with an intense burst of light, and swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
column2: 一种大型鱼般的宝可梦。电灯怪会用身体发光的部位引诱鱼类猎物，再以强光使猎物失明，将无法动弹的猎物一口吞下。

column1: A large, golem-like legendary Pokemon. Regigigas is a skilled craftsman. It created golems out of inanimate objects and brought them to life.
column2: 一种形似魔像的大型传说的宝可梦。雷吉奇卡斯是技艺高超的工匠，曾用无生命的物体制造魔像，并赋予它们生命。

column1: A large, hippo-like Pokemon. It is short-tempered, and may hold its mouth agape as a display of strength.
column2: 一种大型河马般的宝可梦。脾气暴躁，有时会张大嘴巴展示力量。

column1: A large, jellyfish-like Pokemon. Jellicent can absorb seawater then project it from its head, which lets it move forward in the sea. Any ship or crew that wanders into the oceans where it dwells is never found again, and it is known to feed on life energy.
column2: 一个像水母一样的大宝可梦。 胖嘟嘟可以吸收海水，然后从头部喷射出来，使其在海中前进。任何徘徊在它居住的海洋中的船只或船员都不会再被发现，而且众所周知，它以生命能量为食。

column1: A large, ladybug-like Pokemon. When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
column2: 一种大型瓢虫般的宝可梦。夜空的星星闪烁时，安瓢虫会四处飞舞，散播发光的粉末。

column1: A large, menacing arthropod Pokemon in a hunched-over, humanoid posture. It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.
column2: 一只巨大、凶险的节肢动物宝可梦，呈弯腰驼背的人形姿势。它用六只手臂熟练地战斗，但大部分时间都在海底深处的洞穴里安静地冥想。

column1: A large, moth-like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form that shares traits with Volcarona. Some theorize that it may have been revived from fossils of a prehistoric era. However, no Volcarona fossils of that era are known to have been found.
column2: 一种大型蛾般的宝可梦。它是具有火神蛾特征的神秘生命体。有理论认为它可能由史前化石复活而来，但目前还没有发现那个时代的火神蛾化石。

column1: A large, ovoid Pokemon. A small pouch on its belly holds a single egg, which brings feelings of happiness and makes a person pleasant and caring if ingested.
column2: 一种体型庞大、身体呈卵形的宝可梦。腹部的小袋里装着一枚蛋。吃下这枚蛋会让人感到幸福，变得愉快而富有爱心。

column1: A large, penguin-like Pokemon. The edges of its wings can slice through ice floes, and this Pokemon will use them to attack anyone or anything that damages its pride.
column2: 一种大型企鹅般的宝可梦。翅膀边缘能切开浮冰，会用翅膀攻击任何损害其自尊的人或事物。

column1: A large, quadruped, feline Pokemon. It is described as highly intelligent and having an even higher opinion of itself.
column2: 大型四足猫科动物宝可梦。它被描述为非常聪明并且对自己有更高的评价。

column1: A large, quadrupedal brown bear Pokemon. This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
column2: 一种大型四足棕熊般的宝可梦。这只特殊的月月熊能用左眼在黑暗中看清东西，并用坚硬如铁的泥土保护自己。

column1: A large, rotund, amphibian Pokemon. Bellibolt is capable of moving very quickly, but usually chooses to act sluggishly. It is difficult to train Bellibolt to initiate a battle because it has an easygoing temperament, and does not notice its opponents until it is attacked.
column2: 一种体型庞大而圆润的两栖宝可梦。电肚蛙能够快速移动，但通常会选择慢吞吞地行动。它性情随和，直到被攻击才会注意到对手，因此很难训练它主动发起战斗。

column1: A large, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. Dialga can warp time by either speeding it up, slowing it down, or stopping it altogether.
column2: 一种大型蜥脚类恐龙般的传说的宝可梦。帝牙卢卡能够通过加速、减慢或完全停止时间来扭曲时间。

column1: A large, scorpion-like Pokemon. Drapion is a very aggressive Pokemon, attacking anything that enters its territory.
column2: 一个像蝎子一样的大宝可梦。 龙王蝎是一种非常具有攻击性的宝可梦，会攻击任何进入其领地的东西。

column1: A large, sea lion-like Pokemon. While its long tusks are capable of crushing ice, they may break during battle.
column2: 一种大型海狮般的宝可梦。长牙能击碎冰块，但也可能在战斗中折断。

column1: A large, serpentine legendary Pokemon. Rayquaza lives in the ozone layer, where it feeds on water and other particles. Rayquaza is rarely seen by people; even in flight, its appearance is indistinguishable from that of a meteor.
column2: 大型蛇形传说的宝可梦。 烈空坐生活在臭氧层中，以水和其他颗粒为食。 烈空坐很少被人们看到；即使在飞行中，它的外观也与流星没有什么区别。

column1: A large, skeletal, canine Pokemon. Houndstone spends much of its time buried below the ground, particularly in graveyards, with only its "tombstone" visible. Houndstone is considered the most loyal of all dog Pokemon.
column2: 一种大型骷髅犬般的宝可梦。墓扬犬大多时间埋在地下，尤其是墓地中，只露出“墓碑”。被认为是所有犬类宝可梦中最忠诚的。

column1: A large, sticky, amorphous Pokemon made of living purple sludge. Extreme caution is advised in avoiding any contact with this Pokemon, as an accidental brush up can lead to severe sickness.
column2: 一种由有生命的紫色污泥构成的大型宝可梦，身体黏稠且没有固定形状。接近时必须格外谨慎，避免任何接触，因为即使不慎擦碰也可能引发严重疾病。

column1: A large, sticky, amorphous Pokemon made of living purple sludge. Its vivid coloration is a result of the garbage it eats, which causes chemical changes in its body; these same chemical changes are thought to be the cause of its unending hunger.
column2: 一种由活的紫色污泥构成、巨大而黏稠、形状不定的宝可梦。鲜艳的颜色来自垃圾在体内引发的化学变化，人们认为同样的化学变化也导致它永无休止地饥饿。

column1: A large, theropod-like legendary Pokemon. It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things.
column2: 大型兽脚亚目恐龙传说的宝可梦。它翱翔在天空，其形态酷似万物的创造者。

column1: A large, theropod-like legendary Pokemon. Palkia has the ability to warp space, though it was said to create alternate realities as well.
column2: 一种大型兽脚类恐龙般的传说的宝可梦。帕路奇亚能扭曲空间，据说也能创造其他现实。

column1: A large, vampire bat-like Pokemon. Gliscor, along with its unevolved form Gligar, can emit a sort of sound wave in order to detect obstacles and fly around them, similar to echolocation.
column2: 一只类似吸血蝙蝠的大型宝可梦。 天蝎王及其未进化形式天蝎可以发出一种声波，以检测障碍物并绕过它们飞行，类似于回声定位。

column1: A large, wingless, three-headed avian Pokemon. Each head has its own working brain and distinct personality, representing and expressing sorrow, anger and joy respectively. Despite being separate, it has the innate ability to use all three of its brains to collect data, formulate and then execute complex plans and strategies.
column2: 一种没有翅膀的三头大型鸟类宝可梦。每个头都有独立的大脑和鲜明的性格，分别代表并表达悲伤、愤怒与喜悦。尽管彼此独立，它仍能天生协调三个大脑，收集信息，制定并执行复杂的计划与策略。

column1: A legendary titan Pokemon composed of ice. It can survive submerged in molten lava and other extremely hot temperatures.
column2: 由冰组成的传说的巨人宝可梦。它可以在熔岩和其他极热的温度下生存。

column1: A legendary titan Pokemon composed of metal. Dispite being made of metal, this material stretches and shrinks despite its hardness.
column2: 一种由金属构成、巨人般的传说的宝可梦。虽然材料是坚硬的金属，身体仍能伸展和收缩。

column1: A limbless Pokemon composed of magma. In order to prevent its body from cooling and hardening, Slugma neither sleeps nor ever stops moving.
column2: 由岩浆组成的无肢宝可梦。为了防止身体冷却变硬，熔岩虫既不睡觉也不停止移动。

column1: A limbless, snail-like Pokemon consisting almost entirely of magma. Magcargo's internal body temperature can reach over 18,000 F (10,000 C) (27968 U), causing it to evaporate water on contact.
column2: 一种没有四肢、外形像蜗牛的宝可梦，几乎完全由岩浆构成。熔岩蜗牛体内的温度能超过华氏18000度（摄氏10000度；27968 U），接触水时会使其蒸发。

column1: A living, bipedal boulder. The Alolan Golem is capable of firing a rock for attacking; if it is not available, it will fire nearby Geodude instead.
column2: 一种活着的双足巨石。阿罗拉隆隆岩会发射岩石攻击；没有石头时，就会改为发射附近的小拳石。

column1: A living, bipedal boulder. The Alolan Graveler looks similar to their regular counterpart, with the addition of dravite crystals on parts of its body, and iron sand attracted by magnetism.
column2: 一块活的双足巨石。隆隆石（阿罗拉的样子）与普通样子相似，但身体部分部位长有镁电气石晶体，并以磁力吸附铁砂。

column1: A long Pokemon that seems to be perpetually buried within the earth. Wiglett has an exceptional sense of smell, which has a range of over 60 feet (20 meters). Wiglett is a timid and cautious Pokemon; it hides in the sand when it picks up the scents of other Pokemon, such as Veluza, nearby.
column2: 一种身体细长的宝可梦，似乎始终埋在地下。海地鼠的嗅觉极为灵敏，能闻到超过60英尺（20米）外的气味。它胆小而谨慎，一旦闻到附近有轻身鳕等其他宝可梦的气味，就会躲进沙子里。

column1: A long bodied Pokemon. They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
column2: 一种身体细长的宝可梦。会用手臂上的长毛当作鞭子攻击对手。

column1: A long, serpentine Pokemon made up of rock-like sections. It is capable of chewing through boulders with its powerful jaws, and its eyes are capable of seeing in the dark.
column2: 一种身体细长、由岩石状体节组成的蛇形宝可梦。它能用强有力的颚部咬碎巨石，也能在黑暗中看清事物。

column1: A long, serpentine Pokemon. Dragonair hosts a large amount of energy within its body, which it can discharge through the crystal orbs on its neck and tail. This causes its body to brighten and give off a different aura that changes the weather in its vicinity.
column2: 一种身体细长、外形像蛇的宝可梦。哈克龙体内蕴藏着大量能量，能通过颈部和尾部的水晶宝珠释放。这会使身体发亮，散发不同的光环，从而改变附近的天气。

column1: A long-bodied Pokemon similar to a mongoose. Gumshoos hunts by waiting along its prey's known travel routes. Due to its tenacious personality and ability to withstand intense hunger, it is able to wait for its prey for long periods without eating.
column2: 体型较长的宝可梦，类似于猫鼬。 猫鼬探长通过沿着猎物已知的旅行路线等待来狩猎。由于其顽强的性格和承受强烈饥饿的能力，它能够长时间等待猎物而不进食。

column1: A long-bodied Pokemon similar to a mongoose. Yungoos has a voracious appetite and is always hungry. Much of its body is dominated by its stomach, and it is able to digest food quickly.
column2: 一种身体细长、外形像猫鼬的宝可梦。猫鼬少食欲旺盛，总是饥饿。胃占据身体的大部分，能迅速消化食物。

column1: A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. Eevee is said to have an irregularly shaped genetic structure that allows it to adapt to many different kinds of environments. Eventually, Eevee may evolve to better suit its surroundings.
column2: 哺乳动物，四足动物宝可梦。据说伊布具有不规则形状的基因结构，使其能够适应多种不同的环境。最终，伊布可能会进化以更好地适应周围环境。

column1: A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. It will fluff out its collar to cool down its high body temperature. This high temperature is caused by its internal flame sac.
column2: 一种四足的哺乳动物般的宝可梦。体内的火焰囊会产生高温，它会展开颈部的毛领来降低体温。

column1: A mantis-like insect creature. A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. The stones that adorn Kleavor's body often get chipped during fierce fights; larger chips are a sign that it is experienced in battle.
column2: 一种形似螳螂的昆虫生物。它性情凶暴，会用粗糙的斧头砍倒参天大树，并以坚硬的石头保护自己。劈斧螳螂身上的石饰在激战中常会崩裂，崩缺越大，说明战斗经验越丰富。

column1: A marine Pokemon resembling a Sea Cucumber. Pyukumuku tends to find a spot it likes and stay there, even returning to the same spot if moved. Once all the food in its favorite location has been consumed, it will continue to stay there to the point of starvation.
column2: 一种外形像海参的海洋宝可梦。拳海参喜欢选定一个地方一直待在那里，即使被搬走，也会回到原处。哪怕喜爱的地方已经没有食物，也会坚持留在那里，甚至饿死。

column1: A marine sea urchin-like Pokemon. Pincurchin stores electricity in each spine, which flows from the tip of each one. If one gets broken off, it will still continue to emit electricity for approximately three hours.
column2: 一种形似海胆的海洋宝可梦。啪嚓海胆的每根棘刺都储存着电能，电流会从刺尖流出。即使棘刺折断，仍会继续放电约三小时。

column1: A massive Pokemon seemingly formed entirely out of reflective ice. Its cumbersome frame is as hard as steel, able to crush anything that stands in its way.
column2: 一种仿佛完全由反光冰块构成的巨大宝可梦。笨重的身躯坚硬如钢铁，能碾碎任何挡路的东西。

column1: A massive whale-like legendary Pokemon. Kyogre is said to be a powerful Pokemon, having control over the element of water and rain to have quenched areas of the world plagued with drought and to have expanded the seas.
column2: 一种体型巨大的鲸形传说的宝可梦。据说盖欧卡拥有强大的力量，能够控制水与雨，使遭受干旱的地区重获滋润，并扩大海洋。

column1: A massive, bipedal, dinosaur-like legendary Pokemon. Groudon is an immensely powerful Pokemon, having the ability to summon intense droughts and cause volcanic eruptions. The droughts it can cause allow it to evaporate water, while the volcanic eruptions it can summon enable it to create land.
column2: 一种体形庞大的双足恐龙般的传说的宝可梦。固拉多力量强大，能引发严重干旱和火山喷发。干旱使水分蒸发，火山喷发则能创造陆地。

column1: A mechanical, bipedal Pokemon. A mysterious life-form similar in appearance to both Gardevoir and Gallade. It is a cruel Pokemon, willing to take its shining blade and cut down anyone confronting it without hesitation.
column2: 机械双足宝可梦。与沙奈朵和艾路雷朵外表相似的神秘生命体。它是一只残忍的宝可梦，愿意毫不犹豫地拿起它闪亮的利刃砍倒任何与它对抗的人。

column1: A medium-sized fish Pokemon. A long-lived Magikarp is able to utilize its immense splashing power to leap high enough to scale mountains. It also has a strong enough immune system to survive in the most polluted of waters.
column2: 一种中型鱼类宝可梦。长寿的鲤鱼王凭借强大的跃起力量，能跳到足以越过山岭的高度。强健的免疫系统也让它能在污染最严重的水中生存。

column1: A medium-sized, bipedal dragon-like Pokemon. Gabite is a fierce and predatory Pokemon, known for its scales, of which have medicinal properties and can heal most illnesses.
column2: 中型双足龙宝可梦。 尖牙陆鲨是一种凶猛且掠夺性的宝可梦，以其鳞片而闻名，其鳞片具有药用特性，可以治愈大多数疾病。

column1: A medium-sized, bipedal, crocodilian Pokemon. Its teeth are positioned like barbed fishing hooks and are impossible to pull out with ordinary strength.
column2: 一种中型双足鳄鱼般的宝可梦。牙齿像带倒钩的鱼钩，凭普通力量无法将其拔出。

column1: A metallic avian Pokemon. Its steel wings become tattered and bashed in from repeated battles, but once a year the battered wings grow back completely. This process restores the cutting edges. Its feathers are sharp enough to be used as blades.
column2: 金属鸟类宝可梦。它的钢制翅膀因反复的战斗而变得破烂不堪，但每年一次，破损的翅膀会完全重新长出来。此过程可恢复切削刃。它的羽毛足够锋利，可以用作刀片。

column1: A metallic, beetle-like Pokemon. Rabsca gently rolls its ball with its legs so that the infant inside can sleep comfortably. A hypothesis posits that the infant is actually Rabsca's true body, since the body that rolls the ball around barely moves.
column2: 一种金属甲虫般的宝可梦。虫甲圣用腿轻轻滚动球，让球中的幼体能够安睡。由于滚球的身体本身几乎不动，有假说认为幼体才是虫甲圣真正的身体。

column1: A metallic, bipedal Pokemon. In its Chest Form, Gimmighoul's treasure chest provides defense but makes it hard for it to move due to its weight.
column2: 金属双足宝可梦。在其宝箱形态中，索财灵的宝箱提供防御，但由于其重量而使其难以移动。

column1: A metallic, bipedal mythical Pokemon that is made up primarily of spheres. It will try as hard as it can to save injured Pokemon, due to its ability to feel others pain. It can even perceive the emotions, thoughts, or feelings of other Pokemon as well.
column2: 一种主要由球形部件构成的金属双足幻之宝可梦。能感受他人的痛苦，因此会竭尽全力拯救受伤的宝可梦，甚至能感知其他宝可梦的情绪、思想与感受。

column1: A monkey-like Pokemon with a three-fingered hand at the end of its tail. Aipom uses its powerful tail freely and cleverly for many purposes. The tail is strong enough to anchor Aipom to a branch and suspend the rest of its body in the air, but also delicate enough to pick fruit and manipulate objects.
column2: 一只像猴子一样的宝可梦，尾巴末端有一只三指的手。 长尾怪手灵活而巧妙地利用其强大的尾巴来实现多种用途。尾巴足够坚固，可以将长尾怪手固定在树枝上，并将身体的其余部分悬浮在空中，但也足够精致，可以采摘水果和操纵物体。

column1: A monstrous, bipedal Pokemon which resembles a pepper plant. The spicy chemicals in its brain stimulate both heads, turning the green head vicious while providing a source for the red head to convert into spicy, fiery energy, which it blasts its surroundings with.
column2: 一种外形像辣椒植株、怪兽般的双足宝可梦。脑中的辛辣化学物质会刺激两个头，使绿色的头变得凶暴，并为红色的头提供原料，转化成辛辣炽热的能量，向周围轰击。

column1: A moth-like Pokemon. Mothim is a nomadic, nocturnal Pokemon that always remains on the move, searching for honey and nectar.
column2: 类似飞蛾的宝可梦。 绅士蛾是一种游牧、夜间活动的宝可梦，它始终保持移动，寻找蜂蜜和花蜜。

column1: A moth-like Pokemon. The ice scales from Frosmoth's wings can fall like snow while it flies over the fields and mountains. The wings have a temperature of -290 F (-179 C) (9678 U).
column2: 一种蛾般的宝可梦。雪绒蛾飞越田野和群山时，翅膀上的冰鳞会像雪一样飘落。翅膀的温度为华氏零下290度（摄氏零下179度；9678 U）。

column1: A mouse-like rodent Pokemon. The pair that forms Tandemaus sticks together no matter what. They exhibit great teamwork
column2: 一种形似老鼠的啮齿类宝可梦。构成一对鼠的两只个体无论如何都会待在一起，表现出出色的协作能力。

column1: A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
column2: 一种肌肉发达、外形像神灯精灵的人形传说的宝可梦。土地云帮助农作物生长，被视为“田地的守护神”。尾巴能让土壤获得养分。

column1: A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Tornadus can travel at speeds of 200 mph (320 kph). It can also whip up storms with its tail, and is able to blow away houses.
column2: 一种肌肉发达、形似神灵的人形传说的宝可梦。龙卷云的移动速度可达200英里/小时（320公里/小时），也能用尾巴掀起风暴，将房屋吹走。

column1: A mushroom-like Pokemon with a cap that looks quite similar to a Poke Ball. It uses the Poke Ball-like pattern on its head to lure people and Pokemon in grassy areas, then releases a cloud of poisonous spores to defend itself.
column2: 一种蘑菇般的宝可梦，菌盖的外形非常像精灵球。会用头上精灵球般的花纹吸引人们，并在草地上引诱宝可梦，再释放成团的毒孢子保护自己。

column1: A mushroom-like Pokemon with large caps on its head and arms that resemble modern Poke Balls. A mysterious life-form combining traits of dinosaurs with those of Amoonguss. Its gigantic stature and seemingly low intelligence combine to make it a powerful and savage fighter.
column2: 一种蘑菇状宝可梦，头部和手臂上长着酷似现代精灵球的大菌盖。它是兼具恐龙与败露球菇特征的神秘生命体。巨大的体型和似乎不高的智力，使它成为强大而凶暴的战士。

column1: A nearly spherical, quadruped Pokemon of indefinable basis. Munna is able to eat the dreams of people and Pokemon, as well as project these dreams by expelling Dream Mist. A person whose dream was eaten by a Munna will forget the dream's contents.
column2: 一种近乎球形、原型难以确定的四足宝可梦。食梦梦能吃掉人或宝可梦的梦，也能吐出梦之烟雾，将吃下的梦呈现出来。梦被食梦梦吃掉的人会忘记梦中的内容。

column1: A pearl-like Pokemon that is encased inside a shell. With rapid succession, it launches its spikes at the foe, keeping them repelled. Once it has shut itself in, it is impossible to open its shell from the outside.
column2: 珍珠般的宝可梦被包裹在贝壳内。它会快速连续地向敌人发射尖刺，将他们击退。一旦它把自己封闭起来，就不可能从外面打开它的壳了。

column1: A pelican-like Pokemon whose head and bill make up the majority of its body. Skimming across the top of waves, it scoops food from the sea and swallows it in one gulp.
column2: 一种鹈鹕般的宝可梦，头部和鸟嘴占身体的大部分。掠过浪尖时会从海中舀起食物，再一口吞下。

column1: A penguin-like Pokemon. Piplup has a strong sense of self-pride. Because of its pride, it has a hard time accepting food from humans and bonding with its caretakers.
column2: 类似企鹅的宝可梦。 波加曼有很强的自尊心。由于它的骄傲，它很难接受人类的食物并与它的看护者建立联系。

column1: A penguin-like Pokemon. Prinplup has a high sense of self-pride, which prevents it from forming groups of its own kind.
column2: 一种企鹅般的宝可梦。波皇子的自尊心很强，使它无法与同类组成群体。

column1: A pigeon-like Pokemon. Pidove is not particularly intelligent. While it always listens to its Trainers commands, it does not always understand them.
column2: 类似鸽子的宝可梦。 豆豆鸽并不是特别聪明。虽然它总是听从训练家的命令，但它并不总是理解它们。

column1: A pinecone-like Pokemon. It makes its shell thicker by gluing tree bark to its body. The glue is made of fluid that Pineco spits out, which hardens when it is exposed to air.
column2: 一种外形像松果的宝可梦。会将树皮粘在身上，让外壳变厚。榛果球吐出的液体遇到空气就会变硬，可以充当黏胶。

column1: A pinniped Pokemon with three ruffle-like growths around its body. While Brionne normally learns to dance from members of colony, it can also learn to dance from humans. It works hard to memorize each dance through imitation.
column2: 一只鳍足类动物宝可梦，其身体周围有三个褶边状的生长物。虽然花漾海狮通常向群体成员学习跳舞，但它也可以向人类学习跳舞。通过模仿来努力记住每一个舞蹈。

column1: A pinniped Pokemon. Its warm fur and thick hide allow it to swim in waters as cold as -40 F/C (9928 U). It thrives in these cold environments, becoming more active as the temperature drops.
column2: 一种鳍足动物般的宝可梦。温暖的毛皮与厚实的皮肤使它能在华氏及摄氏零下40度（9928 U）的水中游泳。它适应寒冷，气温越低越活跃。

column1: A pinniped Pokemon. When it encounters new objects, they are placed on its nose and rolled around to test its smell and texture. It has also been known to roll Spheal on its nose.
column2: 鳍足类宝可梦。当它遇到新物体时，它们会被放在鼻子上并滚动以测试其气味和质地。人们还知道它会在鼻子上滚动海豹球。

column1: A plant Pokemon resembling a human wearing a dress. Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen.
column2: 一种外形像穿着衣服的人类的植物宝可梦。奥利纽会与他人分享美味清新的油，尽情沐浴阳光，直到头顶的果实成熟。

column1: A plant-based Pokemon with a stem-like body. This stem is long, thin and very flexible, making it capable of swerving rapidly to avoid many attacks or moving with blinding speed to capture prey.
column2: 具有茎状主体的植物宝可梦。这种茎又长又细，非常灵活，能够快速转向以避免多次攻击，或者以惊人的速度移动捕捉猎物。

column1: A plant-like Pokemon that resembles a plant bulb, such as an onion. Its head is tipped with three oblong leaves that are very bitter. However, these leaves possess revitalizing effects.
column2: 一种外形像洋葱等植物球茎的宝可梦。头顶的三片长圆形叶子味道非常苦，却具有恢复活力的功效。

column1: A plant-like Pokemon. Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
column2: 植物状的宝可梦。它发达的腿是在厚厚的雪山上生活的结果。它的花冠散发出的香味使附近的人感到振奋。

column1: A plant-like Pokemon. The flower is on Lilligants head is very difficult to coax into bloom. Once it does bloom, it will wilt if Lilligant is then neglected. The flower emits a sweet smelling aroma, and it is believed to have a relaxing effect on those exposed to the scent.
column2: 一种植物般的宝可梦。裙儿小姐头上的花很难培育到开放；开花后若受到疏忽，就会枯萎。花朵散发甜香，人们相信闻到这种香气能够放松身心。

column1: A pudgy bipedal Dragon-type Pokemon that appears to be made of goo. It is very affectionate and, when it hugs its Trainer, leaves them covered in goo.
column2: 一种矮胖的双足龙属性宝可梦，身体仿佛由黏液构成。它非常亲人，拥抱训练家时会让对方沾满黏液。

column1: A pudgy bipedal Dragon-type Pokemon that appears to be made of goo. It sports a large, spiral-shaped metallic shell on its back, which it can tuck its body into to protect itself, leaving only its head outside of the shell to observe its surroundings.
column2: 一种身材圆胖、双足行走、看似由黏液构成的龙属性宝可梦。背上有巨大的螺旋金属壳，能将身体缩进去保护自己，只露出头部观察周围。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon similar to a dinosaur. When its flower is ready to bloom, it gives off a distinct, strong sweet-smelling aroma and starts swelling.
column2: 类似于恐龙的四足宝可梦。当它的花即将绽放时，它会散发出独特而强烈的甜味，并开始膨胀。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon similar to a goat. Gogoat has the ability to sense the feelings of whoever grips its horns; this ability is so acute that it can move as if it and its rider were one being.
column2: 一种四足山羊般的宝可梦。坐骑山羊能感知握住它的角的人的情绪，敏锐到能如同与骑手融为一体般行动。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a Bactrian camel. Its body contains amounts of molten lava of 18,000 F (10,000 C) (27968 U), which erupts out of its humps if the Pokemon is angered.
column2: 类似于双峰驼的四足动物宝可梦。它的身体含有大量温度为 18,000°F (10,000°C) (27968 U) 的熔岩，如果宝可梦被激怒，熔岩就会从驼峰中喷出。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a Dromedary camel. It slows down when wet and cannot stand when it is hungry. Due to its dull wits, it does not notice when it has been hit.
column2: 一种四足单峰骆驼般的宝可梦。身体潮湿时行动迟缓，饥饿时无法站立。反应迟钝，甚至察觉不到自己受到了攻击。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon with sloth-like qualities. Slakoth lolls around and sleeps for more than twenty hours a day, which can makes those around it drowsy.
column2: 具有树懒般品质的四足动物宝可梦。 懒人獭每天懒洋洋地睡二十多个小时，这会让周围的人昏昏欲睡。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon with two heads. Its heads dislike each other and are very hostile. As a result, the heads often turn eating into a competition. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
column2: 一种长着两个头的四足宝可梦。两个头彼此讨厌，互相敌视，常把进食变成比赛。吃得更多的头就能成为主导。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon. Nidorina is a gentle Pokemon, known to be a caring mother that chews food for its young. It seems to display close family bonds with others of its kind, and becomes nervous when separated.
column2: 四足动物宝可梦。 尼多娜是一只温柔的宝可梦，众所周知，它是一位充满爱心的母亲，会为幼崽咀嚼食物。它似乎与其他同类表现出亲密的家庭关系，并在分开时变得紧张。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon. Nidorino is independent and fierce, often described as violent and easily angered.
column2: 一种四足宝可梦。尼多力诺独立而凶猛，常被形容为粗暴且易怒。

column1: A quadruped canine Pokemon. In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply towards the back serves a leadership role. Leadership is determined by fights within the pack.
column2: 一种四足犬形宝可梦。黑鲁加群中，双角明显向后弯曲的个体会担任首领。首领的位置通过群体内的战斗决定。

column1: A quadruped fox-like Pokemon. Fennekin chews on twigs instead of eating snacks. It can be temperamental, but it tries to do its best for its Trainer.
column2: 一种四足狐狸般的宝可梦。火狐狸会咀嚼树枝，而不是吃零食。可能脾气急躁，但仍会尽力为训练家做到最好。

column1: A quadruped pig-like Pokemon. Tepig will roast berries before eating them, but occasionally gets overexcited and burns them.
column2: 类似猪的四足宝可梦。 暖暖猪在吃树果之前会烤它们，但偶尔会过度兴奋并烧焦它们。

column1: A quadruped turtle Pokemon. Grotle has the ability to sense where pure water wells up, and will carry other Pokemon on its back to these sources.
column2: 一种四足乌龟般的宝可梦。树林龟能感知纯净水涌出的地点，并背着其他宝可梦前往水源。

column1: A quadruped, bovine Pokemon. Tauros is a violent, rowdy Pokemon that whips itself into a frenzy using its three tails. Once it starts charging, it is unable to stop or change course until it hits something.
column2: 一种四足牛形宝可梦。肯泰罗凶暴而躁动，会用三条尾巴鞭打自己，使自己陷入狂怒。一旦开始冲锋，除非撞上东西，否则就无法停下或改变方向。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Arcanine is a fiercely brave and loyal Pokemon. It is capable of running 6,200 miles (10,000 kilometers) in 24 hours with a speed and grace reminiscent of flight.
column2: 一种四足犬类宝可梦。风速狗勇敢而忠诚，能在24小时内跑完6200英里（10000公里），速度和优雅的姿态让人联想到飞行。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Despite how deceivingly bulky Hisuian Arcanine is, it moves around nimbly like a dancer. This allows it to lead opponents in a merry chase while avoiding them at the same time.
column2: 一种四足犬形宝可梦。洗翠风速狗虽然看起来十分庞大，行动却像舞者般灵巧。它能灵活地引着对手追逐，同时避开对方的攻击。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Growlithe is a friendly and loyal Pokemon that will fearlessly defend its Trainer and territory from harm, even against larger, stronger enemies.
column2: 一种四足犬类宝可梦。卡蒂狗友善而忠诚，会无畏地保护训练家和领地，甚至敢面对更大、更强的敌人。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. This Pokemon is very sociable and will greet others by rubbing them with the rocks around its neck.
column2: 四足犬类宝可梦。这只宝可梦非常善于交际，会用脖子上的石头摩擦别人来打招呼。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Yamper tends to be drawn to fast-moving things and will chase after people, other Pokemon, or even vehicles. Yamper has an organ that generates electricity from the base of its tail when it runs.
column2: 一种四足犬类宝可梦。来电汪容易被快速移动的东西吸引，会追逐人、其他宝可梦，甚至车辆。尾巴根部的器官能在奔跑时发电。

column1: A quadruped, chimeric Pokemon identical to that of its pre-evolution. The destruction of its mask activates its RKS System, allowing it to change its type according to the Memory attached to it.
column2: 一种四足嵌合宝可梦，外观与进化前相同。面具被破坏后会启动AR系统，使它能够根据安装的存储碟改变属性。

column1: A quadruped, chimeric Pokemon with traits from a variety of animals. Type Null was created to be an anti-UB Fighting life-form. Codenamed "Beast Killer", Type Null was given cells taken from all known Pokemon types with the intention of giving it the ability to shift between types by holding a corresponding Memory.
column2: 一种兼具多种动物特征的四足嵌合体宝可梦。属性：空是为对抗究极异兽而制造的战斗生命体，代号“异兽杀手”。它被赋予了所有已知属性宝可梦的细胞，目的是让它能通过携带对应的存储碟切换属性。

column1: A quadruped, dinosaurian Pokemon similar to sauropods. Amaura is a calm creature that lived long ago in a cold land without violent predators.
column2: 类似于蜥脚类恐龙的四足恐龙宝可梦。 冰雪龙是一种平静的生物，很久以前生活在没有暴力掠食者的寒冷土地上。

column1: A quadruped, dinosaurian Pokemon that is similar to sauropods. Crystals produce freezing air reaching temperatures of -240 F (-151 C) (9728 U). Aurorus uses this ability to create ice walls for protection.
column2: 一种四足蜥脚类恐龙般的宝可梦。晶体产生的冷气能达到华氏零下240度（摄氏零下151度；9728 U）。冰雪巨龙会利用这种能力制造冰墙保护自己。

column1: A quadruped, equine Pokemon resembling a small donkey. This Pokemon boasts immense strength for its size, and is able to drag or carry loads up to 50 times its own weight.
column2: 一种形似小驴的四足马科宝可梦。与体型相比，它的力量大得惊人，能够拖动或搬运自身重量50倍的物品。

column1: A quadruped, feline Pokemon resembling a lion cub or lynx kitten. Electricity is produced by the extension and contraction of muscles in this Pokemon's forelegs.
column2: 一种四足猫科宝可梦，外形像幼狮或小猞猁。前腿肌肉的伸展和收缩会产生电力。

column1: A quadruped, feline Pokemon. In battle, its tuft of fur radiates heat, and when up against a strong opponent, the temperature increases.
column2: 一只四足猫科动物宝可梦。在战斗中，它的一簇毛皮会散发出热量，当遇到强大的对手时，温度会升高。

column1: A quadruped, feline Pokemon. The bell-like organ is actually a flame sac. Based on this Pokemon's emotions, the temperature of the bell will rise and eventually it will spit flames.
column2: 一种四足猫科宝可梦。铃铛般的器官其实是火焰囊。随着情绪变化，铃铛的温度会升高，最终喷出火焰。

column1: A quadruped, frog-like Pokemon. Froakie is both light and strong, making it capable of jumping incredibly high.
column2: 一只四足青蛙宝可梦。 呱呱泡蛙既轻又坚固，使其能够跳得非常高。

column1: A quadruped, hippo-like Pokemon. Hippopotas spends its time bathing in sand and avoids water at all costs. It covers itself in sand as a protective measure against germs and expels sand instead of sweat.
column2: 一种四足河马般的宝可梦。沙河马会在沙中沐浴，极力避水。用沙子覆盖身体来防范细菌，并排出沙子而非汗水。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon with a sleek body and slender legs. It hides in the darkness while waiting for its opponents, and its rings glow when it leaps to attack. It is also capable of spraying a poisonous sweat whenever it gets agitated.
column2: 四足哺乳动物宝可梦，拥有光滑的身体和修长的双腿。它隐藏在黑暗中等待对手，当它跳跃攻击时，它的圆环会发光。当它受到刺激时，它还能喷出有毒的汗液。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon with slender legs and dainty paws. The gem embedded in its forehead boosts the psychic powers that it gained to protect its Trainer from harm.
column2: 一种四足的哺乳动物般的宝可梦，腿细长，脚爪精巧。额头上的宝石能增强超能力，帮助它保护训练家免受伤害。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Its feelers send a soothing aura to calm fights, and will also use them to "hold hands" with its Trainer.
column2: 四足哺乳动物宝可梦。它的触角会发出舒缓的光环来平息战斗，也会用它们与训练家“牵手”。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Jolteon's fur amplifies the electrical charges produced by its cells. It can also store and generate negative ions in its fur, which create a sparking noise.
column2: 一种四足的哺乳动物般的宝可梦。雷伊布的毛皮能增强细胞产生的电荷，也能储存并产生负离子，发出火花爆响。

column1: A quadruped, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Raikou. It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur, and it is rumored that Raging Bolt does this by covering the skies with dark clouds before using its neck to strike down targets with crashing lighting.
column2: 类似蜥脚类恐龙的四足动物传说的宝可梦。类似雷公的神秘生命体。据说它会用皮毛发射的闪电烧毁周围的一切，有传言说，猛雷鼓会用乌云覆盖天空，然后用脖子用闪电击中目标来做到这一点。

column1: A quadruped, sea lion-like Pokemon. Hisuian Samurott is said to have a cold and hard-hearted nature, and is deft with its shell blades. Unlike its Unovan counterpart, which prefers fighting fair, Hisuian Samurott will do anything to win a battle, and prefers to use tricks such as surprise attacks and cheap shots.
column2: 一种四足海狮般的宝可梦。大剑鬼（洗翠的样子）性情冷酷，善于使用贝壳刀。与喜欢公平战斗的合众地区同类不同，它会为取胜不择手段，尤其喜欢突袭和阴招。

column1: A quadruped, tiger-like legendary Pokemon. Raikou tends to appear during thunderstorms and when other Electric-type Pokemon are in danger. Raikou races across grasslands while barking cries that sound like thunder.
column2: 一只像老虎一样的四足动物传说的宝可梦。 雷公往往会在雷雨天气以及其他电属性宝可梦处于危险之中时出现。 雷公在草原上奔跑，发出雷鸣般的叫声。

column1: A quadrupedal Pokemon composed of rock salt. Naclstack attacks by pressing the rock salt inside its body into hardened pellets, which it then shoots out with enough force to puncture an iron sheet. Naclstack also uses its salt to dry out and cure its prey.
column2: 一种由岩盐构成的四足宝可梦。盐石垒会将体内的岩盐压成坚硬的颗粒，再以足够刺穿铁板的力量射出。也会用盐将猎物脱水腌制。

column1: A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a hog. Its body is surrounded by a floral aroma that calms nearby Pokemon. The female Oinkologne enjoys keeping things tidy, taking a meticulous approach to it.
column2: 类似猪的四足动物宝可梦。它的身体被花香包围，使附近的宝可梦平静下来。雌性飘香豚喜欢保持事物整洁，对待事情一丝不苟。

column1: A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a hog. Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
column2: 一种四足猪般的宝可梦。飘香豚以细腻光滑的皮肤为傲，会从尾尖散发浓郁香气。

column1: A quadrupedal canine Pokemon. Greavard is friendly, affectionate and easily gets lonely. It is really easy to befriend, and will forever follow anyone who gives it the slightest of attention.
column2: 四足犬宝可梦。 墓仔狗友善，深情，容易感到孤独。它真的很容易成为朋友，并且会永远跟随任何给予它丝毫关注的人。

column1: A quadrupedal feline Pokemon. Sprigatito can rub its paws together to unleash a sweet, therapeutic aroma that mesmerizes anyone near it and causes its foes to stop battling.
column2: 一种四足猫科宝可梦。新叶喵摩擦脚爪时会释放带有疗愈效果的甜香，使附近的生物着迷，并让敌人停止战斗。

column1: A quadrupedal legendary Pokemon that possesses traits of stags and goats. Cobalion has a composed demeanor, but dislikes humans. Its glare can make even an unruly Pokemon obey it.
column2: 一种兼具雄鹿和山羊特征的四足传说的宝可梦。勾帕路翁沉着冷静，却不喜欢人类。它的瞪视能使桀骜不驯的宝可梦也乖乖服从。

column1: A quadrupedal, amphibious Pokemon. On top of Clodsire's back are six light purple circular spots. If Clodsire is attacked, it will retaliate by sticking out large, thick, light purple spines from these spots ΓÇö a dangerous and risky move.
column2: 一种四足两栖宝可梦。土王背上有六个淡紫色圆斑。受到攻击时，会从这些部位伸出巨大粗壮的淡紫色刺进行反击，是危险而冒险的举动。

column1: A quadrupedal, draconic Pokemon. A mysterious life-form similar to Salamence when they undergo Mega Evolution. Roaring Moon scatters feathers as it flies around at high speeds seeking prey and is more savage than Salamence.
column2: 四足龙类宝可梦。与暴飞龙经历超级进化时类似的神秘生命体。 轰鸣月会在高速飞行时散落羽毛寻找猎物，比暴飞龙更加凶猛。

column1: A quadrupedal, goat-like Pokemon. Due to its close relationship with humans, Skiddo has developed the ability to read the feelings of its riders through their grip on its horns.
column2: 一种四足山羊般的宝可梦。与人类关系密切，因此坐骑小羊发展出了通过骑手握角来感知其情绪的能力。

column1: A quadrupedal, stag-like cervine legendary Pokemon. Xerneas has the power to share eternal life; this occurs as the horns on its head shine in seven colors. When Xerneas is at the end of its life, it releases all of its life energy into all the living things in around it and transforms into a tree to sleep for 1,000 years.
column2: 一只四足、类似雄鹿的鹿传说的宝可梦。 哲尔尼亚斯拥有分享永生的力量；当它头上的角发出七种颜色的光芒时，就会发生这种情况。当哲尔尼亚斯生命终结时，它会将所有的生命能量释放到周围的所有生物中，并变成一棵树，沉睡1000年。

column1: A rabbit-like Pokemon. A warm-up of running can cause the fire energy in Scorbunny to start coursing through its body. When this occurs, Scorbunny will be able to fight at full power.
column2: 一种兔子般的宝可梦。跑步热身会使炎兔儿体内的火焰能量开始流动，这时它就能发挥全力战斗。

column1: A raccoon-like quadruped Pokemon. Zigzagoon is abundantly curious, as it wanders restlessly back and forth while rubbing its nose to the ground in search of something.
column2: 类似浣熊的四足动物宝可梦。 蛇纹熊非常好奇，它不停地来回徘徊，用鼻子蹭着地面寻找着什么。

column1: A raptor-like avian Pokemon. Pidgeotto is a powerful flier capable of carrying prey several miles to its nest.
column2: 一种猛禽般的鸟类宝可梦。比比鸟飞行能力强，能将猎物带回数英里外的巢穴。

column1: A reptilian Pokemon resembling a lizard. When carrying a human, Cyclizar can reach a speed of over 70 mph (120 km/h). Cyclizar maintains its balance and absorbs shock while running by using its hard head and thick yet supple tail.
column2: 类似蜥蜴的爬行动物宝可梦。当载人时，摩托蜥的速度可以达到超过 70 英里/小时（120 公里/小时）。 摩托蜥在奔跑时利用其坚硬的头部和粗而柔软的尾巴来保持平衡并吸收震动。

column1: A reptilian Pokemon. The membrane surrounding its eyes protects them from sandstorms and acts as a thermal detector. This allows Krokorok to see the temperature of different objects, which also gives it exceptional night vision.
column2: 一种爬行动物般的宝可梦。眼睛周围的膜能防御沙尘暴，也能探测热量，使混混鳄看出不同物体的温度，并拥有出色的夜视能力。

column1: A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon. It is capable of leaping freely from branch to branch. While it has the ability to slice down thick trees, it is known to care lovingly for the plants in the forest.
column2: 爬行动物、双足动物宝可梦。它能够在树枝间自由跳跃。虽然它有能力砍倒茂密的树木，但众所周知，它会精心照顾森林中的植物。

column1: A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon. Krookodile's jaws are extremely powerful, giving it the ability to crush objects as large and durable as an automobile. These features are topped by Krookodile's extremely violent temper.
column2: 一种双足爬行动物般的宝可梦。流氓鳄的下颚力量极强，能咬碎汽车般庞大而坚固的东西，脾气也极为暴躁。

column1: A robotic Pokemon with a body composed of three units. A mysterious life-form that resembles an ancient version of Magnemite. Some scientists claim that Sandy Shocks is a Magneton that has lived for 10,000 years and is said to have an aggressive disposition.
column2: 机器人宝可梦的主体由三个单元组成。类似于古代版本的小磁怪的神秘生命体。一些科学家声称沙铁皮是一只已经活了一万年的三合一磁怪，据说具有攻击性。

column1: A robotic Pokemon. Beldum's body lacks blood, and is instead powered by a magnetic force. It uses magnetism to move, communicate, and control its attacks.
column2: 一种机器宝可梦。铁哑铃体内没有血液，而是由磁力驱动。利用磁力移动、交流并控制攻击。

column1: A robotic Pokemon. Metang is formed when two Beldum fuse together. A magnetic nervous system joins the brains of these two Pokemon. This linkage allows Metang to generate a strong, psychokinetic power.
column2: 机器人宝可梦。 金属怪是由两个铁哑铃熔合而成。磁神经系统连接着这两个宝可梦的大脑。这种联动使金属怪能够产生强大的意念动力。

column1: A robotic moth like Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Volcarona. Some point to Iron Moth's aggression as evidence supporting that it may be a UFO controlled by alien life.
column2: 一种机器蛾般的宝可梦。它是酷似火神蛾的神秘生命体。有人认为铁毒蛾的攻击性行为证明，它可能是由外星生命操控的不明飞行物。

column1: A rock Pokemon. It has three small objects on its sides and back, called Mini-Noses, which it is able to control. With these Mini-Noses, it is able to attack opponents from all three directions.
column2: 一种岩石宝可梦，身体两侧和背部有三个被称为小鼻子的部件。它能够操控这些小鼻子，从三个方向攻击对手。

column1: A rock-like Pokemon. Its orange crystal is the hardened form of its endlessly leaking energy. The crystal shines brightly when its power rises.
column2: 一种岩石般的宝可梦。橙色晶体是不断外泄的能量凝固后形成的。力量上升时，晶体会明亮地发光。

column1: A rodent-like Pokemon resembling a flying squirrel. It can use its flaps to glide from tree to tree, and it can discharge electricity while gliding.
column2: 一种形似飞鼠的啮齿类宝可梦。它可以利用皮膜在树木间滑翔，并在滑翔时释放电流。

column1: A rodent-like Pokemon that resembles a chipmunk. Patrat is very conscious and wary regarding its surroundings and is always on guard.
column2: 一种外形像花栗鼠的啮齿动物般的宝可梦。探探鼠对周围环境十分敏感，始终保持警惕。

column1: A rotund Pokemon with a long tongue. It has a big appetite. It can lick anything or anyone close by for any leftover crumbs.
column2: 一种圆滚滚、长着长舌头的宝可梦，食量很大。它会舔舐附近的物体或人，搜寻残留的食物碎屑。

column1: A rotund feline Pokemon. It barges into the nests of other Pokemon and frighten them off so Purugly can claim the nest as its own.
column2: 一种圆胖的猫科宝可梦。东施喵会闯入其他宝可梦的巢穴，吓跑原主人，将巢穴据为己有。

column1: A roughly spherical elephantine Pokemon. It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
column2: 一种身体大致呈球形的象形宝可梦。它用鼻子挖掘地面，力量也非常大，能轻松搬运超过五吨的重物。

column1: A round Pokemon inside of a cloak of leaves. Swadloon lives on the forest floor and converts fallen leaves into nourishment, which helps the surrounding plant life grow.
column2: 一种裹在叶片斗篷中的圆形宝可梦。宝包茧栖息在森林地面上，将落叶转化为养分，帮助周围植物生长。

column1: A round Pokemon resembling a reverse-colored Poke Ball. When enraged, Hisuian Electrode can unleash a electric current equivalent to about 20 lightning bolts. It can also absorb and store chlorophyll energy along with electricity.
column2: 圆形宝可梦类似于反色精灵球。当洗翠顽皮雷弹被激怒时，可以释放出相当于约20道闪电的电流。它还可以吸收和储存叶绿素能量以及电力。

column1: A round Pokemon surrounded by a gel-like substance. It uses psychic powers to communicate with telepathy, as well as to drive away potential threats.
column2: 一种被胶状物质包裹的圆形宝可梦。用超能力进行心灵感应交流，也用它驱赶潜在的威胁。

column1: A round Pokemon. Jigglypuff uses its eyes to mesmerize opponents. Once it achieves this, it will inflate its lungs and begin to sing a soothing lullaby. If the opponent resists falling asleep, Jigglypuff will endanger its own life by continuing to sing until its lungs run out of air.
column2: 圆形宝可梦。 胖丁用眼睛迷惑对手。一旦达到这一点，它就会使肺部膨胀并开始唱一首舒缓的摇篮曲。如果对手拒绝入睡，胖丁将继续唱歌直至肺部耗尽空气，从而危及自己的生命。

column1: A round Pokemon. Jumpluff drifts on seasonal winds and can use its spores to masterfully maneuver itself around the globe.
column2: 一种圆形宝可梦。毽子棉会随季风飘荡，并利用孢子巧妙地控制方向，周游世界。

column1: A round Pokemon. Venonat's highly developed eyes help it find suitable prey and can shoot powerful beams.
column2: 圆形宝可梦。 毛球的高度发达的眼睛有助于它找到合适的猎物，并能发射强大的光束。

column1: A round Pokemon. When the flame inside its body burns, Darumaka is very active. It cannot calm down in this state, and thus becomes uncontrollable. As the flame shrinks, it falls asleep.
column2: 一种圆形宝可梦。体内火焰燃烧时，火红不倒翁十分活跃，无法平静下来，甚至不受控制。火焰减弱后就会睡着。

column1: A round plant Pokemon. It floats in the air to try to get closer to the sun, but closes its flower and immediately hides under the shade of a tree when it rains.
column2: 圆形植物宝可梦。它漂浮在空中，试图靠近太阳，但下雨时，它会关闭花朵并立即隐藏在树荫下。

column1: A round, amorphous Pokemon. It swallows anything of its own size whole, since its stomach comprises most of its body. The unique stomach acid it has allows it to digest almost anything.
column2: 一种形状不定的圆形宝可梦。胃占身体大部分，因此能吞下与自己一样大的东西。独特的胃酸几乎能消化任何物质。

column1: A round, mouse Pokemon. It can be seen bouncing and playing on its rubbery tail. The tail can also be spun around like a lasso. When the tail is thrown, the body can go as far as 33 feet (10 meters).
column2: 一种圆滚滚的鼠形宝可梦，常在富有弹性的尾巴上跳跃玩耍。尾巴也能像套索一样旋转。将尾巴抛出时，身体最远能被带到33英尺（10米）外。

column1: A round, owl-like bird Pokemon. Inside Hoothoot's body lies a special organ that senses Earth's rotation, allowing it to keep track of time. Hoothoot is well known for its ability to keep rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time, much like a metronome.
column2: 一种外形像猫头鹰的圆形鸟类宝可梦。咕咕体内有能感知地球自转的特殊器官，可以掌握时间。会像节拍器般准时歪头打拍子。

column1: A round-bodied Pokemon. Elekid tends to play out in the middle of thunderstorms. By rotating its arms, it generates electricity. However, it tires easily and can only charge a small amount.
column2: 一种身体圆滚滚的宝可梦。电击怪喜欢在雷暴中玩耍，旋转双臂就能发电。不过它很容易疲倦，只能积蓄少量电能。

column1: A rounded, bipedal Pokemon that has a tapir-like trunk. Dream Mist seeps out of the mark on its forehead. This mist has various colors depending on what kind of dreams Musharna has eaten.
column2: 一种身体圆胖、长着貘般长鼻子的双足宝可梦。梦之烟雾会从额头上的标记中渗出，颜色取决于梦梦蚀吃下的梦。

column1: A sauropod-like Pokemon. It is said that Meganium's petals can release an aroma that can soothe anyone that comes in contact with it and can calm aggressive feelings, and its breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants.
column2: 类似蜥脚类恐龙的宝可梦。据说大竺葵的花瓣可以释放出一种香气，可以安抚任何接触它的人，并可以平息攻击性情绪，而且它的呼吸具有使枯死的草和植物复活的能力。

column1: A sea star-like Pokemon. Many will float from the seafloor to the surface and align themselves with stars of the night sky as their core flickers, displaying a connection with the celestial bodies of space.
column2: 一种海星般的宝可梦。许多只会从海底浮到海面，让自己与夜空中的星星排列对应，同时闪烁核心，显示出与宇宙天体的联系。

column1: A seahorse-like Pokemon. It catches its prey by spinning its body to create large whirlpools. When its prey is exhausted, Seadra swallows it whole using its long snout.
column2: 类似海马的宝可梦。它通过旋转身体制造大漩涡来捕捉猎物。当猎物筋疲力尽时，海刺龙会用长长的鼻子将其整个吞下。

column1: A seed-like Pokemon with a small sprout growing out of its top. Sunkern is known to be very weak. Aware of its weakness, it only feeds until it evolves. However, it feeds on only the dew from under the leaves of plants.
column2: 一种顶部长着小芽的种子般的宝可梦。向日种子十分弱小，也清楚自己的弱点，所以只顾进食，直到进化。只以植物叶片下的露水为食。

column1: A serpent Pokemon. Sandaconda uses its inflated sand pouch to protect its head from harm. The pouch can store up to 220 pounds of sand for a time.
column2: 一条蛇宝可梦。 沙螺蟒使用充气的沙袋来保护头部免受伤害。该袋子一次最多可容纳 220 磅沙子。

column1: A serpent like Pokemon. With a vengeful nature, it will not give up a chase once it targets its prey or an opponent, no matter how far.
column2: 一种蛇般的宝可梦。复仇心很强，一旦锁定猎物或对手，无论对方逃到多远，都不会放弃追逐。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon similar to a Chinese dragon. It loves communicating with people and Pokemon, and is especially gentle with children. It will often appear in areas where children gather.
column2: 一种形似中国龙的蛇形宝可梦。它喜欢与人类和宝可梦交流，对孩子尤其温柔，经常出现在孩子们聚集的地方。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon that is usually depicted scrunched up like an accordion. Seviper wraps around its opponents to make them unable to move. Its tail and fangs are venomous, and are used for striking and poisoning prey or enemies.
column2: 一种蛇般的宝可梦，通常像手风琴般蜷曲。饭匙蛇会缠住对手，使其无法行动。尾巴和獠牙都有毒，能攻击并毒倒猎物或敌人。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon. As Dratini is filled with life energy, it is constantly growing, and can thus reach lengths of over six feet. As it grows, it sheds its skin regularly. Whenever Dratini undergoes shedding, it hides behind a large waterfall.
column2: 一种蛇形宝可梦。迷你龙体内充满生命能量，会不断成长，身长能够超过六英尺。成长过程中会定期蜕皮，每逢蜕皮时，它都会躲到大瀑布后面。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon. By flicking its tongue out, it is able to detect danger and the scent of prey.
column2: 一种蛇般的宝可梦。伸出舌头就能探测危险与猎物的气味。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon. Its pointed mouth is used to stab prey and drain their body fluids. However, it has also been known to feed on seaweed that grows between stones.
column2: 一种蛇形宝可梦。它用尖锐的嘴刺入猎物身体，吸取体液。不过它有时也会吃生长在石缝间的海藻。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon. Serperior will only attack with full force against opponents that are unfazed by its piercing glare.
column2: 一种蛇般的宝可梦。君主蛇只会对不畏惧其锐利目光的对手使出全力攻击。

column1: A shabby, old-looking fish-like Pokemon. While there are many of this Pokemon in existence, populations tend to cluster in small areas.
column2: 一种外貌寒碜、显得苍老的鱼形宝可梦。虽然数量很多，但种群通常聚集在狭小的区域中。

column1: A shadow-like Pokemon holding a mask that has a face from its time as a human. Due to being a human long ago, it has memories of being a human. If someone wears the mask Yamask carries, they will become possessed by the Yamask in question.
column2: 一种影子般的宝可梦，携带着描绘它生前人类面孔的面具。由于很久以前曾是人类，还保有做人时的记忆。若有人戴上哭哭面具携带的面具，就会被那只哭哭面具附身。

column1: A shadow-like mythical Pokemon. Darkrai is known to "inhabit" dreams and causes the target to have unending nightmares, which can be stopped if exposed to a Lunar Wing from Cresselia.
column2: 一种影子般的幻之宝可梦。达克莱伊会“栖息”在梦境中，使目标陷入无尽的噩梦。接触克雷色利亚的新月之羽能够终止噩梦。

column1: A sheep-like Pokemon. Dubwool's wool is very springy. Its horns serve the purpose of attracting the opposite gender rather than being used in battles.
column2: 一种绵羊般的宝可梦。毛毛角羊的羊毛富有弹性，角是用来吸引异性的，无法用于战斗。

column1: A sheep-like Pokemon. Wooloo have an extremely fluffy body which can serve as a cushion and help it survive even when falling off a cliff, and stand up without injures. The fur grows back quickly in three months even when shaved.
column2: 一只像羊一样的宝可梦。 毛辫羊的身体极其蓬松，可以起到缓冲作用，即使从悬崖上掉下来也能生存，站起来也不会受伤。即使剃掉毛发，三个月内毛发也会很快重新长出来。

column1: A short primate Pokemon. Grafaiai's saliva is brightly colored and poisonous, and its color changes depending on Grafaiai's diet, which includes Berries and Bug-type Pokemon. Grafaiai uses this poisonous saliva to attack foes, either by spitting the saliva at them or by coating its hands with the saliva before slashing at them.
column2: 一种身材矮小的灵长类动物般的宝可梦。涂标客的唾液色彩鲜艳且有毒，颜色取决于它吃下的树果和虫属性宝可梦。会向敌人吐出毒唾液，或先涂在手上再发动劈砍。

column1: A short, bipedal plant Pokemon. Capsakid creates spicy chemicals inside its body by using energy from sunlight, which it uses to power its moves.
column2: 一种矮小的双足植物状宝可梦。热辣娃利用阳光的能量，在体内制造辛辣的化学物质，再借此为招式提供力量。

column1: A short, chubby rodent Pokemon. It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
column2: 一种矮小圆胖的啮齿动物般的宝可梦。会随身携带用电烤熟的种子，视若珍宝。无论吃多少，很快就会再次饥饿。

column1: A short, eel-like Pokemon. A single Tynamo does not generate much power, so groups of Tynamo move in schools and create a more powerful shock.
column2: 一种身体短小、形似鳗鱼的宝可梦。单只麻麻小鱼产生的电力不多，因此会成群行动，合力发出更强的电击。

column1: A short, humanoid Pokemon. It creates its own hammer using iron scraps, remaking it as many times as it wants until it is satisfied. Tinkatink uses the hammer to protect itself.
column2: 一种矮小的人形宝可梦。会用铁屑制造自己的锤子，反复重制，直到满意为止。小锻匠用这把锤子保护自己。

column1: A simian Pokemon with two tails, each with a large, rounded hand with three fingers. Ambipom can leap from tree to tree with brilliant speed. To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails.
column2: 一只猿猴宝可梦，有两条尾巴，每条尾巴都有一只大而圆的手，有三个手指。 双尾怪手可以以惊人的速度从一棵树跳到另一棵树。为了吃东西，它会用两条尾巴灵巧地剥坚果。

column1: A simian Pokemon. Annihilape evolved from Primeape when the rage in its soul became too much for its physical form to contain; it gained increased power as a result of its spirit no longer being limited by the flesh.
column2: 一种猿猴般的宝可梦。火暴猴灵魂中的愤怒超出肉体承受的极限后，会进化成弃世猴。精神不再受肉体束缚，使它获得更强的力量。

column1: A simian Pokemon. Nutrient rich water is stored in its crest and it can keep itself damp or water plants by spraying water from its tail.
column2: 猿猴宝可梦。其冠部储存着营养丰富的水，它可以通过从尾部喷水来保持自身湿润或给植物浇水。

column1: A simian Pokemon. Pansage dwells deep in the forest, where it collects berries to share with its friends.
column2: 一种猿猴般的宝可梦。花椰猴栖息在森林深处，收集树果与伙伴分享。

column1: A simian Pokemon. The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
column2: 猿猴宝可梦。它头上的一簇毛可以容纳水。当水位较低时，它会用尾巴吸走水来补充毛簇。

column1: A simian Pokemon. There is a flame inside its body, which it fuels with sweet foods. It is also capable of scattering embers from its tail and the tufts on its head.
column2: 一种猿猴般的宝可梦。体内燃烧着火焰，以甜食为燃料，也能从尾巴和头顶的毛簇中洒出火星。

column1: A simian mythical Pokemon resembling a baboon or mandrill. They're usually incredibly aggressive, and frighten most other Pokemon; excelling in battle with their sharp claws and quick wit.
column2: 类似狒狒或山魈的猿猴幻之宝可梦。它们通常具有令人难以置信的攻击性，并且吓坏了大多数其他宝可梦；凭借锋利的爪子和敏捷的智慧在战斗中表现出色。

column1: A sleek, bipedal snake or dragon-like legendary Pokemon. Thundurus can shoot thunderbolts from its tail.
column2: 一种身形流畅、双足行走、外形像蛇或龙的传说的宝可梦。雷电云能从尾巴射出雷电。

column1: A slender, feline Pokemon. Liepard has well-developed muscles that allows it to run silently and strike opponents from behind. It has also been known to vanish and reappear without warning.
column2: 一只修长的猫科动物宝可梦。 酷豹拥有发达的肌肉，可以悄无声息地奔跑，从背后攻击对手。人们还知道它会在没有任何警告的情况下消失和重新出现。

column1: A slender-bodied, quadruped Pokemon. It prefers recklessly challenging opponents that are stronger than itself. Linoone is known to use its long tongue to taunt opponents.
column2: 一种身材细长的四足宝可梦。喜欢鲁莽地挑战比自己更强的对手。直冲熊以用长舌头挑衅对手而闻名。

column1: A slightly humanoid Pokemon with a few feline traits. Electabuzz is capable of storing huge amounts of electrical energy inside of its body over long periods. During torrential thunderstorms, Electabuzz will compete to determine which is capable of attaining the highest ground, so as to be most likely struck by a bolt of lightning.
column2: 略带人形的宝可梦，带有一些猫科动物的特征。 电击兽能够在体内长期储存大量电能。在暴风雨的时候，电击兽会比拼谁能到达最高的地方，这样就更有可能被闪电击中。

column1: A slightly insectoid, bipedal dragon Pokemon. With its wings, it kicks up sandstorms to hide itself. Its wings make a "singing" sound when they are flapped, earning Flygon the name "The Desert Spirit".
column2: 一种略带昆虫特征的双足龙般的宝可梦。用翅膀掀起沙尘暴隐藏自己。翅膀拍动时会发出“歌声”，让沙漠蜻蜓得到了“沙漠之魂”的称号。

column1: A slim humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Enamorus's love was said to have given rise to fresh life. However, it's also known to be vengeful to those who disrespect any form of life. It will descend from the clouds and deliver a wrathful, ruthless punishment in the process.
column2: 一种身形纤细、形似神灵的人形传说的宝可梦。据说眷恋云的爱催生了新的生命。不过，它也会报复不尊重生命的人，从云中降临，施以愤怒而无情的惩罚。

column1: A slim quadruped Pokemon. The fire coming from its head and rear can be launched as a flame attack. It also uses gusts of superheated air as a battle technique.
column2: 一种身材纤细的四足宝可梦。头部和尾端喷出的火焰能用来发动火焰攻击，也会以灼热的气流作为战斗手段。

column1: A slim, quadruped, mammalian legendary Pokemon. Suicune has the power to walk across water and purify dirty water with one touch. It travels across grasslands in search of water to purify. Northern winds always seem to blow stronger in its presence.
column2: 一种身形纤细的四足哺乳类传说的宝可梦。水君能够在水面上行走，只需触碰就能净化污水。它穿越草原，寻找需要净化的水源。它出现时，北风似乎总会刮得更猛烈。

column1: A slimy, amorphous blob-like Pokemon made of living sludge. Grimer is perpetually hungry and must constantly eat trash; if none is readily available, it will eat other manufactured products instead.
column2: 一种由活污泥构成、黏稠且形状不定的团块般的宝可梦。臭泥总是饥饿，必须不断吃垃圾；没有现成垃圾时，也会吃其他人造物品。

column1: A sloth-like, bipedal Pokemon. Vigoroth's heart beats at a tenfold tempo, and it cannot sit still for even a minute. Attempting to stand still or sleep raises its stress level and agitates its blood.
column2: 树懒般的双足宝可梦。 过动猿的心跳加快了十倍，一刻也不能平静。试图站着不动或睡觉会增加压力水平并扰乱血液。

column1: A slug-like Pokemon whose appearance changes drastically depending on where it is found. If it is pushed or squeezed, a mysterious purple fluid will ooze out of its body.
column2: 一种蛞蝓般的宝可梦。不同地区的外形差异很大。用力挤压时，身体会渗出神秘的紫色液体。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling a bird chick. Flittle is also known to be quite vengeful. Should anyone steal Flittle's berries, it will chase after them for revenge.
column2: 类似小鸟的小宝可梦。 飘飘雏也以复仇心强而闻名。如果有人偷走飘飘雏的树果，它会追赶他们进行报复。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling a key ring with four keys on it. If Klefki finds a key it likes, it will never release it. To threaten attackers, this Pokemon jingles its key collection.
column2: 一种挂着四把钥匙的小钥匙圈般的宝可梦。钥圈儿找到喜欢的钥匙后就绝不放开。会晃响收集的钥匙来威吓攻击者。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling a reptile or amphibian. Dreepy are exceptionally weak in combat, so much that on its own, a mere child could defeat it.
column2: 类似爬行动物或两栖动物的小型宝可梦。 多龙梅西亚的战斗力异常弱，小孩子就可以打败它。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling a salamander or lizard. From the base of its tail, Salandit can emit both a toxic gas and flames. The gas has a sweet odor that causes dizziness.
column2: 一种小型蝾螈或蜥蜴般的宝可梦。夜盗火蜥能从尾巴根部喷出毒气和火焰，毒气带着令人头晕的甜香。

column1: A small Pokemon similar to a mushroom. It moves around to avoid depriving the plants in any one area of too many nutrients. In addition to locomotion, its roots are also used to make communicate with other Morelull.
column2: 一种形似蘑菇的小型宝可梦。它不断移动，以免从同一片区域的植物那里夺取过多养分。根部除了用于移动，还能用来与其他睡睡菇交流。

column1: A small Pokemon similar to a mushroom. When it senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters toxic spores from the top of its head. These spores can make trees and weeds wilt and cause whole body pain if inhaled.
column2: 一种小型蘑菇般的宝可梦。察觉危险时会摇晃身体，从头顶喷出毒孢子。孢子能使树木和杂草枯萎，吸入后会全身疼痛。

column1: A small Pokemon that is shaped like an egg. Happiny's pouch is rubbery and flexible, enabling the Happiny to put things into it with ease. As it cannot produce Eggs yet, it makes up for it by carrying an Egg-shaped stone in its pouch to imitate Chansey and Blissey.
column2: 一种蛋形的小型宝可梦。小福蛋的袋子如橡胶般柔软而富有弹性，能轻松放入物品。由于还不能产蛋，它会在袋子里携带蛋形石头，模仿吉利蛋和幸福蛋。

column1: A small Pokemon that is vaguely star-shaped in appearance. It has been known to be attracted by meteor showers, and sightings of this Pokemon always increase during meteor showers.
column2: 一种外形略像星星的小型宝可梦。会被流星雨吸引，流星雨出现期间，目击次数总会增加。

column1: A small Pokemon that resembles a splash of milk. Milcery is born from sweet smelling particles in the air. It's said that patisseries visited by Milcery are guaranteed success and good fortune.
column2: 一种外形如同一团飞溅牛奶的小型宝可梦。小仙奶诞生于空气中散发甜香的颗粒。据说，被它造访的甜品店必定会获得成功与好运。

column1: A small Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Squirtles shell is a useful tool. It can withdraw into the shell for protection or for sleeping, and its grooved, rounded shape helps to reduce water resistance when this Pokemon swims.
column2: 一种小型乌龟般的宝可梦。杰尼龟的壳用途很多，能缩入其中防御或睡觉。外壳圆润且带有沟槽，游泳时能减小水的阻力。

column1: A small Pokemon whose body is almost entirely hidden under a veil. Mimikyu's disguise is modelled after Pikachu because of the popularity of Pikachu-styled merchandise. This lonely Pokemon thought that this disguise would allow it to make friends with people.
column2: 身体几乎完全隐藏在面纱下的小型宝可梦。由于皮卡丘风格商品的流行，谜拟丘的伪装以皮卡丘为蓝本。这只孤独的宝可梦以为这样的伪装可以让它与人交朋友。

column1: A small Pokemon with a darker necklace of buds. Aside from the soothing aroma that wafts from its leaf, Chikorita uses its leaf to determine the temperature and humidity of the surrounding air.
column2: 一种戴着深色花蕾项链的小型宝可梦。菊草叶的叶片会散发舒缓的香气，也能用来感知周围空气的温度与湿度。

column1: A small Pokemon with a large leaf that resembles a lilypad covering its back. This large leaf allows Lotad to float across ponds, and it will sometimes ferry smaller Pokemon on its back in this manner.
column2: 小型宝可梦，背面有一片类似睡莲的大叶子。这片大叶子允许莲叶童子漂浮在池塘上，有时它会以这种方式在背上运送较小的宝可梦。

column1: A small Pokemon with a large shell covering its body. Although Kabuto have been found fossilized by way of lying on the ocean floor for millennia, on rare occasions, it has been found still living.
column2: 一种身披巨大外壳的小型宝可梦。虽然发现的化石盔往往已在海底沉睡数千年，但极少数仍然活着。

column1: A small Pokemon with an ovoid body. Well-adapted to life in colder climates, it subsists on snow and ice and can survive temperatures as low as -150 F (-100 C) (9818 U).
column2: 小型宝可梦，具有卵形体。它非常适应寒冷气候下的生活，以雪和冰为生，可以在低至 -150°F (-100°C) (9818 U) 的温度下生存。

column1: A small Pokemon with several flowers surrounding it. This Pokemon picks flowers to create the ring around itself, and will give these rings to those it likes. The flowers can also be thrown at enemy Pokemon to create an opening to either flee or attack.
column2: 一种周围环绕着花朵的小型宝可梦。会采花编成环绕身体的花环，并将花环送给喜欢的对象，也会把花扔向敌方宝可梦，创造逃跑或攻击的机会。

column1: A small Pokemon. Due to being a bit timid, should Sobble get nervous or embarrassed, it will secrete water from its body like sweat in order to disappear into its surroundings. Sobble's tears can make others cry; the effect is so powerful that its tears are said to be as potent as 100 onions.
column2: 小型宝可梦。由于泪眼蜥比较胆小，所以如果它感到紧张或尴尬，它就会像汗水一样从体内分泌水分，以便消失在周围的环境中。 泪眼蜥的眼泪可以让别人哭；其效果非常强大，据说其眼泪的效力相当于 100 个洋葱。

column1: A small Pokemon. Hatenna is able to sense other creatures' emotions via the protrusion on its head. It never warms up to anyone that does not have a calm disposition.
column2: 一种小型宝可梦。迷布莉姆能通过头上的突起感知其他生物的情绪，绝不会亲近性情不平静的人。

column1: A small Ultra Beast. It cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
column2: 小型究极异兽。当它用头上的针向对手喷射毒液时，它会疯狂地咯咯笑。

column1: A small amphibian Pokemon. Tadbulb can generate and store enough electricity to power cities. It is also capable of using electricity to float in the air; if the weather is stormy, it can float at a higher altitude.
column2: 一种小型两栖宝可梦。光蚪仔能产生并储存足以供应城市的电力，也能用电力漂浮在空中；暴风雨时甚至能漂到更高处。

column1: A small avian Pokemon. Rufflet is extremely aggressive and knowingly provokes opponents larger and more powerful than itself. It sees this as a means of quickly getting stronger.
column2: 小型鸟类宝可梦。 毛头小鹰极具攻击性，故意激怒比自己更大、更强大的对手。它认为这是快速变得更强的一种手段。

column1: A small bipedal Pokemon. Marill is able to swim in strong water currents without being slowed down by the waters resistance, due to its water-repellent fur.
column2: 一种小型双足宝可梦。防水的皮毛让玛力露能在强劲水流中游泳，不会因水流阻力而减速。

column1: A small bipedal Pokemon. Whimsicott can manipulate its body to pass through cracks, no matter how narrow. Because of this, Whimsicott is a notorious prankster, moving things and leaving cotton balls behind.
column2: 小型双足宝可梦。 风妖精可以操纵它的身体穿过裂缝，无论裂缝有多窄。正因为如此，风妖精是一个臭名昭著的恶作剧者，移动东西并留下棉球。

column1: A small bird Pokemon. Taillow is very gutsy, and will stand up to powerful opponents without backing down.
column2: 一种小型鸟类宝可梦。傲骨燕十分勇敢，面对强大的对手也绝不退缩。

column1: A small blob like mythical Pokemon with a body made of liquid metal. It is a curious and expressive Pokemon. Meltan's liquid arms and legs can corrode and absorb metal into its body, which it uses to generate electricity.
column2: 一种团块状的小型幻之宝可梦，身体由液态金属构成。它好奇而富有表现力。美录坦的液态四肢能够腐蚀并吸收金属，再利用金属发电。

column1: A small candle-like Pokemon. Litwick pretends to guide people and Pokemon around by illuminating darkened areas. However, it is actually sucking away their life energy and leading them to the Ghost World.
column2: 一种小型蜡烛般的宝可梦。烛光灵假装照亮黑暗，为人和宝可梦指路，实际上在吸取他们的生命能量，将其引向灵界。

column1: A small cephalopod Pokemon. They have the intelligence of a three-year-old human. It is a very curious creature and often investigates things through punching them with its tentacles.
column2: 小型头足类动物宝可梦。他们拥有三岁人类的智力。它是一种非常好奇的生物，经常通过用触手猛击事物来调查事物。

column1: A small cherry-like Pokemon. It has been known to sun bathe on warm days. When it is about to evolve, the second head starts to wilt.
column2: 一种小型樱桃般的宝可梦。温暖的日子里会晒太阳。临近进化时，第二个头会开始枯萎。

column1: A small fish Pokemon with an ellipsoid body. Because of its wing-like fins, it is known as "The Beautifly of the Sea".
column2: 一条椭圆形身体的小鱼宝可梦。因其鳍状似翅膀，被称为“海中的狩猎凤蝶”。

column1: A small fishlike Pokemon. Even though an individual Wishiwashi is small and weak, people still fear it and call it the demon of the sea.
column2: 一种小型鱼般的宝可梦。虽然单只弱丁鱼体形小且力量弱，人们仍畏惧它，称它为海中的恶魔。

column1: A small humanoid Pokemon. Hatterene has a solitary and reclusive nature, emitting psychic powers strong enough to cause headaches as a method to deter others from approaching and disturbing it.
column2: 小型人形宝可梦。 布莉姆温性格孤僻，散发出足以令人头痛的灵力，以此来阻止他人接近和打扰它。

column1: A small humanoid Pokemon. Impidimp is a mischievous Pokemon that loves to sneak into people's houses to steal things and generally be a nuisance to their occupants.
column2: 一种小型人形宝可梦。捣蛋小妖调皮，喜欢潜入人们的屋子偷东西，常让住户陷入麻烦。

column1: A small larva Pokemon. Weedle can retaliate against attackers and those who step on it with its strong toxin.
column2: 小幼虫宝可梦。 独角虫可以用其强大的毒素对攻击者和踩踏它的人进行报复。
