column1: A small mole like Pokemon. Drilbur can straighten its body and align its claws forward, allowing it to spin like a drill and dig through the ground.
column2: 一种小型鼹鼠般的宝可梦。螺钉地鼠能伸直身体，将爪子朝前并拢，像钻头一样旋转，钻掘地面。

column1: A small piscine dragon Pokemon. Although relatively weak, Tatsugiri is one of the most intelligent dragon Pokemon. It baits prey such as bird Pokemon by playing dead. When its prey approaches, Tatsugiri then commands its partner, Dondozo, to attack.
column2: 一种小型鱼状龙宝可梦。米立龙虽然较弱，却是最聪明的龙宝可梦之一。它会装死，引诱鸟类宝可梦等猎物；猎物靠近后，再指挥伙伴吃吼霸发起攻击。

column1: A small quadrupedal Pokemon. As it is blind, it will bite at and eat anything that moves, and it has the vigor and energy to bite constantly and without stopping.
column2: 一种小型四足宝可梦。因为看不见，会咬住并吃掉任何移动的东西，精力充沛到能不停地咬下去。

column1: A small sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.
column2: 一种形似南瓜的小型双足宝可梦。住在南瓜中的灵魂被困在人世。南瓜精能够把游荡的灵魂送到它们应去的地方，使它们安息。

column1: A small sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.
column2: 一种小型双足南瓜般的宝可梦。南瓜怪人心怀恶意，会用头发般的手臂捕捉猎物，并以受害者的痛苦为乐。无月之夜会在城镇街头游荡，唱出诡异的歌，诅咒不幸听见的生物。

column1: A small, aquatic mythical Pokemon. Eighty percent of Manaphy's body is made of water. It is highly susceptible to its environment, and swims long distances to return to its birthplace.
column2: 一种小型水生幻之宝可梦。玛纳霏身体的80%由水构成，很容易受到环境影响，因此会游过漫长的距离，回到出生的地方。

column1: A small, arthropod Pokemon. This Pokemon is cowardly by nature and wary of both noise and sudden movements. However, its curiosity will cause it to approach people or Pokemon that are standing still.
column2: 一种小型节肢动物般的宝可梦。天生胆小，对噪音与突然的动作十分警惕，但好奇心又会驱使它接近静止不动的人或宝可梦。

column1: A small, avian Pokemon similar to a robin. Fletchling are said to be very friendly and are well known for their beautiful songs. They communicate by using chirps and moving their tail-feathers to signal one another.
column2: 一种小型鸟类宝可梦，类似于知更鸟。据说小箭雀非常友好，并以优美的歌曲而闻名。它们通过鸣叫和移动尾羽来相互发出信号进行交流。

column1: A small, bearlike legendary Pokemon. Kubfu works hard to train both body and mind, even if it suffers defeat. It has a unique organ that allows it to create "fighting energy" through special deep breathing and intense focusing.
column2: 一种小型熊般的传说的宝可梦。熊徒弟即使遭遇失败，也会继续锻炼身体和精神。特殊的器官能通过深呼吸与高度专注产生“斗气”。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon that seems to be a composite of features from an echidna and a shrew. Cyndaquil is usually timid by nature and often curls into a ball when intimidated.
column2: 小型双足宝可梦，似乎是针鼹和鼩鼱特征的复合体。 火球鼠通常生性胆怯，受到威胁时常常蜷缩成一团。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon with mixed reptilian and avian traits. It is believed to be the ancestor of all bird Pokemon.
column2: 一种兼具爬行动物与鸟类特征的小型双足宝可梦。被认为是所有鸟类宝可梦的祖先。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon. Cubone will often weep at night in mourning of its mother. When Cubone cries, the skull that it wears on its head vibrates and emits "a plaintive and mournful sound.
column2: 一种小型双足宝可梦。卡拉卡拉经常在夜晚哭泣，悼念自己的母亲。哭泣时，头上戴着的头骨会振动，发出哀怨而悲伤的声音。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon. It will test its endurance by squeezing up against other Wynaut at night. In doing so, it strengthens itself, toughens its spirit, and learns to deal powerful counterattacks.
column2: 一种小型双足宝可梦。夜里会与其他小果然相互挤推，考验耐力，借此锻炼身体和精神，学会使出强力反击。

column1: A small, bipedal canine Pokemon. It is sensitive to a special type of energy called Aura; however, It does not have the ability to fully use these powers, although it can still emanate these waves to communicate and sense them, albeit only in ripples.
column2: 一种小型双足犬形宝可梦，能感知一种名为波导的特殊能量。它还不能充分运用这种力量，但仍能发出微弱的波动，与其他生物交流并感知波导。

column1: A small, bipedal dragon-like Pokemon. It has tremendously strong jaws that it uses to bite enemies. However, when biting, it often hurts itself because of clumsiness.
column2: 一种小型双足龙般的宝可梦。下颚力量很强，可以咬击敌人，但咬东西时经常因动作笨拙而弄伤自己。

column1: A small, bipedal, bird-like Pokemon. Aromatisse can give off a variety of different smells, from a pleasant fragrance to an odor so repugnant to its opponent that it can turn a battle in its favor.
column2: 一只小型双足鸟类宝可梦。 芳香精可以散发出多种不同的气味，从令人愉悦的香味到令对手反感的气味，甚至可以扭转战局。

column1: A small, bipedal, feline Pokemon. Its ears are folded and beneath them are two ring-shaped organs. These organs emit Espurr's intense psychic powers, and said power would leak out were the ears not sheltering the organs.
column2: 一种小型双足猫科宝可梦。折叠的耳朵下有两个环状器官，是妙喵强大超能力的来源。据说耳朵若不盖住器官，力量就会泄漏。

column1: A small, caterpillar-like Pokemon. Wurmple has suction pads at the tips of its feet, which allow it to cling to glass or tree branches without slipping.
column2: 一个像毛毛虫一样的小宝可梦。 刺尾虫的脚尖有吸盘，可以吸附在玻璃或树枝上而不会滑倒。

column1: A small, ceratopsian-like reptilian Pokemon. Its facial hide is extremely hard; however, it is vulnerable when attacked from behind.
column2: 一种小型角龙般的爬行动物宝可梦。面部的皮肤极其坚硬，但背后遭到攻击时十分脆弱。

column1: A small, cuboid Pokemon resembling an insect. Charjabug creates and stores electricity in its body by digesting food. This energy is stored in an electric sac.
column2: 一个类似昆虫的小型长方体宝可梦。 虫电宝通过消化食物在体内产生并储存电力。这种能量储存在电囊中。

column1: A small, elephant-like Pokemon. In the deserted morning hours, Phanpy uses its trunk to shower in the river. Sometimes, groups of this Pokemon form and soak each other thoroughly.
column2: 一种小型大象般的宝可梦。清晨四下无人时，小小象会用鼻子从河里吸水淋浴。有时会聚成群，相互泼水，把对方彻底浇湿。

column1: A small, fairy like Pokemon. It is seen holding the pistil of a flower, which has petals that come in five colors.
column2: 一种小型妖精状宝可梦，手中握着花朵的雌蕊。花瓣有五种不同的颜色。

column1: A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Azelf's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. Legends say that if Azelf is harmed, it can cause humans to lose all will inside of them, making them completely immobile for all eternity.
column2: 一种小型妖精般的传说的宝可梦。亚克诺姆的灵魂能离开身体而不死亡，并随意返回。传说若亚克诺姆受到伤害，会使人类失去全部意志，永远无法动弹。

column1: A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Uxie's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. It created all knowledge in the Pokemon universe.
column2: 一种小型妖精状传说的宝可梦。由克希的灵魂能够在不死亡的情况下离开身体，并随时返回。它创造了宝可梦世界中的全部知识。

column1: A small, feline Pokemon. It is known to wander about city streets and pick up anything that sparkles, including loose change.
column2: 一种小型猫科宝可梦。会在城市街道上闲逛，捡起任何闪亮的东西，包括零钱。

column1: A small, feline Pokemon. The luxurious royal lifestyle soon led to Meowth diverging from its origins and becoming the selfish and prideful Alolan Meowth.
column2: 一只小型猫科动物宝可梦。奢华的皇室生活方式很快导致喵喵背离了其起源，成为自私而骄傲的阿罗拉喵喵。

column1: A small, fluffy Pokemon. It only eats sweets, which makes its fur as sticky as cotton candy.
column2: 一种毛茸茸的小型宝可梦。只吃甜食，所以毛皮像棉花糖一样黏。

column1: A small, ground-dwelling rodent Pokemon. Pichu is a social Pokemon known for its playful and mischievous demeanor. It is usually found in groups and often touch tails with other Pichu as a show of courage, creating a shower of sparks that can make them cry.
column2: 一种生活在地面的小型啮齿类宝可梦。皮丘喜欢群居，活泼又调皮。它们常与其他皮丘碰尾巴，展示勇气，但产生的火花有时会让它们疼得哭出来。

column1: A small, hedgehog-like mythical Pokemon. Each season, Shaymin gathers with others in a flower field somewhere and migrates from there. This behavior is called Flower Carrying because a new field of flowers grow where it lands.
column2: 一种小型刺猬般的幻之宝可梦。每个季节，谢米都会与同类聚集在某片花田，再从那里迁徙。这种行为被称为“携花”，因为它落下的地方会长出新的花田。

column1: A small, humanoid Pokemon. Gothita intently observes those around it, and can become unaware of attacks.
column2: 小型人形宝可梦。 哥德宝宝专注地观察周围的人，并且可能不会意识到攻击。

column1: A small, humanoid Ultra Beast that resembles origami. Despite its small size compared to the other Ultra Beasts, Kartana is extremely dangerous, as every edge of its body is impossibly sharp.
column2: 一种小型人形折纸般的究极异兽。虽然纸御剑比其他究极异兽小，却极度危险，因为身体的每一条边都异常锋利。

column1: A small, insectoid Pokemon. If threatened by a bird Pokemon, it can spew a powder that paralyzes on contact. The powder covering its body regulates its temperature, allowing it to adapt to any climate.
column2: 小型昆虫宝可梦。如果受到鸟类宝可梦的威胁，它会喷出粉末，接触后会麻痹。覆盖在其身体上的粉末可以调节其温度，使其能够适应任何气候。

column1: A small, insectoid Pokemon. In order to defend itself, Spewpa will bristle its fur to threaten predators or spray powder at them.
column2: 一种小型昆虫般的宝可梦。为了自卫，粉蝶蛹会竖起皮毛威吓捕食者，或向其喷出粉末。

column1: A small, insectoid Pokemon. Its claws are used to carve the roots of tree and absorb moisture and nutrients.
column2: 一种小型昆虫状宝可梦。它用爪子刮开树根，吸收其中的水分和养分。

column1: A small, larval Pokemon. Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak. The cloak protects it from the cold, and will become thinner when the weather is hot.
column2: 一种小型幼虫般的宝可梦。即使出生在没有结茧材料的地方，也不知为何总能披上蓑衣。蓑衣能抵御寒冷，天气炎热时会变薄。

column1: A small, lizard-like Pokemon. Helioptile can generate its own energy from sunlight, so it can thrive without food; it will still eat if needed.
column2: 一只像蜥蜴一样的小宝可梦。 伞电蜥可以从阳光中产生自己的能量，因此它可以在没有食物的情况下茁壮成长；如果需要的话它仍然会吃。

column1: A small, plant like Pokemon. The pollen it produces has a healing effect, and it can be made into a tea as a common folk remedy given to sick children.
column2: 一种小型植物般的宝可梦。产生的花粉具有治疗效果，可以泡成茶，作为民间常用的药物喂给生病的孩子。

column1: A small, plump-bodied avian Pokemon. Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction and homing instincts. It can locate its nest even when far removed from familiar surroundings.
column2: 体型小而丰满的鸟类宝可梦。 波波具有极其敏锐的方向感和归航本能。即使远离熟悉的环境，它也能找到自己的巢穴。

column1: A small, quadruped Pokemon resembling a round ice chunk. Bergmite can summon air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its opponents solid.
column2: 一种外形像圆冰块的小型四足宝可梦。冰宝能制造华氏零下150度的冷气，将对手完全冻住。

column1: A small, quadruped Pokemon similar to a dinosaur. While Jangmo-o trains diligently and remains humble, it has the pride of a warrior. It employs the scale on its forehead for both attack and defense, so it never shows its back to its foe.
column2: 类似于恐龙的小型四足动物宝可梦。 心鳞宝刻苦训练、谦虚低调的同时，却有着战士的骄傲。它利用额头上的鳞片进行攻击和防御，因此它不会向敌人露出背部。

column1: A small, quadruped Pokemon. On its back is a green plant bulb, which is grown from a seed planted there at birth. The bulb provides it with energy through photosynthesis as well as from the nutrient-rich seeds contained within.
column2: 一种小型四足宝可梦。背上有绿色植物球茎，由出生时种下的种子长成。球茎通过光合作用，以及其中营养丰富的种子，为它提供能量。

column1: A small, quadruped rodent Pokemon. Thanks to its sharp fangs, it is able to eat nearly anything. When it is threatened, Rattata can deliver a powerful bite.
column2: 小型四足啮齿动物宝可梦。由于其锋利的尖牙，它几乎可以吃掉任何东西。当受到威胁时，小拉达可以发出强有力的咬合。

column1: A small, quadruped, fox-like Pokemon. Alolan Vulpix can expel breath as cold as -58 F (-50 C) (9918 U), which is capable of freezing anything. While it is not suited to warmer environments, its tail can produce ice to lower the surrounding temperature if needed.
column2: 一种小型四足狐狸般的宝可梦。六尾（阿罗拉的样子）能呼出低至华氏零下58度（摄氏零下50度；9918 U）的气息，冻结任何东西。虽然不适应温暖环境，但必要时能用尾巴生成冰，降低周围温度。

column1: A small, quadruped, rodent-like Pokemon. Nidoran constantly listens for the sounds of approaching enemies with its large ears. Said ears have unique muscles that allow them to be moved in any direction, and even the slightest sound does not escape Nidorans notice.
column2: 一种小型四足啮齿类宝可梦。尼多朗会用大耳朵不断聆听接近的敌人的声音。耳朵上独特的肌肉使它能朝任何方向转动，连最细微的声音也逃不过它的注意。

column1: A small, quadruped, rodent-like Pokemon. The poison secreted by the spines and horn is extremely potent, and even a scratch from its horn or a drop of poison from its barbs can be deadly.
column2: 一种小型四足啮齿动物般的宝可梦。尖刺和角分泌的毒素极其猛烈，角造成的一道擦伤，或刺尖的一滴毒液，都可能致命。

column1: A small, rabbit-like Pokemon. Bunnelby's ears are strong enough to shovel dirt and chop tree roots.
column2: 一个像兔子一样的小宝可梦。 掘掘兔的耳朵足够坚固，可以铲土和砍树根。

column1: A small, rabbit-like mythical Pokemon. Victini is said to bring victory to the Trainer that befriends it. It produces an infinite amount of energy within itself and can share it with others by touch.
column2: 一种小型兔子般的幻之宝可梦。据说比克提尼能给与它成为朋友的训练家带来胜利。体内能够产生无限能量，并通过触碰与他人分享。

column1: A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. In this form, Terapagos resembles the world as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy is abnormally amplified.
column2: 一种形似乌龟的小型爬行动物传说的宝可梦。在这种形态下，太乐巴戈斯仿佛呈现出古人眼中的世界，太晶能量也异常增强。

column1: A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals.
column2: 一种小型乌龟般的爬行动物传说的宝可梦。太乐巴戈斯能将能量转化成坚硬的结晶，保护自己。

column1: A small, round Pokemon with a body shaped like a furin wind chime. Chimecho can create ultrasonic sound waves and other noises. It uses seven different echoing cries to communicate with others.
column2: 一种小而圆的宝可梦，身体形似日式风铃。风铃铃能够发出超声波和其他声音，并用七种不同的回响叫声与同伴交流。

column1: A small, round, fish-like Pokemon. Chinchou charges up its electric attacks by absorbing energy through its two antennae, and flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
column2: 一种圆形的小型鱼般的宝可梦。灯笼鱼通过两根触角吸收能量，为电气攻击蓄能，也会闪烁电光，与同类交换信号。

column1: A small, roundish Pokemon with branch-like growths on its back similar to coral. Corsola requires clean water to live. If its habitat is dirty, the growths on its back become discolored and degenerate.
column2: 小型圆形宝可梦，背部有类似于珊瑚的树枝状生长。 太阳珊瑚需要干净的水来生活。如果它的栖息地很脏，它背上的生长物就会变色和退化。

column1: A small, seahorse-like Pokemon. It is highly adept in the water, using its dorsal fin to swim in any direction while facing forward. It can use its tail as both a balance and an anchor when caught in a strong current.
column2: 一种小型海马般的宝可梦。非常擅长水中活动，能面朝前方，用背鳍向任何方向游动。陷入强劲水流时，会用尾巴维持平衡，并像锚一样固定身体。

column1: A small, skunk-like Pokemon. Stunky can spray a foul-smelling liquid from its rear in order to drive attackers away. The stench can be smelled from over a mile away, and will linger for around 24 hours.
column2: 一只像臭鼬一样的小宝可梦。 臭鼬噗可以从后方喷出恶臭液体，以驱赶攻击者。恶臭在一英里外都能闻到，并且会持续约 24 小时。

column1: A small, squirrel-like Pokemon. When it sleeps, Pachirisu likes to curl its big, fluffy tail round to the front of its body and uses it as a pillow. It also likes to chase and groom its tail.
column2: 一种小型松鼠般的宝可梦。帕奇利兹睡觉时喜欢将蓬松的大尾巴卷到身前当枕头，也喜欢追着自己的尾巴玩和梳理它。

column1: A small, vaguely humanoid Pokemon. Hattrem makes use of its ponytails as hands, pummeling its foes with them. One blow from these ponytails would knock out a professional boxer.
column2: 一个小型的、模糊的人形宝可梦。 提布莉姆以马尾辫为手，猛击敌人。这些马尾辫的一击就能击倒一名职业拳击手。

column1: A small, worm-like Pokemon. As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple, which serves as a home, food source, and protection against preying bird Pokemon. The flavor of the apple determines which evolution Applin will evolve into.
column2: 一种小型蠕虫般的宝可梦。出生后就会钻入苹果，将其作为住处和食物来源，也用它保护自己免受捕食的鸟类宝可梦攻击。苹果的味道决定啃果虫会进化成哪一种宝可梦。

column1: A snail-like legendary Pokemon. Wo-Chien is able to drain the life force of vegetations in a wide area around it, causing entire forests and fields to instantly become barren.
column2: 像蜗牛一样的传说的宝可梦。 古简蜗能够吸干周围大范围植被的生命力，让整个森林和田野瞬间变得荒芜。

column1: A snow deer-like Pokemon. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing. By using the orbs on its antlers, Wyrdeer can unleash psychic powers strong enough to distort space, and also create invisible barriers for protection.
column2: 一种雪鹿般的宝可梦。胡须脱落的毛保暖性很好，是制作冬衣的优良材料。诡角鹿能借助鹿角上的宝珠释放足以扭曲空间的超能力，并制造无形屏障保护自己。

column1: A specter Pokemon which possesses a teapot. It is made of black tea that tastes very good, but can cause indigestion or stomach aches if drunk in excess.
column2: 一种附身于茶壶的幽灵宝可梦。它由味道很好的红茶构成，但饮用过量会引起消化不良或胃痛。

column1: A specter Pokemon which possesses a teapot. It is made of black tea that tastes very good, but can cause indigestion or stomach aches if drunk in excess. Most of the teapots that Polteageist infects are forgeries.
column2: 一种附身于茶壶的幽灵宝可梦。身体由美味的红茶构成，但饮用过量会导致消化不良或胃痛。怖思壶附身的茶壶大多是赝品。

column1: A spherical Pokemon similar to a bell. Inside its mouth is an orb, which creates a ringing sound as the Pokemon moves. Additionally, the orb can be vibrated to create high frequency, long lasting cries to deafen its opponents.
column2: 一种形似铃铛的球形宝可梦。口中的圆球会在移动时发出铃声，也能通过振动产生高频而持续的叫声，使对手失聪。

column1: A spherical Pokemon that appears to be covered by a gray cloth. Its horn collects the negative emotions of people, on which this Pokemon feeds. The emotions it feeds on include anger, jealousy, and envy.
column2: 一种仿佛披着灰布的球形宝可梦。角能收集人类的负面情绪，作为它的食物，包括愤怒、妒忌与嫉恨。

column1: A spherical Pokemon that looks like a Poke Ball with a face, minus the button. It has a volatile temperament, and will explode if bumped or agitated.
column2: 一种球形宝可梦，外形如同长着脸、没有按钮的精灵球。它脾气暴躁，受到碰撞或刺激就会爆炸。

column1: A spherical Pokemon that looks like a Poke Ball with a face, minus the latch. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
column2: 一种球形宝可梦，外形像长着脸、没有开关的精灵球。兴奋时会释放腹部储存的电流，再发出响亮的大笑。

column1: A spherical Pokemon. Sigilyph will use its psychic powers to attack anyone who invades its territory. Due to it retaining memories from when it guarded an ancient city, it apparently flies along the same route constantly.
column2: 球形宝可梦。 象征鸟将利用其心灵力量攻击任何入侵其领地的人。由于它保留着守护古城时的记忆，所以它显然一直沿着同一条路线飞行。

column1: A spherical Pokemon. While it is always expressionless, it is able to sense the emotions and thoughts of others.
column2: 一种球形宝可梦。虽然总是面无表情，却能感知他人的情绪和想法。

column1: A spherical, bull-like legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Terrakion. Iron Boulder stores laser energy within its sharp horns. Iron Boulder uses the charged energy within its axe horns to plow through anything within Iron Boulder's path.
column2: 一种身体呈球形的牛形传说的宝可梦，是外形酷似代拉基翁的神秘生命体。铁磐岩把激光能量储存在锋利的角里，再用充满能量的斧状角冲破挡路的一切。

column1: A spherical, golem-like legendary Pokemon. Due to its body being formed by crystallized dragon energy, Regidrago is said to have the most powerful Dragon-type moves of all Pokemon. It also has the power of every Dragon-type Pokemon.
column2: 一种球形魔像般的传说的宝可梦。雷吉铎拉戈的身体由龙之能量结晶而成，据说拥有所有宝可梦中最强大的龙属性招式，也拥有每一种龙属性宝可梦的力量。

column1: A spirit possessing a rotten tree stump. People that happen to enter the forest may be led astray by Phantump, as they are capable of imitating the sound of childrens voices.
column2: 一种附身于腐烂树桩的灵魂。小木灵能够模仿孩子的声音，因此进入森林的人可能被它引入歧途。

column1: A squat ape-like Pokemon. The snowball on its head serves as a way of preserving food and other things it finds by storing them in the snowball itself.
column2: 一种矮胖猿猴般的宝可梦。会把食物和找到的其他东西藏进头上的雪球，以此保存它们。

column1: A squat quadruped Pokemon. Venusaur uses its flower to catch the suns rays to convert them into energy, which causes the flower to take on colors that are more vibrant.
column2: 一种矮壮的四足宝可梦。妙蛙花利用花朵吸收阳光，将其转化为能量，使花朵的颜色更加鲜艳。

column1: A squid-like Pokemon. It can lure prey with hypnotic motions before it wraps its tentacles around the prey, then it finishes off with digestive fluids.
column2: 一种鱿鱼般的宝可梦。会用催眠般的动作引诱猎物，再用触手缠住，最后用消化液将其解决。

column1: A squirrel-like Pokemon. Using its special cheeks, Skwovet can stuff a tremendous amount of food and can stretch to many times its normal volume. When they are not eating berries, they spit out the seeds in the rich soil in order to cultivate berry trees.
column2: 一种形似松鼠的宝可梦。贪心栗鼠特殊的脸颊能够容纳大量食物，伸展到正常体积的数倍。不吃树果时，它们会把种子吐到肥沃的土壤里，培育树果树。

column1: A stag or antelope-like, mechanical, quadruped legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Virizion. It has glowing parts on its forehead and neck can transform into ethereal swords.
column2: 一种外形像雄鹿或羚羊的四足机器传说的宝可梦。它是酷似毕力吉翁的神秘生命体，额头和颈部的发光部位能化成无实体的剑刃。

column1: A starfish-like Pokemon with a stalk-like body. Mareanie is known to actively hunt and prey on Corsola. Its main tactic is to harass it until the Corsola sheds its horns.
column2: 类似海星的宝可梦，身体像茎一样。众所周知，好坏星会主动捕猎太阳珊瑚。它的主要策略是骚扰它，直到太阳珊瑚掉下角。

column1: A stocky, armored, Pokemon. Lairon smashes its steely body against others in battle over territory, and shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming into rocks.
column2: 一种身材壮实、披着盔甲的宝可梦。可多拉争夺领地时，会用钢铁般的身体撞击对手，也会撞击岩石，用产生的巨大火花展示力量。

column1: A stout, bipedal, reptilian Pokemon. Frigibax stores the ice energy inside its body and uses it to cool its dwelling. It stores more ice energy the greater its surrounding temperatures are.
column2: 一种粗壮的双足爬行动物宝可梦。凉脊龙把冰之能量储存在体内，用来给住所降温。周围温度越高，它储存的冰之能量就越多。

column1: A stout, bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. Although Pawmot's reaction speed is normally low, it is able to strike opponents with fast movements when battling.
column2: 一种身材粗壮的双足啮齿动物般的宝可梦。巴布土拨平时反应慢，战斗时却能以迅疾的动作攻击对手。

column1: A stout, canine Pokemon. Dachsbun's body emanates a pleasant, appetizing aroma, which helps wheat to grow; thus, Dachsbun is historically treasured by farming villages.
column2: 一种粗壮的犬形宝可梦。麻花犬的身体散发着诱人的香气，能够帮助小麦生长，因此自古以来深受农耕村落珍爱。

column1: A super sized bipedal Pokemon that resembles a pumpkin. The spirit residing in the pumpkin is trapped in this world. Pumpkaboo can carry wandering spirits to where they belong, so they can move on.
column2: 一种特大体形的双足南瓜般的宝可梦。居住在南瓜里的灵魂被困在了这个世界。南瓜精能将游荡的灵魂带回它们应去的地方，让它们继续旅程。

column1: A swan-like Pokemon. Swanna is known to fly for thousands of miles without rest. Swanna flies out when the sun rises. At dusk, flocks of Swanna will dance, with the leader in the middle of the routine.
column2: 一种形似天鹅的宝可梦。舞天鹅能连续飞行数千英里而不休息。日出时，它们外出飞行；黄昏时，成群的舞天鹅会围着居中的首领起舞。

column1: A swan-like legendary Pokemon. Cresselia has the power to dispel nightmares, and holding one of its feathers is said to bring happy dreams.
column2: 一种天鹅般的传说的宝可梦。克雷色利亚能驱散噩梦，据说握住它的一根羽毛就能做美梦。

column1: A tall Pokemon resembling Stonehenge. Occasionally, it will unleash a burst of speed to perform dynamic feats with its legs. Most of the time, it stands in a field watching the sun's progress, preferring a quiet life.
column2: 一种高大的宝可梦，外形酷似巨石阵。它偶尔会突然加速，用双腿做出充满力量的动作。大多数时候，它喜欢安静地站在原野中，观看太阳在天空中移动。

column1: A tall Pokemon with a soft body. Wobbuffet is usually a docile Pokemon that will never attack first. However, when it is attacked, it will inflate its body and initiate a counterstrike.
column2: 一种身体柔软、身材高大的宝可梦。果然翁通常温顺，绝不主动攻击。但受到攻击时，会鼓起身体进行反击。

column1: A tall bipedal Pokemon. The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokemon has considerable agility.
column2: 高大的双足宝可梦。构成其身体的特殊金属非常轻，因此这种宝可梦具有相当的灵活性。

column1: A tall flightless avian Pokemon resembling an ostrich. Espathra is able to emit psychic powers from its eyes and the gaps between its frills. By using the psychic powers emitted from its eyes, it can immobilize foes.
column2: 一种外形像鸵鸟的高大无翼鸟类宝可梦。超能艳鸵能从眼睛与褶边之间的缝隙释放超能力，也能用眼中发出的超能力让敌人无法动弹。

column1: A tall, avian Pokemon that resembles an owl. It takes only a tenth of a second for it pluck, aim, and fire an arrow quill from its wings. It is not only quick, but also accurate, capable of striking targets over half a mile away.
column2: 一只高大的鸟类宝可梦，类似于猫头鹰。它从翅膀上拔出、瞄准并发射箭羽只需要十分之一秒的时间。它不仅速度快，而且准确，能够打击半英里外的目标。

column1: A tall, avian Pokemon that resembles an owl. It tends to have a nomadic lifestyle, wandering the region in search of food. Its legs can deliver powerful kicks that can knock down trees and destroy boulders.
column2: 一种高大的猫头鹰般的鸟类宝可梦。常过着游荡的生活，四处寻找食物。双腿能使出强力踢击，踢倒树木、击碎巨岩。

column1: A tall, bipedal Pokemon that strongly resembles a coconut palm or other palm tree. Each head thinks independently of the others, so it makes a lot of noise as each head speaks its mind.
column2: 高大的双足宝可梦，与椰子树或其他棕榈树非常相似。每个头都独立思考，因此当每个头说出自己的想法时会发出很大的噪音。

column1: A tall, metallic, bipedal dinosaur-like Pokemon. When Archaludon faces danger, it will get down on all fours, straighten its body, retract its limbs, and fully extend the spires on its hands and feet, forming a shape that resembles a steel bridge. In this position, Archaludon is capable of using the static electricity stored in its terminals to fire a tremendously powerful beam of electric energy.
column2: 一种高大的金属双足恐龙般的宝可梦。铝钢桥龙遇到危险时会四足着地，伸直身体，收拢四肢，并完全展开手脚上的尖塔，形成钢桥般的姿态。这时能用末端储存的静电，发射极其强大的电能光束。

column1: A thin bipedal, insectoid Pokemon. It is very parental and uses its cutters and a sticky silk it produces to create clothing made of leaves for small Pokemon.
column2: 一种细长的双足昆虫宝可梦。它非常有爱心，用它的刀具和它生产的粘丝为小宝可梦制作树叶衣服。

column1: A three-headed, draconic Pokemon. Hydreigon is a violent, destructive Pokemon. It will attack anything that moves, determining it a foe.
column2: 一种三头龙般的宝可梦。三首恶龙凶暴而喜欢破坏，将一切移动的东西视为敌人并发动攻击。

column1: A tiny Pokemon that seems to be perpetually buried within the earth. Diglett digs regularly through the earth at a shallow depth, leaving perfectly tilled soil in its wake.
column2: 一个微小的宝可梦似乎永远埋在地下。 地鼠定期在浅层土壤中挖掘，留下完美耕耘的土壤。

column1: A tiny avian Pokemon. Wattrel flies in a specific way so that its wings are able to catch the wind. Its bones, in reaction to the wind, create electricity for Wattrel, and it uses this ability to dive into bodies of water to electrocute its prey, such as Arrokuda.
column2: 一种小型鸟类宝可梦。电海燕会以特定的方式飞行，让翅膀捕捉风。骨头对风作出反应并产生电力，它会利用这种能力潜入水中，电击刺梭鱼等猎物。

column1: A tiny insectoid Pokemon. Ribombee uses its fluffy hair to hold pollen it collects from flowers. Rain causes its hair to become dirty, so it only visits fields if the weather will remain clear.
column2: 一只微小的昆虫宝可梦。 蝶结萌虻用蓬松的毛发来容纳从花朵中收集的花粉。雨水会使它的头发变脏，所以只有在天气晴朗的情况下它才会去田野。

column1: A tiny shrew-like Pokemon. Shroodle has a mellow personality, but if angered, it will bite into the offender, inflicting them with its venom.
column2: 一种极小的鼩鼱般的宝可梦。滋汁鼹性情温和，但被激怒时会咬住冒犯者，注入毒液。

column1: A tortoise-like, quadruped Pokemon. It uses coal to fill the hollow spaces in its shell, and then burns it for energy. When it blows out smoke from its nostrils and the top of its back, it sounds like a locomotive horn.
column2: 类似乌龟的四足宝可梦。它用煤填充壳内的空腔，然后燃烧以获取能量。当它从鼻孔和背顶喷出烟雾时，发出的声音就像是火车头的喇叭声。

column1: A tumbleweed-like Pokemon. Brambleghast catches prey using its branches, completely enveloping them. Once accomplished, it will not let go of the prey until all of its life energy has been drained.
column2: 一种风滚草般的宝可梦。怖纳噬草会用枝条抓住猎物，将其完全包裹。随后绝不松开，直到吸干猎物的生命能量。

column1: A turtle-like bipedal Pokemon. Golem is able to withdraw its head, arms, and legs into its shell and roll at high speeds. Golem is dangerous when doing this, as it is unable to see and may crash into or run over anything in its path.
column2: 一只像乌龟一样的双足宝可梦。 隆隆岩能够将头、手臂和腿缩回壳内并高速滚动。 隆隆岩执行此操作时很危险，因为它无法看到并且可能会撞上或碾过其路径上的任何东西。

column1: A two-headed Pokemon covered in a swirled substance that resembles ice cream. Vanilluxe ingests large quantities of water, which it uses to create internal snow clouds. When angered, it expels a powerful blizzard.
column2: 一种双头宝可梦，表面覆盖着旋卷的冰淇淋般的物质。双倍多多冰会喝下大量的水，在体内制造雪云，发怒时喷出强烈的暴风雪。

column1: A vaguely anthropoid Pokemon with a body made of whipped cream. When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
column2: 一种身体由鲜奶油构成、略呈人形的宝可梦。霜奶仙感到满足时，手中分泌的奶油会变得更加香甜浓郁。

column1: A vaguely humanoid Pokemon capable of spinning on its head. Hitmontop moves more quickly by spinning on the spike on its head than it does by walking normally. Capable of spinning at high speeds, it may bore into the ground similar to a drill.
column2: 一种略呈人形、能倒立旋转的宝可梦。战舞郎依靠头顶尖刺旋转时，比正常行走更快。高速旋转也能让它像钻头般钻入地面。

column1: A very tall Ultra Beast that resembles a vaguely humanoid mass of electrical wiring. It is speculated to sustain itself with electricity. This is supported by observations that it will "plug" its limbs and tail into the ground when it is low on energy, entering a treelike state to absorb electricity from the earth.
column2: 一种非常高大的究极异兽，外形仿佛一团略呈人形的电线。人们推测它靠电力生存：能量不足时，它会把四肢和尾巴“插”进地面，进入树木般的状态，从大地吸收电力。

column1: A virtual, manmade Pokemon. Porygon-Z was given additional software in order to increase its abilities. The initial idea was to give it the ability to travel through alien dimensions, but an error occurred. Instead, the Pokemon began acting erratically.
column2: 一种虚拟的人造宝可梦。为了提高能力，多边兽乙型被加入了额外软件。原本希望让它能够穿越异次元，但程序出错，反而让它开始出现反常行为。

column1: A vulture-like Pokemon, particularly resembling a turkey vulture. Mandibuzz lives in nests made from the bones it finds. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
column2: 类似秃鹫的宝可梦，特别像火鸡秃鹫。 秃鹰娜生活在用它发现的骨头制成的巢中。当它们发现猎物时，它们会攻击并轻松地将其带回巢穴。

column1: A worm-like Pokemon that lives inside an apple. Dipplin is capable of producing syrup, which they use to coat their apple in layers. This syrup has a fragrant scent that captivates Dipplin's opponents.
column2: 一种居住在苹果中的蠕虫般的宝可梦。裹蜜虫能产生糖浆，层层涂在苹果表面。糖浆带有芳香，能迷惑对手。

column1: A zebra-like Pokemon. Its mane captures and stores electricity, which flashes whenever this Pokemon discharges energy. It communicates with other members of its species by controlling the rhythm and frequency of these flashes.
column2: 类似斑马的宝可梦。它的鬃毛可以捕获并储存电力，每当宝可梦释放能量时，鬃毛就会闪烁。它通过控制这些闪光的节奏和频率来与其物种的其他成员进行交流。

column1: A zebra-like Pokemon. This irritable Pokemon fires lightning bolts from its mane when angry. Zebstrika can move as quickly as lightning, releasing thunderclaps at full gallop.
column2: 一种斑马般的宝可梦。性情易怒，发火时会从鬃毛射出闪电。雷电斑马的移动速度快如闪电，疾驰时会发出雷鸣。

column1: An Ultra Beast composed of stone squares stacked together to form a four-sided tower. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
column2: 究极异兽由石块堆叠在一起形成四面塔。每一个似乎都是由许多生命形式堆叠而成。

column1: An Ultra Beast mostly resembling an anthropomorphic, feminine cockroach. Pheromosa's lithe, elegant body is capable of sudden feats of acceleration, able to twitch its limbs at an estimated 120mph/200kmh instantaneously.
column2: 一种主要呈现拟人化雌性蟑螂外形的究极异兽。费洛美螂轻盈优雅的身体能突然加速，四肢的瞬间移动速度估计达到每小时120英里（200公里）。

column1: An Ultra Beast that resembles a large, anthropomorphic mosquito. For unknown reasons, Buzzwole appears to strike bodybuilding poses before it performs any sort of action; this is thought to be its main form of communication, but what it could be trying to communicate is not understood.
column2: 究极异兽类似于大型拟人化蚊子。由于未知的原因，爆肌蚊在执行任何动作之前似乎都会摆出健美姿势；这被认为是它的主要交流形式，但它试图交流的内容尚不清楚。

column1: An Ultra Beast which resembles a jellyfish. Nihilego is a parasitic organism, capable of injecting a neurotoxin that manipulates the thoughts and actions of the host. This neurotoxin stimulates intense feelings of excitement while causing a loss of inhibitions, which acts to forcibly bring out any latent potential within the host at the expense of its mental stability.
column2: 一种水母般的究极异兽。虚吾伊德是寄生生物，能注入神经毒素，操控宿主的思想与行动。毒素会引发强烈兴奋，削弱自制力，强行激发宿主的潜能，同时损害其精神稳定性。

column1: An alien-like bipedal legendary Pokemon. Deoxys was formed by the mutation of a virus from outer space and came inside of a meteor.
column2: 一种形似外星人的双足传说的宝可梦。代欧奇希斯由外太空病毒变异而成，并乘着陨石来到这里。

column1: An ammonite Pokemon. Its shell constantly grows, getting heavier over time and thus limiting its mobility.
column2: 一种菊石般的宝可梦。外壳不断生长，越来越重，逐渐限制了活动能力。

column1: An amphibious Pokemon that resembles an upright, armless axolotl. When sleeping, it partially buries itself in the mud at the bottom. It will occasionally leave the water when the air cools in the evening to search for food along the shore.
column2: 两栖宝可梦，类似于直立的无臂蝾螈。睡觉时，它会把自己的一部分埋在底部的泥里。当晚上空气变凉时，它偶尔会离开水面，沿着海岸寻找食物。

column1: An amphibious bipedal Pokemon. It has powerful vision, enabling it to see even in murky water. Swampert also has the ability to predict storms, sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins.
column2: 一种双足两栖宝可梦。视力很好，即使在浑浊的水中也能看清。巨沼怪还能用鳍感知海浪与潮风声音的细微差异，预测风暴。

column1: An amphibious, bipedal Pokemon with an ovoid body. The bumps on its head can be vibrated to create either waves or earthquakes.
column2: 两栖双足宝可梦，身体呈卵形。它头上的凸起可以振动以产生波浪或地震。

column1: An angular, hard bipedal Pokemon that closely resembles the Easter Island Heads. To protect itself when in danger, it raises its magnetism and draws iron objects to its body.
column2: 一种棱角分明、身体坚硬的双足宝可梦，外形很像复活节岛石像的头部。遇到危险时，会增强磁力，将铁质物体吸到身上保护自己。

column1: An aquatic Pokemon that resembles a sea dragon. Dragalge can spit poison strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker; this territorial Pokemon will spit this poison at whatever trespasses its territory. As a result, it is said that ships sailing through the seas where it lives never return.
column2: 一种形似海龙的水生宝可梦。毒藻龙的毒液足以腐蚀油轮船体，它会向任何闯入领地的东西喷吐毒液。因此，据说驶入它栖息海域的船只再也不会返回。

column1: An aquatic Pokemon with a serpentine body. It uses its fish-like tail to attract prey, and then uses its mouth to grab and swallow the prey whole.
column2: 一种身体细长如蛇的水生宝可梦。会用鱼般的尾巴吸引猎物，再用嘴抓住并吞下。

column1: An aquatic, serpentine Pokemon. Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all Pokemon. When there are fights going on, it has the power to calm angry feelings and end arguments by releasing a wave of energy.
column2: 水生蛇形宝可梦。 美纳斯据说是所有宝可梦中最漂亮的。当发生争斗时，它有能力通过释放能量波来平息愤怒情绪并结束争吵。

column1: An arachnoid Pokemon. Spidops is a covert ambush predator that utilizes its sticky and resilient silk threads to cling upon any surface and move without making a sound.
column2: 一种蜘蛛般的宝可梦。操陷蛛擅长隐蔽伏击，能用黏性且坚韧的丝附着在任何表面上，无声地移动。

column1: An arachnoid Pokemon. Tarountula's thread is elastic and strong as wire, being able to deflect even the attacks of its natural enemy, Scyther.
column2: 一种蛛形宝可梦。团珠蛛的丝富有弹性且坚韧如钢丝，连天敌飞天螳螂的攻击也能抵挡。

column1: An arthropod Pokemon, resembling an anomalocaris. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.
column2: 一种外形像奇虾的节肢动物般的宝可梦。会伸出爪子，抓住藏在海底岩石中的猎物。

column1: An avian Pokemon resembling a flamingo. Flocks of Flamigo are known to attack together in perfect harmony, via a behavior known as "synchronizing".
column2: 类似火烈鸟的鸟类宝可梦。众所周知，缠红鹤群会通过一种被称为“同步”的行为，以完美和谐的方式一起攻击。

column1: An avian Pokemon resembling a parrot. Squawkabilly are known to be exceptionally noisy. They have a strong sense of community and dislike being alone, so they cooperate and form flocks that can contain more than 50 individuals based on the color of their feathers.
column2: 一种鹦鹉般的鸟类宝可梦。怒鹦哥非常吵闹，群体意识强，不喜欢独处。会互相合作，并根据羽毛颜色组成超过50只的群体。

column1: An avian Pokemon similar to a parakeet. This Pokemon's tongue is similar to a humans, allowing it to imitate human speech. Chatot is also able to mimic the cries of other Pokemon, and uses this ability as a defense mechanism.
column2: 与长尾小鹦鹉相似的鸟类宝可梦。 宝可梦的舌头与人类的舌头很相似，可以模仿人类的语言。 聒噪鸟还能够模仿其他宝可梦的叫声，并利用这种能力作为防御机制。

column1: An avian Pokemon that can change between four markedly different forms. Baile Style Oricorio is very passionate and exudes power when it dances. It throws off downy fluff when it dances that it can ignite to perform a fiery dance attack.
column2: 一种能在四种明显不同的样子之间变化的鸟类宝可梦。花舞鸟（热辣热辣风格）跳舞时热情洋溢、充满力量。会甩出柔软的绒毛并将其点燃，发动火焰舞蹈攻击。

column1: An avian Pokemon that can change between four markedly different forms. Pom-Pom Style Oricorio's dancing charges its feathers with static electricity. While charged, its feathers can be used to attack and unleash electric shocks.
column2: 一种能在四种明显不同的形态之间变化的鸟类宝可梦。啪滋啪滋风格的花舞鸟跳舞时，会让羽毛带上静电。带电的羽毛能够用来攻击并释放电击。

column1: An avian Pokemon that can change between four markedly different forms. Sensu Style Oricorio is a calm and collected Pokemon. Through its dance, it draws in nearby spirits and borrows their power to fight.
column2: 一种能在四种明显不同的样子之间变化的鸟类宝可梦。花舞鸟（轻盈轻盈风格）冷静沉着，会通过舞蹈吸引附近的灵魂，借用它们的力量战斗。

column1: An avian Pokemon that is very small. Although inept at other aspects of its flying, such as height and distance, Spearow is still capable of flying quickly to protect its territory.
column2: 非常小的鸟类宝可梦。尽管烈雀在飞行的其他方面（例如高度和距离）无能为力，但仍然能够快速飞行以保护其领地。

column1: An avian Pokemon that resembles a white duck. It is said that this evolution was attained by a Farfetch'd who experienced and survived many battles. It is known to be calm and collected, preferring to fight fairly.
column2: 一种外形像白鸭的鸟类宝可梦。据说经历过多次战斗并幸存的大葱鸭才能完成这种进化。性情冷静沉着，喜欢公平战斗。

column1: An avian Pokemon with a beak that is reminiscent of a doctors mask. The scent it emits, which can vary depending on its diet, enraptures those who smell it.
column2: 一只禽类宝可梦，其喙让人想起医生的面具。它散发出的气味会根据其饮食的不同而变化，让闻到它的人着迷。

column1: An avian Pokemon with a prominent beak similar to a toucan's. There are gases inside the beak, which can ignite and launch seeds with enough force to shatter boulders.
column2: 一种鸟类宝可梦，有着巨嘴鸟般突出的鸟嘴。嘴里储存着可燃气体，能将其点燃并发射种子，威力足以击碎巨岩。

column1: An avian Pokemon with an ovoid body. When it is seen or visits respectful people, it showers gifts of blessings and kindness.
column2: 具有卵形身体的鸟类宝可梦。当它被看到或拜访受人尊敬的人时，它会送上祝福和仁慈的礼物。

column1: An avian Pokemon with plumage resembling a person dressed in formal attire. With a mere cry, It can summon and organize flocks of Murkrow in this manner, and is known as the "summoner of the night" by the pitch black darkness that often accompany such a spectacle.
column2: 一种羽毛像穿着正装的人类的鸟类宝可梦。只需一声鸣叫，就能召集并组织成群的黑暗鸦。这样的景象往往伴随着漆黑的夜色，因此被称为“黑夜召唤者”。

column1: An avian Pokemon. Although capable of flapping its wings powerfully, Starly is weak and inconspicuous when alone.
column2: 鸟类宝可梦。虽然姆克儿能够有力地扇动翅膀，但单独行动时却很弱且不引人注目。

column1: An avian Pokemon. Aware of its own weakness, it forms flocks of its own kind and cries noisily if left on its own.
column2: 一种鸟类宝可梦。清楚自己弱小，因此会与同类聚在一起，落单时会大声哭叫。

column1: An avian Pokemon. Murkrow has a fondness for anything sparkly, and it will steal things such as jewelry to bring it back to its nest.
column2: 鸟类宝可梦。 黑暗鸦喜欢闪闪发光的东西，它会偷走珠宝之类的东西，把它带回巢穴。

column1: An avian Pokemon. No matter how far a Tranquill travels, it is always able to return to its Trainer.
column2: 一种鸟类宝可梦。无论咕咕鸽走得多远，都能回到训练家身边。

column1: An avian Pokemon. This Pokemon feeds on berries. It stores the seeds in its beak and uses them as ammunition against both enemies and prey.
column2: 鸟类宝可梦。此宝可梦以树果为食。它将种子储存在喙中，并将其用作对抗敌人和猎物的弹药。

column1: An avian Pokemon. This Pokemon uses its wings to catch updrafts and soar across the sky. It gracefully glides through the clouds, often while singing or humming in a soprano voice.
column2: 一种鸟类宝可梦。会用翅膀捕捉上升气流，在天空中翱翔。常一边发出女高音般的歌声或轻哼，一边优雅地滑翔穿过云层。

column1: An avian legendary Pokemon. Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokemon.
column2: 一种鸟类传说的宝可梦。吉雉鸡拍打光泽亮丽的翅膀，散播能使人类和宝可梦着迷的信息素。

column1: An eel-like Pokemon that resembles a lamprey. It can use its arms to crawl out of the ocean and its sucker mouth to suck in prey. After latching onto its prey using its sucker mouth, it drags the prey into the ocean. It electrifies prey before eating.
column2: 一种外形像七鳃鳗的鳗鱼般的宝可梦。能用手臂爬出海洋，用吸盘般的嘴吸入猎物。抓住猎物后，会将其拖入海中，在进食前先施以电击。

column1: An elephant-like Pokemon. Donphan has the ability to curl up into a ball and violently roll around like a wheel. These rolling tackles are strong enough to knock down a house. Once it starts its rampage, it will be almost unstoppable.
column2: 一种象形宝可梦。顿甲能够蜷成一团，像车轮一样猛烈滚动。滚动冲撞的力量足以撞倒房屋，一旦开始暴走，几乎无法阻挡。

column1: An equine Pokemon. At full gallop, its hooves barely touch the ground. The faster Rapidash go, the longer the swaying flames of its mane will become. At an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, a feature which is said to enhance its beautiful appearance.
column2: 一种马般的宝可梦。全速奔跑时，蹄子几乎不碰地面。烈焰马跑得越快，鬃毛中的火焰就越长。全力奔驰时，火焰鬃毛闪闪发光，更显美丽。

column1: An equine Pokemon. Galarian Rapidash is known for being brave and prideful. It can channel its psychic power into a powerful Psycho Cut from its horn that can pierce through sheet metal.
column2: 一种马形宝可梦。伽勒尔烈焰马勇敢而自尊心强，能够把超能力凝聚到角上，释放足以切开金属薄板的精神利刃。

column1: An equine Pokemon. Ponyta can control its flames so that its rider is not burned by them. It also has extraordinary jumping abilities, and is capable of leaping tall buildings in a single bound.
column2: 一种马般的宝可梦。小火马能控制火焰，使骑手不会被灼伤。跳跃能力出众，能一跃越过高楼。

column1: An equine legendary Pokemon. Its kicks are said to separate a soul from its body, and it can steal the life force of sleeping beings. It feeds on the ambient life-force it steals from others and will attack anyone who would try to disturb it.
column2: 马传说的宝可梦。据说它的踢腿可以将灵魂与身体分离，并且可以窃取沉睡生物的生命力。它以从他人那里窃取的周围生命力为食，并会攻击任何试图干扰它的人。

column1: An equine mythical Pokemon resembling a qilin or centaur. Arceus does not suffer fools gladly, and it will attack in a violent rampage if betrayed or deceived.
column2: 一种兼有麒麟或半人马外形的马般的幻之宝可梦。阿尔宙斯不能容忍愚弄，一旦遭到背叛或欺骗，就会暴怒攻击。

column1: An extraterrestrial Pokemon. It communicates by flashing its multi-colored fingers. Beheeyem can change the memories of its opponents, being able to erase or even rewrite them.
column2: 外星人宝可梦。它通过闪烁多彩的手指进行交流。 大宇怪可以改变对手的记忆，能够擦除甚至重写它们。

column1: An extraterrestrial Pokemon. It is willing to help in stressful and otherwise difficult situations. However, Elgyem can become fully involved in something it feels to be important and protect that with its life.
column2: 一种外星宝可梦。愿意在紧张或困难的情况下提供帮助。然而，小灰怪也会全身心投入它认为重要的事情，并用生命保护它。

column1: An inorganic Pokemon resembling a car engine. Revavroom typically attaches itself to rocks that resemble the wheels and the body of a wagon, which it uses as a means of locomotion. It can create gas by combining the minerals in the rocks with its poison. The gas is then detonated in its cylinders to generate energy for itself.
column2: 类似于汽车发动机的无机宝可梦。 普隆隆姆通常将自己附着在类似于车轮和马车车体的岩石上，将其用作移动手段。它可以通过将岩石中的矿物质与其毒物结合来产生气体。然后气体在气缸中引爆，为自身产生能量。

column1: An inorganic, metallic Pokemon. Varoom attaches itself to rocks that resemble wheels. These rocks constitute Varoom's diet, as it feeds on minerals from the rocks and converts them into energy.
column2: 一种无机金属宝可梦。噗隆隆会附在轮子般的岩石上，以岩石中的矿物质为食，并将其转化成能量。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon resembling a grasshopper. When threatened, Nymble can jump to a height of over 30 feet (10 meters). Its jumping capabilities allow it to dodge attacks while dealing damage.
column2: 类似蚱蜢的昆虫宝可梦。当受到威胁时，豆蟋蟀可以跳到超过 30 英尺（10 米）的高度。它的跳跃能力使其能够在造成伤害的同时躲避攻击。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon resembling a locust. Lokix usually keeps its third set of legs folded on its back; however, it can unfold these legs to enter what is known as its Showdown Mode.
column2: 一种蝗虫般的昆虫宝可梦。烈腿蝗通常将第三对腿折叠在背上，但可以将其展开，进入被称为“决战模式”的状态。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon that has been completely overtaken by the parasitic mushroom on its back. The insect has been drained of nutrients and is now under the control of the fully-grown tochukaso.
column2: 一种被背上寄生蘑菇完全占据的昆虫状宝可梦。昆虫的养分已被吸干，如今完全受长成的冬虫夏草控制。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon with a head sporting the horsehair crest of a knight's helmet, with a visor underneath it. Its tough armor protects its entire body. It flies around at high speed, jabbing foes with its lances.
column2: 一种昆虫般的宝可梦。头部像带有马鬃饰冠和面甲的骑士头盔。坚固的铠甲保护全身，会高速飞行，用长枪刺击敌人。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon with a pronounced hump. Venipede is brutally aggressive, and its bite injects a poison strong enough to paralyze large bird Pokemon.
column2: 具有明显驼峰的类昆虫宝可梦。 百足蜈蚣具有残酷的攻击性，它的咬伤会注入足以麻痹大鸟宝可梦的毒液。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon with some plant-like features. Lurantis both looks and smells like a flower, a trait that it exploits to lure in foes so it can spring a surprise attack.
column2: 一种兼有植物特征的昆虫般的宝可梦。兰螳花的外形与气味都像花朵，会借此引诱敌人，发动突然袭击。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon. It builds its nest in a bowl-shaped pit dug in sand. It sits in its nest and waits for prey to stumble inside. Once inside, the prey cannot climb back out.
column2: 类昆虫宝可梦。它在用沙子挖的碗形坑中筑巢。它坐在巢中，等待猎物跌跌撞撞地爬进去。一旦进入，猎物就无法再爬出来。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon. It can secrete oil from the tips of its feet, which enables it to walk on water as though skating.
column2: 一种昆虫般的宝可梦。脚尖能分泌油脂，使它能像滑冰一样在水面上行走。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon. Masquerain's four wings allow it to fly in any direction and hover, but it cannot fly when its wings are wet.
column2: 类昆虫宝可梦。 雨翅蛾的四个翅膀可以让它向任何方向飞行并悬停，但翅膀湿时无法飞行。

column1: An octopus-like Pokemon. With a body made of pure muscle, it gives it very powerful grip strength. It enjoys fighting opponents, and moves onto the land to fight them, before returning to its ocean home.
column2: 一种章鱼般的宝可梦。完全由肌肉构成的身体赋予它极强的握力。喜欢与对手战斗，会爬上陆地挑战，结束后再返回海中。

column1: An upright, meerkat-like Pokemon. There are luminescent compounds in Watchog's body that allow its stripes and eyes to glow. It uses this ability to threaten predators.
column2: 直立的、像猫鼬的宝可梦。 步哨鼠的体内含有发光化合物，可以使其条纹和眼睛发光。它利用这种能力来威胁掠食者。

column1: An ursine, quadruped Pokemon capable of standing on its hind legs. Beartic is capable of freezing its own breath, and will create pathways across water using this technique.
column2: 一种四足熊般的宝可梦，也能以后腿站立。冻原熊可以将呼出的气息冻结，借此在水中开辟通道。

column1: As a result of Gigantamaxing, its psychic power and intelligence have become overwhelming. Should Gigantamax Orbeetle use a slight bit of power it has, it can control the minds of every living being within the vicinity.
column2: 超极巨化使它的超能力和智力强大得惊人。超极巨以欧路普只需动用极少的力量，就能控制附近所有生物的心智。

column1: By combining the strength of its jaws and powerful neck, Drednaw is capable of punching a hole through a mountain with one strike. According to one tale, Drednaw stopped a flood by using the rubble from a mountain it chewed up.
column2: 暴噬龟结合下颚力量与强健的颈部，一击就能在山上打出洞。传说它曾用吞食山体后产生的碎石阻止洪水。

column1: Gigantamax Blastoise can adapt to any situation using various cannon combinations. It never aims in battle as it prefers to overwhelm its opponent by launching dynamic, powerful torrents from its cannons.
column2: 超极巨化的水箭龟能组合使用各种炮口，适应任何情况。战斗时从不瞄准，而是从大炮中射出猛烈的水流，以压倒对手。

column1: Gigantamax Gengar's mouth is rumored to not lead into its body. Due to the cursed energy, it is believed to instead lead into the afterlife. By laying a trap, it attempts to steal the lives of those it captures.
column2: 据说超极巨耿鬼的嘴并不通向体内。在诅咒能量的作用下，它似乎反而通向死后世界。它会布下陷阱，试图夺走被捕获者的生命。

column1: Gigantamax Melmetal can release tremendous electric beams from its belly, capable of vaporizing the opponent in one shot and vaporizing an entire hill.
column2: 超极巨化的美录梅塔能从腹部释放巨大的电能光束，一击就能让对手甚至整座山丘蒸发。

column1: Gigantamax Sandaconda attacks by spinning its body at high speeds, causing the sand to move at incredible speeds and inflicting massive damage to anything that touches it.
column2: 超极巨沙螺蟒通过高速旋转身体进行攻击，使沙子以令人难以置信的速度移动，并对接触它的任何物体造成巨大伤害。

column1: Gigantamax Single Strike Style Urshifu has been called "the very embodiment of rage" and "a divine emissary that banishes evil spirits with its fury.
column2: 超极巨化的武道熊师（一击流）被称为“愤怒的化身”和“以愤怒驱逐邪灵的神圣使者”。

column1: Gigantamax Venusaur's vines are powerful enough to topple down a 10-story building, while Venusaur's flower can spread enough pollen similar to a volcano eruption.
column2: 超极巨妙蛙花的藤蔓的力量足以推倒10层楼，而妙蛙花的花可以传播足够的花粉，类似于火山喷发。

column1: In its Gigantamax form, Corviknight is powerful enough to generate hurricane-force winds. It can use its massive wings to hover in the air on updrafts created while Gigantamaxing.
column2: 超极巨化后的钢铠鸦力量足以产生飓风级的风。巨大的翅膀能借助超极巨化产生的上升气流，使它悬停在空中。

column1: It is compelled to drum due to its power building up from inside. The sounds it makes can reach across oceans and other regions. Those who hear the beat will start to dance uncontrollably.
column2: 由于其内部积聚的力量，它被迫击鼓。它发出的声音可以跨越海洋和其他地区。那些听到节拍的人就会开始不受控制地跳舞。

column1: Its body is a colossal stove. With Gigantamax energy stoking the fire, its fire can burn even hotter than 3600 F (2000 C) (13568 U) and its shoulders temperature is over 3140 F (1727 C) (13108 U).
column2: 身体是一座巨大的火炉。超极巨化能量助燃后，火焰温度超过华氏3600度（摄氏2000度；13568 U），肩部温度也超过华氏3140度（摄氏1727度；13108 U）。

column1: Its power is equal to that a power plant; however, it is difficult to use it in peoples' homes since Pikachu can only remain in its Gigantamax form for a short time.
column2: 它产生的电力相当于一座发电厂。不过，皮卡丘只能短时间维持超极巨形态，因此很难把这些电力用于家庭供电。

column1: Known as the Raging Goddess, Gigantamax Hatterene has the ability to sense the emotions of creatures from over 30 miles (50 kilometers) away, and it will become enraged and attack if it senses any hostility.
column2: 超极巨化的布莉姆温被称为“愤怒女神”，能感知30英里（50公里）以外的生物情绪。感受到敌意时就会发怒并发动攻击。

column1: Poltchageist was born from the regrets of an old tea master, who was so obsessed with perfecting the art of the tea ceremony that he drove away everyone around him. It has taken up residence in a very expensive tea caddy.
column2: 斯魔茶诞生于一位老茶师的悔恨。这位茶师一心追求茶道的完美，以至于赶走了身边所有人。它如今寄居在一个十分昂贵的茶罐中。

column1: The Azure Flute is a hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. It puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world.
column2: 天界之笛是一种手持管乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的音孔选择音高。它发出的回响仿佛不属于这个世界。

column1: The Chilan Berry whistle is a small hand-held wind instrument made from a Chilan Berry that is cored out and dried. The musician blows through the hole. The instrument has an indescribable sound.
column2: 灯浆果哨子是一种小型手持管乐器，由掏空并风干的灯浆果制成。演奏者通过孔洞吹气，发出难以形容的声音。

column1: The Clear Bell is a small hand-held percussion instrument. The musician shakes the bell. The instrument makes a gentle ringing sound.
column2: 透明铃铛是一种小型手持打击乐器。演奏者摇动铃铛，发出轻柔的铃声。

column1: The Gigantamax energy coursing through its arms makes its punches hit as hard as bomb blasts.
column2: 超极巨的能量在手臂中流动，使其拳头如同炸弹爆炸一样猛烈。

column1: The Moon Flute is a medium hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokemon of the moon.
column2: 月亮之笛是一种中型手持管乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的音孔选择音高。据说笛声曾用于向月亮的传说的宝可梦表达感激。

column1: The Sun Flute is a medium hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokemon of the sun.
column2: 太阳之笛是一种中型手持管乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的音孔选择音高。据说，这支笛子奏出的音色曾被献给太阳的传说的宝可梦，以表达感激之情。

column1: The Tidal Bell is a small hand-held percussion instrument. The musician shakes the bell. The instrument makes a gentle ringing sound.
column2: 海声铃铛是一种小型手持打击乐器。演奏者摇动铃铛，发出轻柔的铃声。

column1: The flames within Gigantamax Charizard burns hotter than 3600 F (1982 C) (13568 U). When it roars, the temperature can climb to even higher lengths.
column2: 超极巨喷火龙体内的火焰温度超过3600°F（1982°C，13568 U）。当它咆哮时，温度还会进一步升高。

column1: The glass flute is a small hand-held wind instrument made from glass. The musician blows through the opening. The instrument has various effects depending on the color.
column2: 玻璃笛是一种由玻璃制成的小型手持管乐器。演奏者向开口吹气。不同颜色的笛子具有不同效果。

column1: The massive wings are powerful enough to lift a ten-ton truck through a simple flap. The wind it generates can scatter poisonous scales throughout the area, making it dangerous to be near it.
column2: 它巨大的翅膀只需轻轻一扇，就能举起十吨重的卡车。产生的风会把有毒的鳞粉散布到周围区域，使靠近它变得十分危险。

column1: The powers of Plates are shared among Pokemon. The rightful bearer of a Plate draws from the Plate it holds.
column2: 石板的力量由宝可梦共享。石板真正的持有者能从持有的石板中获得力量。

column1: The the result of Magneton leveling up in the presence of a special magnetic field. With its magnets, it has the ability to control anti-gravity and float through the air at will.
column2: 三合一磁怪在特殊磁场中提升等级后进化而成。它利用磁铁操控反重力，可以在空中随意漂浮。

column1: This is Necrozma's form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.
column2: 这是奈克洛兹玛吸收了压倒性的光之能量后的样子。全身都能发射激光束。

column1: This is Necrozma's form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.
column2: 这是奈克洛兹玛吞噬露奈雅拉之光时的形态。它用巨大的爪子抓住敌人，再以蛮力将其撕碎。

column1: This is a temporary creature so revived Pokemon are healed.
column2: 这是一种临时生物，用于使复活的宝可梦得到治疗。

column1: Under the influence of Gigantamax energy, it produces much more sweet, sticky nectar. It blasts its opponents with massive amounts of this nectar, drowning them under the deluge.
column2: 在超极巨能量的影响下，它会分泌出更多香甜黏稠的花蜜，并用大量花蜜轰击对手，将对手淹没。

column1: Using its well-honed techniques and fighting spirit, Gigantamax Cinderace can make its ball chase after opponents almost like it has a mind of its own. It is said to have the strongest leg strength of any Pokemon.
column2: 超极巨化的闪焰王牌凭借精湛的技巧与斗志，能让火焰球像拥有意志般追赶对手。据说它的腿部力量是所有宝可梦中最强的。

column1: When the cream gets hit by a strong impact, the cream hardens depending on the blow. This allows it to be resistant to all physical attacks while the giant berry decorations cannot be scratched due to them being as hard as diamond.
column2: 奶油受到强烈冲击时，会随着冲击力度而硬化，因此能够抵挡所有物理攻击。巨大的树果装饰坚硬如钻石，也不会被划伤。

column1: While Gigantamaxed, Copperajah's trunk is powerful enough to level mountains and obliterate large structures.
column2: 超极巨化时，大王铜象的鼻子力量足以夷平山脉，摧毁大型建筑。

column1: its gills have hardened, and it coats its body with a poisonous film that keeps it from drying out.
column2: 它的鳃已经变硬，身体上覆盖着一层有毒的薄膜，防止身体干燥。

column1: they share any food they find equally within the pair, and they build their nest together using materials they've gathered with their incisors.
column2: 它们会平分找到的食物，并用门牙收集材料，共同建造巢穴。

column1: 5,000 people can ride on the shell of Gigantamax Lapras for a very comfortable ride without any issues. Lapras can use its giant ring to break any icebergs that may prevent it from swimming.
column2: 超极巨化的拉普拉斯的背甲能让５０００人舒适地乘坐，不会出现任何问题。拉普拉斯能用巨大的圆环击碎妨碍它游泳的冰山。

column1: A Legendary Pokemon that resembles a serpent. This form of Zygarde is thought to monitor those who destroy the ecosystem from deep with its cave. Should the regions ecosystem fall into disarray, it will appear and reveal its power.
column2: 外形像蛇的传说的宝可梦。人们认为，这种形态的基格尔德会在洞穴深处监视破坏生态系统的人。如果当地的生态系统陷入混乱，它就会现身并展现力量。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Absol. Its fur is longer overall, and the increased energy coursing through its body makes the fur at the back of its mane stand on end, so that it appears to have wings.
column2: 阿勃梭鲁的超级进化形态。全身的毛发都变长了，体内流动的能量增强，使鬃毛后方的毛发竖起，看起来仿佛长出了翅膀。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Alakazam. The organ on its forehead is said to emit psychic power.
column2: 胡地的超级进化形态。据说，它额头上的器官会释放精神力量。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Audino. Mega Audino can release pulses that reduce hostility, and the secondary feelers can put those who come in contact with them into a deep sleep.
column2: 差不多娃娃的超级进化形态。超级差不多娃娃能释放减轻敌意的脉冲，另外一对触角能让接触者陷入沉睡。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Blastoise. The two cannons on its back are replaced by a single, central water cannon of greater size. This cannon extends forward over Mega Blastoise's head and is said to have a blast range of over 6 miles (10 km).
column2: 水箭龟的超级进化形态。背上的两门炮合为位于中央的一门巨大水炮。这门水炮向前伸到超级水箭龟的头顶，据说射程超过６英里（１０公里）。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Charizard. Mega Charizard X breathes blue flames out the sides of its mouth, and the flame on its tail now burns blue with increased heat.
column2: 喷火龙的超级进化形态。超级喷火龙Ｘ从嘴巴两侧喷出蓝色火焰，尾巴上的火焰也变成蓝色，温度更高。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Gallade. When the situation demands, Mega Gallade can use its psychic power to reshape both arms into blades simultaneously, and fight using a dual-wielding style.
column2: 艾路雷朵的超级进化形态。必要时，超级艾路雷朵能用精神力量同时将双臂变成利刃，以双刀作战。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Gengar. A third eye appears on its forehead. This new unblinking eye allows it to see into other dimensions.
column2: 耿鬼的超级进化形态。额头上出现了第三只眼睛。这只从不眨动的新眼睛让它能看见其他次元。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Heracross. This Pokemon has a high body temperature, so it opens the shell on its torso to allow heat to escape.
column2: 赫拉克罗斯的超级进化形态。这种宝可梦的体温很高，会打开躯干上的甲壳散热。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Latias. Its body can refract light, which allows it to become invisible or alter its appearance.
column2: 拉帝亚斯的超级进化形态。身体能折射光线，使它隐身或改变外貌。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Manectric. The mane on Mega Manectric is considerably larger than its previous state.
column2: 雷电兽的超级进化形态。超级雷电兽的鬃毛比进化前大得多。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Metagross. Its multiple brains process information simultaneously, enabling it to calmly assess the tide of a battle and defeat its opponent with accuracy.
column2: 巨金怪的超级进化形态。多个大脑同时处理信息，让它能冷静判断战局，准确地击败对手。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Rayquaza. Inside Rayquaza's body lies an organ that contains the same power as a Mega Stone. By consuming meteoroids as it flies through the stratosphere, the mikado organ will be filled with enough energy to enable Rayquaza's Mega Evolution.
column2: 烈空坐的超级进化形态。烈空坐体内有一个器官，蕴含着与超级石相同的力量。它飞过平流层时会吞食流星体，让这个“天皇器官”积蓄足够的能量，使烈空坐超级进化。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Sceptile. Mega Sceptile can cut off a portion of its tail to fire it like a missile at an opponent.
column2: 蜥蜴王的超级进化形态。超级蜥蜴王能截断尾巴的一部分，像导弹一样射向对手。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Slowbro. Mega Slowbro's energy has gathered into Shellder, which has increased its hardness. This allows it to act as an armor so hard that nothing can scratch it.
column2: 呆壳兽的超级进化形态。超级呆壳兽的能量集中到了大舌贝身上，使其变得更硬，成为连刮痕都不会留下的坚固盔甲。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Tyranitar. The scales on Mega Tyranitar's belly seethe with energy, enabling it to emanate more power.
column2: 班基拉斯的超级进化形态。超级班基拉斯腹部的鳞片涌动着能量，让它能释放更强的力量。

column1: A Pokemon based on a cicadas shed exoskeleton. It is said that looking into the crack on its back will steal ones spirit.
column2: 外形源自蝉蜕的宝可梦。据说，窥视它背上的裂缝会被夺走灵魂。

column1: A Pokemon composed of seven symbiotic partners known as "syrpents" living within an apple made of red syrup. The syrpents that form Hydrapple have inconstant temperaments. On the rare occasion that the syrpents' moods align, Hydrapple reaches its full potential.
column2: 由七条共生的“糖蛇”组成的宝可梦，栖居在由红色糖浆构成的苹果中。组成蜜集大蛇的糖蛇头部脾气各不相同、变化无常。只有在这些头部难得心意一致时，蜜集大蛇才能发挥全部潜力。

column1: A Pokemon covered in vines. Tangela can ensnare and entangle anything that moves too close to it with its vines. The vines constantly jiggle and sway, unnerving enemies and deterring herbivores that might mistake Tangela for a shrub.
column2: 全身覆盖藤蔓的宝可梦。蔓藤怪能用藤蔓缠住任何靠得太近的东西。藤蔓不停地晃动，让敌人心生不安，也能吓退可能把蔓藤怪当作灌木的食草动物。

column1: A Pokemon in the shape of a sarcophagus. Ancient legends once told Cofagrigus could eat nearby humans and turn their lifeless bodies into mummies.
column2: 石棺形状的宝可梦。古老传说称，迭失棺会吞吃附近的人类，并将他们失去生命的身体变成木乃伊。

column1: A Pokemon made of matcha tea. It pretends to be tea in order to trick people into drinking it, so it can absorb their life force.
column2: 由抹茶构成的宝可梦。它假装成茶，诱骗人们喝下，以吸取他们的生命力。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a Venus flytrap. With its mouth wide open, it attracts the prey it waits for with a sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.
column2: 外形像捕蝇草的宝可梦。它张大嘴巴，用散发甜香的唾液吸引等待中的猎物，随后一口咬下。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a bear or panda cub. Despite its small size, Stufful has extraordinary strength and can knock out even well trained Pokemon if they are unprepared.
column2: 外形像小熊或熊猫幼崽的宝可梦。童偶熊虽然体型小，力量却十分惊人。即使训练有素的宝可梦，也可能在毫无防备时被它击倒。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a chrysalis. Metapod generally remains motionless, preparing its soft innards for evolution inside its hard shell.
column2: 外形像蛹的宝可梦。铁甲蛹通常一动不动，在坚硬外壳内让柔软的内部组织做好进化的准备。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a flattened durian. It can use its spiked appendages to either cling to ceilings of its cave or walk around. When hanging, it can attack its prey underneath by shooting spikes.
column2: 外形像压扁的榴莲的宝可梦。它能用带刺的附肢攀附洞穴顶部，也能四处行走。悬挂时，它会发射尖刺，攻击下方的猎物。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a manta ray. Mantyke is a friendly Pokemon that can be found swimming near the oceans surface with schools of Remoraid.
column2: 外形像蝠鲼的宝可梦。小球飞鱼性情友好，常与铁炮鱼群一起在海面附近游泳。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a salamander or lizard. Salazzle is a female-only species. It creates a reverse harem with the male Salandit it lives with.
column2: 外形像蝾螈或蜥蜴的宝可梦。焰后蜥只有雌性个体，它会让同住的雄性夜盗火蜥围绕自己，形成由它统领的群体。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a small olive tree. Arboliva has a calm and compassionate nature, kind enough to share its nutrient-rich, aromatic oil with weakened Pokemon. However, when threatened, it will drive back enemies by launching its oil at them, with a force powerful enough to destroy a boulder.
column2: 外形像小橄榄树的宝可梦。奥利瓦性情平和、富有同情心，会与虚弱的宝可梦分享营养丰富、芳香四溢的油。受到威胁时，它会喷射油来击退敌人，威力足以击碎巨石。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a spider. The bubble serves as a means of protection to Dewpider's soft head and allows it to breathe when on land.
column2: 外形像蜘蛛的宝可梦。气泡能保护滴蛛柔软的头部，也让它在陆地上能够呼吸。

column1: A Pokemon resembling a weasel and a sea otter. Its tail acts as a boat propeller by spinning, though it was seen flying using its tail.
column2: 外形像鼬和海獭的宝可梦。它的尾巴能像船的螺旋桨一样旋转，也曾有人看见它用尾巴飞行。

column1: A Pokemon resembling six light pink eggs, usually seen arranged with five heads huddled around a sixth. The heads communicate with each other by using a form of telepathy that only they can understand.
column2: 外形像六枚浅粉色蛋的宝可梦，通常是五个头围在第六个头旁。各个头用只有它们自己能理解的心灵感应交流。

column1: A Pokemon seemingly formed out of stone. The armored plates on its lower jaw are stronger than steel, and allow Hisuian Avalugg to break through boulders easily and shovel through deep snow.
column2: 身体仿佛由石头构成的宝可梦。下颚的甲片比钢铁还坚硬，让冰岩怪（洗翠的样子）能轻易撞碎巨石，在深厚的积雪中开路。

column1: A Pokemon shaped like a refrigerator. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 外形像冰箱的宝可梦。洛托姆能进入电器并控制它们，还经常捉弄毫无防备的人。

column1: A Pokemon similar to a koala. This Pokemon has never been seen awake. While its expression sometimes changes as if it is aware of its surroundings, this appears to be a result of its dreams instead.
column2: 外形像考拉的宝可梦。从未有人见过它醒着。有时它的表情会变化，仿佛察觉到了周围的情况，但这似乎只是梦境造成的。

column1: A Pokemon surrounded by a blob of translucent, gelatinous substance. Reuniclus controls its powerful arms using psychic powers. It can form a network with the brains of other Reuniclus by clasping hands with them.
column2: 包裹在半透明胶状物质中的宝可梦。人造细胞卵用精神力量操纵强壮的双臂，也能通过与其他人造细胞卵握手，让彼此的大脑连成网络。

column1: A Pokemon that bears a strong resemblance to a ferret. Its most notable feature is its long skinny body, which is used for slipping through the small entrances to its nest and squirm through small spaces to escape foes.
column2: 外形与雪貂十分相似的宝可梦。它最显眼的特征是细长的身体，既能钻过巢穴狭小的入口，也能在狭窄空间中穿行，逃离敌人。

column1: A Pokemon that is comprised of a golden sword and ornate shield. It is said to be able to detect the innate qualities of leadership; legend has it that whoever Aegislash recognizes as a worthy leader is destined to become king.
column2: 由金色长剑和华丽盾牌组成的宝可梦。据说它能识别与生俱来的领导才能。传说，被坚盾剑怪认可为合格领袖的人，注定会成为国王。

column1: A Pokemon that looks like a stylized personification of the Grim Reaper. It is said that this Pokemon will spirit away disobedient children, and it has been described to enjoy the crying of children.
column2: 外形像拟人化死神的宝可梦。据说它会掳走不听话的孩子，而且喜欢听孩子的哭声。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a bipedal crocodile. Totodile tends to be playful by nature, and has a habit of biting anything it sees, including its Trainer.
column2: 外形像双足鳄鱼的宝可梦。小锯鳄天性顽皮，习惯咬住看到的任何东西，甚至包括自己的训练家。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a blob with stubby arms and legs. Its body is soft and rubbery, allowing it to inflate by inhaling. While it is inflated, it is able to move by bouncing or floating.
column2: 身体像一团软胶、四肢短粗的宝可梦。身体柔软而有弹性，能吸气膨胀。膨胀时，它能靠弹跳或漂浮移动。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a caterpillar. Caterpie will shed its skin many times before finally cocooning itself in thick silk.
column2: 外形像毛毛虫的宝可梦。绿毛虫会蜕皮很多次，最终用厚厚的丝把自己裹成茧。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a duck or bipedal platypus. Psyduck is constantly stunned by its headache and is unable to think very clearly. It usually stands immobile, trying to calm its headache. However, when its headache becomes too severe, it releases tension in the form of strong psychic powers.
column2: 外形像鸭子或双足鸭嘴兽的宝可梦。可达鸭总是被头痛弄得晕头转向，无法清晰思考。它通常一动不动地站着，试图缓解头痛。头痛过于剧烈时，它会释放强大的精神力量，以排解积聚的压力。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a full garbage bag. Trubbish emits noxious, burp-like gases which, when inhaled, will render the victim bedridden for a week.
column2: 外形像装满垃圾的袋子的宝可梦。破破袋会释放类似打嗝气体的毒气，吸入者会卧床不起整整一周。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a lantern. Lampent can sense when someone is about to die, whom it visits and steals the spirit from the person's body.
column2: 外形像灯笼的宝可梦。灯火幽灵能感知即将死去的人，会前去拜访并从他们体内夺走灵魂。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a modestly sized rock. When its shell breaks, Minior becomes lighter and capable of attacking quickly, but it cannot survive for long with its core exposed.
column2: 外形像中等大小岩石的宝可梦。壳破裂后，小陨星会变得更轻，能迅速攻击。但核心暴露在外时，它无法存活太久。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a quadruped wolf. Little things don't shake the calm behavior of Dusk Form Lycanroc, but it carries an intense fighting spirit hidden within, which as a result, it relishes combat at close quarters.
column2: 外形像四足狼的宝可梦。鬃岩狼人（黄昏的样子）处事沉着，不会被小事动摇；内心却隐藏着强烈的斗志，因此特别热衷近身战斗。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a sentient chandelier. Chandelure's fires do not burn its victims physically, instead burning their spirit. After hypnotizing its opponent by waving these flames, it absorbs the victims spirit.
column2: 外形像有生命的吊灯的宝可梦。水晶灯火灵的火焰灼烧的是灵魂，而非肉体。它会摇曳火焰催眠对手，再吸取受害者的灵魂。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a slouched, bipedal wolf or werewolf. Lycanroc's Midnight Form is thrilled by battling, and becomes more excited the stronger its opponent.
column2: 外形像弯腰站立的双足狼或狼人的宝可梦。鬃岩狼人（黑夜的样子）热衷战斗，对手越强，它就越兴奋。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a snow-covered tree. A curious Pokemon, it often approaches people and can be found inspecting footprints in the snow.
column2: 外形像覆雪树木的宝可梦。它好奇心旺盛，经常接近人类，也常被发现正在查看雪地中的脚印。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a sword from the medieval times. The sash is known to suck out the life energy of anyone around whose arm it wraps.
column2: 外形像中世纪长剑的宝可梦。据说，剑上的缎带缠住谁的手臂，就会吸取谁的生命能量。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Tirtouga's shell is very tough, and it can dive down to depths of as much as 1000 meters.
column2: 外形像龟的宝可梦。原盖海龟的壳非常坚硬，能潜到深达１０００米的水下。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles an over-sized, scorpion. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey, and grips prey with its tail claws, injecting poison; it will then hold on until the poison takes effect.
column2: 外形像巨大蝎子的宝可梦。它把自己埋在沙中，等待毫无防备的猎物，再用尾钳抓住猎物并注入毒液。它会一直抓着猎物，直到毒性发作。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles two interlocking gears with six teeth each. Once two bodies have joined, they cannot combine with any others and will rebound without meshing.
column2: 由两个相互啮合、各有六齿的齿轮组成的宝可梦。一旦两个身体结合，就无法与其他个体组合，接触时只会弹开，无法啮合。

column1: A Pokemon which resembles a lizard. Drakloak is capable of flying at speeds greater than 120 mph (193.121 kph). It carries a Dreepy on its head, which it takes care of and fights alongside until the Dreepy manages to evolve.
column2: 外形像蜥蜴的宝可梦。多龙奇的飞行速度能超过每小时１２０英里（１９３．１２１公里）。它把多龙梅西亚放在头上照顾，与其并肩作战，直到多龙梅西亚能够进化。

column1: A Pokemon with a body of plasma that is shaped like a lightning rod. Rotom has the ability to enter and control appliances and will often pull pranks on unsuspecting people.
column2: 身体由等离子体构成、形状像避雷针的宝可梦。洛托姆能进入电器并控制它们，还经常捉弄毫无防备的人。

column1: A Pokemon with a round head and a tiny body. Phione inflates the sac on its head to drift in the water and search for food. When the water grows warm, it will drift in packs with other members of its species.
column2: 头部圆圆、身体小巧的宝可梦。霏欧纳会让头上的囊膨胀，在水中漂流觅食。水温升高时，它会与同类成群漂游。

column1: A Pokemon with a spherical body. A mysterious life-form having the appearance of a Jigglypuff but with a ferocious aggression that leads it to attack anyone who comes near. Scream Tail is capable of levitating itself, as opposed to walking.
column2: 身体呈球形的宝可梦。它是外形像胖丁的神秘生物，却具有凶猛的攻击性，会袭击任何靠近者。吼叫尾能悬浮移动，无须步行。

column1: A Pokemon with the impression of a stylized rooster. Its known for protecting its home, but it is fickle and will not necessarily help people in need. However, it is very curious, and may come to play or battle with people or Pokemon that interest it.
column2: 外形像公鸡的宝可梦。它以守护家园闻名，但性情反复无常，不一定会帮助有需要的人。不过，它好奇心很强，可能会找感兴趣的人或宝可梦玩耍或战斗。

column1: A badger-like Pokemon with a bulky yet agile body. Typhlosion will make anything go up in flames when angered, and generates shimmering heat from its body when it is ready for battle.
column2: 外形像獾的宝可梦，身体厚重却敏捷。火暴兽被激怒时，能让任何东西燃起火焰；准备战斗时，身体会散发使空气晃动的热气。

column1: A bat-like Pokemon. It glides smoothly and silently through the air with its limbs extended, and startles its prey and enemies by flying straight toward them.
column2: 外形像蝙蝠的宝可梦。它伸展四肢，在空中平稳而无声地滑翔，还会直冲猎物和敌人，令它们受惊。

column1: A bat-like Pokemon. Zubat lives in abundance in caves. It has evolved to have neither eyes nor nostrils, instead navigating through dark environments with echolocation.
column2: 外形像蝙蝠的宝可梦。超音蝠大量栖居在洞穴中。它演化得既没有眼睛，也没有鼻孔，而是依靠回声定位在黑暗中辨识方向。

column1: A beetle-like Pokemon that resembles the body of a ladybug. Orbeetle are famous for their large brains and high intelligence. Its large brain is proof of the immense psychic power it possesses.
column2: 身体像瓢虫的甲虫状宝可梦。以欧路普以硕大的脑和高智力闻名，巨大的脑正是它拥有强大精神力量的证明。

column1: A bell-shaped Pokemon. Weepinbell camouflages itself as a plant in the forest whilst awaiting an unwary victim. When its prey draws near it sprays toxic pollen to immobilize the target before melting it with its internal acids.
column2: 外形像铃铛的宝可梦。口呆花伪装成森林中的植物，等待毫无防备的猎物。猎物靠近时，它会先喷洒有毒花粉使其无法动弹，再用体内的酸液溶解猎物。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon resembling a cross between a mongoose and cat. Zangoose is bitter enemies with Seviper, which it has battled against for many generations.
column2: 外形兼具獴和猫的特征的双足宝可梦。猫鼬斩与饭匙蛇是世仇，双方已经争斗了许多代。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon resembling an ogre. It is known to carry concrete pillars in its massive arms, which it uses to attack strongly without using physical strength or to support its massive upper body.
column2: 外形像食人魔的双足宝可梦。它用巨大的双臂搬运混凝土柱，借助柱子省力地发动猛烈攻击，也用柱子支撑沉重的上半身。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon similar to a turtle. Its tail is a popular symbol of longevity, making it popular with the elderly.
column2: 外形像龟的双足宝可梦。它的尾巴常被视作长寿的象征，因此深受老年人的喜爱。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that is similar to a cyclops. Its body is hollow and can absorb anything much like a black hole.
column2: 外形像独眼巨人的双足宝可梦。身体内部是空的，能像黑洞一样吸入任何东西。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon that resembles a tapir. Drowzee is able to put people to sleep, and can then sense the person's dreams. This is so it knows what kind of dream it would be eating.
column2: 外形像貘的双足宝可梦。催眠貘能使人入睡，再感知他们的梦境，好知道自己将要吃下怎样的梦。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a Shellder latched onto its head. Galarian Slowking have been observed gathering in groups to chant mysterious spells to use in battle or communicate with each other.
column2: 头上咬着大舌贝的双足宝可梦。人们曾观察到呆呆王（伽勒尔的样子）聚集起来吟唱神秘咒语，用于战斗或彼此交流。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a chubby, vaguely star-shaped body. On the rare occasions it does come down from its mountain home, it can be seen dancing under the light of the full moon. Once the sun starts to rise, it returns home where it sleeps nestled with other Clefairy.
column2: 身体圆胖、略呈星形的双足宝可梦。它很少离开山中的家，偶尔下山时，会在满月的光辉下跳舞。太阳开始升起后，它便回家，与其他皮皮依偎着睡觉。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a round body and cactus-like striations. The beauty and fragrance of its flower depend on the harshness of its environment. This flower releases a strong aroma to attract prey. When prey approaches, Cacnea shoots sharp thorns to bring it down.
column2: 身体圆圆、带有仙人掌状条纹的双足宝可梦。花朵的美丽程度和芳香取决于生长环境有多严酷。花会散发浓香吸引猎物；猎物靠近时，刺球仙人掌便射出锐刺将其击倒。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a single green leaf atop its head. Using the leaf on its head as a flute, it makes music with leaves that creates a sense of unease in people. However, it can also play comforting melodies.
column2: 头顶长着一片绿叶的双足宝可梦。它把头上的叶子当作笛子，吹奏令人不安的乐声，也能奏出抚慰心灵的旋律。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with a square build. Loudred is able to shout at high volumes by inhaling, then exhaling using powerful stomach muscles. Additionally, its round ears serve as loudspeakers and it will stomp its feet to build power.
column2: 体形方正的双足宝可梦。吼爆弹先吸气，再用强壮的腹肌呼气，发出震耳欲聋的喊声。它的圆耳朵也像扩音器一样放大声音，还会用跺脚积蓄力量。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with muscular arms. When it swims, it uses all the muscles in its body, and is able to swim vast distances with minimal breathing. It is even capable of briefly running on the waters surface.
column2: 双臂肌肉发达的双足宝可梦。游泳时，它调动全身的肌肉，仅靠少量呼吸就能游过很远的距离，甚至能短暂地在水面上奔跑。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon with straight tusks protruding from the sides of its mouth. These tusks can regenerate if broken, and will regrow if they fall out. This repeated regrowth strengthens and sharpens its tusks.
column2: 嘴巴两侧伸出笔直獠牙的双足宝可梦。獠牙折断后能再生，掉落后也会重新长出。反复再生会使獠牙更坚固、更锋利。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. It always carries squared logs and use them to fight with. When it can easily lift a heavy block of timber, it is close to evolving.
column2: 双足宝可梦。它总是携带方形木料，用来战斗。能够轻松举起沉重木块时，便离进化不远了。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. It is a master of courtesy and swordsmanship that is capable of predicting its foes moves.
column2: 双足宝可梦。它精通礼仪和剑术，还能预判敌人的动作。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Magby can breathe 1100 F (600 C) (11068 U) flames, and hot embers drip from its mouth. Its health is determined by these flames. Yellow flames show that a Magby is in good health, while flames mixed with a lot of smoke show that it is fatigued.
column2: 双足宝可梦。鸭嘴宝宝能喷出１１００华氏度（６００摄氏度、１１０６８游戏温度单位）的火焰，嘴里还会滴落炽热的火星。火焰反映了它的健康状况：黄色火焰说明身体健康，混杂大量烟雾则说明它十分疲惫。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. Plusle can create sparkly pom-poms by shorting out the electrical current in its palms. It uses these pom-poms to cheer on its teammates, and will cry loudly if they lose.
column2: 双足宝可梦。正电拍拍让掌中的电流短路，制造闪闪发光的绒球。它用这些绒球为队友加油；队友输了，它就会放声大哭。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. The orb on its tail can shine so bright, that it can be seen from space. People have used the light as a beacon, or to send signals across the ocean.
column2: 双足宝可梦。尾巴上的球能发出极为明亮的光，甚至在太空中也能看见。人们把这束光当作信标，或用来跨越大海传递信号。

column1: A bipedal Pokemon. This Pokemon has even been known to alter unfavorably cold surroundings by spitting scorching flames about to warm up the area and establish an environment more suitable to it.
column2: 双足宝可梦。它会向周围喷洒灼热的火焰，让寒冷而不宜居的环境暖和起来，营造更适合自身生活的环境。

column1: A bipedal balloon-like Pokemon. This small Pokemon is extremely elastic and can bounce like a ball, although it may not be able to stop if it does this.
column2: 外形像气球的双足宝可梦。它体型小、弹性极强，能像球一样弹跳，但跳起来后可能无法停下。

column1: A bipedal crocodilian Pokemon. Crocalor's internal flame sac has a valve that connects to its vocal cords. As a result, Crocalor lets out guttural cries as it releases fire from its mouth.
column2: 外形像鳄鱼的双足宝可梦。炙烫鳄体内的火焰囊有一道连接声带的阀门，因此它从嘴里喷火时，也会发出低沉的叫声。

column1: A bipedal feline Pokemon. The organs hidden in Meowstic's ears emit psychic energy powerful enough to obliterate a 10-ton truck.
column2: 外形像猫的双足宝可梦。超能妙喵耳朵里隐藏的器官能释放精神能量，威力足以摧毁一辆１０吨重的卡车。

column1: A bipedal humanoid Pokemon. Gholdengo is a sociable Pok├⌐mon, able to quickly befriend anybody. It overwhelms opponents by firing coins at them in quick succession.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。赛富豪善于交际，能很快和任何人成为朋友。它接连不断地向对手发射硬币，将对手压制。

column1: A bipedal legendary Pokemon of indefinable but seemingly draconic basis. Kyurem generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out. Due to an old legend, it may be assumed Kyurem may be hostile towards Pokemon and humans, due to the fact it supposedly ate them if they were found outside at night.
column2: 双足的传说的宝可梦，外形难以明确归类，但似乎带有龙的特征。酋雷姆体内产生强大的冰冻能量，泄漏的能量却把自身冻结了。古老传说称，它会吃掉夜间出现在外的人类和宝可梦，因此人们认为它可能敌视两者。

column1: A bipedal legendary Pokemon with draconic, avian and mammalian traits. Reshiram has a jet engine-like tail, which it uses to accelerate itself when flying at high speeds. It can send flames from its tail into the air to incinerate everything around it.
column2: 兼具龙、鸟和哺乳动物特征的双足的传说的宝可梦。莱希拉姆的尾巴像喷气发动机，能在高速飞行时助它加速。它还会从尾巴向空中喷出火焰，将周围的一切焚烧殆尽。

column1: A bipedal otter-like Pokemon. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
column2: 外形像水獭的双足宝可梦。每只双刃丸使用贝壳的技巧都不一样，它从不疏于保养自己的贝壳。

column1: A bipedal squirrel-like Pokemon. True to their name, Greedent are extremely greedy and gluttonous. Greedent stuff their tails with so many Berries, that these berries fall out constantly, especially when it is hit or faints.
column2: 外形像松鼠的双足宝可梦。藏饱栗鼠正如其名字一样，极为贪吃。它往尾巴里塞进太多树果，导致树果不断掉落，受到攻击或昏倒时尤其如此。

column1: A bipedal weasel-like Pokemon. Due to its severe poison and deadly physical power, no other Pokemon species can defeat Sneasler in its habitat. Using its claws, Sneasler is capable of climbing up walls and cliffs with ease.
column2: 外形像鼬的双足宝可梦。凭借猛烈的毒性和强悍的肉体力量，大狃拉在自己的栖息地中没有其他宝可梦能匹敌。它能用爪子轻松攀上墙壁和悬崖。

column1: A bipedal, anteater-like Pokemon. Durant are the preferred prey of Heatmor. It burns through Durant's steel bodies with its tongue and consumes their insides.
column2: 外形像食蚁兽的双足宝可梦。铁蚁是熔蚁兽最喜爱的猎物。它用舌头烧穿铁蚁的钢铁身躯，再吃掉内部。

column1: A bipedal, bird-like legendary Pokemon. Tornadus can travel at speeds of 200 miles per hour (320 kilometers per hour). It can also whip up storms with its tail, and is able to blow away houses.
column2: 外形像鸟的双足的传说的宝可梦。龙卷云能以每小时２００英里（３２０公里）的速度移动，还能用尾巴掀起足以吹走房屋的风暴。

column1: A bipedal, canine-like Pokemon. Lucario is considered to be prideful, and is extremely loyal to its Trainer. It also seems to have a natural sense of justice.
column2: 外形像犬的双足宝可梦。路卡利欧性格高傲，对训练家极为忠诚，似乎还有与生俱来的正义感。

column1: A bipedal, clay Pokemon. Golett burns energy inside itself in order to move. This energy causes Golett to release light through the holes near its arms and legs.
column2: 由黏土构成的双足宝可梦。泥偶小人消耗体内的能量来行动，能量会让它从手臂和腿部附近的孔洞中透出光芒。

column1: A bipedal, duck-like Pokemon. Golduck is a fast swimmer, out-swimming even the most athletic of humans because of its webbed hands and feet. Even rough seas do not hamper this Pokemon's swimming abilities, and it will sometimes rescue people from shipwrecks.
column2: 外形像鸭子的双足宝可梦。哥达鸭的手脚有蹼，游泳速度甚至超过最擅长运动的人类。汹涌的海面也无法妨碍它游泳，它有时还会救起遭遇海难的人。

column1: A bipedal, fox-like Pokemon. As a result of its apearance, Hisuian Zoroark was said to resemble an embodiment of death. The illusions channeled through Hisuian Zoroark's long withering fur are full of spite. Uniquely, this spiteful illusion can cause physical harm to its opponent on both the inside and outside.
column2: 外形像狐狸的双足宝可梦。索罗亚克（洗翠的样子）的外貌让人认为它如同死亡的化身。它通过枯槁的长毛释放充满怨恨的幻象；这些幻象十分特别，能同时从内部和外部伤害对手的身体。

column1: A bipedal, frog-like Pokemon. Frogadier is a nimble and swift Pokemon; it can scale a tower exceeding 2,000 feet in one minute, and it can throw bubble-coated pebbles at targets up to 100 feet away.
column2: 外形像青蛙的双足宝可梦。呱头蛙灵活迅捷，一分钟内就能攀上超过２０００英尺高的塔，也能把包裹着泡沫的小石子掷向１００英尺外的目标。

column1: A bipedal, ground dwelling pholidote Pokemon. Sandshrew can quickly curl into a tight ball to protect itself from great falls and opponents, but may also throw sand at attackers.
column2: 外形像穿山甲、栖居地面的双足宝可梦。穿山鼠能迅速蜷成紧密的球，保护自己免受高处坠落和敌人攻击，也会向袭击者扬沙。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon that resembles a woman. It prefers to communicate by using dance-like movements. These rhythmic movements often cause people to dance along with it.
column2: 外形像女性的双足人形宝可梦。它喜欢用舞蹈般的动作交流，有节奏的动作常常让人不由自主地跟着跳舞。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Armarouge is loyal and believes in fighting fair, willing to fight head-on no matter how strong the foe is. It first focuses on using its sturdy armor for defense before using high firepower in order to take down opponents.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。红莲铠骑忠诚而崇尚公平战斗，无论敌人多强都愿意正面对决。它会先用坚固的铠甲防御，再以强大火力击倒对手。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. From birth, this Pokemon is an excellent pantomime. As it matures, it gains the ability to solidify air molecules by vibrating its fingertips. This ability allows it to create invisible objects with its gestures.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。它从出生起就擅长哑剧表演。随着成长，它能振动指尖使空气分子凝固，从而用手势制造看不见的物体。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Machoke is a Pokemon of immense strength. Its muscles are as hard as steel, and it is capable of lifting extremely heavy objects with only one finger. In spite of this, it is modest and often helps people with manual labor.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。豪力拥有惊人的力量，肌肉坚硬如钢，仅用一根手指就能举起极重的物体。不过它十分谦逊，经常帮人们做体力活。

column1: A bipedal, humanoid Pokemon. Through its feet, it is able to control the temperature and create a floor of ice, which it can kick up to act as a barrier.
column2: 双足人形宝可梦。它能通过双脚控制温度，在地面形成冰层，再将冰层踢起作为屏障。

column1: A bipedal, insectoid Pokemon. Scyther's blade-like forearms are capable of slicing through logs, and become sharper by cutting through hard materials. Using swift movements, it camouflages itself and enhances the effectiveness of its scythes.
column2: 双足的昆虫状宝可梦。飞天螳螂刀刃般的前臂能劈开原木，并在切割坚硬材料时变得更锋利。它以迅速的动作迷惑对手，使镰刀更具威力。
