column1: A bipedal, lizard-like Pokemon. Low Key Form Toxtricity are known to be selfish and have a high regard towards its strength. Unlike its Amped form counterpart, Toxtricity prefers to taunt opponents into fighting it when making eye contact with them.
column2: 外形像蜥蜴的双足宝可梦。颤弦蝾螈（低调的样子）性格自私，对自身实力十分自负。与高调的样子不同，它更喜欢用目光挑衅对手，诱使对手战斗。

column1: A bipedal, mammalian Pokemon with some plant-like features. Once it gets into its defensive stance with its hands covering its face, it can stand up to a bombs explosion.
column2: 兼具植物特征的双足哺乳动物状宝可梦。它双手护住脸、摆出防御姿态后，甚至能抵御炸弹爆炸。

column1: A bipedal, mushroom-like Pokemon with some kangaroo-like qualities. Breloom can stretch its short arms to deliver fast punches. Additionally, it has light, springy footwork that allows it to get close to opponents.
column2: 外形像蘑菇，又带有袋鼠特征的双足宝可梦。斗笠菇能伸长短短的手臂，迅速挥拳；它还会以轻盈而富有弹性的步法逼近对手。

column1: A bipedal, pig-like Pokemon. Pignite has a fire in its stomach, which it fuels with food. The intensity of this flame increases as fuel is added or when Pignite is angered.
column2: 外形像猪的双足宝可梦。炒炒猪胃中的火以食物为燃料，进食或发怒时，火势都会增强。

column1: A bipedal, plant-like Pokemon with a humanoid appearance. While it has a delectable fragrance, this Pokemon also has a tomboyish personality that can make it hard to get along with.
column2: 外形像植物的双足人形宝可梦。它虽然散发着诱人的香气，却性情活泼粗野，有时难以相处。

column1: A bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.
column2: 双足的南瓜状宝可梦。南瓜怪人性情邪恶，用发丝般的手臂抓住猎物，以受害者的痛苦为乐。无月之夜，它们会游荡在城镇街道上，唱出诡异的歌，诅咒不幸的听者。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon covered in scaly armor. Because it does not wish to fight weak foes, it clangs its scales together when it senses someone approaching. This ringing sound alerts others of its presence. The power of this Pokemon's uppercut is enough to send foes flying.
column2: 全身披着鳞甲的双足爬行动物状宝可梦。它不愿与弱小的敌人战斗，察觉有人靠近时，会敲响鳞片，用鸣响宣告自己的存在。它的上勾拳威力足以把敌人打飞。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon with a slender build. Its tail is capable of performing photosynthesis, which allows Snivy to move more quickly. However, the tail will begin to droop when Snivy loses energy.
column2: 身形修长的双足爬行动物状宝可梦。藤藤蛇的尾巴能进行光合作用，让它行动得更快；精力不足时，尾巴就会下垂。

column1: A bipedal, reptilian Pokemon. Charmeleon has a vicious nature and will constantly seek out opponents. Strong opponents excite this Pokemon, causing it to spout bluish-white flames that torch its surroundings.
column2: 双足爬行动物状宝可梦。火恐龙性情凶猛，不断寻找对手。强大的对手会让它兴奋，使它喷出蓝白色火焰，将周围烧毁。

column1: A bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. Raichu exudes a weak electrical charge from all its body and slightly glows in the dark, and is capable of storing over 100,000 volts of electricity. However, it will become aggressive if it has stored too much electricity.
column2: 外形像啮齿动物的双足宝可梦。雷丘全身会释放微弱电流，在黑暗中微微发光，并能储存超过１０万伏的电力。但储存太多电力时，它会变得好斗。

column1: A bipedal, ursine Pokemon. Cubchoo's nose is constantly running. It inhales the mucus and uses it in its attacks. If it is in bad health, the mucus becomes watery, which weakens its Ice-type techniques.
column2: 外形像熊的双足宝可梦。喷嚏熊总是流鼻涕，会把鼻涕吸入体内，用于攻击。身体不适时，鼻涕会变得稀薄，使冰属性招式的威力减弱。

column1: A bird-like, legendary Pokemon with an aerodynamic body. Its body can refract light, which allows it to become invisible or alter its appearance.
column2: 外形像鸟的传说的宝可梦，身体适合高速飞行。它能折射光线，借此隐身或改变外貌。

column1: A boulder Pokemon with arms. There are areas on the Alolan Geodude's body that are especially magnetic and attracts iron sand.
column2: 外形像长着双臂的岩石的宝可梦。小拳石（阿罗拉的样子）身上某些部位的磁力特别强，能吸附铁砂。

column1: A bulky, bipedal Pokemon similar to a beaver. This Pokemon is known to be an industrious worker that dams rivers by building its nest.
column2: 体格厚重、外形像海狸的双足宝可梦。它十分勤劳，筑起的巢能拦住河流，形成堤坝。

column1: A bulky, bipedal crocodilian Pokemon. When hunting or fighting, Feraligatr is agile and fast, due to its powerful hind legs that are used to kick the ground hard and charge.
column2: 体格厚重、外形像鳄鱼的双足宝可梦。捕猎或战斗时，大力鳄用强壮的后腿猛蹬地面，迅速冲锋，动作十分敏捷。

column1: A butterfly-like Pokemon. Beautifly has long and curled proboscis that it uses to drain body fluids from its prey. Additionally, this aggressive Pokemon will jab at foes with its proboscis if it is disturbed while collecting pollen.
column2: 外形像蝴蝶的宝可梦。狩猎凤蝶有细长卷曲的吻管，用来吸取猎物的体液。它性情好斗，采集花粉时若受到打扰，会用吻管刺向敌人。

column1: A canine Pokemon. Herdier is very loyal, and it will help its Trainer raise other Pokemon.
column2: 外形像犬的宝可梦。哈约克十分忠诚，会帮助训练家抚养其他宝可梦。

column1: A canine, quadruped Pokemon. Manectric gathers electricity in its mane and then discharges it. This process creates thunderclouds, which it uses in battle. Since lightning falls in its vicinity, it is said to have been born from lightning and make its nest where lightning has struck.
column2: 外形像犬的四足宝可梦。雷电兽在鬃毛中积蓄电力，再将其放出，形成战斗时使用的雷云。它周围常有雷电落下，因此传说它诞生于雷电，也会在雷击过的地方筑巢。

column1: A centipede-like Pokemon. It is very aggressive and will not give up until victorious. This Pokemon chases down enemies with great speed, and then attacks relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
column2: 外形像蜈蚣的宝可梦。它非常好斗，不获胜就不会罢休。它迅速追上敌人，再用角持续猛攻，直到赢得胜利。

column1: A cetacean Pokemon resembling a dolphin. Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
column2: 外形像海豚的鲸类宝可梦。它的身体能力与波普海豚没有区别，但同伴遇到危险时，它会变身，增强自身力量。

column1: A chubby, spherical, seal-like Pokemon. When happy or cheerful, such as when eating in a group, this Pokemon will clap its fins. Because its body is poorly shaped for swimming and can only walk slowly, it moves primarily by rolling across ice floes.
column2: 身体圆胖、呈球形的海豹状宝可梦。开心时，例如与同伴一起进食时，它会拍打双鳍。它的体形不适合游泳，走路也很慢，所以主要靠在浮冰上滚动来移动。

column1: A cocoon-like Pokemon. It is almost completely covered in silk which forms a hard cocoon that it can use to repel enemy attacks. Dew and rainwater collect on the silk, which provides Silcoon with nourishment.
column2: 外形像茧的宝可梦。几乎全身都被丝覆盖，形成坚硬的茧，抵御敌人的攻击。丝上聚集的露水和雨水为甲壳茧提供养分。

column1: A condor-like Pokemon. One theory explains that Xatu can see into the future with its right eye and the past with its left, and it does not move due to fears of its visions of the future coming true.
column2: 外形像秃鹰的宝可梦。有一种说法认为，天然鸟右眼能看见未来，左眼能看见过去；它害怕所见的未来成真，因此保持一动不动。

column1: A crocodilian Pokemon. Skeledirge has a meddlesome but caring personality. Its singing is gentle, but powerful and full of vitality, capable of soothing the souls of all who hears it.
column2: 外形像鳄鱼的宝可梦。骨纹巨声鳄爱管闲事，却很体贴。歌声轻柔有力、充满生机，能抚慰所有听者的心灵。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon resembling a crab. A competitive Pokemon that hates to lose, Crabrawler strives to achieve not only a high social standing, but a physically higher position as well.
column2: 外形像螃蟹的甲壳类宝可梦。好胜蟹争强好胜、不愿认输，既想获得更高的社会地位，也想占据位置更高的地方。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon similar to a crab. In times of scarce food sources, it may eat sand to regain nutrients, and will be very aggressive in defending its home.
column2: 外形像螃蟹的甲壳类宝可梦。食物匮乏时，它会吃沙子来补充养分，保卫家园时也会表现得极为凶猛。

column1: A crustacean Pokemon. Clauncher uses its larger claw to shoot compressed water like a pistol shot at its prey. Up close, the compressed water can shatter rocks.
column2: 甲壳类宝可梦。铁臂枪虾用较大的钳子向猎物发射压缩水流，犹如手枪开火。近距离射出的水流甚至能击碎岩石。

column1: A dainty bipedal Pokemon that is small in stature. Togetic can sense the kindness in other people and Pokemon's hearts. Whenever it spots a pure-hearted person, it tends to go to that person and shower them with happiness and glowing down called "joy dust".
column2: 体形娇小精巧的双足宝可梦。波克基古能感知人类和宝可梦心中的善意。发现心地纯洁的人时，它会飞到那人身边，洒下幸福，以及被称为“喜悦之尘”的发光绒羽。

column1: A dinosaurian Pokemon, closely resembling theropods such as Tyrannosaurus. Tyrunt will throw tantrums and run wild if it encounters something it does not like, and its strong jaws have enough force to shred an automobile.
column2: 外形像恐龙的宝可梦，与暴龙等兽脚类恐龙十分相似。宝宝暴龙遇到不喜欢的东西就会大发脾气、四处乱闯，强壮的颚足以撕碎汽车。

column1: A draconic Pokemon. Dragapult carries a pair of Dreepy inside its horns, which it will fire at its opponents like supersonic missiles during battle. It's said that the Dreepy it carries greatly enjoy being sent flying toward opponents at immense speeds.
column2: 龙形宝可梦。多龙巴鲁托的角里载着两只多龙梅西亚，战斗时会将它们当作超音速导弹射向对手。据说，被载着的多龙梅西亚非常享受高速冲向对手的感觉。

column1: A dragon-like Pokemon inhabiting a body reminiscent of apple pie. Appletun produces a nectar-like scent which attracts Bug-type Pokemon, which it preys on. The skin on its back is especially yummy.
column2: 身体像苹果派的龙形宝可梦。丰蜜龙散发类似花蜜的气味，吸引虫属性宝可梦前来，再将它们捕食。它背上的皮特别美味。

column1: A duckling-like Pokemon. It is a talented diver and can spray water from its feathers for self-defense. The foe is distracted by the spray, allowing Ducklett to escape.
column2: 外形像小鸭的宝可梦。鸭宝宝很擅长潜水，也能从羽毛中喷水自卫。水花会分散敌人的注意力，让鸭宝宝趁机逃走。

column1: A fairy-like mythical Pokemon. It is able to travel through time and exist simultaneously throughout time, and plant life flourishes wherever it has been.
column2: 外形像妖精的幻之宝可梦。它能穿越时间，在各个时代同时存在；凡是它到过的地方，植物都会茂盛生长。

column1: A feline Pokemon. It is fascinated by moving objects, and chases them. It is known to chase its own tail and become dizzy from it.
column2: 外形像猫的宝可梦。它对移动的物体十分着迷，会追着它们跑，有时还会追自己的尾巴，转得头晕目眩。

column1: A feline, quadruped Pokemon resembling a young lynx or lion. Luxio is able to communicate with others of its kind using electrical pulses from its claws.
column2: 外形像幼年猞猁或狮子的四足猫形宝可梦。勒克猫能用爪子发出的电脉冲与同类交流。

column1: A firefly-like, bipedal Pokemon. It has a spherical yellow tail, which glows to communicate and draw geometric patterns in the sky while in a swarm.
column2: 外形像萤火虫的双足宝可梦。它有球形的黄色尾巴，用发光传递信息；成群飞行时，还会在空中绘出几何图案。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon covered in colorful scales and fins. This Pokemon buries itself on the seafloor, leaving only the growth on its head exposed. By emitting a low level of psychic power, it serves as radar to detect prey.
column2: 全身有彩色鳞片和鳍的鱼形宝可梦。它把自己埋在海底，只露出头部的突起。这个突起释放微弱的精神力量，像雷达一样探测猎物。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon. Barraskewda's jaws are said to be as sharp as a spear and strong like steel. It propels itself up to speeds of 100 knots (185 kph, 115 mph) by spinning its tail, and uses that speed to ram into its prey, spearing it.
column2: 鱼形宝可梦。据说，戽斗尖梭的颚锋利如长矛、坚硬如钢。它旋转尾巴推进身体，速度可达１００节（每小时１８５公里、１１５英里），再高速撞向猎物，将其刺穿。

column1: A fish-like Pokemon. Remoraid is well known for its ability to shoot jets of water from the surface with incredible accuracy, often to shoot down flying insect prey out of the air.
column2: 鱼形宝可梦。铁炮鱼以极其准确的喷水能力闻名，能从水面射出水柱，击落空中飞行的昆虫猎物。

column1: A flat, centipede-like Pokemon. Centiskorch creates flammable gas through fermenting the food in its body, and then burns these gases through the heat-generating organs along its underside. This results in overflowing flames emerging from the antennae on either end of its body.
column2: 身体扁平的蜈蚣状宝可梦。焚焰蚣让体内的食物发酵，产生可燃气体，再用腹面的发热器官点燃气体，使火焰从身体两端的触角中涌出。

column1: A flat, fish-like Pokemon with a broad body. Stunfisk's very tough skin keeps them unharmed if stepped on, even by sumo wrestlers. To exploit this, it buries itself in mud of the seashore and waits for prey to pass by.
column2: 身体宽阔扁平的鱼形宝可梦。泥巴鱼的皮肤十分坚韧，就连相扑力士踩上去也不会受伤。它利用这一点，把自己埋在海边的泥中，等待猎物经过。

column1: A fox-like Pokemon. A cunning thief, Nickit enjoys stealing food from others instead of spending their time finding food on their own.
column2: 外形像狐狸的宝可梦。狡小狐是狡猾的小偷，喜欢偷取其他生物的食物，而不愿花时间自己寻找。

column1: A fox-like, quadruped Pokemon. Alolan Ninetales can produce ice crystals from its fur, which it can use for both offense and defense. The ice crystals can act as a shield or form balls that can be fired like bullets with enough force to shatter rock.
column2: 外形像狐狸的四足宝可梦。九尾（阿罗拉的样子）能从毛发中制造冰晶，用于攻击和防御。冰晶既可组成盾牌，也可聚成球，像子弹般发射，威力足以击碎岩石。

column1: A furry chinchilla-like Pokemon. Its fur feels amazing to touch, and it repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
column2: 外形像绒鼠的毛茸茸的宝可梦。它的毛发触感极佳，能防尘，也能防止静电积聚。

column1: A ghost like mythical Pokemon. Hoopa has the power to transport things using teleportation, which warps space.
column2: 外形像幽灵的幻之宝可梦。胡帕能扭曲空间，通过传送来移动物品。

column1: A ghost-like Pokemon. Mismagius can use advanced incantations for various purposes, such as causing misery or happiness. People that hear its cries will usually receive headaches and hallucinations.
column2: 外形像幽灵的宝可梦。梦妖魔会使用高深的咒语，实现各种目的，例如带来痛苦或幸福。听到它的叫声的人通常会头痛并产生幻觉。

column1: A gigantic, draconic alien legendary Pokemon. It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokemon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
column2: 体形巨大的外星龙形的传说的宝可梦。它藏在两万年前坠落的陨石中，似乎与极巨化现象有关。

column1: A group of small, bipedal Pokemon. The six members rely on teamwork as their strategy to win battles, and constantly change formation when they fight. The five troopers follow their brass loyally, and the brass's orders are considered absolute by them.
column2: 由一群小型双足个体组成的宝可梦。六个成员依靠团队合作取胜，战斗时不断变换阵形。五名士兵忠实地追随头领，绝对服从头领的命令。

column1: A huge, bipedal Pokemon. It wakes up only to eat and seldom for exercises. It is not a picky eater, as its strong stomach allows it to eat even moldy food without feeling any ill effects.
column2: 体形巨大的双足宝可梦。它醒来几乎只是为了进食，很少活动。它不挑食，强健的胃让它即使吃下发霉的食物，也不会感到不适。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon resembling a waterfowl. Quaquaval has a cheerful and energetic disposition, dancing away no matter what situation it faces. However, it is also stoic and very serious, especially when it comes to consistently polishing its skills.
column2: 外形像水鸟的人形宝可梦。狂欢浪舞鸭性情开朗、精力旺盛，无论遇到什么情况都会跳舞。不过，它也十分克己认真，尤其会坚持磨炼自己的技巧。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon with a hollow torso that resembles a kimono. Froslass has the ability to freeze foes with its -58 F (-50 C) (9910 U) breath. It is thought to display its victims secretly after freezing them.
column2: 躯干中空、外形像和服的人形宝可梦。雪妖女能吐出零下５８华氏度（零下５０摄氏度、９９１０游戏温度单位）的寒气，把敌人冻住。据说它会把冻住的受害者秘密陈列起来。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon with slim arms and legs. Gothorita uses starlight as the source of its power, and is able to use its psychic powers to arrange rocks to match the star. It can also use these powers to control people and Pokemon with hypnosis.
column2: 四肢纤细的人形宝可梦。哥德小童以星光为力量来源，能用精神力量摆放岩石，使其排列与星辰对应，也能通过催眠控制人类和宝可梦。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Gothitelle's immense psychic power can distort the space around it, showing visions of distant stars and past events. It can predict the future from the placement and movement of stars, and weeps when it discovers the lifespan of its Trainer.
column2: 人形宝可梦。哥德小姐强大的精神力量能扭曲周围空间，显现远方星辰和过去事件的景象。它根据星星的位置与运动预知未来，得知训练家的寿命时会流泪。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. It is known to do false acts of forgiveness, luring in opponents and getting down to its knees, before stabbing them with its hair. It is believed that Morgrem has the ability to make plants grow.
column2: 人形宝可梦。诈唬魔会假意求饶，跪下引诱对手靠近，再用头发刺向对方。人们认为，它还能促进植物生长。

column1: A humanoid Pokemon. Tinkaton wields a crude, gigantic metal hammer that weighs over 220 pounds (100 kg) and is larger than its own body. The hammer appears to have been made using the old hammer Tinkaton had as a Tinkatuff for the base, with several scraps of metal colored in varying shades of gray and purple welded onto it.
column2: 人形宝可梦。巨锻匠挥舞着一把粗制的巨大金属锤，重量超过２２０磅（１００公斤），比它的身体还大。这把锤子似乎以它还是巧锻匠时使用的旧锤为底，焊上不同深浅的灰色和紫色金属碎片制成。

column1: A humanoid feline Pokemon. It can often be very attached to its Trainer, and it will become upset if its Trainer gives attention to other Pokemon.
column2: 外形像猫的人形宝可梦。它往往很依恋训练家，训练家关注其他宝可梦时，它就会不高兴。

column1: A humanoid, Djinn like mythical Pokemon. Hoopa Unbound is said to be Hoopa's true form. Hoopa Unbound is said to have the power to bend dimensions which allows it to seize anything in the world.
column2: 外形像神灯巨灵的人形幻之宝可梦。据说，解放胡帕是胡帕的真正形态。它拥有扭曲次元的力量，能夺取世界上任何东西。

column1: A humanoid, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a yoga practitioner. Through the power of meditation and fasting, Medicham has developed a sixth sense. This allows it to use psychokinetic powers, and it heightens its energy to enhance this sixth sense.
column2: 外形像瑜伽练习者的双足人形宝可梦。恰雷姆通过冥想和禁食培养出了第六感，从而能够运用念力。它会增强自身能量，进一步提升这种感知。

column1: A hybrid fossil Pokemon. By shaking its freezing upper half, Arctozolt can generate electricity. It was known to live on ancient shores and preserved its food with the ice on its body.
column2: 由不同部分组合而成的化石宝可梦。雷鸟海兽能摇动冰冷的上半身发电。它曾生活在古代海岸，并用身上的冰保存食物。

column1: A hybrid fossil Pokemon. It has trouble eating due to its mouth being on top of its head, even though it captures prey by freezing its surroundings.
column2: 由不同部分组合而成的化石宝可梦。它能冻结周围环境捕获猎物，但嘴长在头顶，进食十分困难。

column1: A large Pokemon resembling a bell. It can summon rain clouds, which earned it the nickname "bringer of plentiful harvests".
column2: 外形像钟的大型宝可梦。它能召唤雨云，因此被称为“带来丰收的宝可梦”。

column1: A large Pokemon that resembles a mushroom. The strange lights that it emits can confuse people who enter its habitat at night, causing them to be unable to ever find their way home again.
column2: 外形像蘑菇的大型宝可梦。它发出的奇异光芒会迷惑夜间进入栖息地的人，让他们再也找不到回家的路。

column1: A large Pokemon. Rhyperior can insert rocks and boulders into its arms through the holes in its hands and then fire them like bullets. However, it will occasionally insert and fire Geodude by accident.
column2: 大型宝可梦。超甲狂犀能从掌心的孔洞将石块和巨石装入手臂，再像子弹一样射出。有时它也会不小心把小拳石装进去发射出去。

column1: A large avian Pokemon with a vulturine neck and broad, powerful wings. Fearow's large wings and stamina allow it to fly for an entire day without landing. It will shoot upward, and then dive down to catch prey.
column2: 大型鸟形宝可梦，拥有秃鹰般的颈和宽阔有力的翅膀。大嘴雀凭借巨大的翅膀和耐力，能连续飞行一整天而不落地。它会先冲向高空，再俯冲捕捉猎物。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. Galarian Articuno keeps itself airborne with its psychic power, almost never having to use its wings for this purpose. Instead, the blades on its wings can be used to slice through iron as easily as paper.
column2: 大型鸟形的传说的宝可梦。急冻鸟（伽勒尔的样子）用精神力量保持飞行，几乎无须扇动翅膀。翅膀上的刀刃则能切开铁，犹如切纸般轻松。

column1: A large avian legendary Pokemon. When Articuno flaps its wings, it can chill the moisture in the air around it, making snow fall. According to legend, it appears before doomed travelers lost in icy regions.
column2: 大型鸟形的传说的宝可梦。急冻鸟扇动翅膀时，会冻结周围空气中的水分，使雪花飘落。传说，它会出现在冰雪地区迷路、命悬一线的旅人面前。

column1: A large bipedal Pokemon, resembling a humanoid panda bear. With arms powerful enough to snap a telephone pole, it charges into battle like a berserker, heedless of any damage it might suffer as it bashes its opponents.
column2: 外形像人形熊猫的大型双足宝可梦。它的双臂强壮得足以折断电线杆，会像狂战士一样冲入战斗，猛攻对手，完全不顾自己可能受到的伤害。

column1: A large dragonfly Pokemon. Yanma is a skillful flier. It can make sudden stops, turn in midair and hover in place by flapping its wings at a high speed. It can also generate shock waves capable of breaking glass by flapping its wings very fast.
column2: 大型蜻蜓状宝可梦。蜻蜻蜓擅长飞行，能高速振翅，突然停下、在空中转向或原地悬停。快速振翅还能产生击碎玻璃的冲击波。

column1: A large fish-like Pokemon. Basculegion's evolution is said to be achieved by a surviving White-Striped Basculin being possessed by the deceased souls of other Basculin in its school who did not survive the harsh journey swimming upstream. When it senses danger, Basculegion will turn hostile and attack along with its souls until the enemy is defeated.
column2: 大型鱼形宝可梦。据说，一同逆流而上的野蛮鲈鱼中，未能挺过艰难旅程的个体会留下灵魂，附在幸存的野蛮鲈鱼（白条纹的样子）身上，使其进化为幽尾玄鱼。察觉危险时，幽尾玄鱼会发起攻击，与体内的灵魂一同战斗，直到击败敌人。

column1: A large jellyfish-like Pokemon. Tentacruel's tentacles can be freely elongated and shortened, and can absorb water to stretch to some length. The tentacles are normally kept short, but on hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
column2: 外形像水母的大型宝可梦。毒刺水母的触手能自由伸缩，也能吸水伸长。平时触手保持较短，捕猎时则会伸出，缠住猎物使其无法动弹。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon resembling a white lion. Known as the "beast that devours the sun," Solgaleo has long been honored as an emissary of the sun. Its body is capable of holding a vast amount of energy and glows when active.
column2: 外形像白狮的大型的传说的宝可梦。索尔迦雷欧被称为“吞噬太阳之兽”，自古以来被尊为太阳的使者。体内能容纳大量能量，活跃时会发光。

column1: A large mushroom-like Pokemon. Toedscruel eats by wrapping prey with its tentacles and sucking out their nutrients, which causes the prey pain.
column2: 外形像蘑菇的大型宝可梦。陆地水母用触手缠住猎物，吸取其养分，令猎物感到疼痛。

column1: A large reptilian legendary Pokemon. Koraidon dominates its opponents using its immense strength and the many natural weapons available to it, including its tough jaws and fangs, sharp claws, and thick, powerful tail.
column2: 大型爬行动物状的传说的宝可梦。故勒顿凭借惊人的力量，以及强壮的颚和獠牙、锐利的爪、粗壮有力的尾巴等天然武器，压制对手。

column1: A large rodent Pokemon. It is selective in what it eats, only eating fresh, high quality foods.
column2: 大型啮齿动物状宝可梦。它很挑食，只吃新鲜优质的食物。

column1: A large sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.
column2: 体型较大的双足南瓜状宝可梦。南瓜怪人性情邪恶，用发丝般的手臂抓住猎物，以受害者的痛苦为乐。无月之夜，它们会游荡在城镇街道上，唱出诡异的歌，诅咒不幸的听者。

column1: A large, avian Pokemon. Braviary is extremely aggressive, but for noble reasons. It will fight fiercely to help and protect its friends. Even if injured, it will still fight.
column2: 大型鸟形宝可梦。勇士雄鹰非常好斗，却是出于高尚的理由。它会为帮助和保护朋友而奋勇作战，即使受伤也不会停下。

column1: A large, bat-like Pokemon. Golbat drinks so much blood, that its blood type will change to that of its victim following a feed. It is also gluttonous, occasionally gorging itself to the extent that it becomes too heavy to fly.
column2: 大型蝙蝠状宝可梦。大嘴蝠会吸取大量血液，进食后连血型都会变得与受害者相同。它十分贪吃，有时会吸血过量，重得飞不起来。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon with distinct reptilian features. Nidoking uses this tail to smash, constrict, or break the bones of its prey and enemies. The tail can be swung to create distance between it and its foes before Nidoking charges.
column2: 具有明显爬行动物特征的大型双足宝可梦。尼多王用尾巴砸击、缠紧猎物和敌人，或折断它们的骨头。它也会先挥尾拉开与敌人的距离，再发动冲锋。

column1: A large, bipedal Pokemon. It arrives with chilly, wintry winds and is feared by people as the guardian of the forest. It is able to read an opponents mind, and then take preemptive action.
column2: 大型双足宝可梦。它伴着凛冽的寒冬之风到来，作为森林的守护者而令人敬畏。它能读取对手的想法，先发制人。

column1: A large, bipedal legendary Pokemon resembling a humanoid black bear with a wushu motif. Single Strike Style Urshifu prefers battling without holding back. It strongly believes in using the One-hit KO strategy. If enraged, it will mercilessly attack the opponent until utterly crushed.
column2: 外形像习武的人形黑熊的大型双足的传说的宝可梦。武道熊师（一击流）喜欢毫无保留地战斗，坚信应以一击制胜。被激怒后，它会毫不留情地持续攻击，直至彻底击倒对手。

column1: A large, bipedal, frog-like Pokemon. Greninja moves with the speed and grace of a ninja, using swift movements to confuse its enemies while it slices them up with throwing stars made of compressed water; these throwing stars are sharp enough to split metal.
column2: 外形像青蛙的大型双足宝可梦。甲贺忍蛙动作迅捷灵巧，如同忍者，以快速移动迷惑敌人，再用压缩水流制成的手里剑斩击对方。这些手里剑锋利得足以切开金属。

column1: A large, bipedal, theropod legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Suicune. Walking Wake is capable of walking on water.
column2: 外形像兽脚类恐龙的大型双足的传说的宝可梦。波荡水是外形类似水君的神秘生物，能在水面上行走。

column1: A large, bulky, bipedal ape-like Pokemon. It is considered the laziest Pokemon, but even when it is lounging it's saving energy. It can exert a lot of power by releasing built up energy all at once.
column2: 体格厚重的大型双足猿形宝可梦。它被认为是最懒的宝可梦，却连躺着休息时都在积蓄能量。把积蓄的能量一次释放，就能发挥惊人的力量。

column1: A large, dinosaurian Pokemon, closely resembling theropods such as Tyrannosaurus. Before its extinction, wild Tyrantrum used to live 100 million years ago, when its powerful jaw conferred its status as an unmatched predator. Since it was considered invincible in the ancient world, it behaved like a king.
column2: 大型恐龙状宝可梦，与暴龙等兽脚类恐龙十分相似。怪颚龙在灭绝前生活于一亿年前，强大的颚让它成为无可匹敌的捕食者。在古代世界中，它所向无敌，举止如同王者。

column1: A large, elephantine Pokemon. Copperajah's tarnished skin is resistant to water. It lives in social herds and its trunk is strong enough to crush boulders into powder.
column2: 外形像大象的大型宝可梦。大王铜象生有铜锈的皮肤能防水。它成群生活，强壮的象鼻能将巨石碾成粉末。

column1: A large, flying creature that bears similarities to a dinosaur. It is capable of flying, but is more adept at running. It can outrun even an automobile. It has the intelligence to work with its partners in order to catch prey.
column2: 外形像恐龙的大型飞行生物。它能够飞行，却更擅长奔跑，甚至能跑得比汽车还快。它有足够的智慧与同伴合作捕获猎物。

column1: A large, humanoid Ultra Beast with a bodily construction that closely resembles that of a bamboo shoot. Its most distinctive feature is the energy that it stores within itself
column2: 身体构造酷似竹笋的大型人形究极异兽。它最突出的特征是体内储存的能量。

column1: A large, manta ray-like Pokemon. Mantine can fly in the air if it builds up enough speed and can soar gracefully out of the water.
column2: 外形像蝠鲼的大型宝可梦。巨翅飞鱼加速到足够快后，能优雅地跃出水面，在空中翱翔。

column1: A large, moth-like Pokemon. It is said that its fires can replace the sun when it is dark with ash, and it has been known to rescue freezing Pokemon.
column2: 外形像蛾的大型宝可梦。据说，火山灰遮暗天空时，它的火焰能代替太阳。人们也曾看见它拯救快被冻僵的宝可梦。

column1: A large, quadruped, feline Pokemon. Although popular for its elegance, it is extremely difficult to raise as a pet due to its fickle and temperamental personality.
column2: 大型四足猫形宝可梦。它因优雅而深受喜爱，但性情善变、喜怒无常，作为宠物饲养极为困难。

column1: A large, quadrupedal brown bear Pokemon. Ursaluna's physique allows it to travel through swamps with ease and it can also manipulate the peat soil at will to its advantage. Ursaluna are known to be good at searching for items, and even missing persons, using their sense of smell.
column2: 大型四足棕熊状宝可梦。月月熊的体格让它能轻松穿越沼泽，还能随意操纵泥炭土，使环境有利于自己。它擅长用嗅觉搜寻物品，甚至寻找失踪者。

column1: A large, sauropod-like legendary Pokemon. Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokemon.
column2: 外形像蜥脚类恐龙的大型的传说的宝可梦。耀眼的光芒使帝牙卢卡变成一种与创造者宝可梦极为相似的形态。

column1: A large, seahorse-like Pokemon with a tightly curled tail. The yawn of a sleeping Kingdra is powerful enough to create undercurrents capable of destroying small ships. Should it decide to emerge from the depths of the ocean, Kingdras strength can create large whirlpools and sea-born tornadoes on the surface.
column2: 外形像海马的大型宝可梦，尾巴紧紧卷曲。刺龙王睡觉时打个哈欠，就能引发足以摧毁小船的暗流。它从海底深处浮现时，力量还能在海面掀起巨大的漩涡和海上龙卷风。

column1: A large, spherical Pokemon. Forretress can defend itself from enemies by shooting out pieces of its outer shell. It opens its shell to capture prey, but does so quickly that its interior body cannot be seen.
column2: 身体呈球形的大型宝可梦。佛烈托斯能射出外壳碎片，抵御敌人。它会打开壳捕捉猎物，但动作太快，谁也看不清壳中的身体。

column1: A large, theropod-like Pokemon. When in battle, Baxcalibur flips upside-down, using its spine as an axe while supporting itself with its head and forelimbs. It also spews out cryogenic air from its mouth, which is cold enough to freeze lava.
column2: 外形像兽脚类恐龙的大型宝可梦。战斗时，戟脊龙会倒转身体，用头和前肢支撑，以背刺作为斧头攻击。它还会从嘴里喷出足以冻结熔岩的极寒空气。

column1: A large, vaguely humanoid Pokemon with an egg-shaped body. When Magmortar prepares to shoot fire from its hands, the claws may disappear into its skin, forming something similar to a cannon.
column2: 身体呈蛋形、略具人形的大型宝可梦。鸭嘴炎兽准备从手部喷火时，爪子可能缩入皮肤，形成类似炮筒的结构。

column1: A lean, quadruped legendary Pokemon with feline features. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
column2: 身形精瘦、具有猫科动物特征的四足的传说的宝可梦。土地云能帮助农作物生长，因此被称为“田地的守护者”。它的尾巴能为土壤增添养分。

column1: A legendary titan Pokemon composed of stone. When it gets damaged in battle it will search for new rocks to repair itself. Because of this, the rocks it is made of come from several different places, which contributes to Regirocks patchwork appearance.
column2: 由岩石组成的传说的巨人宝可梦。战斗中受损时，它会寻找新岩石修补自身。因此，组成雷吉洛克的岩石来自不同地点，形成了拼接般的外貌。

column1: A living, bipedal boulder. Its preferred locomotion is rolling, specifically because it is a slow walker. It often rolls down mountain paths at high speeds, crushing objects in the way and stopping by running into huge rocks.
column2: 长着两条腿的活岩石。它走得很慢，更喜欢滚动前进。它经常沿山路高速滚下，碾碎挡路的东西，最后撞上巨石才停住。

column1: A lizard-like Pokemon. Heliolisk can use this electric energy to stimulates its muscles, boosting the strength in its legs and therefore enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds, or 20 yards per second.
column2: 外形像蜥蜴的宝可梦。光电伞蜥用电能刺激肌肉，增强腿部力量，能在五秒内跑过１００码，相当于每秒２０码。

column1: A long three-bodied Pokemon that lives in a black spiky rock. It is considered a particularly aggressive Pokemon species, wrapping its three bodies around prey and dragging them down to its lair.
column2: 拥有三条细长身体、栖居在黑色带刺岩石中的宝可梦。它性情极为好斗，会用三条身体缠住猎物，将其拖回巢穴。

column1: A long, worm-like Pokemon with a six-segmented metal body. Orthworm lives in dry deserts, and eats iron from the soil to maintain its body.
column2: 身形细长、由六节金属身体组成的蠕虫状宝可梦。拖拖蚓栖居在干旱沙漠中，吃土壤里的铁来维持身体。

column1: A mammalian, bipedal Pokemon that resembles a young panda. Pancham tries to make itself serious towards its foes, but its glare is not so intimidating.
column2: 外形像幼年大熊猫的双足哺乳动物状宝可梦。顽皮熊猫试图摆出严肃的样子面对敌人，但它瞪眼的模样没什么威慑力。

column1: A mammalian, quadruped Pokemon. This Pokemon's cellular structure is similar to plants, which allows it to perform photosynthesis and purify the air around it by sleeping under patches of sunshine.
column2: 四足哺乳动物状宝可梦。它的细胞构造与植物相似，能进行光合作用，在阳光照到的地方睡觉时，会净化周围的空气。

column1: A marine Pokemon that resembles a cross between a sea lion and a mermaid. Primarina uses water balloons and its voice as its main weapons. Water balloons are released as it dances, and are controlled by its voice.
column2: 外形兼具海狮和美人鱼特征的海洋宝可梦。西狮海壬以水球和歌声作为主要武器，跳舞时释放水球，再用声音控制它们。

column1: A massive leonine-ceratopsia hybrid legendary Pokemon with some mastiff qualities. A mysterious life-form resembling Entei. Its rumored that Gouging Fire can make magma on the ground erupt by roaring.
column2: 体形巨大的传说的宝可梦，外形兼具狮子、角龙和獒犬的特征。破空焰是类似炎帝的神秘生物。传闻它的咆哮能让地面上的岩浆喷发。

column1: A massive, leonine quadruped legendary Pokemon. An Entei is born whenever a new volcano appears. It is also said that whenever Entei roars, a volcano erupts somewhere in the world.
column2: 外形像狮子的巨大四足的传说的宝可梦。每当新火山出现，就会诞生一只炎帝。据说，炎帝每次咆哮，世界某处就会有火山喷发。

column1: A medium-sized mammalian Pokemon that resembles a skunk. Skuntank is known for its noxious fluid which smells dreadful. It can spray this fluid over 160 feet (48.8 meters), and the longer it allows the liquid to ferment within its body, the more powerful the smell.
column2: 外形像臭鼬的中型哺乳动物状宝可梦。坦克臭鼬以恶臭的毒液闻名，能将毒液喷到１６０英尺（４８．８米）以外。毒液在体内发酵得越久，气味就越浓烈。

column1: A medium-sized, penguin-like Pokemon with a large ice cube on its head. It can produce cold air from inside its head to create ice to protect its head from heat. The ice, however, is not very durable, as a strong blow can shatter it, after which it goes on to create new ice.
column2: 外形像企鹅的中型宝可梦，头部罩着巨大的冰块。它能从头部内部产生冷气，结冰来隔绝热量。不过冰块并不坚固，重击就能击碎；碎掉后，它会重新结冰。

column1: A metallic, bipedal Pokemon. Gimmighoul is extremely timid, running away and dropping its coin as soon as anyone approaches.
column2: 金属身体的双足宝可梦。索财灵非常胆小，谁一靠近，它就会丢下硬币逃跑。

column1: A mole like Pokemon. Excadrill can straighten its entire body, allowing it to spin like a drill. It has the ability to cut through iron and steel plating.
column2: 外形像鼹鼠的宝可梦。龙头地鼠能将整个身体挺直，像钻头一样旋转，钻穿铁板和钢板。

column1: A moth-like Pokemon. Dustox is nocturnal and is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms are attracted by the bright light of cities where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
column2: 外形像蛾的宝可梦。毒粉蛾夜间活动，本能地追逐光亮。它们成群被城市灯光吸引，啃食路边树木的叶子，造成严重破坏。

column1: A mouse-like rodent Pokemon. Maushold creates and lives in huge nests comprising many rooms with different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.
column2: 外形像老鼠的啮齿动物状宝可梦。一家鼠建造并居住在巨大的巢穴中，里面有许多分别用于进食、睡眠等活动的房间。

column1: A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Thundurus can shoot thunderbolts from its tail.
column2: 肌肉发达、外形像神灯精灵的人形的传说的宝可梦。雷电云能从尾巴放出雷电。

column1: A mushroom-like Pokemon with a large, Poke Ball designed cap with warts. It uses the Poke Ball-like patterns on its arms to lure in prey, though it doesn't work too well in most cases.
column2: 外形像蘑菇的宝可梦，巨大的菌盖上有疣状凸起和精灵球图案。它用双臂上的精灵球状图案引诱猎物，不过通常收效甚微。

column1: A pearl-like Pokemon encased within a spiky, bivalve shell. Its body is known to be soft and tender; however, its shell is said to be harder than diamond.
column2: 外形像珍珠、藏在带刺双壳中的宝可梦。身体柔软娇嫩，壳却据说比钻石还硬。

column1: A penguin-like Pokemon with a hollow tail. Delibird carries food bundled up in its tail. It normally gives stored food to its chicks, but has been known to share its food with humans stranded on icy mountains.
column2: 外形像企鹅、尾巴中空的宝可梦。信使鸟把食物包在尾巴里携带，通常喂给幼鸟，也会与困在冰雪山中的人类分享。

column1: A pig-like Pokemon. Motion is achieved by bouncing on its spring-like tail. The bouncing has a vital function, in that it keeps its heart beating. Even while it is sleeping, it continues to bounce.
column2: 外形像猪的宝可梦。它靠弹簧般的尾巴弹跳移动。弹跳还有维持心脏跳动的重要作用，因此就连睡觉时，它也不停地跳。

column1: A pinniped Pokemon resembling a sea lion. By storing thermal energy within its body, it is completely unharmed by even the most intense freezing weather.
column2: 外形像海狮的鳍足类宝可梦。它在体内储存热能，即使最严寒的天气也不会对它造成伤害。

column1: A pinniped Pokemon. Popplio is able to snort bubbles of water from its nose, which it uses as part of its battle strategy.
column2: 鳍足类宝可梦。球球海狮能从鼻子里喷出水泡，作为战斗手段之一。

column1: A plant like Pokemon. Eldegoss's cotton fluff acts like a cushion to protect its head from attacks. The cotton can also be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn.
column2: 植物状宝可梦。白蓬蓬的棉絮像软垫一样，保护头部免受攻击，也能纺成光泽亮丽的纱线。

column1: A plant-like Pokemon. In order to prevent being washed away by ocean tides, the body of this Pokemon is heavy.
column2: 植物状宝可梦。它的身体十分沉重，以免被海潮冲走。

column1: A primate Pokemon, similar to a New World monkey. Mankey specializes in physical fighting, and is very aggressive and short-tempered. When angry, Mankey begins shaking and its breathing turns rough.
column2: 外形像新大陆猴的灵长类宝可梦。猴怪擅长肉搏，非常好斗、脾气暴躁。发怒时，它会浑身颤抖，呼吸也变得粗重。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon similar in appearance to hyenas and canines. It takes a bite at anything that moves, and makes the hair on its tail bristle out to try to intimidate its foes.
column2: 外形像鬣狗和犬的四足宝可梦。任何会动的东西，它都想咬上一口，还会竖起尾巴上的毛，试图吓退敌人。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon that is based on a hyena. Mightyena lives in a pack in the wild. As a member of this pack follows the orders of its leader and chases down prey. It gives obvious signals when it is about to attack, as it starts to growl deeply and flattens its body.
column2: 外形像鬣狗的四足宝可梦。大狼犬在野外成群生活，听从群体头领的命令追捕猎物。攻击前，它会低吼并压低身体，发出明显的警告。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon that resembles a pupal stage. Inside the shell, its body is busy forming for its next evolution. The moment this Pokemon evolves, its shell peels away.
column2: 外形像蛹的四足宝可梦。壳内的身体正在为下一次进化不断成形。进化的那一刻，外壳就会脱落。

column1: A quadruped Pokemon. Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. It uses this ore to make its body.
column2: 四足宝可梦。可可多拉挖出山中的铁矿石，吃下后用来构成自身的身体。

column1: A quadruped canine Pokemon. Houndour is an intelligent Pokemon that forms packs to hunt for prey, and shows unparalleled teamwork.
column2: 四足犬形宝可梦。戴鲁比很聪明，会组成群体捕猎，表现出无可比拟的默契。

column1: A quadruped mythical Pokemon. Volcanion has a unique organ capable of turning water vapor around it into hot steam in an instant. It can expel steam of superbly high pressure and has the ability to blow away mountains.
column2: 四足的幻之宝可梦。波尔凯尼恩拥有特殊器官，能把周围的水汽瞬间变成灼热蒸汽。它喷出的蒸汽压力极高，威力足以吹飞山岳。

column1: A quadruped, bovine Pokemon. A territorial Pokemon, it will headbutt anyone that attempts to invade its territory.
column2: 四足牛形宝可梦。它的领地意识很强，会用头撞击任何企图入侵者。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Boltund can channel the electricity that it generates to its legs in order to keep them strong, boosting its strength and allowing it to run nonstop for three full days.
column2: 四足犬形宝可梦。逐电犬把自身产生的电流导向双腿，让双腿保持强健、增强力量，能连续奔跑整整三天。

column1: A quadruped, canine Pokemon. Hisuian Growlithe's soft and insulated fur allows it to survive the cold weather. Growlithe rarely uses its horn unless needed due to it being easily broken.
column2: 四足犬形宝可梦。卡蒂狗（洗翠的样子）柔软保暖的毛发让它能在寒冷天气中生存。角很容易折断，所以它只有必要时才会使用。

column1: A quadruped, caribou-like Pokemon. Stantler can distort reality and create illusions with its antlers by subtly changing the flow of air around them. Staring into them creates an odd sensation, as if one is being sucked through them, and one may become so dizzy that it is impossible to stand.
column2: 外形像驯鹿的四足宝可梦。惊角鹿能微妙地改变鹿角周围的气流，扭曲现实、制造幻象。盯着鹿角看会产生被吸入其中般的怪异感觉，令人晕眩得无法站立。

column1: A quadruped, colt-like mythical Pokemon. Keldeo tends to cross the world, and often appears at beautiful watersides. It can walk across water by ejecting water from its hooves.
column2: 外形像小马的四足幻之宝可梦。凯路迪欧周游世界，常出现在美丽的水边。它能从蹄中喷出水，在水面上行走。

column1: A quadruped, draconic Pokemon. If enraged, it loses all sense of self and flies into an uncontrollable rampage, destroying everything around it until it tires itself out.
column2: 四足龙形宝可梦。被激怒时，它会失去理智，陷入无法控制的狂暴，破坏周围的一切，直到精疲力竭。

column1: A quadruped, feline Pokemon. Delcatty is happy most of the time and rarely gets involved in conflicts. When it is disturbed, it just moves to another area instead of fighting.
column2: 四足猫形宝可梦。优雅猫大多时候都很快乐，极少参与争斗。受到打扰时，它会换个地方，而不与对方交战。

column1: A quadruped, feline Pokemon. While grooming, it collects fur inside its stomach. By setting the stored fur alight, it can spit fireballs that change based on how it coughs.
column2: 四足猫形宝可梦。梳理身体时，它把毛发收集在胃里。点燃这些毛发后，它能吐出火球，火球会随着咳嗽方式而变化。

column1: A quadruped, leonine Pokemon. Pyroar live in prides, led by the male with the largest mane of fire, and the females protect the prides cubs.
column2: 四足狮形宝可梦。火炎狮成群生活，由火焰鬃毛最大的雄性带领，雌性则负责保护幼崽。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles. It is also able to create small ice crystals around it by controlling its body temperature.
column2: 四足哺乳动物状宝可梦。它能冻结全身毛发，让毛竖得像针一样来自卫，也能控制体温，在周围制造小冰晶。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Using its horn, it is able to sense even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict when a natural disaster will occur.
column2: 四足哺乳动物状宝可梦。它用角感知天空和大地中极其细微的变化，预知自然灾害何时发生。

column1: A quadruped, sea lion-like Pokemon. When in battle, Samurott can stand on its hind legs and use one of its blades as a sword to fight. In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
column2: 外形像海狮的四足宝可梦。战斗时，大剑鬼能用后腿站立，拔出利刃作剑。在对手眨眼的瞬间，它就能完成前腿上贝壳刀的拔刀与收刀。

column1: A quadrupedal Pokemon resembling a fully-grown lion. Luxray has powerful eyesight that is capable of seeing through most objects and walls, like x-ray vision.
column2: 外形像成年狮子的四足宝可梦。伦琴猫的视力极强，能像Ｘ射线一样看穿大多数物体和墙壁。

column1: A quadrupedal Pokemon with a spherical body. A mysterious life-form resembling Donphan. Iron Treads is said to have a cruel nature. It is capable of swiftly curling up its body and rolling like a wheel to attack. The trails it leaves behind are described as similar to scorched earth.
column2: 身体呈球形的四足宝可梦。铁辙迹是外形类似顿甲的神秘生物，据说生性残酷。它能迅速蜷起身体，像车轮一样滚动攻击，经过的地方留下如同焦土般的痕迹。

column1: A quadrupedal giraffine Pokemon. Farigiraf's two brains are connected through thick nerves, allowing it to increase its psychic energy and unleash psychic waves through its antennae. The increased psychic power is 10 times stronger than that of Girafarig.
column2: 四足长颈鹿状宝可梦。奇麒麟的两个脑通过粗大的神经相连，增强精神能量，再从触角释放精神波。增强后的精神力量是麒麟奇的１０倍。

column1: A quadrupedal, canine Pokemon. Maschiff always tilts its head and makes a big scowl to appear threatening, although the display is highly ineffective even towards children.
column2: 四足犬形宝可梦。偶叫獒总是歪头皱眉，试图摆出凶狠的模样，可连孩子都吓不住。

column1: A quadrupedal, lizard-like Baby Pokemon. Toxel has a poison sac which it uses to store its poison and secretes the same poison through its skin. By manipulating the chemical makeup of this poison, it can produce electricity.
column2: 外形像蜥蜴的四足幼年宝可梦。电音婴用毒囊储存毒液，并通过皮肤分泌。它能改变毒液的化学成分，从而产生电力。

column1: A raccoon-like quadruped Pokemon. They enjoy battling to the point they often attempt to provoke others into fighting it.
column2: 外形像浣熊的四足宝可梦。它们非常喜欢战斗，经常故意挑衅其他生物，让对方与自己交战。

column1: A relatively tall bipedal Pokemon resembling a fox. Delphox carries a stick that it uses like a magic wand; when in use, the tip is set alight, and when not in use, the stick is hidden away in its sleeve-like fur.
column2: 体形较高、外形像狐狸的双足宝可梦。妖火红狐带着一根当作魔杖使用的树枝。使用时，枝尖会燃烧；不用时，树枝会藏进袖子般的毛发中。

column1: A reptilian, bipedal Pokemon with large, membranous wings. With its impressive wings, Aerodactyl fearlessly soars high in the skies, freely letting out its high-pitched cries.
column2: 拥有巨大膜翼的双足爬行动物状宝可梦。化石翼龙凭借强大的翅膀，无畏地翱翔高空，尽情发出高亢的叫声。

column1: A rhinoceros-like Pokemon. Rhyhorn's brain is very small, giving it a one-track mind. When it runs, it forgets why it started and continues until it falls asleep. However, it may recall the reason upon demolishing something.
column2: 外形像犀牛的宝可梦。独角犀牛的脑很小，思考只能一条道走到底。一旦跑起来，它就会忘记为何起跑，一直跑到睡着；不过撞毁东西时，它可能又会想起原因。

column1: A robotic Pokemon. Metagross is the result of two Metang fusing together. This gives Metagross four brains in total, all connected by a complex network of neurons. Because of these complex connections and the number of brains, this Pokemon is capable of complex calculations and is more intelligent than a supercomputer.
column2: 外形像机器人的宝可梦。巨金怪由两只金属怪融合而成，因此共有四个脑，通过复杂的神经元网络相连。多脑协同和复杂的连接让它能够完成精密计算，智慧甚至胜过超级计算机。

column1: A rock Pokemon with a crescent moon shape. The moon increases its power, and its health is tied to the lunar phases.
column2: 外形像新月的岩石宝可梦。月亮能增强它的力量，健康状况也随月相变化。

column1: A rock-like, quadruped Pokemon. It compresses energy in the core inside its body that is enough to blow away mountains. It can also store sunlight in its orange crystals and shoot powerful energy from its mouth.
column2: 外形像岩石的四足宝可梦。它把能量压缩在体内的核心中，威力足以炸飞山岳。它也能用橙色结晶储存阳光，再从嘴里射出强大的能量。

column1: A rodent-like Pokemon. Despite its stout body, this Pokemon can be agile and is not easily perturbed.
column2: 外形像啮齿动物的宝可梦。身体虽然敦实，动作却很敏捷，也不容易受惊。

column1: A roughly spherical Pokemon. Its body houses an energy core; due to compression underground, both this core and Roggenrola's body are as hard as steel.
column2: 身体近似球形的宝可梦。石丸子体内有一个能量核心。地下压力让核心和身体都变得坚硬如钢。

column1: A round Pokemon resembling a reverse-colored Poke Ball. Electrode explodes in response to even the smallest stimulation, simply to entertain itself, or because it has taken in too much electricity.
column2: 外形像上下颜色颠倒的精灵球的圆形宝可梦。顽皮雷弹受到极微小的刺激就会爆炸，有时为了自娱自乐也会爆炸，吸收太多电力同样会引发爆炸。

column1: A round Pokemon with the top of its head resembling a club. Bonsly is a good mimic, making it often mistaken for a real bonsai tree. It can remain in the same spot for a long time.
column2: 身体圆圆、头顶像棍棒的宝可梦。盆才怪善于模仿，经常被错认成真正的盆景树。它能长时间待在同一个地方。

column1: A round Pokemon. The fire that burned within their bodies went out, leaving an organ that produces cold air instead. The colder Galarian Darumaka gets, the more energetic it becomes.
column2: 身体圆圆的宝可梦。原本体内燃烧的火已经熄灭，留下了产生冷气的器官。火红不倒翁（伽勒尔的样子）越冷就越有活力。

column1: A round cetacean Pokemon. Cetoddle is thought to be a close relative of Wailmer. However, unlike Wailmer, who once lived on land before becoming a sea-dwelling species, Cetoddle used to live in the ocean a long time ago, before it migrated onto land.
column2: 身体圆圆的鲸类宝可梦。走鲸被认为是吼吼鲸的近亲。吼吼鲸曾生活在陆地上，后来进入海洋；走鲸则恰恰相反，很久以前生活在海中，后来迁上陆地。

column1: A round, bipedal Pokemon. When it senses danger, it spews an acidic liquid from its mouth. It targets Shelmet, so it can evolve.
column2: 身体圆圆的双足宝可梦。察觉危险时，它会从嘴里喷出酸液。它以小嘴蜗为目标，以便完成进化。

column1: A round, tadpole-like Pokemon. It has two ringed half-spheres on either side of its head. These spheres are vibrated to create a sound too high-pitched for humans to hear.
column2: 身体圆圆的蝌蚪状宝可梦。头部两侧各有一个带环纹的半球形突起，振动后能发出人类听不到的高频声音。

column1: A rounded, digital Pokemon that shows similarities to a drinking bird. It is artificially intelligent, and is capable of learning new behaviors on its own. As a result, it will sometimes perform motions or abilities that are not in its programming.
column2: 身体圆润、外形像饮水鸟摆件的数字宝可梦。它具有人工智能，能自行学习新行为，因此有时会做出程序中未设定的动作，或使用未设定的能力。

column1: A sea star-like Pokemon. The multi-color glowing of its core is believed to be a method of communication inside the species. However, Starmie's core is most commonly seen as red in color.
column2: 外形像海星的宝可梦。人们认为，核心发出的多色光是同类之间的交流方式。不过，宝石海星的核心最常呈现红色。

column1: A seemingly robotic life form. The magnetic units on Magnemite's body create electromagnetic waves that allow it to defy gravity and can potentially disrupt electrical equipment.
column2: 看似机械构造的生物。小磁怪身上的磁性部件产生电磁波，让它克服重力悬浮，也可能干扰电器设备。

column1: A serpentine Chinese dragon-like Pokemon. Its fangs can crush stones and its scales are harder than steel. Gyarados is infamously known for its fierce temper and wanton destructive tendencies, and is attracted to violence.
column2: 外形像中国龙的蛇形宝可梦。獠牙能咬碎石头，鳞片比钢铁更坚硬。暴鲤龙因暴躁易怒、肆意破坏而声名狼藉，也会被暴力吸引。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon with a drill-like tail. Though Dunsparce can float slightly with its wings, it avoids detection by burrowing into the ground with its tail. It lives immobile in caves and beneath the earth, where it makes maze-like nests.
column2: 尾巴像钻头的蛇形宝可梦。土龙弟弟能用翅膀稍稍浮起，但通常会用尾巴钻进地底，躲避他者的视线。它在洞穴和地下建造迷宫般的巢穴，平时静止不动。

column1: A serpentine Pokemon. Dudunsparce makes its nest, which can reach over six miles (10 km) long, by using its hard tail to bore holes into bedrock deep underground.
column2: 蛇形宝可梦。土龙节节用坚硬的尾巴钻穿地下深处的基岩，建造长度能超过６英里（１０公里）的巢穴。

column1: A set of Diglett triplets sharing a single body. Dugtrio's three heads think the same thoughts and act cooperatively. In order to make burrowing easier, each head will bob up and down to loosen the soil.
column2: 三只地鼠共用一个身体的三胞胎宝可梦。三地鼠的三个头思考一致、行动协同。为了更方便挖洞，每个头都会上下晃动，松开土壤。

column1: A shadow-like Pokemon holding a tablet. The tablet bears cursed engravings that resemble a serpent's tail and is said to absorb Yamask's dark power.
column2: 拿着石板的影子状宝可梦。石板上刻着形似蛇尾的诅咒纹样，据说能吸收哭哭面具的黑暗力量。

column1: A sheep-like Pokemon. Mareep's wool, which grows continuously, stores electricity, rubbing together and building a static charge. Touching the wool when it is charged will result in a static shock.
column2: 外形像羊的宝可梦。咩利羊的羊毛不断生长，彼此摩擦积蓄静电，储存电力。触碰带电的羊毛就会被电到。

column1: A short, bipedal Pokemon. It uses its non-threatening appearance to make foes underestimate it, then attacks with its giant jaws; when engaged in battle, Mawile usually has its back turned on the enemy to better use its jaws.
column2: 身材矮小的双足宝可梦。大嘴娃用毫无威胁的外貌让敌人轻视自己，再用巨颚攻击。战斗时，它通常背对敌人，以便更好地运用巨颚。

column1: A short, chubby rodent Pokemon. Pikachu has been known to build up energy in its glands, and will need to discharge to avoid complications. It is also able to release energy through its tail, which acts as a grounding rod, as well as recharging fellow Pikachu with electric shocks.
column2: 身材矮胖的啮齿动物状宝可梦。皮卡丘的腺体会积蓄电能，需要及时放电，以免身体出问题。它能通过像接地棒一样的尾巴释放电能，也能用电击为其他皮卡丘补充电力。

column1: A short, quadruped Pokemon. It usually burrows under the surface, with only its nose and eyes above the sand. Due to being so close to the surface, it can move around the desert and allow the heat of the sand to regulate its body temperature.
column2: 身材矮小的四足宝可梦。它通常钻入浅层沙土，只把眼睛和鼻子露在沙面上。它沿着地表下方在沙漠中移动，利用沙子的热量调节体温。

column1: A simian Pokemon. Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
column2: 猿猴状宝可梦。它脾气暴躁，会疯狂甩动带刺的尾巴战斗。

column1: A simian Pokemon. The tuft on its head contains a flame that can reach temperatures of 600 F (315 C) (10568 U).
column2: 猿猴状宝可梦。头顶的簇毛中燃烧着火焰，温度可达６００华氏度（３１５摄氏度、１０５６８游戏温度单位）。

column1: A simian legendary Pokemon. Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
column2: 猿猴状的传说的宝可梦。愿增猿待在安全的地方戏弄敌人，用念力使对方陷入强烈的晕眩。

column1: A slender tree that stands on six roots bent like spider legs. Trevenant can use its roots as a nervous system, allowing it to control trees at will. It uses this ability to trap those who bring harm to the forest, so they can never leave.
column2: 外形像细长树木的宝可梦，站在六条蜘蛛腿般弯曲的根上。朽木妖能把根当作神经系统，随意操纵树木。它利用这种能力困住破坏森林的人，让他们永远无法离开。

column1: A slender-bodied, quadruped Pokemon. Linoone has an attraction to anything round, and will grab any orb-shaped object it sees if given the chance.
column2: 身形细长的四足宝可梦。直冲熊特别喜欢圆形物体，只要有机会，就会拿走看到的球状物品。

column1: A slim bipedal Pokemon. This swift Pokemon hides in thick foliage or shadows to avoid attacks before retaliating.
column2: 身形纤细的双足宝可梦。它动作敏捷，会藏进茂密枝叶或阴影中躲避攻击，再进行反击。

column1: A slim, bipedal lizard-like Pokemon. Drizzile uses special pores to create water balloons secreted from the moisture in its palms to attack. While it is highly intelligent, Drizzile is exceptionally lazy and prefers to not do anything unless it has to.
column2: 身形纤细、外形像蜥蜴的双足宝可梦。变涩蜥通过特殊孔隙分泌掌中的水分，制成水球攻击。它虽然很聪明，却极为懒惰，不到迫不得已就什么也不想做。

column1: A slimy, amorphous blob-like Pokemon made of living sludge. Pieces of it often breaks off during travel, and from these pieces new Grimer will begin to grow. It happily consumes and thrives off nearly any form of waste or refuse.
column2: 由有生命的污泥构成的黏稠、形状不定的宝可梦。移动时，身体常有一部分脱落，新的臭泥会从这些碎块中长出。它乐于吞吃几乎任何废物或垃圾，并以此茁壮成长。

column1: A slug-like Pokemon. When it is threatened, it oozes purple fluid and flees.
column2: 外形像蛞蝓的宝可梦。受到威胁时，它会分泌紫色液体，随后逃跑。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling a mangostee. While fleeing danger, Bounsweet skips along in a way that does not convey its desperation. As a result, no one ever comes to help it.
column2: 外形像山竹的小型宝可梦。甜竹竹遇到危险时会跳着逃走，动作却完全看不出慌张，所以从来没人来帮它。

column1: A small Pokemon resembling an olive. Inside its fruit, Smoliv stores oil made from nutrients it gathers through photosynthesis, which allows it to go for a week without eating or drinking.
column2: 外形像橄榄的小型宝可梦。迷你芙把光合作用获得的养分制成油，储存在果实里，让它能整整一周不吃不喝。

column1: A small Pokemon similar to a seagull. By extending its wings, it is able to glide across the sky.
column2: 外形像海鸥的小型宝可梦。它展开翅膀，就能在天空中滑翔。

column1: A small Pokemon that resembles a figurine made out of clay or mud. It moves by spinning on its single, pointed foot, and balance upright on it to sleep.
column2: 外形像黏土或泥制小偶的小型宝可梦。它靠一只尖脚旋转移动，睡觉时也用这只脚保持直立平衡。

column1: A small Pokemon that resembles an acorn. While hanging, this Pokemon absorbs moisture and nutrients from the tree until becomes too heavy and falls to the ground.
column2: 外形像橡子的小型宝可梦。悬挂在树上时，它不断吸取树的水分与养分，直到身体太重而落到地上。

column1: A small Pokemon with a gaseous body similar to a nebula. Cosmog has the ability to open Ultra Wormholes, but only when under stress, and this process is very dangerous for Cosmog.
column2: 身体由气体构成、外形像星云的小型宝可梦。科斯莫古只有受到压力时才能打开究极之洞，而这个过程对它十分危险。

column1: A small Pokemon with a round body that is still encased in its eggshell. It has a very joyful nature. As a result, it is said that it shares its joy with those who take care of it.
column2: 身体圆圆、仍裹在蛋壳里的小型宝可梦。它天性快乐，据说会把喜悦分享给照顾自己的人。

column1: A small Pokemon with two different forms. Cherrim waits quietly as a bud for a ray of sunlight. When it is hit with strong sunlight, it blooms and absorbs the rays with its entire body. It quickly changes from quiet to excitable and active.
column2: 拥有两种形态的小型宝可梦。樱花儿平时呈花蕾状，静静等待阳光。受到强烈日照时，它会绽放，用全身吸收阳光，性情也从安静迅速变得兴奋活泼。

column1: A small Pokemon. Mime Jr. has a knack for imitating others; it can easily pick up emotions of those around it and imitate it.
column2: 小型宝可梦。魔尼尼擅长模仿，能轻易感知周围生物的情绪，并加以模仿。

column1: A small amphibious, quadruped Pokemon. By using the fin on its head, Mudkip is able to detect changes in air and water currents as well as bodies of water.
column2: 小型四足两栖宝可梦。水跃鱼用头上的鳍感知空气与水流的变化，也能感知周围的水域。

column1: A small bipedal Pokemon. Roselia's aroma brings serenity, but the thorns on its head contain a vicious poison. The more healthy it is, the more pleasant its flower's aroma.
column2: 小型双足宝可梦。毒蔷薇的香气能带来宁静，但头上的刺含有剧毒。身体越健康，花香就越宜人。

column1: A small bird-like Pokemon. Rookidee are feisty and territorial Pokemon and will bravely fight against anybody, no matter how big and strong that opponent is.
column2: 外形像小鸟的宝可梦。稚山雀性情好斗、领地意识强，不管对手多么高大强壮，都会勇敢应战。

column1: A small canine Pokemon. Fidough's smooth, moist skin is firm yet soft to the touch, and has elastic qualities; when agitated, Fidough will puff itself up to appear larger, in an attempt to intimidate its opponents.
column2: 小型犬形宝可梦。狗仔包的皮肤光滑湿润，结实却柔软，富有弹性。激动时，它会鼓起身体，让自己显得更大，试图吓退对手。

column1: A small chick Pokemon. Somewhere in its belly, this Pokemon has a place where it keeps a flame. This internal flame causes Torchic to feel warm if hugged.
column2: 外形像小鸡的宝可梦。火稚鸡腹部有一处储存着火焰，因此抱着它时会感到温暖。

column1: A small hermit crab-like Pokemon. When finding a rock to use as its shell, Dwebble inspects the rock to see if it can be used, then it digs a hole in the rocks bottom.
column2: 外形像寄居蟹的小型宝可梦。石居蟹找到可作外壳的岩石后，会先检查是否合适，再在石头底部挖洞。

column1: A small insectoid Pokemon that resembles three pieces hexagonal honeycomb stuck together. When it is not gathering honey, it sleeps or protects its queen. The former is done by creating a hive along with other Combee, locking together into a "wall" to feel safe in larger numbers.
column2: 外形像三个六角蜂巢相连的小型昆虫状宝可梦。不采蜜时，它会睡觉或保护蜂后。睡觉时，它与其他三蜜蜂拼接成巢，连成一面“墙”，依靠众多个体聚在一起获得安全感。

column1: A small mythical Pokemon resembling a piece of mochi. It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under PecharuntΓÇÖs control, chained to its will.
column2: 外形像一块粘糕的小型幻之宝可梦。桃歹郎把有毒的粘糕喂给其他生物，激发它们的欲望和能力。吃下粘糕者会受到桃歹郎的控制，被它的意志束缚。

column1: A small round, Pokemon. Hoppip's body is very light, and it is easily lifted off the ground by winds and will drift in the air.
column2: 身体圆圆的小型宝可梦。毽子草的身体非常轻，容易被风吹离地面，在空中漂浮。

column1: A small, ammonite Pokemon. Several gas-filled chambers exist within Omanyte's shell, which it uses to regulate its buoyancy within the water. By evacuating or filling the chambers, it rises and falls while twisting its tentacles to swim.
column2: 小型菊石状宝可梦。菊石兽的壳内有多个气室，用来调节水中的浮力。它通过排空或充满气室来升降，同时摆动触手游泳。

column1: A small, avian Pokemon resembling a young owl. It approaches opponents by silently gliding, before unleashing a volley of kicks.
column2: 外形像幼年猫头鹰的小型鸟形宝可梦。它无声地滑翔接近对手，再连续踢击。

column1: A small, beetle-like Pokemon. Rellor creates its mud ball by mixing dirt and sand with psychic energy. It values its mud ball more than its own life, and rolls it around as the energy needed for it to evolve matures.
column2: 外形像甲虫的小型宝可梦。虫滚泥用精神能量混合泥土与沙子，制成泥球。它把泥球看得比生命还重要，不停滚动泥球，让进化所需的能量逐渐成熟。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon. Blades comprise this Pokemon's entire body. When hunting, Pawniard immobilizes prey by repeated stabbing with these blades.
column2: 小型双足宝可梦。驹刀小兵全身由利刃组成，捕猎时会用利刃反复刺击，使猎物无法动弹。

column1: A small, bipedal bird-like Pokemon. Hawlucha makes up for its small body with its proficiency in fighting, which allows it to keep up with bigger fighters such as Machamp and Hariyama.
column2: 小型双足鸟形宝可梦。摔角鹰人凭借精湛的格斗技巧弥补体形的不足，足以与怪力、铁掌力士等大型格斗高手抗衡。

column1: A small, bipedal reptilian Pokemon. Because of its territorial nature, it is known to be the protector of the forests trees.
column2: 小型双足爬行动物状宝可梦。它的领地意识很强，被认为是森林树木的守护者。

column1: A small, bipedal, rabbit-like Pokemon. It can deliver powerful blows with its curled up ears, and it has an impressive jumping ability.
column2: 外形像兔子的小型双足宝可梦。它能用卷起的耳朵猛烈打击对手，跳跃能力也非常出色。

column1: A small, cicada-like Pokemon. Ninjask is a very fast Pokemon that is said to be able to evade any attack, and was long believed to be invisible due to its high speed.
column2: 外形像蝉的小型宝可梦。铁面忍者速度极快，据说能躲开任何攻击。因为移动太快，人们长期以为它能够隐身。

column1: A small, fairy like Pokemon. It flutters around and cares for flowers that are about to wilt; if the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, Floette celebrates with an elegant dance.
column2: 外形像妖精的小型宝可梦。花叶蒂四处飞舞，照料即将枯萎的花。精心照料的花坛开花时，它会跳起优雅的舞蹈庆祝。

column1: A small, fairy-like legendary Pokemon. Mesprit's spirit can leave its body without dying, and return to the body at will. Legends say that a person that touches it will have their emotions completely drained away.
column2: 外形像妖精的小型的传说的宝可梦。艾姆利多的灵魂能离开身体而不死亡，并随时返回。传说，碰到它的人会被抽走所有情感。

column1: A small, feline Pokemon. The darker the coin is, the more respect it gets from its peers. Galarian Meowth's body has partially turned to iron as a result of many years of living with a race of savage seafarers.
column2: 小型猫形宝可梦。喵喵（伽勒尔的样子）的金币颜色越深，就越受同类尊敬。与凶悍的航海民族共同生活多年后，它的身体有一部分变成了铁。

column1: A small, furry Pokemon. It will not sleep alone, and usually sleeps while another of its kind watches for danger.
column2: 毛茸茸的小型宝可梦。它不会独自入睡，通常由另一只同类警戒危险，自己才睡觉。

column1: A small, humanoid Pokemon that resembles a baby. Being very conscious of its appearance, it will check is reflection when given the chance to make sure it is not dirty.
column2: 外形像婴儿的小型人形宝可梦。它十分在意外貌，一有机会就会查看自己的倒影，确认身上没有弄脏。

column1: A small, humanoid mythical Pokemon. Jirachi hibernates for extensive periods, forming a protective crystalline shell as it sleeps. However, it is still capable of fighting while asleep if it is in danger.
column2: 小型人形幻之宝可梦。基拉祈会长时间休眠，睡觉时形成保护身体的晶壳。不过，遇到危险时，即使睡着也能战斗。

column1: A small, insectoid Pokemon. It uses its jaw as a weapon, a tool for burrowing, and for extracting sap from trees.
column2: 小型昆虫状宝可梦。它把颚用作武器，也用来挖洞和汲取树汁。

column1: A small, larval Pokemon. Snom anchors itself to branches with frigid thread it extrudes from its mouth to disguise itself as an icicle while sleeping.
column2: 小型幼虫状宝可梦。雪吞虫从嘴里吐出冰冷的丝，把自己固定在树枝上，睡觉时伪装成冰柱。

column1: A small, plant-like Pokemon. If anything bothers it while it is gathering sunlight, Fomantis will fiercely attack it.
column2: 小型植物状宝可梦。伪螳草吸收阳光时，任何打扰它的东西都会遭到猛烈攻击。

column1: A small, quadruped Pokemon resembling a turtle or tortoise. As a plant-based Pokemon, Turtwig usually nourishes itself through photosynthesis. It also drinks water, which hardens its soil-based shell.
column2: 外形像海龟或陆龟的小型四足宝可梦。草苗龟具有植物特征，通常通过光合作用获取养分。它也会喝水，让泥土构成的壳变得坚硬。

column1: A small, quadruped rodent Pokemon. Alolan Rattata search out fresh food by smell, and ignore anything spoiled.
column2: 小型四足啮齿动物状宝可梦。小拉达（阿罗拉的样子）用嗅觉寻找新鲜食物，对腐败变质的食物毫不理会。

column1: A small, quadruped, fox-like Pokemon. Vulpix has a flame inside its body that never goes out, and is capable of manipulating fire to such precision as to create floating wisps of flame.
column2: 外形像狐狸的小型四足宝可梦。六尾体内有永不熄灭的火，能精确操纵火焰，制造悬浮的火团。

column1: A small, quadrupedal, rodent Pokemon. Pawmi has yellow underdeveloped electric sacs in its cheeks, as well as yellow pad-like organs on its forepaws that can discharge electricity. If it feels threatened, it will rub its cheeks to generate electricity, which it then delivers to its opponents by touching them with its forepaws.
column2: 小型四足啮齿动物状宝可梦。布拨脸颊上有尚未发育成熟的黄色电囊，前爪上有能放电的黄色肉垫状器官。受到威胁时，它会摩擦脸颊发电，再用前爪碰触对手，将电流导入对方体内。

column1: A small, reptilian Pokemon with rocky skin. Larvitar is born deep underground, far from its parent. It grows by consuming soil, and will enter its pupal stage upon eating an entire mountains worth of earth.
column2: 皮肤像岩石的小型爬行动物状宝可梦。幼基拉斯出生在地下深处，远离双亲。它靠吃土壤成长，吃完一整座山的土后便会进入蛹期。

column1: A small, reptilian legendary Pokemon that resembles a turtle. Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.
column2: 外形像龟的小型爬行动物状的传说的宝可梦。察觉危险时，它会让太晶能量结晶，形成坚固的壳，做好战斗准备。

column1: A small, round, mouse-like Pokemon. Its tail can absorb electricity from power plants or house outlets. It can then fire electricity from its whiskers.
column2: 身体圆圆、外形像老鼠的小型宝可梦。尾巴能吸收发电厂或家用插座中的电力，再从胡须释放出去。

column1: A small, serpentine Pokemon that resembles a loach. A slimy film covers it and protects it from bacteria and allows it to get away easily when grabbed. If it does not stay moist, it dries up and weakens.
column2: 外形像泥鳅的小型蛇形宝可梦。黏滑的薄膜覆盖全身，既能抵御细菌，也让它被抓住时容易滑脱。不保持湿润，身体就会干燥衰弱。

column1: A small, tick like Pokemon. Joltik is too small to generate its own electricity, so it attaches itself to larger Pokemon and feeds off their static electricity.
column2: 外形像蜱虫的小型宝可梦。电电虫太小，无法自行发电，因此会附在更大的宝可梦身上，以对方的静电为食。

column1: A snail-like Pokemon. It closes the lid on its helmet-like shell as a defensive tactic, and can spit a poisonous sticky fluid.
column2: 外形像蜗牛的宝可梦。它合上头盔状外壳的盖子来自卫，也能吐出有毒的黏液。

column1: A somewhat plant-like Pokemon. Its tentacles are waved around to attract prey, which is swallowed whole after being entangled.
column2: 略带植物特征的宝可梦。它挥舞触手引诱猎物，缠住后便将猎物整个吞下。

column1: A spherical Pokemon filled with toxic gasses. Koffing creates gases within its body by mixing toxins with garbage, and produces more gas in higher temperatures. These gases are malodorous and cause sniffles, coughs, and teary eyes to those around it.
column2: 体内充满毒气的球形宝可梦。瓦斯弹把毒素和垃圾混合，生成气体；温度越高，产气越多。气体恶臭难闻，会让周围的生物流鼻涕、咳嗽、流泪。

column1: A spherical Pokemon that consists of a rock core covered by ice. Its icy body will not melt, and it can control ice by freezing moisture in the air. This ability is used to freeze its opponents, which it then consumes.
column2: 由冰包裹岩石核心构成的球形宝可梦。冰体不会融化，还能通过冻结空气中的水分来控制冰。它用这种能力冻住对手，再将其吃掉。

column1: A spherical Pokemon, resembling a Honduran White Bat. Woobat's nose serves various purposes. It uses ultrasonic waves from its nostrils for echolocation, and it can also be used to grip walls as Woobat sleeps, which leaves heart-shaped marks on the walls of caves.
column2: 外形像洪都拉斯白蝙蝠的球形宝可梦。滚滚蝙蝠的鼻子用途很多，既能从鼻孔发出超声波进行回声定位，也能在睡觉时贴住墙壁，在洞壁上留下心形印记。

column1: A spherical whale Pokemon with no tail. When storing water in its body, it can turn into a bouncing ball. The more water filling its body, the higher it can bounce.
column2: 没有尾巴的球形鲸类宝可梦。它在体内储水后，就能像球一样弹跳。体内的水越多，跳得就越高。

column1: A spherical, rodent-like Pokemon. Togedemaru uses the needle on top of its head to attract and gather electricity. Groups can be seen gathered with their needles standing upright, waiting to be struck by lightning on stormy days.
column2: 球形啮齿动物状宝可梦。托戈德玛尔用头顶的针引导、收集电力。暴风雨时，它们会成群聚集，竖起针，等待雷击。

column1: A squat ape-like Pokemon. When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
column2: 身材矮壮的猿形宝可梦。战斗中体力不足时，它会变成石像，集中精神，继续用精神力量战斗。

column1: A squid-like Pokemon. Those who stare into its yellow lights become dazed and lose their will to battle, allowing Inkay to escape.
column2: 外形像鱿鱼的宝可梦。盯着黄色光点看的人会陷入恍惚，失去战斗意志，让好啦鱿得以逃走。

column1: A stag or antelope-like, quadruped legendary Pokemon. Its horns are as sharp as blades, and are used to cut opponents.
column2: 外形像雄鹿或羚羊的四足的传说的宝可梦。它的角锋利如刀，用来斩击对手。

column1: A stout Pokemon resembling a hog. Lechonk has an excellent sense of smell, which it uses to find fragrant wild grasses and rich Berries to eat.
column2: 外形像猪的敦实宝可梦。爱吃豚嗅觉极佳，用它寻找芳香的野草和营养丰富的树果。

column1: A stout, bipedal, rodent-like Pokemon. When attacked, Pawmo will be the first to fight back, defeating foes with its electricity.
column2: 身体敦实的双足啮齿动物状宝可梦。受到攻击时，布土拨会率先反击，用电力击败敌人。

column1: A super sized bipedal, pumpkin Pokemon. Gourgeist are malevolent Pokemon that catch their prey in their hairlike arms and take delight in their victim's suffering. On moonless nights, they are known to wander through town streets, singing an eerie song that curses its unfortunate listeners.
column2: 体型特大的双足南瓜状宝可梦。南瓜怪人性情邪恶，用发丝般的手臂抓住猎物，以受害者的痛苦为乐。无月之夜，它们会游荡在城镇街道上，唱出诡异的歌，诅咒不幸的听者。

column1: A sylph-like mythical Pokemon. It can instantly create diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air; these diamonds can then be used to defend itself.
column2: 外形像风之精灵的幻之宝可梦。它能压缩空气中的碳，瞬间制造钻石，再用钻石自卫。

column1: A tall Pokemon with a vaguely star-shaped body. Clefable is a timid creature that flees when it senses people approaching, and is one of the worlds rarest Pokemon. Its sensitive ears can distinctly hear a pin drop from half a mile (one kilometer) away.
column2: 身材高大、身体略呈星形的宝可梦。皮可西很胆小，察觉有人靠近就会逃跑，是世界上最稀有的宝可梦之一。它的耳朵极其灵敏，能清楚听见半英里（一公里）外落针的声音。

column1: A tall, amorphous Pokemon. It is capable of swallowing anything whole, and can digest anything except its own stomach lining.
column2: 身形高大、形状不固定的宝可梦。它能把任何东西整个吞下，除了自身胃壁，什么都能消化。

column1: A tall, bipedal Pokemon that resemble a palm tree. Each head thinks independently of the others, so it makes a lot of noise as each head speaks its mind.
column2: 外形像棕榈树的高大双足宝可梦。每个头都独立思考，各自表达想法时会吵闹不休。

column1: A theropod-like Pokemon. Arctibax has strong back and leg muscles, which allow it to do a front flip while airborne and attack opponents with its dorsal fin.
column2: 外形像兽脚类恐龙的宝可梦。冻脊龙的背部和腿部肌肉强壮，能腾空前翻，用背鳍攻击对手。

column1: A three-headed, mechanical, draconic Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Hydreigon. It combines Hydreigon's ferocity with the ruthlessness of a machine.
column2: 拥有三个头的机械龙形宝可梦。它是外形类似三首恶龙的神秘生物，兼具三首恶龙的凶猛和机器的冷酷。

column1: A tiny insect Pokemon. Cutiefly is capable of detecting the aura of living things, such as plants, people, and Pokemon. It collects nectar and pollen from flowers, which are found by the color and brightness of their auras.
column2: 体型极小的昆虫状宝可梦。萌虻能感知植物、人类和宝可梦等生物的气场，根据花朵气场的颜色与亮度找到花，采集花蜜和花粉。

column1: A tiny, bird Pokemon with a nearly spherical body. It has the quirky behavior of staring at something until the thing moves.
column2: 身体接近球形的小鸟状宝可梦。它有个奇怪的习惯：盯住一样东西，直到对方动起来。

column1: A turtle-like Pokemon. Chewtle snaps at anything in front of it because of an itch of its teething. It is known to attack first with its horn, flinching them before biting down and not letting go.
column2: 外形像龟的宝可梦。咬咬龟因长牙时发痒，会咬住面前的任何东西。它先用角攻击，使对手畏缩，再一口咬住不放。

column1: A two-headed, bipedal avian Pokemon. Even when sleeping or nourishing itself with food and water, one head is always awake and alert and keeps a keen eye out for enemies. Both heads have an identical brain. However, it is believed that on occasion they may possess different sets of brains.
column2: 有两个头的双足鸟形宝可梦。即使睡觉、进食或喝水，也总有一个头保持清醒警戒，密切留意敌人。两个头的脑通常相同，但据说偶尔也会出现不同的脑。

column1: A vaguely slug-like Pokemon. Goomy is widely considered the weakest Dragon-type Pokemon. It hides in damp and shady places, such as swamps, to prevent its slimy body from drying out.
column2: 外形略像蛞蝓的宝可梦。黏黏宝被普遍认为是最弱的龙属性宝可梦。它躲在沼泽等潮湿阴凉的地方，防止黏滑的身体干燥。

column1: A vulpine Pokemon. When Thievul finds a potential target, it will secretly mark a scent on them. Thievul then uses that scent to track and stalk its targets.
column2: 狐狸状宝可梦。猾大狐发现合适的目标后，会偷偷在对方身上留下气味，再沿着气味追踪、尾随目标。

column1: A worm-like dragon Pokemon. Its cheeks store acid strong enough to induce chemical burns, which it is able to spit at its targets. It can disguise itself as an apple by folding its apple peels.
column2: 外形像虫子的龙形宝可梦。脸颊储存的酸液足以造成化学灼伤，它能将酸液吐向目标。折叠苹果皮后，它能伪装成一颗苹果。

column1: An Ultra Beast that has both draconic and insectoid features. It fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
column2: 兼具龙与昆虫特征的究极异兽。它从针状器官中射出发光的毒液，液体还具有极强的黏性。

column1: An Ultra Beast with a humanoid figure. Blacephalon are known to trick its target through the silly way it walks, blowing its head up without warning in order to steal their vitality.
column2: 人形究极异兽。砰头小丑用滑稽的走路姿态迷惑目标，再毫无预兆地引爆自己的头，以夺取对方的生命力。

column1: An amphibious Pokemon that resembles an upright, armless axolotl. Paldean Wooper employs two adaptations to allow it to survive on land
column2: 外形像直立、没有手臂的美西螈的两栖宝可梦。乌波（帕底亚的样子）通过两种适应方式，让自己能在陆地上生存。

column1: An amphibious bipedal Pokemon. With its sturdy legs, it has good footing in mud that allows it to overwhelm struggling opponents.
column2: 双足两栖宝可梦。强健的双腿让它在泥中也能站得稳，压制行动艰难的对手。

column1: An aquatic Pokemon that resembles a marine animal similar to a sea dragon. Skrelp camouflages itself as rotten kelp while it stores up energy until its able to evolve.
column2: 外形像海龙的水生宝可梦。垃垃藻伪装成腐烂的海带，积蓄能量，直到能够进化。

column1: An aquatic Pokemon. The pearls produced by this Pokemon amplify psychic power.
column2: 水生宝可梦。它产生的珍珠能增强精神力量。

column1: An arachnoid Pokemon. Spinarak is a patient hunter that can wait motionlessly for several days for unsuspecting prey to become trapped in its thin yet strong web, which it weaves in the forest.
column2: 蜘蛛状宝可梦。圆丝蛛是耐心的猎手，能一动不动地等上几天，等待毫无防备的猎物落入它在森林中织出的纤细而坚韧的网。

column1: An artificial Pokemon that changes appearance and attitude based on the weather.
column2: 人造宝可梦，会随着天气改变外貌和性情。

column1: An avian Pokemon similar to a large bird of prey. Upon evolution, this Pokemon leaves its flock to live alone. It can be highly aggressive, persistently attacking even larger foes in spite of illness or injury.
column2: 外形像大型猛禽的鸟形宝可梦。进化后，它离开鸟群独自生活。它极为好斗，即使生病或受伤，也会持续攻击比自己更大的敌人。

column1: An avian Pokemon that can change between four markedly different forms. Pa'u Style Oricorio can be difficult to deal with due to its laid-back nature. It uses its dance to focus its mind and increase its psychic power.
column2: 能在四种明显不同的形态间变化的鸟形宝可梦。花舞鸟（呼拉呼拉风格）性情悠闲，有时很难相处。它用舞蹈集中精神、增强精神力量。

column1: An avian Pokemon that closely resembles a falcon. When battling, Talonflame dives at foes, reaching speeds of 500 kp/h (310 mp/h), and then attacks with devastating kicks.
column2: 外形很像隼的鸟形宝可梦。战斗时，烈箭鹰以每小时５００公里（３１０英里）的速度俯冲向敌人，再发动威力惊人的踢击。

column1: An avian Pokemon that resembles an owl. This alert Pokemon is sensitive to the presence of others around it, and is capable of launching attacks on unseen enemies behind it.
column2: 外形像猫头鹰的鸟形宝可梦。它非常警觉，敏锐地感知周围的存在，甚至能攻击背后看不见的敌人。

column1: An avian Pokemon with a round body. Swablu does not like dirty surroundings, so it cleans things with its cottony wings. It uses streams and freshwater springs to wash its wings when they become dirty from polishing.
column2: 身体圆圆的鸟形宝可梦。青绵鸟不喜欢脏乱的环境，会用棉花般的翅膀擦拭物品。擦脏翅膀后，它便用溪水和淡水泉洗净。

column1: An avian Pokemon, resembling a stork. Hanging from Bombirdier's chest is a long white apron made of its own shed feathers, which droops down past its legs. When flying, Bombirdier holds the end of this apron in its beak. It uses the apron to gather food, such as Basculin, and bring them to its nest.
column2: 外形像鹳的鸟形宝可梦。下石鸟胸前挂着用自身脱落羽毛制成的白色长围裙，一直垂过双腿。飞行时，它用喙衔住围裙末端，用围裙装起野蛮鲈鱼等食物，带回巢穴。

column1: An avian Pokemon. Fletchinder is known to hunt by igniting tall grass and swooping down on prey that attempt to escape the blaze.
column2: 鸟形宝可梦。火箭雀会点燃高草，再俯冲捕捉试图逃离火海的猎物。

column1: An avian Pokemon. Pikipek is able to strike 16 times per second with its beak. This allows it to not only drill through wood, but shatter stone as well.
column2: 鸟形宝可梦。小笃儿每秒能用喙啄击１６次，既能钻穿木头，也能击碎石头。

column1: An avian legendary Pokemon resembling a phoenix and a peacock. Ho-Oh has a mythical power to resurrect the dead. It is said that when it flies its huge wings create bright, colorful rainbows.
column2: 外形兼具凤凰和孔雀特征的鸟形的传说的宝可梦。凤王拥有让死者复生的神奇力量。据说，它飞翔时，巨大的翅膀会绘出明亮绚丽的彩虹。

column1: An eel-like Pokemon. Eelektrik is a vigorous carnivore and has a good appetite. Upon spotting prey, it immediately attacks and paralyzes it, then coils around it and shocks it with electricity from its circular electricity-generating organs before eating it.
column2: 外形像鳗鱼的宝可梦。麻麻鳗是食欲旺盛的凶猛肉食者。发现猎物后，它立即攻击，使猎物麻痹，再盘绕缠住猎物，用圆形发电器官释放电击，最后将其吃掉。

column1: An equine Pokemon. Galarian Ponyta can absorb the life energy located in the atmosphere and store it in its mane, which will then become more colorful and potentially release a shining glow if there is a lot of energy to use.
column2: 马形宝可梦。小火马（伽勒尔的样子）能吸收空气中的生命能量，储存在鬃毛中，让鬃毛颜色更加绚丽。能量充足时，鬃毛还可能发出亮光。

column1: An equine legendary Pokemon. Glastrier has a coat of ice covering its face which is noted to be 100 times harder than diamond. It emits extreme cold from its hooves and possesses incredible physical strength and extraordinary destructive power.
column2: 马形的传说的宝可梦。雪暴马脸上覆着一层冰，据说硬度是钻石的１００倍。它从蹄部释放极寒之气，拥有惊人的体力与破坏力。

column1: An ethereal composition of swirling purple fog. Spiritomb can be just as aggressive and destructive as the spirits that it is composed of. It will lash out at anyone with little thought, often exercising short sightedness in its pursuit of vengeance.
column2: 由旋转的紫色雾气组成的灵体。花岩怪和构成它的灵魂一样好斗、富有破坏性。它常常不假思索地袭击他者，为了复仇不顾长远后果。

column1: An goat like legendary Pokemon. A mysterious life-form resembling Cobalion. Its shining blades can cut everything around it to pieces.
column2: 外形像山羊的传说的宝可梦。它是类似勾帕路翁的神秘生物，闪耀的利刃能将周围一切切成碎片。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon encased in a hard, segmented shell. If attacked, it can quickly spin its body like a wheel and crash furiously into opponents.
column2: 包裹在坚硬分节甲壳中的昆虫状宝可梦。受到攻击时，它会迅速把身体转成车轮状，猛烈撞向对手。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon resembling the nymph stage of a cicada. Red-and-yellow mushrooms known as tochukaso grow on this Pokemon's back. The mushrooms can be removed at any time, and grow from spores that are doused on this Pokemon's back at birth by the mushroom on its mothers back.
column2: 外形像蝉若虫的昆虫状宝可梦。背上生长着被称为“冬虫夏草”的红黄色蘑菇，随时都能摘下。它出生时，母亲背上的蘑菇会把孢子撒到它背上，这些孢子随后长成蘑菇。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon with a long, flat body. Sizzlipede uses its coils to wrap around the prey before using its heated body to cook it. Sizzlipede, much like its evolved form Centiskorch, can generate heat using the flammable gas stored within its body.
column2: 身体细长扁平的昆虫状宝可梦。烧火蚣盘绕身体缠住猎物，再用炽热的身体将其烤熟。和进化后的焚焰蚣一样，它能利用体内储存的可燃气体产生热量。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon. A constant collector of information, Blipbug are very smart, but very weak.
column2: 昆虫状宝可梦。索侦虫不断收集信息，非常聪明，身体却很弱。

column1: An insectoid Pokemon. Its two pairs of wings are covered in dust-like scales that vary in color depending on their toxic capability. Dark scales are poisonous, while lighter scales can cause paralysis. These scales are released when Venomoth flutters its wings.
column2: 昆虫状宝可梦。两对翅膀上覆着粉尘般的鳞片，颜色随毒性而变化：深色鳞片有毒，浅色鳞片能使对手麻痹。摩鲁蛾振翅时，这些鳞粉便会散落。

column1: An ovoid Pokemon. Chansey lays several nutritious eggs every day, which it carefully carries in its pouch. A kindhearted Pokemon, it will share these eggs with injured people and Pokemon.
column2: 身体呈蛋形的宝可梦。吉利蛋每天产下数枚营养丰富的蛋，小心地装在腹袋中携带。它心地善良，会与受伤的人类和宝可梦分享这些蛋。

column1: As a result of Gigantamaxing, its many hidden body tools have been enhanced. With its sharp mind, this extremely skilled sniper can figure out how to use gravity for a precise trajectory shot.
column2: 超极巨化增强了它身体中隐藏的多种工具。凭借敏锐的头脑，这位技艺精湛的狙击手能利用重力计算准确的弹道，精准射击。

column1: Due to Gigantamaxing, Eevee becomes even more playful and rambunctious, desiring to play with its opponent and often unintentionally crushing them with its size.
column2: 超极巨化后，伊布更加顽皮、精力旺盛，总想和对手一起玩，却常因巨大的体形而不小心压伤对方。

column1: Gigantamax Garbodor releases the gas through its mouth and fingers and should the gas engulf someone, the toxin will seep deep into their bones.
column2: 超极巨化的灰尘山从嘴和手指释放气体。气体包围谁，毒素就会深入谁的骨髓。

column1: Gigantamax Rapid Strike Style Urshifu maintains a perfect one-legged stance in a calm manner while in its Gigantamax form. It can maintain it to the point of not twitching.
column2: 超极巨化的武道熊师（连击流）能沉着地保持完美的单腿站姿，甚至纹丝不动。

column1: Gigantamax Toxtricity's main weapon is the excessive energy it generates while Gigantamaxed. It can create more electricity than a thundercloud. It can also store up to one million liters of poison.
column2: 超极巨化的颤弦蝾螈以极巨化时产生的庞大能量作为主要武器。它产生的电力比雷云更多，还能储存多达一百万升毒液。

column1: It almost never moves; even when in battle it only slightly lifts its body and attacks by flailing with its arms and legs.
column2: 它几乎不动。即使在战斗中，也只是稍微抬起身体，挥舞手脚攻击。

column1: Its firepower increases, resulting in its internal temperature exceeding 1800 F (1000 C) (11768 U). The heat waves coming off of Centiskorch are hot enough to burn opponents and disturb the air currents to the point of causing storms to form.
column2: 火力增强后，焚焰蚣的体内温度超过１８００华氏度（１０００摄氏度、１１７６８游戏温度单位）。它散发的热浪能灼伤对手，还会扰乱气流，甚至引发风暴。

column1: Poltchageist was born from the regrets of an old tea master, who was so obsessed with perfecting the art of the tea ceremony that he drove away everyone around him.
column2: 斯魔茶诞生于一位老茶师的悔恨。这位茶师过分执着于完善茶道，最终把身边的人全都赶走了。

column1: The Celestica Flute is a small hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. Its timbre is eerie and mysterious.
column2: 神阖之笛是一种小型手持管乐器。演奏者从开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的孔来改变音高。音色诡异而神秘。

column1: The Eon Flute is a medium hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body.
column2: 无限之笛是一种中型手持管乐器。演奏者从开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的孔来改变音高。

column1: The Primal form of Kyogre. Primal Kyogre is similar to Kyogre, but it grows to more than twice its usual size.
column2: 盖欧卡原始回归后的形态。盖欧卡（原始回归的样子）与平常外形相似，体形却增大到平常的两倍以上。

column1: The cells in its body are exceptionally durable, even among Steel-type Pokemon and it is resistant to earthquakes thanks to its body structure.
column2: 它体内的细胞格外坚固，即使在钢属性宝可梦中也很突出；身体结构还让它能够抵御地震。

column1: The left pincer of Gigantamax Kingler can destroy anything it hits. The bubbles it releases are strongly alkaline. Should any opponent be struck by the bubbles, their bodies will quickly melt away.
column2: 超极巨化的巨钳蟹的左钳能摧毁击中的一切。它释放的泡沫呈强碱性，击中对手后，会迅速溶解对方的身体。

column1: The result of three Magnemite being linked together by a strong magnetic force. When sunspots flare up, Magneton tends to appear more often, presumably due to the changes in the suns magnetic field.
column2: 由三只小磁怪通过强磁力连接形成的宝可梦。太阳黑子活跃时，三合一磁怪会更加频繁地出现，可能是因为太阳磁场发生了变化。

column1: This is Necrozma's form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.
column2: 这是奈克洛兹玛吞噬索尔迦雷欧光芒时的形态。它扑向敌人，用四肢和背部的爪子将其撕裂。

column1: Two Binacle have multiplied into seven, giving Barbaracle two legs, four arms and one head. Each limb thinks for itself and moves independently, though they usually follow the head's orders.
column2: 两只龟脚脚增殖为七只，构成龟足巨铠的两条腿、四条臂和一个头。每条肢体独立思考、独立行动，但通常会服从头的指令。

column1: When in Gigantamax form, it creates a powerful drill with its leg hair. This drill can create large holes in the terrain. Thanks to its increased strength, Gigantamax Grimmsnarl can jump over the world's tallest building.
column2: 超极巨化时，它用腿部的毛发形成强力钻头，能在地面钻出巨大的洞。力量增强后的超极巨化长毛巨魔，甚至能跃过世界上最高的建筑。

column1: a flammable gas that it can shoot from its two huge arms. This is mostly used to propel itself in flight and for battle, but it is thought to have sufficient power and lift to even fly into space.
column2: 它能从两条巨大的手臂喷出可燃气体，主要用于推进飞行和战斗。据说，气体提供的动力与升力足以让它飞入太空。

column1: A bipedial legendary Pokemon. It has been referred to as the "King of Bountiful Harvests" due to its role in bringing lush vegetation and harvests yearly. Calyrex's right hand can cause the land to be covered in verdant grass and blooms. The left hand of Calyrex allows it to make the fields of fruit become ripen and heavy.
column2: 双足传说的宝可梦。蕾冠王每年带来繁茂的植被和丰收，因此被称为“丰饶之王”。它的右手能让大地长满青草鲜花，左手能让田地的果实成熟，结出累累硕果。

column1: A cetacean Pokemon resembling a dolphin. Palafin is known as the "Pelagic Protector". When it hears its allies calling for help, Palafin will change its appearance from its Zero Form to its Hero Form.
column2: 海豚状鲸类宝可梦。海豚侠被称为“远洋守护者”。听到伙伴求救时，它会从平凡形态变成全能形态。

column1: A coral-like Pokemon with an ectoplasmic "body". This ectoplasm was a result of a long and continuous process absorbing spirit energy from other creatures. Anyone who touches it will rapidly stiffen.
