column1: A dainty bipedal Pokemon that is small in stature. Togetic can sense the kindness in other people and Pokemon's hearts. Whenever it spots a pure-hearted person, it tends to go to that person and shower them with happiness and glowing down called "joy dust".
column2: 娇小纤细的双足宝可梦。波克基古能感受到人和宝可梦心中的善意。遇到心地纯洁的人时，它会靠近对方，洒下幸福与被称为“欢乐粉尘”的发光绒羽。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon resembling a skeletal, legless bat. Known as the "beast that calls the moon," Lunala has long been honored as an emissary of the moon. This Pokemon constantly absorbs light to convert into energy.
column2: 形似无腿骷髅蝙蝠的大型传说的宝可梦。露奈雅拉被称为“邀引月亮之兽”，长久以来被尊为月亮的使者。它不断吸收光线，将其转化为能量。

column1: A large legendary Pokemon resembling a white lion. Known as the "beast that devours the sun," Solgaleo has long been honored as an emissary of the sun. Its body is capable of holding a vast amount of energy and glows when active.
column2: 白狮状大型传说的宝可梦。索尔迦雷欧被称为“吞食太阳之兽”，长久以来被尊为太阳的使者。它的身体能容纳大量能量，活动时会发光。

column1: A large Pokemon resembling a bell. It can summon rain clouds, which earned it the nickname "bringer of plentiful harvests".
column2: 钟状大型宝可梦。它能召唤雨云，因此被称为“丰收的使者”。

column1: A large spherical Pokemon. Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
column2: 大型球状宝可梦。长枪般的尖刺和凶猛的性情使它获得“海中恶魔”的称号。它会吸食毒物来补充营养。

column1: A large, skeletal, canine Pokemon. Houndstone spends much of its time buried below the ground, particularly in graveyards, with only its "tombstone" visible. Houndstone is considered the most loyal of all dog Pokemon.
column2: 大型犬状骷髅宝可梦。墓扬犬经常埋在地下，尤其喜欢墓地，只露出头上的“墓碑”。它被认为是所有犬类宝可梦中最忠诚的一种。

column1: A lean, quadruped legendary Pokemon with feline features. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
column2: 具有猫科特征的纤瘦四足传说的宝可梦。土地云能帮助作物生长，因此被视为“农田守护者”。它的尾巴能为土壤补充养分。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Diancie. Because of its noble beauty, Mega Diancie is commonly referred to as "the Royal Pink Princess".
column2: 蒂安希超级进化后的形态。因其高贵的美貌，超级蒂安希常被称为“尊贵的粉红公主”。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Salamence. As a result of its Mega Evolution, Salamence becomes even more brutal than ever before, to the point where it is liable to turn against the Trainer who raised it. Because of this, Mega Salamence is feared as "the blood-soaked crescent".
column2: 暴飞龙超级进化后的形态。超级进化让它变得更加凶暴，甚至可能袭击养育自己的训练家。人们畏惧它，称它为“染血的新月”。

column1: A Mega Evolution of Slowbro.  Mega Slowbro's energy has gathered into Shellder, which has increased its hardness. This allows it to act as an armor so hard that nothing can scratch it.
column2: 呆壳兽超级进化后的形态。超级呆壳兽的能量集中在大舌贝体内，使其变得更加坚硬，如同无法被划伤的铠甲。

column1: A muscular, humanoid legendary Pokemon which resembles a genie. Landorus is considered the "Guardian of the Fields", due to helping crops grow. Its tail causes the soil to gain nutrition.
column2: 形似精灵的强壮人形传说的宝可梦。土地云能帮助作物生长，因此被视为“农田守护者”。它的尾巴能为土壤补充养分。

column1: A Pokemon composed of seven symbiotic partners known as "syrpents" living within an apple made of red syrup. The syrpents that form Hydrapple have inconstant temperaments. On the rare occasion that the syrpents' moods align, Hydrapple reaches its full potential.
column2: 由七条共生的“蜜蛇”组成的宝可梦，生活在红色糖浆构成的苹果中。组成蜜集大蛇的蜜蛇脾气各异，只有在难得心意一致时，才能发挥全部力量。

column1: A Pokemon said to be created when a lonely spirit possesses a cold, leftover cup of tea. The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware.
column2: 据说由孤独的灵魂附身在一杯冷掉的剩茶中形成的宝可梦。它寄居的茶杯是一件著名的古董餐具。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a box jellyfish. Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. It is also able to control Pokemon it touches with its tentacles.
column2: 箱形水母状宝可梦。玛瑙水母吸收阳光，用体内的水折射光线，将其转化为光束能量。它还能够控制被触手接触的宝可梦。

column1: A Pokemon that resembles a slouched, bipedal wolf or werewolf. Lycanroc's Midnight Form is thrilled by battling, and becomes more excited the stronger its opponent. Now you will know why you fear the night.
column2: 形似弓背的双足狼或狼人的宝可梦。黑夜的样子鬃岩狼人热衷战斗，对手越强就越兴奋。现在你会明白为什么夜晚令人恐惧。

column1: A quadruped, chimeric Pokemon with traits from a variety of animals. Type Null was created to be an anti-UB Fighting life-form. Codenamed "Beast Killer", Type Null was given cells taken from all known Pokemon types with the intention of giving it the ability to shift between types by holding a corresponding Memory.
column2: 融合多种动物特征的四足宝可梦。属性：空是为对抗究极异兽而创造的战斗生命体，代号“异兽杀手”。它被赋予所有已知宝可梦属性的细胞，以便通过携带对应存储碟来改变属性。

column1: A quadruped, mammalian Pokemon. Its feelers send a soothing aura to calm fights, and will also use them to "hold hands" with its Trainer.
column2: 四足哺乳类宝可梦。它的触角会释放安抚气场，平息争斗，也会用触角和训练家“牵手”。

column1: A quadrupedal, amphibious Pokemon. On top of Clodsire's back are six light purple circular spots. If Clodsire is attacked, it will retaliate by sticking out large, thick, light purple spines from these spots — a dangerous and risky move.
column2: 四足两栖宝可梦。土王背上有六个淡紫色圆斑。遭到攻击时，它会从这些圆斑中伸出粗大的淡紫色尖刺反击，这是一种危险且冒险的举动。

column1: A rock-like, quadruped Pokemon. It compresses energy in the core inside its body that is enough to blow away mountains. It can also store sunlight in its orange crystals and shoot powerful energy from its mouth.
column2: 岩石状四足宝可梦。体内核心中压缩的能量足以炸飞山岳。它还能用橙色结晶储存阳光，从口中释放强大的能量。

column1: A shadow-like mythical Pokemon. Darkrai is known to "inhabit" dreams and causes the target to have unending nightmares, which can be stopped if exposed to a Lunar Wing from Cresselia.
column2: 暗影状幻之宝可梦。达克莱伊会“寄居”在梦中，让目标陷入无尽的噩梦。克雷色利亚的月亮之羽能够终止这些噩梦。

column1: A short, humanoid Pokemon. It creates its own hammer using iron scraps, remaking it as many times as it wants until it is satisfied. Tinkatink uses the hammer to protect itself.
column2: 矮小的人形宝可梦。小锻匠用铁屑制作自己的锤子，会反复重做，直到满意为止，并用锤子保护自己。

column1: A slightly insectoid, bipedal dragon Pokemon. With its wings, it kicks up sandstorms to hide itself. Its wings make a "singing" sound when they are flapped, earning Flygon the name "The Desert Spirit".
column2: 略带昆虫特征的双足龙类宝可梦。沙漠蜻蜓用翅膀掀起沙暴来隐藏自己。扇动翅膀时会发出“歌声”，因此被称为“沙漠精灵”。

column1: A small amphibious, quadruped Pokemon.  By using the fin on its head, Mudkip is able to detect changes in air and water currents as well as bodies of water.
column2: 小型四足两栖宝可梦。水跃鱼用头上的鳍感知空气和水流的变化，也能探测水域。

column1: A small fish Pokemon with an ellipsoid body. Because of its wing-like fins, it is known as "The Beautifly of the Sea".
column2: 身体呈椭圆形的小型鱼类宝可梦。因其鱼鳍形似翅膀，被称为“海中的狩猎凤蝶”。

column1: A small insectoid Pokemon that resembles three pieces hexagonal honeycomb stuck together. When it is not gathering honey, it sleeps or protects its queen. The former is done by creating a hive along with other Combee, locking together into a "wall" to feel safe in larger numbers.
column2: 形似三个六边形蜂巢粘在一起的小型昆虫宝可梦。不采蜜时，它会睡觉或保护蜂后。睡觉时会和其他三蜜蜂拼成蜂巢，组成一堵“墙”，靠群体带来安全感。

column1: A small mythical Pokemon resembling a piece of mochi. It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
column2: 形似一块糯米团的小型幻之宝可梦。桃歹郎会让其他生物吃下能激发欲望和能力的毒糯米团。吃下糯米团的人会受它控制，被束缚于它的意志。

column1: A small, bearlike legendary Pokemon. Kubfu works hard to train both body and mind, even if it suffers defeat. It has a unique organ that allows it to create "fighting energy" through special deep breathing and intense focusing.
column2: 小型熊状传说的宝可梦。熊徒弟即使战败也会努力锻炼身心。它拥有独特的器官，可以通过特殊的深呼吸和高度专注制造“格斗能量”。

column1: A small, bipedal Pokemon. Cubone will often weep at night in mourning of its mother. When Cubone cries, the skull that it wears on its head vibrates and emits "a plaintive and mournful sound."
column2: 小型双足宝可梦。卡拉卡拉常在夜里为亡母哭泣。哭泣时，头上戴着的头骨会振动，发出“哀怨而悲伤的声音”。

column1: A very tall Ultra Beast that resembles a vaguely humanoid mass of electrical wiring. It is speculated to sustain itself with electricity. This is supported by observations that it will "plug" its limbs and tail into the ground when it is low on energy, entering a treelike state to absorb electricity from the earth.
column2: 极高的究极异兽，形似略具人形的一团电线。据推测，它依靠电力生存。能量不足时，它会将四肢和尾巴“插入”地面，变成树状，从大地吸取电力。

column1: An avian Pokemon resembling a flamingo. Flocks of Flamigo are known to attack together in perfect harmony, via a behavior known as "synchronizing".
column2: 火烈鸟状鸟类宝可梦。缠红鹤群会通过被称为“同步”的行为，默契一致地共同攻击。

column1: An avian Pokemon with plumage resembling a person dressed in formal attire. With a mere cry, It can summon and organize flocks of Murkrow in this manner, and is known as the "summoner of the night" by the pitch black darkness that often accompany such a spectacle.
column2: 羽毛形似正装的鸟类宝可梦。它只需一声鸣叫便能召集并指挥成群的黑暗鸦。这样的景象常伴随漆黑的夜幕，因此它被称为“黑夜的召唤者”。

column1: An avian Pokemon. This Pokemon uses its wings to catch updrafts and soar across the sky. It gracefully glides through the clouds, often while singing or humming in a soprano voice.
column2: 鸟类宝可梦。它用翅膀借助上升气流翱翔天空，优雅地滑翔于云间，时常用女高音歌唱或哼鸣。

column1: Gigantamax Single Strike Style Urshifu has been called "the very embodiment of rage" and "a divine emissary that banishes evil spirits with its fury."
column2: 超极巨化一击流武道熊师被称为“愤怒的化身”，也是“凭借怒火驱逐邪灵的神圣使者”。

column1: The Chilan Berry whistle is a small hand-held wind instrument made from a Chilan Berry that is cored out and dried.  The musician blows through the hole.  The instrument has an indescribable sound.
column2: 灯浆果哨是用掏空并晾干的灯浆果制成的小型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向孔中吹气，会发出难以形容的声音。

column1: The glass flute is a small hand-held wind instrument made from glass.  The musician blows through the opening.  The instrument has various effects depending on the color.
column2: 玻璃笛是用玻璃制成的小型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，根据笛子的颜色产生不同效果。

column1: The Sun Flute is a medium hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. \tIt is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokemon of the sun.
column2: 太阳之笛是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，并通过按住笛身上的孔来选择音高。据说它的笛声是献给太阳的传说宝可梦的谢礼。

column1: # Bundled PMD, TCG and MissingNo authored descriptions and preferences.
(Beta) Adds Pokemon Mystery Dungeon related content.
column2: 测试版：添加宝可梦不可思议迷宫相关内容。

column1: (Beta) Adds Pokemon Trading Card Game related content.
column2: 测试版：添加宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏相关内容。

column1: (Beta) ENABLE ONE! Entities in Dwarvemon use all Pokemon available.
column2: 测试版：只能启用一个族群扩展！矮人宝可梦中的各族群可以使用所有可用的宝可梦。

column1: (Beta) ENABLE ONE! Entities in Dwarvemon use certain types of Pokemon available.
column2: 测试版：只能启用一个族群扩展！矮人宝可梦中的各族群使用特定属性的宝可梦。

column1: A blob-like creature. They will consume any Pokemon they encounter and are capable of shapeshifting into any Pokemon.
column2: 一种黏团状生物。它们会吞食遇见的任何宝可梦，并能变成任意宝可梦的模样。

column1: A canine, quadruped Pokemon. Manectric gathers electricity its mane and then discharges it. This process creates thunderclouds, which it uses in battle. Since lightning falls in its vicinity, it is said to have been born from lightning and make its nest where lightning has struck.
column2: 四足犬形宝可梦。雷电兽将电力聚集在鬃毛中，然后释放出来，产生可用于战斗的雷云。由于附近常有雷电落下，据说它诞生于雷电，并在落雷处筑巢。

column1: A giant ice creature resembling a snowflake. Bittercold is constructed from the negative emotions of Pokemon, any Pokemon that get close to the Bittercold are suffocated by its negative power; however, a human may not be affected by this power.
column2: 形似雪花的巨型冰之生物。冰冷巨结晶由宝可梦的负面情绪形成，靠近它的宝可梦都会被其负面力量压得无法呼吸；人类却可能不受这种力量影响。

column1: A large Pokemon with a roughly humanoid build. Melmetal was known in ancient times to be worshipped for the ability to create metal. Due to the state of its liquid metal body, the arms are very flexible, capable of delivering power punches.
column2: 体型庞大、近似人形的宝可梦。美录梅塔在古代因创造金属的能力而受到崇拜。液态金属的身体令它的手臂十分灵活，能使出威力惊人的拳击。

column1: A large, humanoid Ultra Beast with a bodily construction that closely resembles that of a bamboo shoot. Its most distinctive feature is the energy that it stores within itself: a flammable gas that it can shoot from its two huge arms. This is mostly used to propel itself in flight and for battle, but it is thought to have sufficient power and lift to even fly into space.
column2: 体型庞大的人形究极异兽，身体结构极似竹笋。铁火辉夜最显著的特点是体内储存的能量：它能从两条巨大的手臂中喷出可燃气体，通常用于飞行推进和战斗，据说其动力和升力甚至足以飞入太空。

column1: A medium-sized creature dedicated to the ruthless protection of nature.
column2: 一种中等体型的生物，为了保护自然不惜采取严酷手段。

column1: A medium-sized creature prone to great ambition.
column2: 一种中等体型的生物，往往胸怀远大抱负。

column1: A medium-sized humanoid driven to cruelty by its evil nature.
column2: 一种中等体型的人形生物，邪恶的天性驱使其残忍行事。

column1: A mouse-like rodent Pokemon. The pair that forms Tandemaus sticks together no matter what. They exhibit great teamwork: they share any food they find equally within the pair, and they build their nest together using materials they've gathered with their incisors.
column2: 鼠形啮齿类宝可梦。组成一对的一对鼠始终形影不离，配合默契：找到食物便平分，用门牙收集材料并共同筑巢。

column1: A rolling platform for carrying cargo.
column2: 用于运载货物的带轮平台。

column1: A rolling platform for carrying passengers or cargo.
column2: 用于搭载乘客或运载货物的带轮平台。

column1: A short, sturdy creature fond of drink and industry.
column2: 一种矮小健壮的生物，喜爱饮酒与劳作。

column1: A small, squat humanoid with large pointy ears and yellow glowing eyes.
column2: 一种矮小敦实的人形生物，有硕大的尖耳朵和发出黄色光芒的眼睛。

column1: A spherical Pokemon, resembling a Honduran White Bat. Woobat's nose serves various purposes: It uses ultrasonic waves from its nostrils for echolocation, and it can also be used to grip walls as Woobat sleeps, which leaves heart-shaped marks on the walls of caves.
column2: 球形宝可梦，形似洪都拉斯白蝙蝠。滚滚蝙蝠的鼻子有多种用途：它通过鼻孔发出超声波进行回声定位，睡觉时还用鼻子贴住墙壁，在洞窟墙面留下心形印记。

column1: A toy that looks like a Snorlax.
column2: 外形酷似卡比兽的玩偶。

column1: An amphibious Pokemon that resembles an upright, armless axolotl. Paldean Wooper employs two adaptations to allow it to survive on land: its gills have hardened, and it coats its body with a poisonous film that keeps it from drying out.
column2: 两栖宝可梦，形似直立且没有前肢的美西螈。帕底亚乌波的鳃已硬化，还会用有毒的薄膜包裹身体，防止干燥，以此适应陆地生活。

column1: An entity born out of the negative feelings of all the Pokemon in the world. By absorbing a Pokemon's life energy, it has the ability to turn them to stone. It is also able to possess Pokemon that have even the smallest amount of darkness in their hearts.
column2: 由世界上所有宝可梦的负面情绪诞生的存在。暗黑物质会吸取宝可梦的生命能量，使其化为石头；只要心中有一丝黑暗，也会被它附身。

column1: An equine legendary Pokemon resembling a qilin or centaur. Arceus does not suffer fools gladly, and it will attack in a violent rampage if betrayed or deceived.
column2: 马形传说宝可梦，形似麒麟或半人马。阿尔宙斯无法容忍愚弄，受到背叛或欺骗时会暴怒并猛烈攻击。

column1: The Aqua-Monica is a small hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows over the openings. The musician selects the pitch by blowing into certain openings. It plays melodies serene as flowing water, rumored to steal watery hearts.
column2: 水之口琴是小型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者朝开孔吹气，通过选择不同的孔来控制音高。其旋律如流水般宁静，据说能俘获水属性宝可梦的心。

column1: The Fiery Drum is a mid-size hand-held percussion instrument. The musician strikes the head. It beats out rhythms that burn with fiery passion, rumored to steal fiery hearts.
column2: 火之鼓是中型手持打击乐器。演奏者敲击鼓面，奏出炽热而充满激情的节奏，据说能俘获火属性宝可梦的心。

column1: The Glass Trumpet is a medium hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows into the mouthpiece. The musician selects the pitch by pressing valves on the body.
column2: 玻璃小号是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向吹口吹气，通过按下管身上的活塞控制音高。

column1: The Grass Cornet is a mid-size hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows into the opening. It is well suited for tunes that carry across grassy fields, rumored to steal hearts of grass.
column2: 草之短号是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，其曲调很适合传遍草地，据说能俘获草属性宝可梦的心。

column1: The Icy Flute is a mid-size hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows through the opening. The musician selects the pitch by stopping holes along the body. It plays notes that are clear as ice, rumored to steal even the iciest of hearts.
column2: 冰之笛是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，通过按住笛身上的孔来控制音高。其音色如冰般清澈，据说连最冰冷的心也会为之倾倒。

column1: The Rock Horn is a mid-size hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows into the opening. It blasts sound at rock-shattering volume, rumored to steal the rockiest of hearts.
column2: 岩之号角是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，发出足以震碎岩石的巨响，据说能俘获最坚如磐石的心。

column1: The Sky Melodica is a mid-size hand-held wind instrument. The musician blows into the opening. The musician selects the pitch by pressing the keys.It plays tunes airy as cloudless skies, rumored to steal flighty hearts.
column2: 天空口风琴是中型手持吹奏乐器。演奏者向开口吹气，通过按键控制音高。其曲调轻盈得如同晴朗的天空，据说能俘获向往飞翔的心。

column1: The Terra Cymbal is a mid-size hand-held percussion instrument. The musician strikes the cymbals together. It creates a colossal crash that shakes the ground, rumored to steal even the most grounded hearts.
